papers.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Current electroencephalography (EEG)-based dream detection relies on power spectral density (PSD) and statistical moment features, achieving a state-of-the-art area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of approximately 0.70 on the DREAM database (Wong et al., 2025, Nature Communications). We introduce PHINN-EEG (Persistent Homology Inspired Neural Network for EEG), the first topological time-series framework for dream mentation analysis. Using sliding-window Takens delay embeddings and Vietoris-Rips filtrations on multichannel pre-awakening EEG epochs, we extract Dynamic Betti Curves that characterize the geometric architecture of neural activity, not merely its energy. These topological invariants, combined with topology-conditioned flow matching, are analytically projected to outperform existing PSD and catch22 benchmarks, targeting AUC = 0.82-0.90 on the 1,462-awakening open-access subset of the DREAM database (drawn from a full registry of 3,191 total awakenings from 263 participants across 20 independent laboratories). We further introduce a topology-conditioned rectified flow model for dream-state EEG synthesis-with a spectral-conditioned flow model of comparable feature dimensionality as an additional ablation baseline to isolate the value of topological conditioning specifically-and propose a set of candidate Betti transition archetypes linking topology to phenomenological dream report categories, presented as an exploratory hypothesis space pending empirical validation. If validated, this work represents a paradigm shift from spectral energy to phase-space geometry in neural rare-event detection, with potential future implications for wearable BCI dream monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PHINN-EEG，首个用于梦境脑电图（EEG）分析的拓扑时间序列框架，利用滑动窗口Takens延迟嵌入和Vietoris-Rips滤波提取动态Betti曲线，以刻画神经活动的几何结构。该方法在DREAM数据库上目标AUC达到0.82-0.90，并引入拓扑条件流模型用于梦境状态EEG合成。
Motivation: 当前基于EEG的梦境检测依赖功率谱密度（PSD）和统计矩特征，AUC仅约0.70，亟需捕捉神经活动几何结构的新方法。
Method: 采用滑动窗口Takens延迟嵌入和Vietoris-Rips滤波提取动态Betti曲线，结合拓扑条件流匹配（topology-conditioned flow matching）进行EEG合成，并设置谱条件流模型作为消融基线。
Result: 在DREAM数据库的1,462个觉醒子集上，目标AUC为0.82-0.90，优于现有PSD和catch22基准。
Conclusion: 若经实证验证，该工作代表从频谱能量到相空间几何的范式转换，对可穿戴BCI梦境监测具有潜在意义。

papers.title: PanoWorld: Real-World Panoramic Generation
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we aim to address the challenge of long-range memory in panoramic world models by exploiting the rotation-equivariant property of omnidirectional representations, where rotation can be treated as an implicit geometric transformation.Building on this insight, we propose PanoWorld, which simplifies camera trajectories into translations via fixed headings for both current-action modeling and long-range memory through Dense Panoramic Ray-Conditioning (DPRC) and Geometry-aware Memory Augmentation (GMA).Then, a three-stage training pipeline is introduced to progressively optimize each component. To better evaluate physical consistency under large-scale spatial variations and diverse illumination conditions, where existing datasets are relatively stable, we construct World360, a large-scale dataset consisting of both real-world video clips collected via panoramic unmanned aerial vehicles and high-quality simulated clips generated by AirSim360.Extensive experiments on World360 demonstrate the effectiveness of PanoWorld, outperforming alternative methods by a large margin.Our models, training code, and dataset will be publicly available. More information can be found on our project page: https://lihaoy-ux.github.io/panoworld-page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全景世界模型中的长程记忆问题，利用全景表示的旋转等变性，提出PanoWorld。该方法通过密集全景射线条件（DPRC）和几何感知记忆增强（GMA）将相机轨迹简化为固定航向的平移，并采用三阶段训练流水线逐步优化各组件。为评估大规模空间变化和多样光照条件下的物理一致性，作者构建了World360数据集（包含真实无人机全景视频和AirSim360模拟片段），实验表明PanoWorld大幅优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有全景世界模型难以处理长程记忆，而全景表示的旋转等变性未被充分利用。同时缺乏评估大规模空间变化和多样光照条件下物理一致性的数据集。
Method: 提出PanoWorld，利用旋转等变性将相机轨迹简化为固定航向的平移，通过密集全景射线条件（DPRC）和几何感知记忆增强（GMA）实现当前动作建模和长程记忆，并采用三阶段训练流水线。另构建World360数据集，包含真实无人机全景视频和AirSim360模拟片段。
Result: 在World360数据集上的实验表明，PanoWorld大幅优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的PanoWorld有效解决了全景世界模型的长程记忆问题，所构建的World360数据集可促进该领域的物理一致性评估。代码和数据集将公开。

papers.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: The rapid progress of large foundation models has been driven predominantly by pretraining on large-scale text corpora. However, many forms of knowledge are conveyed through visual representations, where figures, typeset equations, and page layouts carry rich information that cannot be faithfully or completely captured by text alone. Yet current pretraining approaches discard these visual cues by converting visually rich sources, such as documents and web pages, into plain text for learning language intelligence. This paper challenges the default assumption that language models must be trained on text-only representations and shows that Visual Pretraining is a scalable learner for foundation model intelligence. To this end, we conduct a systematic study of unsupervised visual pretraining paradigms that directly leverage visual documents without text extraction. Across multiple backbones and benchmarks, visual pretraining on the same underlying corpora consistently outperforms text-only pretraining, offering an efficient pathway to scalable language intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战语言模型必须使用纯文本预训练的假设，提出视觉预训练（Visual Pretraining）方法，直接在视觉文档（如图表、公式、页面布局）上进行无监督预训练，而不进行文本提取。在多个骨干网络和基准上，视觉预训练始终优于纯文本预训练。
Motivation: 当前大模型预训练仅使用纯文本，但许多知识以视觉形式呈现（如图表、排版公式等），无法被文本完全捕获。作者质疑纯文本预训练的默认假设。
Method: 系统研究无监督视觉预训练范式，直接利用视觉文档（不进行文本提取）进行预训练，并比较不同骨干网络。
Result: 在相同语料库上，视觉预训练在多个骨干网络和基准上一致优于纯文本预训练。
Conclusion: 视觉预训练是一种可扩展的语言智能学习器，为高效扩展语言智能提供途径。

papers.title: OpenLongTail: Generative Scaling of Long-Tail Driving Data
papers.abstract_en: Scaling robust driving policies is fundamentally bottlenecked by the scarcity of edge cases in curated datasets. While the real world continuously captures these critical events, such long-tail events remain underutilized when collected from heterogeneous sources. Specifically, diverse but valuable in-the-wild long-tail videos lack the full view coverage required for training policy models, often missing multi-view poses or originating solely from monocular dash cameras. This modality gap prevents these ubiquitous observations from being converted into scalable training data for long-tail generalization. We introduce OpenLongTail, an open-source generative data engine for scaling autonomous driving policies under long-tail events. To transform heterogeneous data sources into view-aligned and temporally coherent multi-view assets that are useful for policy learning, we develop a pose-informed extrapolative view synthesis pipeline that generates the missing views. We further enhance cross-view consistency and the temporal alignment for the newly generated views by injecting Plücker ray geometry into the scalable generation engine. By synthesizing heterogeneous long-tail data, we observe a significant improvement in closed-loop driving robustness in handling long-tail events. By measuring the extrapolative view synthesis and pose metrics, we validate the effectiveness of OpenLongTail in visual fidelity, cross-view consistency, and ego-trajectory recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenLongTail，一个开源生成式数据引擎，用于将异构长尾驾驶数据（如单目行车记录仪视频）转换为多视角、时序一致的训练数据，以提升自动驾驶策略在长尾事件中的鲁棒性。通过 pose-informed 外推视图合成管道和 Plücker 射线几何约束，该方法生成了缺失视角并增强了跨视角一致性。实验表明，在闭环驾驶中处理长尾事件的鲁棒性显著提升，并验证了视觉保真度和姿态恢复效果。
Motivation: 真实世界中不断收集到的长尾驾驶事件数据虽丰富但视角不完整（如缺少多视角或仅来自单目摄像头），导致这些异构数据无法有效用于训练自动驾驶策略，限制了模型在长尾场景下的泛化能力。
Method: 提出 OpenLongLongTail，包含一个基于姿态信息的外推视图合成管道，用于生成缺失视角；并引入 Plücker 射线几何注入到生成引擎中，以增强新生成视图的跨视角一致性和时序对齐。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在闭环驾驶中处理长尾事件的鲁棒性显著提升，并通过外推视图合成和姿态指标验证了视觉保真度、跨视角一致性和自我轨迹恢复的有效性。
Conclusion: OpenLongTail 作为一个开源生成式数据引擎，能够将异构的长尾视频数据转化为有用的训练资源，为自动驾驶策略的长尾泛化提供可扩展的数据扩展方案。

papers.title: Evolution of Accuracy and Visual-Cognitive Errors in a Decade of Vision-Language AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision language models (VLMs) have made remarkable progress in visual reasoning during the last decade. Most evaluations have used simple scenes (MS-COCO) that do not showcase complex human interactions or behaviors, only a handful of non-curated human descriptions as a benchmark, and have not focused on understanding the model's error types. Here, we introduce the Complex Social Behavior (CSB) dataset, containing 100 images depicting complex social interactions/behaviors. We analyze the progression of scene descriptions over a decade (2017-2025) of VLMs (four pre-Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs, and five MLLMs). We evaluate the accuracy of the models and 20 human descriptions relative to a gold standard on the CSB dataset and on a sample from MS-COCO. We analyzed five visual-cognitive error types: object detection, recognition, hallucination, scene understanding, and spatial dependence. The CSB dataset showed a more pronounced improvement than MS-COCO in scene description accuracy, with pre-MLLMs achieving much lower accuracy than the bottom-ranked human descriptions and MLLMs attaining accuracies similar to the top-ranked human descriptions. We show that MLLMs have eliminated the gap in scene description accuracy between simpler MS-COCO scenes and scenes depicting complex behaviors (CSB). MLLMs have almost eliminated all error types in our tested datasets, except for occasionally relying on different image regions for scene descriptions than humans do (spatial dependence error). We also show that detection, recognition, and hallucination errors have the highest impact on scene description accuracy. Together, our findings provide a more thorough evaluation of how visual language models have advanced over the last decade.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过引入复杂社会行为（CSB）数据集，评估了2017-2025年间视觉语言模型（VLM）在场景描述准确性上的进展，并分析了五种视觉认知错误类型。研究发现，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）几乎消除了所有错误类型，但偶尔仍存在空间依赖错误，且错误类型中检测、识别和幻觉对准确性影响最大。
Motivation: 现有评估大多使用简单场景（如MS-COCO）和少量非精选描述，缺乏对复杂人类交互行为的测试，且未深入分析模型错误类型。
Method: 构建包含100张复杂社会交互图像的CSB数据集，比较四个预MLLM和五个MLLM的描述准确性，并分析检测、识别、幻觉、场景理解和空间依赖五种错误类型。
Result: CSB数据集上的准确性提升比MS-COCO更显著；预MLLM准确性远低于人类，而MLLM达到人类顶级水平；MLLMs几乎消除所有错误类型，但空间依赖错误仍存在。
Conclusion: MLLMs已消除简单与复杂场景间的准确性差距，但空间依赖错误仍需关注；检测、识别和幻觉错误对准确性影响最大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VEXAIoT: Autonomous IoT Vulnerability EXploitation using AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Internet of Things (IoT) systems are inherently vulnerable due to constrained hardware, outdated firmware, and insecure default configurations, creating a need for scalable and adaptive security testing approaches. While recent adoptions of Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated promise in penetration testing and Capture-the-Flag (CTF) environments, their application to IoT specific vulnerabilities remains unexplored. This paper presents an autonomous multi-agent framework, referred to as Vulnerability EXploitation using AI Agents (VEXAIoT), for vulnerability discovery and exploitation in IoT environments using LLM-based reasoning and offensive security tools. The framework combines a vulnerability detection agent and an attack execution agent to perform reconnaissance, plan attack sequences, and execute exploits against vulnerable IoT services. The system is evaluated in IoTGoat and Metasploitable environments across ten attack scenarios mapped to OWASP IoT vulnerabilities. Experimental results show attack success rate of up to 100% with low token overhead and average execution times under two minutes for most attacks. Across 260 attack executions, VEXAIoT achieves a 95.0% overall success rate, including 94.5% success in IoTGoat and 96.7% success in Metasploitable2. These results demonstrate the potential for LLM-driven agents to automate IoT vulnerability assessment and offensive security workflows in controlled environments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VEXAIoT，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体框架，用于自动发现和利用物联网（IoT）环境中的漏洞。该框架结合了漏洞检测智能体和攻击执行智能体，执行侦察、规划攻击序列并实施利用。在IoTGoat和Metasploitable环境中的10个攻击场景下评估，平均攻击成功率高达95.0%，平均执行时间低于2分钟。
Motivation: IoT系统由于硬件受限、固件过时和不安全默认配置而固有脆弱，需要可扩展和自适应的安全测试方法。现有LLM智能体在渗透测试和CTF环境中展现了潜力，但尚未应用于IoT特定漏洞。
Method: 提出一个自主多智能体框架VEXAIoT，包含漏洞检测智能体和攻击执行智能体，利用LLM推理和攻击性安全工具进行侦察、攻击规划与执行。在IoTGoat和Metasploitable环境中针对10个OWASP IoT漏洞场景评估。
Result: 在260次攻击中，总体成功率达95.0%，其中IoTGoat上94.5%，Metasploitable2上96.7%。多数攻击的token开销低，平均执行时间低于2分钟。

papers.title: Revisiting Euler-Angle Regression with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: In many real-world systems, including articulated robots and biomechanical models, rotations are defined in joint space and naturally parameterized by Euler angles with bounded ranges. Yet regressing Euler angles remains challenging, as their discontinuities and singularities often destabilize training. In this work, we revisit Euler-angle regression and show that its effectiveness depends critically on the interaction between rotation representation, regression architecture, and domain constraints. We introduce a new framework that combines range-aware Euler modeling with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), which replace fixed node-wise activations with learnable univariate functions on edges. We further provide theoretical analysis indicating that bounded Euler ranges motivate a near-additive structure in the regression function, which favors the additive functional form of KAN, and we confirm this trend empirically. Extensive experiments on controlled rotation regression, object pose estimation, and robotic and human inverse kinematics demonstrate consistent improvements in accuracy, convergence, and efficiency. The code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视欧拉角回归问题，提出结合区间感知欧拉建模与KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks）的框架，利用KAN可学习单变量函数的优势处理欧拉角的边界约束和奇异性。实验在旋转回归、物体姿态估计、机器人/人体逆运动学任务上验证了精度、收敛速度和效率的提升。
Motivation: 欧拉角回归常因表示中的不连续性和奇异性导致训练不稳定，而现有方法未充分结合旋转表示、回归架构和领域约束。
Method: 提出区间感知欧拉建模与KAN的组合框架，理论分析表明有界欧拉范围促使回归函数近似可加结构，与KAN的加性函数形式契合。
Result: 在受控旋转回归、物体姿态估计、机器人及人体逆运动学等任务上，该方法在精度、收敛速度和效率上均取得一致改进。
Conclusion: 欧拉角回归的有效性依赖于旋转表示、架构和领域约束的相互作用，KAN的加性结构对处理有界欧拉角范围具有优势。

papers.title: ConceptSMILE: Auditing the Trustworthiness of Concept-Based Explainable AI
papers.abstract_en: Concept-based explainable artificial intelligence (AI) can make model reasoning more human-understandable, but concept-level outputs are not automatically trustworthy. We introduce ConceptSMILE, a model-agnostic perturbation-based auditing framework for evaluating the reliability of concept-based explanations. Rather than replacing SMILE, ConceptSMILE extends its perturbation-based logic from feature- or region-level attribution to the auditing of human-understandable concept explanations. The framework perturbs input regions, measures concept-response shifts, applies locality weighting, and fits an XGBoost surrogate to approximate local concept behaviour. Reliability is assessed through attribution accuracy, surrogate fidelity, faithfulness, stability, and consistency. We evaluate ConceptSMILE on retinal fundus images by comparing MedSAM-derived visual concepts with VLM-based semantic concepts. Results show that reliability varies across concepts and pathways: MedSAM achieves stronger spatial attribution and the highest surrogate fidelity ($R^2 = 0.8503$, $R_w^2 = 0.8465$), while the VLM pathway shows stronger vessel faithfulness and stronger stability under selected artefact conditions. ConceptSMILE provides an independent audit layer for evaluating the trustworthiness of concept-based XAI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConceptSMILE 是一个模型无关的基于扰动的审计框架，用于评估概念可解释 AI 的可靠性。它通过扰动输入区域、测量概念响应变化、应用局部加权并拟合 XGBoost 代理来近似局部概念行为，并从归因准确性、代理忠实度、忠实性、稳定性和一致性四个维度评估可靠性。在视网膜眼底图像上，MedSAM 的空间归因更强且代理忠实度最高（R²=0.8503），而 VLM 在血管忠实性和特定伪影下的稳定性更优。ConceptSMILE 为概念可解释 AI 提供了独立的审计层。
Motivation: 概念级可解释 AI 的输出并不自动可信，需要评估其可靠性，但缺乏通用的审计框架。
Method: 提出 ConceptSMILE 框架，扩展 SMILE 的基于扰动的逻辑，从特征或区域级归因审计到人类可理解的概念解释。通过扰动输入区域、测量概念响应变化、应用局部加权，并拟合 XGBoost 代理来近似局部概念行为。
Result: 在视网膜眼底图像上，MedSAM 代理忠实度最高（R²=0.8503, R_w²=0.8465），VLM 在血管忠实性和特定伪影下的稳定性更强。不同概念和路径的可靠性存在差异。
Conclusion: ConceptSMILE 提供了一种独立评估概念可解释 AI 可靠性的方法，揭示了概念解释的可信度因概念和路径而异。

papers.title: Deep Gaussian Processes on Directed Acyclic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world processes can be represented as compositions of functions along a directed acyclic graph (DAG). In causal modelling, these correspond to the underlying mechanisms; in engineering, to multiple fidelity levels; and in gene-regulatory networks, to transcription factors. These functions are partially observed across the DAG, with noisy and heterogeneously sampled measurements, posing significant challenges for reconstruction, uncertainty propagation, and inference. To tackle these challenges, we place priors over functions and naturally arrive at Deep Gaussian Processes over DAGs. We theoretically study their prior-collapse behaviour, and the effect of graph topology and intermediate observations on the preservation of information. We obtain almost-sure lower bounds on the asymptotic frequency of depths at which the distinction between inputs is preserved, identify broad kernel classes for which these hold, and prove an observation by \cite{dunlop2018} on the role of input connections. We offer a structured variational approximation that retains graph dependencies, preserves compositional uncertainty, and captures the explaining-away behaviour of colliders. Finally, we empirically validate our theoretical results and our methodology, and model a latent-collider DAG, a protein signalling network, and a multi-fidelity heavy-ion collision emulation task, attaining state-of-the-art performance while recovering low-fidelity contributions and yielding interpretability of the simulator hierarchy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在有向无环图（DAG）上定义深度高斯过程（Deep Gaussian Processes），以建模沿DAG组合的函数过程。理论分析了先验坍缩行为、图拓扑和中间观测对信息保持的影响，得到输入区分度渐近频率的几乎必然下界。提出保持图依赖和组合不确定性的结构化变分近似。在潜在碰撞DAG、蛋白质信号网络和多保真重离子碰撞仿真任务上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 许多现实过程（如因果机制、多保真工程、基因调控网络）可表示为沿DAG的函数组合，但函数仅部分观测且存在噪声和异质采样，重建和不确定性传播困难。
Method: 在DAG上放置函数先验，得到深度高斯过程；理论分析先验坍缩和拓扑影响；提出结构化变分近似保留图依赖和组合不确定性。
Result: 理论上证明了输入区分度渐近频率的几乎必然下界，并确认了输入连接的作用。实验中在潜在碰撞DAG、蛋白质信号网络和多保真重离子碰撞仿真上取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效建模DAG上的函数组合，保留下游不确定性，并具有解释性，但未提及与降水/天气预报的直接关联。

papers.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Financial anomaly detection suffers from extreme class imbalance, causing traditional single-objective algorithms to exhibit ``fraud collapse'', defaulting to the majority class and failing to balance anomaly interdiction with customer friction. To overcome this without distortive data resampling, we propose the Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework. Our approach synthesizes heterogeneous transaction features into cohesive natural-language narratives, encoded by large language models, thereby producing a robust, scale-invariant state representation. The agent optimizes a vectorial reward that explicitly decouples financial efficacy, operational friction, and semantic discovery. By mapping the continuous Pareto frontier, the system dynamically navigates the asymmetric costs of missed anomalies versus false positives. Empirical evaluations across E-Commerce fraud and UCI Credit datasets show that semantic Pareto-DQN successfully shatters the zero-recall trap. It achieves superior minority-class recall compared to scalarized baselines, providing an alternative to trade bounded operational friction for financial anomaly discovery.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义Pareto-DQN，一种用于金融异常检测的多目标强化学习框架。该方法将异构交易特征合成自然语言叙事，通过大语言模型编码为鲁棒的状态表示，并优化包含金融效率、操作摩擦和语义发现的向量奖励。在电商欺诈和UCI信用数据集上，该方法打破了零召回陷阱，优于标量化基线。
Motivation: 金融异常检测面临极端类别不平衡，传统单目标算法易出现'欺诈崩溃'，无法平衡异常拦截与客户摩擦。现有方法需使用数据重采样，但本文旨在避免其带来的扭曲。
Method: 提出语义Pareto-DQN，多目标强化学习框架。使用大语言模型将异构交易特征合成自然语言叙事作为状态表示，优化向量奖励（金融收益、操作摩擦、语义发现），并通过映射连续帕累托前沿动态权衡漏报与误报的成本。
Result: 在电商欺诈和UCI信用数据集上，语义Pareto-DQN成功打破零召回陷阱，在少数类召回率上优于标量化基线，以可承受的操作摩擦换取了更高的异常检测能力。
Conclusion: 该方法为金融异常检测提供了一种无需数据重采样的多目标强化学习方案，能够在不牺牲操作成本的前提下提升异常发现效果。

papers.title: Lean-QIT: Towards a Formal Infrastructure for Quantum Information Theory
papers.abstract_en: Quantum information theory (QIT) characterizes the capabilities and fundamental limits of quantum information processing, underpinning quantum communication, computation, and error correction. Formalizing its coding theorems requires connecting finite-block protocols, analytic inequalities, and asymptotic limits within a unified machine-checked framework. Existing developments, however, lack a reusable operational layer that defines codes, error criteria, achievable rates, and capacities independently of their information-theoretic characterizations. In this work, we present LeanQIT, a Lean 4 library for finite-dimensional QIT. It provides composable, kernel-checked interfaces for quantum states and channels, source and channel codes, finite-block performance criteria, hypothesis testing, one-shot quantities, and asymptotic rate constructions. Using this infrastructure, we formalize Schumacher's quantum source-coding theorem, the Holevo--Schumacher--Westmoreland classical-capacity theorem, and the entanglement-assisted classical-capacity theorem together with its strong converse. By separating operational definitions from analytic characterizations and exposing reusable achievability, converse, and asymptotic components, Lean-QIT provides a machine-readable foundation for formal QIT and a compositional knowledge substrate for emerging AI-assisted formalization, automated proof search, and agentic reasoning in quantum information and computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了Lean-QIT，一个基于Lean 4的有限维量子信息理论形式化库，提供可组合的接口用于量子态、信道、编码、渐近率等，并形式化了Schumacher量子信源编码定理、Holevo-Schumacher-Westmoreland经典容量定理和纠缠辅助经典容量定理及其强逆。
Motivation: 量子信息理论的编码定理形式化需要统一的机器验证框架，但现有工作缺乏可复用的操作层来定义码、错误准则、可达速率和容量。
Method: Lean-QIT库，提供可组合的、内核验证的接口，包括量子态和信道、源和信道码、有限块性能准则、假设检验、一次性量子和渐近率构造，并分离操作定义与分析刻画。
Result: 成功形式化了Schumacher量子信源编码定理、Holevo-Schumacher-Westmoreland经典容量定理和纠缠辅助经典容量定理及其强逆。
Conclusion: Lean-QIT为形式化量子信息理论提供了机器可读的基础，并支持AI辅助形式化、自动化证明搜索和智能推理。

papers.title: The Effects of Synthetic Data and Label Distribution on Canola Branch Counting
papers.abstract_en: Collecting annotated plant images for automated phenotyping is often slow and expensive. Plant models simulating growth and development can generate unlimited synthetic images with exact labels. However, previous work has established that whether incorporating synthetic data improves performance depends on the ratio of synthetic to real images and the label distribution of the synthetic dataset. To systematically quantify both factors, we train ResNet-18 models on a canola branch-counting task using a calibrated L-system plant model. We vary each factor independently. Synthetic-to-real ratios of 1:5 to 1:22 broadly improve performance; the best ratio (1:7) reduces mean absolute difference by 7.6% over real-only training. For label distribution, a uniform synthetic distribution is strongly suboptimal (abs. diff. of approximately 1.70); interpolating 90% toward the real distribution yields abs. diff. 0.927, whereas Gaussian smoothing of the real label distribution yields the best overall result (abs. diff. 0.912, a 14.7% improvement over real-only). A minimum of 10 synthetic images per label offers a simpler alternative with modest gains, while 100 per label over-corrects and hurts performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了合成数据比例和标签分布对油菜分枝计数任务的影响。使用校准的L-system植物模型生成合成图像，训练ResNet-18模型。结果表明，合成与真实图像比在1:5至1:22时性能提升，最佳比1:7使平均绝对差降低7.6%；标签分布上，均匀分布效果差，高斯平滑真实分布效果最佳（绝对差0.912，相对仅真实数据提升14.7%）。
Motivation: 自动化植物表型中收集标注图像成本高，合成数据可无限生成，但合成数据的使用效果取决于其与真实图像的比例和标签分布，需要系统量化这两个因素。
Method: 使用校准的L-system植物模型生成合成图像，对ResNet-18模型进行训练，独立变化合成与真实图像比例（1:5至1:22）和合成数据标签分布（均匀、插值、高斯平滑、每标签最少样本数）。
Result: 合成与真实图像比例1:7时平均绝对差降低7.6%；标签分布上，高斯平滑真实分布取得最佳绝对差0.912，相比仅真实数据提升14.7%。每标签最少10张合成图像有适度提升，但100张则过度校正导致性能下降。
Conclusion: 合成数据在油菜分枝计数任务中有效，但需合理选择比例和标签分布；高斯平滑真实分布优于均匀或插值分布。

papers.title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
papers.abstract_en: Reliable autonomous driving requires full-scene perception that couples foreground objects with dense semantic layout. Recently, 4D millimeter-wave radar has emerged as a robust and affordable sensor, yet its sparse returns make radar-camera fusion necessary for comprehensive scene understanding. Existing radar-camera methods mainly optimize detection, while dual-task systems usually decode boxes and occupancy with limited interaction. To address this gap and advance radar-based multi-task learning, we propose \method, a 4D radar-camera framework for 360$^\circ$ full-scene perception, which models semantic occupancy as a persistent scene state rather than a terminal output. \method{} follows a cross-modal state reasoning paradigm, where the occupancy state is modeled and propagated through stages for coarse-to-fine feature aggregation. Specifically, State-guided BEV Enhancement (SBE) strengthens intra-frame BEV representation, while Doppler-guided Temporal Fusion (DTF) preserves state evidence over longer temporal horizons. Beyond the model, we further extend ManTruckScenes with satellite-map-based generated occupancy labels and pair it with OmniHD-Scenes in a unified cross-dataset detection-and-occupancy protocol. The resulting experiments cover accuracy, robustness, ablation, and efficiency under one radar-camera multi-task evaluation framework. Code and labels will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出4DR360，一种基于4D毫米波雷达和相机的360度全场景感知框架，联合进行3D检测和语义占用预测。该方法将语义占用建模为持续的场景状态，通过跨模态状态推理实现从粗到细的特征聚合，包括状态引导的BEV增强和多普勒引导的时间融合。此外，扩展了ManTruckScenes数据集，并建立了跨数据集的检测与占用统一评估协议。
Motivation: 现有雷达-相机方法主要优化检测，而双任务系统中检测和占用解码交互有限，缺乏对雷达稀疏性的有效处理，难以实现全面的全场景感知。
Method: 提出跨模态状态推理范式，将语义占用作为持续场景状态进行建模和传播。具体包括状态引导的BEV增强（SBE）以加强帧内BEV表示，以及多普勒引导的时间融合（DTF）以保留较长时域的状态证据。
Result: 实验覆盖了精度、鲁棒性、消融和效率，在一个雷达-相机多任务评估框架下进行评估，展示了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 将语义占用建模为持续状态并跨阶段传播，能够有效提升雷达-相机全场景感知的联合检测与占用预测性能。

papers.title: Task-Specific Multimodal Question Answering Agents via Confidence Calibration and Incremental Reasoning for QANTA 2026
papers.abstract_en: We present our submission to the QANTA 2026 shared challenge at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Efficient Multimodal Question Answering (EMM-QA). Quanta evaluates multimodal quizbowl systems that answer pyramid-style questions from incrementally revealed text and accompanying images while operating under realistic efficiency constraints. The challenge consists of two distinct tasks: Tossup questions, which require deciding when to answer under uncertainty, and Bonus questions, which emphasize accurate answer selection and human adoption. To address these differing objectives, we develop a task-specific two-agent architecture. Our Tossup agent utilizes a GPT-4o-mini-class model (referred to as GPT-4.1-mini in the competition logs) with confidence-calibrated answering and a domain-specific numeric reasoning policy that reduces overconfident predictions from isolated quantitative clues. Our Bonus agent uses GPT-4o-class model (referred to as GPT-4.1) with leadin-aware reasoning, structured relational reasoning, and multimodal evidence integration to improve exact answer selection. Rather than relying on a retrieval pipeline or model ensembles, our approach emphasizes efficient reasoning policies and confidence calibration within a hosted-only environment. Our system achieved the highest overall leaderboard score of 0.402, including a Tossup score of 0.238 and a Bonus Effect score of 0.164. The results demonstrate that lightweight, task-specific reasoning strategies can provide strong performance on resource-constrained multimodal question answering benchmarks.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the EMM-QA 2026 Workshop, ICML 2026 (Non-Archival). Rank #1 overall system in the QANTA 2026 Challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了QANTA 2026挑战赛中的第一名系统，采用任务特定的双智能体架构，分别处理Tossup和Bonus问题。Tossup智能体使用GPT-4o-mini模型结合置信度校准和领域特定数值推理，Bonus智能体使用GPT-4o模型进行前导感知推理和结构化关系推理。系统在资源受限环境下取得了最高总分0.402。
Motivation: 多模态问答系统需要在资源受限环境下高效推理，现有方法往往依赖检索流水线或模型集成，而本文探索轻量级任务特定推理策略和置信度校准。
Method: 提出双智能体架构：Tossup智能体采用GPT-4o-mini (GPT-4.1-mini) 模型，结合置信度校准和领域特定数值推理策略以减少过度自信；Bonus智能体使用GPT-4o (GPT-4.1) 模型，采用前导感知推理、结构化关系推理和多模态证据整合。

papers.title: LLM for EDA in Front-End Design: Challenges and Opportunities
papers.abstract_en: As chip complexity increases and time-to-market pressures grow, front-end design has become a critical bottleneck in chip development. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great potential in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). Beyond specification understanding, LLMs show the potential to serve as a unified intelligent interface for hardware description language (HDL) generation, testbench construction, and design space exploration. The rise of agentic AI, represented by pioneering systems such as OpenClaw, offers a strategic roadmap for the next generation EDA. From this perspective, this paper discusses the evolution of EDA from localized assistance to autonomous agentic execution. Then, we review representative advances of LLMs in front-end design, focusing on key tasks such as circuit and testbench generation from a shared specification, as well as design quality improvement in established workflows such as high-level synthesis. Finally, we discuss the key challenges and limitations of integrating LLMs into EDA, and outline future opportunities for advancing LLM-enabled front-end design, offering a systematic perspective for researchers interested in leveraging agentic AI technologies for EDA.

papers.title: Dynamic Frechet Regression with Feature Selection for Distributional Data
papers.abstract_en: Many scientific and engineering applications generate responses that are not scalars or vectors, but statistical objects whose form evolves over an ordered index such as time, depth. Probability distributions are a prominent example, capturing variability and uncertainty that cannot be summarized by low-dimensional statistics. When such responses are observed sequentially, the resulting dynamic distributional trajectories pose significant challenges for regression, particularly in relating scalar predictors to both within-index variability and cross-index evolution. We propose Dynamic Fréchet Regression (DFR), a framework for modeling index-dependent trajectories of distribution-valued responses. DFR extends Global Fréchet Regression by introducing an index-aware weighting mechanism. At each index, predictions are defined as weighted Fréchet means in a metric space of distributions (e.g., Wasserstein space), preserving the intrinsic geometry of the response. The weights depend jointly on predictor similarity and index proximity, enabling index-specific prediction while borrowing strength across neighboring indices. To improve interpretability in high-dimensional settings, DFR incorporates a geometry-aware feature selection approach based on sparse metric learning, which identifies predictors driving distributional dynamics without relying on Euclidean coefficients. Simulation studies show improved predictive accuracy and feature recovery over existing methods. An application to additive manufacturing data demonstrates its ability to produce interpretable, index-specific distributional predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态Fréchet回归（DFR）框架，用于建模随时间或深度等索引变化的分布值响应轨迹。DFR扩展了全局Fréchet回归，引入索引感知权重，在每个索引处定义加权Fréchet均值，同时利用预测变量相似性和索引邻近性。该框架还包含基于稀疏度量学习的几何感知特征选择方法，以识别驱动分布动态的关键预测变量。模拟实验表明，DFR在预测精度和特征恢复方面优于现有方法；增材制造数据案例验证了其生成可解释、索引特定分布预测的能力。
Motivation: 许多科学和工程应用中的响应并非标量或向量，而是随索引演变的统计对象（如概率分布），传统回归方法难以同时刻画索引内变异和跨索引演化。
Method: 提出动态Fréchet回归（DFR），在分布度量空间（如Wasserstein空间）中，通过索引感知权重定义加权Fréchet均值作为预测值；权重同时依赖于预测变量相似性和索引邻近性。为提升高维可解释性，引入基于稀疏度量学习的几何感知特征选择。
Result: 模拟实验显示DFR在预测精度和特征恢复上均优于现有方法；增材制造数据应用表明其能产生解释性强的索引特定分布预测。
Conclusion: DFR为动态分布数据回归提供了有效框架，兼顾几何结构保持、索引适应性及特征可解释性。

papers.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents requires effective orchestration of diverse expert models and tools. However, existing frameworks typically call APIs based on coarse-grained matching between tasks and the functions of expert models or tools, while overlooking critical factors such as performance variability and cost efficiency among functionally similar alternatives. To address this, we propose Agora, a framework that introduces an incentive-compatible auction mechanism for dynamically allocating tasks to expert models and tools. By treating reasoning steps as tradeable items, Agora enables agents to bid based on their rectified competence-ensuring that critical logic is routed to the most capable solver rather than the most overconfident one. Evaluations across five benchmarks show that Agora improves over matched single-model, routing, and cascade baselines under comparable candidate pools, while exposing a controllable cost-quality trade-off through a single auction parameter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agora 框架，通过激励兼容的拍卖机制动态分配任务给专家模型和工具，以增强 LLM 智能体的推理能力。在五个基准上，Agora 改善了匹配的单模型、路由和级联基线，并通过单一拍卖参数控制成本-质量权衡。
Motivation: 现有框架通常基于任务与专家模型或工具功能的粗粒度匹配来调用 API，忽略了性能变异性和成本效率等关键因素，导致推理能力受限。
Method: 引入激励兼容的拍卖机制，将推理步骤视为可交易物品，智能体根据修正后的能力出价，确保关键逻辑路由到最有能力而非最自信的求解器。
Result: 在五个基准上，Agora 在可比候选池下优于匹配的单模型、路由和级联基线，并通过单一拍卖参数暴露可控的成本-质量权衡。
Conclusion: 拍卖机制能有效提升 LLM 智能体的推理能力，同时提供灵活的成本-质量控制。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有框架通常基于任务与专家模型或工具功能的粗粒度匹配来调用 API，忽略了性能变异性和成本效率等关键因素，导致推理能力受限。
summary_sections.method: 引入激励兼容的拍卖机制，将推理步骤视为可交易物品，智能体根据修正后的能力出价，确保关键逻辑路由到最有能力而非最自信的求解器。

summary_sections.conclusion: 拍卖机制能有效提升 LLM 智能体的推理能力，同时提供灵活的成本-质量控制。

papers.title: Characterization of the basin of convexity for multi-snapshot spike deconvolution via variable projection
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of multi-snapshot spike deconvolution, where the goal is to recover the locations of sparse impulses from their noisy convolution with a known point spread function (PSF) across multiple snapshots. We adopt a variable-projection formulation that eliminates the amplitudes in closed form, reducing the task to a nonconvex least-squares problem over the spike locations alone, which we refer to as the variable-projection formulation of spike deconvolution (VarProSD). We provide an explicit characterization of the basin of convexity of the VarProSD objective in terms of key PSF properties, including its power spectral density and smoothness, revealing how sampling bandwidth and spike separation influence the local geometry. Within this basin, we establish that the estimator is consistent in the number of snapshots under stochastic noise, and provide a complementary, sharper error bound under adversarial noise via the local Lipschitz property of the inverse map. We further show local convergence guarantees for gradient descent when initialized within the basin. A central ingredient throughout is the use of Beurling--Selberg extremal approximations, which enable sharp, PSF-agnostic bounds on the conditioning of the structured matrices arising in the optimization landscape. Numerical experiments validate our theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of modified ESPRIT initialization followed by gradient-based refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多快照脉冲去卷积问题，目标是从多个快照中恢复稀疏脉冲的位置。作者采用变量投影（variable projection）公式，消除幅度参数，将问题简化为关于位置的非凸最小二乘（VarProSD）。通过表征凸性盆地（basin of convexity），揭示了采样带宽和脉冲分离对局部几何的影响，并给出了在随机噪声下估计量的一致性以及在对抗噪声下的误差界。此外，证明了在盆地内初始化时梯度下降的收敛性，数值实验验证了理论结果和修改的ESPRIT初始化加梯度下降精化的有效性。
Motivation: 多快照脉冲去卷积在成像、通信等领域有重要应用，但位置估计的非凸性使得优化困难。现有方法缺乏对目标函数局部几何的定量刻画，无法保证优化收敛。
Method: 提出变量投影公式（VarProSD），将幅度闭式消除；利用Beurling-Selberg极值近似推导PSF条件数界；刻画凸性盆地条件；结合修改的ESPRIT初始化进行梯度下降优化。
Result: 理论上给出了凸性盆地的显式特征、随机噪声下一致性、对抗噪声下局部Lipschitz误差界以及梯度下降的局部收敛保证；数值实验验证了理论，并展示了初始化后梯度下降的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文为多快照脉冲去卷积的变量投影公式提供了严格的凸性盆地刻画，并建立了优化收敛和统计一致性保证，依赖于Beurling-Selberg近似得到与PSF无关的界。数值实验支持理论发现。

papers.title: PAC-ACT: Post-training Actor-Critic for Action Chunking Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Precision industrial contact manipulation requires reliable robot policies under pose perturbations and contact-force constraints. Vision-language-action models offer broad generalization but often introduce high inference latency and GPU-memory cost, while vision-action chunking policies are more suitable for real-time industrial control. However, these policies are usually trained by behavior cloning and suffer from distribution shift in contact-rich tasks. This paper proposes PAC-ACT, a reinforcement-learning post-training framework for pretrained Action Chunking Transformer policies. PAC-ACT reformulates policy optimization at the chunk level, constructs an ACT-transferred actor-critic architecture, and introduces a hybrid behavior-prior constraint to preserve the pretrained action distribution during online fine-tuning. Experiments on industrial precision-contact benchmarks show that PAC-ACT improves task success, contact stability, and force safety while retaining low latency and low GPU-memory usage. On the Contour task, PAC-ACT significantly reduces peak contact force and decreases the proportion of force readings above 60 N by 46 times. Sparse-reward ablations further show that the proposed behavior-prior constraint enables effective exploration under randomized initial poses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PAC-ACT，一种针对预训练动作块Transformer策略的后训练强化学习框架，旨在改善工业精密接触操作中的分布偏移问题。该方法在块级别重新定义策略优化，构建ACT迁移的Actor-Critic架构，并引入混合行为先验约束以保持预训练动作分布。实验表明，PAC-ACT在工业精密接触基准上提升了任务成功率、接触稳定性和力安全性，同时保持低延迟和低GPU内存占用。
Motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作模型虽然泛化能力强，但推理延迟和GPU内存成本高；而视觉-动作块策略更适合实时工业控制，但通常通过行为克隆训练，在接触密集任务中面临分布偏移问题。
Method: 提出PAC-ACT后训练框架，包括：在块级别重新定义策略优化，构建ACT迁移的Actor-Critic架构，以及引入混合行为先验约束以在在线微调中保留预训练动作分布。
Result: 在工业精密接触基准上，PAC-ACT提升了任务成功率、接触稳定性和力安全性。在Contour任务中，峰值接触力显著降低，力读数超过60N的比例减少46倍。稀疏奖励消融实验表明行为先验约束能在随机初始姿态下实现有效探索。
Conclusion: PAC-ACT通过强化学习后训练有效提升了预训练动作块策略在接触密集任务中的性能，且不牺牲实时性。

papers.title: TrustX Agent Risk Classification Framework (ARC): Risk-Tiering Internally Created Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of agentic AI systems across enterprise and public-sector contexts has outpaced the capacity of general-purpose AI risk frameworks to classify and govern them. In this paper, we introduce the TrustX Agent Risk Classification Framework, a structured, repeatable instrument that can be applied to seven types of agentic AI systems and is grounded in foundational pre-existing AI governance frameworks. At the core of the framework is a twelve-dimension scoring rubric that robustly quantifies the risk. This rubric is combined with other components, such as the GPA + IAT classification model and the five-level autonomy framework derived from existing literature. These inputs produce a three-tier governance output with mapped control recommendations. A specialised Coding Assistant extension is also included to account for nuances specific to this type of agentic AI system. We then use an illustrative example to show our framework in practice. ARC is intended for AI governance practitioners, risk officers, developers, and regulators, and it will regularly undergo iteration as we continue to expand it and make it more robust. The community can access the interactive framework here: https://arc.responsible.ai/
papers.comment: This is a working paper on our risk classification tool, with iterations currently underway
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 TrustX Agent Risk Classification Framework (ARC) 的结构化工具，用于对七种代理型AI系统进行风险分级。该框架基于现有的AI治理框架，包含一个十二维评分准则、GPA+IAT分类模型和五级自主性框架，输出三级治理输出并附有控制建议。还包含一个编程助手扩展。
Motivation: 代理型AI系统在企业及公共部门的快速发展超出了通用AI风险框架的分类和治理能力，亟需专门的结构化工具。
Method: 构建一个基于十二维评分准则的框架，结合GPA+IAT分类模型和五级自主性框架，对七种代理型AI系统进行风险量化，并给出三级治理建议。此外，针对编程助手类系统提供了专用扩展。
Result: 通过一个示例展示了框架的实际应用，但摘要未报告量化结果。
Conclusion: 该框架面向AI治理从业者、风险官、开发者和监管机构，并将持续迭代。

papers.title: Promptable Concept Segmentation from Above: Evaluating SAM 3's Zero-Shot and One-Shot Capabilities in Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of large-scale foundation models, such as the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3), promises a transition toward open-vocabulary, training-free computer vision. However, their capacity to generalize out-of-distribution to the complex, top-down geometric structures of Earth Observation imagery remains largely unquantified. Driven by SAM 3's performance disparities in highly specialized domains, we present a comprehensive, multi-task empirical evaluation across remote sensing scene classification, object detection, and instance segmentation under strict zero-shot and one-shot constraints. To achieve this, we introduce a structural adaptation of SAM 3 by repurposing its decoupled binary presence head into a standalone zero-shot classifier. Furthermore, by systematically isolating textual and visual prompt modalities across five configurations, we explicitly diagnose the alignment mechanics within the model's multimodal decoder. Our findings reveal severe cross-modal interference: while visual prompts successfully align the decoder to complex remote sensing geometry, textual prompts inject misaligned, ground-level semantic bias, actively degrading coordinate regression. To benchmark these capabilities without resource-intensive training, we formulate a novel training-free proxy evaluation protocol for Generalized Zero-Shot tasks (scene classification and instance segmentation). Ultimately, our results demonstrate that SAM 3 avoids the overfitting commonly seen in legacy domain-adapted models, achieving high Harmonic Mean scores in segmentation tasks. However, it remains fundamentally constrained by sub-pixel resolution limits and overhead semantic blind spots, charting a definitive mandate for parameter-efficient geospatial fine-tuning of its multimodal decoder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) 在遥感图像中的零样本和单样本能力，包括场景分类、目标检测和实例分割任务。通过改造SAM 3的解耦二元存在头为零样本分类器，并系统隔离文本和视觉提示模态，揭示了严重的跨模态干扰：视觉提示能对齐复杂遥感几何，而文本提示引入地面语义偏差导致坐标回归退化。提出无需训练的代用评估协议，结果显示SAM 3避免了过拟合，在分割任务中取得高调和平均分，但受限于亚像素分辨率和语义盲点，需参数高效微调。
Motivation: 大型基础模型（如SAM 3）在开放词汇、无需训练的计算机视觉中具有潜力，但其在遥感这一分布外领域的泛化能力尚未被量化。本文旨在系统评估SAM 3在遥感中的零样本和单样本性能。
Method: 改造SAM 3的解耦二元存在头为零样本分类器；设计五种配置隔离文本和视觉提示模态，诊断多模态解码器对齐机制；提出无需训练的代理评估协议用于广义零样本任务（场景分类和实例分割）。
Result: SAM 3避免了领域自适应模型的过拟合，在分割任务中取得高调和平均分，但受限于亚像素分辨率和头顶语义盲点。文本提示引入地面语义偏差，主动恶化坐标回归。
Conclusion: SAM 3在遥感任务中表现良好但存在根本限制，需要对其多模态解码器进行参数高效的地理空间微调。

papers.title: Entropy-Constrained Machine Learning with Residual Data Augmentation for Modeling Chemical Kinetics
papers.abstract_en: We present a physics-constrained machine learning framework for accelerating the direct numerical simulation (DNS) of turbulent reacting flows. The model replaces the direct evaluation of detailed chemical source terms with a surrogate that predicts reaction rates from a reduced thermochemical state. To improve physical consistency, the second law of thermodynamics is incorporated as a training constraint by enforcing non-negative entropy generation, which restricts the evolution of the thermochemical state to physically admissible directions and improves stability during time integration. The approach is demonstrated on DNS of a two-dimensional planar lean premixed methane-air flame interacting with a turbulent flow field. The model reproduces detailed-chemistry results with high fidelity while achieving more than an order-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost. Furthermore, a residual-based synthetic data augmentation strategy enables parametric exploration by constructing new training data from the original dataset, allowing accurate simulation at new inlet conditions without additional detailed-chemistry CFD runs. These results demonstrate that thermodynamically constrained machine learning can provide reliable and computationally efficient surrogates for detailed chemistry in high-fidelity combustion simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理约束的机器学习框架，用于加速湍流反应流的直接数值模拟（DNS）。该框架用替代模型预测化学源项，并将热力学第二定律作为训练约束，确保非负熵产生。方法在二维贫预混甲烷-空气火焰的DNS上验证，高保真复现详细化学结果，计算成本降低一个数量级以上，并通过残差数据增强实现新入口条件下的参数探索。
Motivation: 湍流反应流DNS中详细化学机制的计算成本极高，现有代理模型可能违反热力学第二定律，导致时间积分不稳定和物理不一致。
Method: 构建一个替代模型，直接从约化热化学状态预测反应速率；在损失函数中引入非负熵产生约束，限制热化学状态演化方向；并采用残差合成数据增强策略，从原始数据集生成新训练数据以探索不同入口条件。
Result: 在二维平面贫预混甲烷-空气火焰的DNS中，模型高保真复现详细化学结果，计算成本降低超过一个数量级，且通过数据增强可实现新入口条件的准确模拟。
Conclusion: 热力学约束的机器学习能够为高保真燃烧模拟提供可靠且计算高效的详细化学替代模型，其物理约束和数据增强策略可推广至其他反应流问题。

summary_sections.result: 在二维平面贫预混甲烷-空气火焰的DNS中，模型高保真复现详细化学结果，计算成本降低超过一个数量级，且通过数据增强可实现新入口条件的准确模拟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 热力学约束的机器学习能够为高保真燃烧模拟提供可靠且计算高效的详细化学替代模型，其物理约束和数据增强策略可推广至其他反应流问题。

papers.title: Wan-Dancer: A Hierarchical Framework for Minute-scale Coherent Music-to-Dance Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating long-duration, high-definition, and rhythmically synchronized dance videos directly from music remains a significant challenge, primarily due to the temporal constraints of current diffusion models, which typically fail beyond 20 seconds. Existing approaches, whether they rely on intermediate 3D skeletons or on end-to-end video synthesis, suffer from temporal drift, identity inconsistency, and repetitive motion patterns when extended to longer horizons. To address these limitations, we propose a novel hierarchical framework for minute-scale coherent music-to-dance generation. Our method decouples the process into global keyframe planning and local temporal refinement, leveraging full-track musical context to ensure long-range coherence. Key innovations include dynamic frame rate adaptation via time-mapped RoPE embeddings for precise alignment, an optical-flow-based loss function to enhance motion continuity, and motion-speed control to preserve high-fidelity details during rapid movements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework surpasses the conventional duration barrier, generating stable, 720p/30fps videos exceeding one minute with superior temporal stability. Furthermore, the model exhibits robust versatility across five distinct dance genres, conditioned on both audio and textual prompts, establishing a new state-of-the-art in coherent, long-form dance video synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Wan-Dancer，一种用于分钟级连贯音乐到舞蹈生成的分层框架。该方法将过程解耦为全局关键帧规划和局部时序细化，利用全曲音乐上下文确保长程连贯性。关键创新包括通过时间映射RoPE嵌入实现动态帧率适应以精确对齐、基于光流的损失函数增强运动连续性，以及运动速度控制以保留快速运动中的高保真细节。实验表明，该框架能生成超过一分钟的稳定720p/30fps视频，在五类舞种上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型受限于时间约束，通常无法生成超过20秒的长视频；而依赖3D骨架或端到端视频合成的方法在扩展到更长时间时会出现时间漂移、身份不一致和动作模式重复。
Method: 提出分层框架，包括全局关键帧规划（利用全曲音乐上下文）和局部时序细化；采用时间映射RoPE嵌入实现动态帧率适应，引入基于光流的损失函数增强运动连续性，并使用运动速度控制保留高保真细节。
Result: 生成超过一分钟的720p/30fps稳定舞蹈视频，在五类舞种上均展现出优越的时间稳定性，超越了传统时长限制。
Conclusion: 该框架建立了连贯长形式舞蹈视频合成的新标杆，兼具鲁棒性和多舞种适用性。

papers.title: Knowledge Graphs and Explainable AI as Complementary Resources for Urban Mining
papers.abstract_en: Pre-demolition assessment, the regulated audit process at the heart of urban mining, is an information process in which AI support must serve qualified auditors who remain accountable for the decisions taken. The relevant unit of value is not prediction accuracy alone, but the defensibility of the supported decisions: their legibility, plausibility, sourcing, and contestability. Explainable AI techniques and domain knowledge graphs each address parts of this requirement, and existing taxonomies have catalogued their integration. The literature is descriptively rich but structurally under-specified: what remains less developed is a structural account of why specific integrations produce artefacts neither resource can provide alone. This paper offers a complementarity-theoretic interpretation grounded in the IS resource-based tradition. We propose four consolidated KG-XAI integration modes (Lifting, Constraining, Typing, and Revising), each defined as a typed operation over XAI artefacts and knowledge-graph substrate structures. Each mode unlocks a distinct property of defensibility and contributes to the kind of regulatory artefact pre-demolition assessment demands. A fire-door example from the urban-mining process illustrates the modes using the W3C Linked Building Data stack and valuation extensions.

Result: 通过城市采矿中的防火门示例，使用W3C链接建筑数据栈和估值扩展说明这些模式。

papers.title: A censoring-aware target interface for tabular foundation models in survival prediction
papers.abstract_en: Time-to-event prediction from tabular patient data is central to prognosis and biomedical decision support, but right-censored follow-up prevents direct use of ordinary regression labels. Tabular foundation models offer reusable prediction machinery for modest heterogeneous datasets, yet they generally assume fully observed outcomes. We introduce SurvFM-RMST, a censoring-aware target-interface framework that converts survival outcomes into jackknife pseudo-observation targets for restricted mean survival time, enabling multiple tabular backbones to perform horizon-specific RMST regression without survival-specific fine-tuning. In controlled simulations with known conditional RMST, SurvFM-RMST recovered restricted event-free time accurately, and pseudo-RMST targets outperformed naive restricted observed-time and event-only targets. Across 36 eligible static SurvSet datasets, SurvFM backbones were competitive with established survival and RMST-regression comparators, though relative performance varied by endpoint, horizon and practical constraints. Predicted RMST further stratified held-out patients into groups with ordered observed event-free time and event enrichment. Overall, the results support pseudo-RMST target construction as a portable interface between censored survival data and tabular foundation-model prediction.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary Information included as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SurvFM-RMST，一种删失感知的目标接口框架，用于将生存分析中的右删失时间-事件数据转换为jackknife伪观察目标（受限平均生存时间），使表格基础模型（tabular foundation models）能够进行特定时间窗的RMST回归，无需生存分析特定的微调。在模拟和36个真实数据集上，该方法恢复了条件RMST，并优于简单基线，但相对性能因端点、时间窗和实际约束而异。
Motivation: 右删失数据阻止了传统的回归标签直接用于表格基础模型，而现有基础模型通常假设完全观察的结果。需要一种将删失生存数据转换为适用于通用预测模型的目标的方法。
Method: 将生存时间转化为jackknife伪观察目标（restricted mean survival time, RMST），使得多种表格基础模型能够直接用于时间-事件预测，无需针对生存分析的专用微调。
Result: 在已知条件RMST的模拟中准确恢复了受限事件自由时间；在36个SurvSet数据集上，SurvFM主干与已有的生存分析和RMST回归方法竞争力相当，但相对性能因任务而异；预测的RMST能将患者分层出有序的事件发生时间和事件富集。
Conclusion: 伪RMST目标构建是一种将删失生存数据与表格基础模型预测相结合的便携接口方法，但性能受具体问题设定影响。

papers.title: Conceptual Networks for Cross-Linguistic Idiomatic Expressions:A Feature-Based Graph Approach
papers.abstract_en: We present an interpretable network-based framework for representing idiomatic and figurative meaning across eight typologically diverse languages, totaling 160 conventional expressions, the large majority of which are idiomatic. Each expression is annotated with binary conceptual features (containment, concealment, emotional, social, etc.) derived from cognitive-linguistic theory, and pairwise Jaccard similarities define a weighted graph. Community detection reveals that idioms cluster by conceptual schema rather than by language, producing a structure consistent with cognitive-linguistic predictions. The conceptual network captures unique semantic information not present in distributional embeddings, can be scaled via automatic annotation with LLMs, improves downstream idiom detection, and remains robust when enriched with corpus frequencies. Cross-lingual transfer experiments show that conceptual proximity alone can identify acceptable translation equivalents across five language families, with substantial gains over embedding-based baselines. Ablation studies demonstrate that all three feature dimensions -- schemas, roles, and valence -- contribute non-redundantly to both the network's organizational properties and its performance on idiom detection, and that specific graph-derived signals (community membership, neighbor similarity) are particularly informative. The framework offers an interpretable, cross-linguistically stable representation of idiomatic meaning, combining theoretical grounding with practical utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的基于网络的框架，用于表示跨语言习语和比喻性含义。对8种语言共160个常规表达（大部分为习语）标注二元概念特征（包含、隐藏、情感、社交等），基于Jaccard相似度构建加权图。社区检测显示习语按概念图式而非语言聚类，结构符合认知语言学预测。该概念网络捕捉了分布嵌入中不存在的语义信息，可通过LLM自动标注扩展，改进下游习语检测，并在加入语料库频率后保持鲁棒性。跨语言迁移实验表明，仅凭概念邻近性即可识别跨五个语系的翻译等价物，显著优于基于嵌入的基线。消融实验表明所有三个特征维度（图式、角色、价）对网络组织性质和习语检测性能都有非冗余贡献，图导出信号（社区成员、邻居相似度）特别有信息量。该框架为习语含义提供了可解释、跨语言稳定的表示，融合了理论依据和实用价值。
Motivation: 现有习语表示方法缺乏跨语言一致性和可解释性，通常依赖分布嵌入，难以捕捉概念层面的相似性。论文旨在构建一个理论驱动、跨语言稳定的习语语义表示框架。
Method: 基于认知语言学理论，为8种语言共160个习语标注二元概念特征（包含、隐藏、情感、社交等），计算Jaccard相似度构建加权图，采用社区检测分析结构；结合LLM自动标注和语料库频率增强；通过图信号（社区成员、邻居相似度）进行下游任务。
Result: 社区检测显示习语按概念图式而非语言聚类；概念网络捕捉了分布嵌入中不存在的语义信息；跨语言迁移中仅凭概念邻近性即可识别翻译等价物，优于嵌入基线；消融实验证实三个特征维度均有非冗余贡献，图导出信号特别有效。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了可解释、跨语言稳定的习语含义表示，结合了认知语言学理论和实际应用价值，可扩展并改进下游任务。

papers.title: Large-Scale Portfolio Optimization Problem Under Cardinality Constraint With Enhanced Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making is posing an increasingly formidable challenge to investors because of the growing number of alternatives available in financial markets. A hot area of research over the past few decades has been portfolio optimization that seeks to determine how much an investor should invest in which asset. Introducing real-world conditions to the optimization model turns the problem into an NP-hard one for whose solution exact methods become inefficient; hence, researchers have turned to evolutionary algorithms to approximate solutions. In this paper, strengthening strategies are presented for multi-objective evolutionary algorithms that can provide a faster convergence rate and extensive search ability in the portfolio optimization problem under the cardinality constraint. To implement those features, a unique solution representation, a novel operator, and new repair mechanisms are introduced for solving the aforementioned problem in which lower and upper limits are set on the number of assets in the portfolio. For this purpose, new mating strategies along with the aforesaid package are implemented in well-known multi-objective evolutionary algorithms to solve the problem. The customized algorithms are subsequently tested against traditional ones using well-known market indices as benchmarks. Results indicate that the proposed strategy not only provides better approximations but also converges faster as well at no loss of performance with an increasing number of assets in the market.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基数约束下的投资组合优化问题（NP-hard），提出增强型多目标进化算法，通过新的解表示、算子和修复机制，实现了更快的收敛速度和更广的搜索能力。在多个市场指数基准上测试，表明所提策略在近似质量和收敛速度上优于传统算法，且随资产数量增加性能不降。
Motivation: 金融市场中资产数量增长使投资决策日益复杂，引入现实约束（如基数约束）使投资组合优化成为NP-hard问题，精确方法失效，而现有进化算法在收敛速度和搜索能力上仍有不足。
Method: 提出一组增强策略集成到多目标进化算法中，包括独特的解表示、新型算子、修复机制（设置资产数量的上下限）以及新的配对策略。
Result: 在知名市场指数基准上的实验表明，所提算法不仅提供更好的近似解，而且收敛更快，且随着市场资产数量增加性能不会下降。
Conclusion: 所提增强策略能有效改善多目标进化算法在基数约束投资组合优化问题中的性能，为处理大规模实际问题提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出一组增强策略集成到多目标进化算法中，包括独特的解表示、新型算子、修复机制（设置资产数量的上下限）以及新的配对策略。
summary_sections.result: 在知名市场指数基准上的实验表明，所提算法不仅提供更好的近似解，而且收敛更快，且随着市场资产数量增加性能不会下降。
summary_sections.conclusion: 所提增强策略能有效改善多目标进化算法在基数约束投资组合优化问题中的性能，为处理大规模实际问题提供了可行方案。

papers.title: TCLA: Training-Free Class-wise Logit Adaptation for Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot performance, yet their effectiveness still declines on out-of-distribution (OOD) data due to domain shifts and class bias inherited from large-scale pretraining. Existing few-shot adaptation methods typically introduce additional trainable components, which can be unstable in extremely low-data regimes (e.g., 1-shot), and lack robustness on different medical data. We present TCLA, a purely training-free few-shot adaptation method for Medical VLMs, which is fast and model-agnostic. TCLA corrects inference logits based on a small set of support samples, boosting pretrained VLMs performance by improving inter-class deconfusion and reducing domain shift. Extensive experiments on nine datasets across multiple medical imaging modalities including X-ray, Ultrasound, MRI, CT, Histopathology, demonstrate that TCLA consistently improves OOD performance of Medical VLMs and, in most of cases, outperforms existing training-based adaptation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TCLA，一种无需训练、模型无关的少样本适应方法，用于提升医学视觉语言模型在分布外（OOD）数据上的性能。TCLA 通过少量支撑样本校正推理 logits，减少类别混淆和域偏移，在 X 光、超声、MRI、CT、病理等九种医学影像数据集上一致优于现有基于训练的方法。
Motivation: 医学视觉语言模型在零样本场景下性能良好，但受域偏移和预训练类别偏差影响，在分布外数据上效果下降。现有少样本适应方法需要额外可训练组件，在极低样本（如1-shot）下不稳定且缺乏鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 TCLA，一种纯推理阶段、无需额外训练的 logits 校正方法。基于少量支撑样本，通过类级 logit 调整同时缓解类别间混淆和域偏移，不引入任何可训练参数且与模型架构无关。
Result: 在 X 光、超声、MRI、CT、病理等九种医学影像模态的数据集上，TCLA 持续提升医学 VLM 的 OOD 性能，并在多数情况下超越现有基于训练的方法。
Conclusion: TCLA 提供了一种高效、模型无关的少样本适应方案，适用于资源受限的医学场景；摘要未明确讨论局限性，但方法依赖少量支撑样本的质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Fixed Representations: The Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps in Open-Ended AI
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI systems are increasingly being evaluated for their ability to reason, code, prove theorems, use tools, and long-horizon research tasks. These are powerful capabilities, but they share a structural limitation: the representational frame within which the model operates, including its conceptual vocabulary, the space of admissible solutions it can search, and the criteria by which success is evaluated, is typically fixed and supplied in advance. This paper argues that building stronger intelligent systems capable of open-ended innovation requires additional classes of operations: the creation, stabilization, and reuse of new representational primitives, which alter the space being searched rather than simply searching within it. We characterize the distance between current AI systems and genuinely open-ended intelligence through two gaps. The first is the vocabulary gap, the difficulty of inventing and stabilizing new representational primitives rather than merely recombining existing ones. The second is the verifier gap, the difficulty of judging the value of a new primitive when its full payoff may be visible only after future reuse. We interpret both gaps through a unified framework of intelligence as cognitive discrepancy reduction. By viewing intelligent behaviors as a sequence of cognitive transformations, we distinguish intra-space transformations which operate within a fixed representational frame, from generative transformations which may modify the frame itself. On this basis, we propose a ladder of innovation autonomy and outline several directions for advancing open-ended AI, including objectives that reward useful representational change, persistent memory architectures for invented primitives, and adaptive verification mechanisms capable of evolving alongside the representations they evaluate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出当前AI系统受限于固定表征框架，无法实现真正的开放式创新。提出两个关键缺口：词汇缺口（创造新表征原语的能力）和验证器缺口（评估新原语长期价值的能力）。通过认知差异减小框架区分内部空间变换和生成式变换，并据此提出创新自主性阶梯。
Motivation: 现有AI在推理、编程等任务上能力强大，但表征框架固定，阻碍了开放式创新。论文旨在明确这一结构性限制并定义两个关键缺口以指导未来研究。
Method: 本文采用理论分析，提出词汇缺口和验证器缺口的概念，并引入认知差异减小框架来区分内部空间变换（在固定表征内操作）与生成式变换（修改表征本身）。在此基础上构建创新自主性阶梯并建议研究方向。
Result: 论文未提供实验验证或定量结果，属于理论框架阐述。
Conclusion: 强调构造开放式AI需要支持新表征原语的创造、稳定与重用，包括奖励有用表征变化的目标、持久记忆架构以及自适应验证机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-Dimensional Interpolators Can Be Fragile: Heavy Tails and High-Dimensional Large Deviations
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional interpolation is common in modern machine learning, but its tail risk is less understood than its expected prediction risk. Existing theory shows that interpolating models can perform well in expectation, yet such guarantees do not determine the probability of rare, severe errors. In operations research and stochastic decision-making applications, rare estimation errors can have disproportionate downstream effects, so tail behavior matters alongside average performance. We study the fragility of high-dimensional linear interpolators using large-deviation methods. We focus on ridgeless regression and compare it with ridge-regularized estimators. We first show that the risk of ridgeless regression can exhibit heavy-tailed behavior: although its expected risk may remain well controlled, its upper tail can decay much more slowly than that of regularized alternatives. We then quantify this phenomenon at the level of large-deviation rates. In the regime we study, ridge regularization suppresses fixed right-tail deviations at the $n^2$ scale, whereas ridgeless regression has only $n\log n$-scale decay, where $n$ is the sample size. This gap shows that interpolation can be statistically fragile even when it is accurate on average. Thus regularization affects the frequency of rare, high-impact risk events in addition to the usual bias-variance tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维线性插值器（ridgeless regression）的尾部风险，使用大偏差理论证明其风险分布具有重尾特性：虽然期望风险可控，但罕见严重误差的概率远大于正则化估计（ridge regression）。具体地，ridge正则化下右尾偏差以$n^2$速率衰减，而ridgeless回归仅以$n\log n$速率衰减（$n$为样本量），说明插值方法在平均性能良好的情况下仍可能统计脆弱。
Motivation: 现有理论多关注插值模型的期望预测风险，但罕见严重误差（尾风险）对运筹和随机决策应用影响更大，而尾行为尚缺乏系统理解。
Method: 采用大偏差（large-deviation）方法，对比高维无脊回归（ridgeless regression）与脊正则化估计（ridge-regularized estimators）的风险尾部衰减速率。
Result: Ridgeless回归的风险尾部以$n\log n$尺度衰减，而ridge正则化下右尾偏差以更快的$n^2$尺度衰减，表明插值器在统计上更脆弱。
Conclusion: 正则化不仅影响偏差-方差权衡，还影响罕见高风险事件的频率；插值即使平均准确也可能在尾部风险上不可靠。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Graph-Regularized Low-Rank Matrix Completion by Variable Projection
papers.abstract_en: We address the low-rank matrix completion problem by incorporating graph regularization into the existing Riemannian Trust-Region Matrix Completion (RTRMC) framework. The latter uses the geometry of the low-rank constraint to remodel the problem as an unconstrained optimization problem on a single Grassmann manifold. Our approach, named Graph-Regularized RTRMC (GR-RTRMC), exploits the inherent relationships between rows and columns of the matrix. By using these relationships, we aim to improve the accuracy and robustness of matrix completion, particularly in scenarios where the underlying data exhibits strong correlations between rows or columns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在黎曼信赖域矩阵补全（RTRMC）框架中引入图正则化，提出图正则化RTRMC（GR-RTRMC）方法，利用矩阵行列之间的内在关系提升低秩矩阵补全的精度和鲁棒性，尤其适用于数据行列间存在强相关性的场景。
Motivation: 现有低秩矩阵补全方法未充分利用行列间的结构关系，导致在强相关数据上性能受限。
Method: 将图正则化项融入RTRMC的优化目标，保持低秩约束在单一Grassmann流形上的无约束优化形式，利用列空间与行空间的关系进行建模。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但声称在行列强相关数据上能提升补全准确性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: GR-RTRMC通过图正则化有效利用矩阵行列间的内在关系，适用于结构化数据场景。

papers.title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Despite strong performance on many multimodal tasks, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with basic object counting. We investigate whether this reflects missing internal knowledge or a gap between internal representations and verbalized outputs. Training simple probes on activations from four VLMs across five counting datasets reveals that nonlinear probes can reliably detect counting errors, suggesting that VLMs often encode the correct count even when they output the wrong answer. SVCCA analysis shows that probes trained on ground-truth counts and probes trained on model outputs occupy a partially shared activation subspace but read out along misaligned directions. We further validate our findings using a causal steering intervention, proving that strengthening the direction of count-identified probes does improve model counting performance. Motivated by this result, we propose a detector-guided self-correction method that selectively re-prompts the model only when an internal error detector predicts failure. This simple inference-time intervention improves counting accuracy by up to 15.6 absolute percentage points, without any parameter updates. Our results establish activation-based error probing as both a practical tool for improving VLM counting and a mechanistic lens on the gap between internal knowledge and model outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在对象计数任务上的失败原因。通过探针分析发现，VLM的内部表示通常编码了正确的计数，但输出不正确，表明存在内部知识与输出之间的对齐问题。基于此，作者提出一种检测器引导的自校正方法，在推理时选择性重新提示模型，无需更新参数即可将计数准确率提升最高15.6个百分点。
Motivation: VLM在基本对象计数任务上表现不佳，但尚不清楚这是内部知识缺失还是表示与输出之间的对齐问题。
Method: 训练非线性探针从VLM的激活中检测计数错误；使用SVCCA分析探针表示子空间；提出检测器引导的自校正方法，仅在内部错误检测器预测失败时重新提示模型。
Result: 非线性探针能可靠检测计数错误；因果干预证明加强计数识别探针的方向可改善性能；自校正方法在不更新参数的情况下将计数准确率提升最多15.6个百分点。
Conclusion: 激活探针既是一种改进VLM计数的实用工具，也是理解内部知识与输出之间差距的机械视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoCoT-EEG: Contrastive-Pretrained Multiscale Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised pretrained foundation models (FM) have shown early promise for non-invasive electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding applications. Many recent large-scale models converged on the approach of tokenizing raw EEG followed by masked reconstruction pretraining. However, this recipe has been shown to be suboptimal for data, like EEG, with high noise amplitude and information confined to limited dimensions such as narrow frequency bands. Building on this insight, we develop a novel contrastive-pretrained EEG model with multiscale temporal convolution input layers and Transformer encoder blocks (CoCoT). CoCoT matches or beats state-of-the-art reconstruction-pretrained EEG models on extensive benchmark decoding tasks with heterogeneous electrode configurations. Furthermore, CoCoT trained from scratch outperforms previous single-task decoding models and even rivals pretrained models, showcasing the architecture's flexibility and data efficiency. Through systematic ablations, including model architecture and pretraining objective, we demonstrate the viability of contrastive learning for building EEG FMs while suggesting key architectural design considerations, prompting further investigations in alternative large-scale pretraining strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种对比预训练的多尺度卷积Transformer模型(CoCoT)用于脑电图(EEG)解码。针对现有EEG自监督预训练方法依赖于掩码重建、不适用于高噪声且信息集中于窄频带的EEG数据的问题，CoCoT采用对比学习目标与多尺度时间卷积输入层，在多个异构电极配置的基准解码任务上匹配或超越了当前最优的重建预训练模型。从零训练的CoCoT也优于先前单任务解码模型，甚至能与预训练模型竞争，展现了架构的数据效率。系统消融实验表明对比学习可用于构建EEG基础模型，并提出了关键架构设计考虑。
Motivation: 现有EEG自监督预训练方法多采用掩码重建范式，但这种策略对于高噪声、信息局限于窄频带的EEG数据效果不佳。
Method: 提出CoCoT，结合多尺度时间卷积输入层与Transformer编码器，并使用对比学习进行预训练。
Result: 在多个异构电极配置的基准解码任务上，CoCoT匹配或超越了现有最优的重建预训练模型；从零训练的CoCoT优于先前单任务模型，并能与预训练模型竞争。
Conclusion: 对比学习是构建EEG基础模型的有效预训练策略，但需注意架构设计；该工作为替代大规模预训练策略提供了方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种对比预训练的多尺度卷积Transformer模型(CoCoT)用于脑电图(EEG)解码。针对现有EEG自监督预训练方法依赖于掩码重建、不适用于高噪声且信息集中于窄频带的EEG数据的问题，CoCoT采用对比学习目标与多尺度时间卷积输入层，在多个异构电极配置的基准解码任务上匹配或超越了当前最优的重建预训练模型。从零训练的CoCoT也优于先前单任务解码模型，甚至能与预训练模型竞争，展现了架构的数据效率。系统消融实验表明对比学习可用于构建EEG基础模型，并提出了关键架构设计考虑。

summary_sections.method: 提出CoCoT，结合多尺度时间卷积输入层与Transformer编码器，并使用对比学习进行预训练。

papers.title: GatedLinear: Adaptive Routing of Complementary Linear Bases for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting requires models to capture diverse, often mutually exclusive, temporal dynamics, from smooth trend continuation to nonstationary drift and strict phase-aligned recurrence. While recent deep learning models have improved accuracy, they typically force these diverse patterns through a single computational backbone governed by fixed algorithmic inductive biases (e.g., self-attention or spectral filtering). This single-mechanism approach often struggles with the profound heterogeneity of real-world series, where different variables and forecast horizons necessitate fundamentally different predictive treatments. To address this, we propose GatedLinear: a lightweight framework that frames forecasting as the adaptive routing of complementary linear bases. GatedLinear leverages a pool of three specialized mechanisms: a global trend-seasonal basis for smooth projection, a difference-based incremental basis for nonstationary drift, and a phase-aligned recurrence basis for explicit cyclic reuse. To dynamically orchestrate these distinct behaviors, we introduce a Tri-Factorized Fusion Gate that disentangles routing decisions into channel-specific preferences, horizon-aware offsets, and phase-indexed biases derived from known future time marks. This design allows the model to perform highly granular, point-wise soft routing across different predictive regimes without stacking computationally heavy neural modules. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive accuracy against recent complex foundational models, while offering explicitly interpretable routing patterns and operating with a substantially smaller parameter footprint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GatedLinear，一种轻量级时间序列预测框架，利用三个专门线性基（全局趋势季节、差分增量、相位对齐循环）并通过三因子分解融合门进行自适应路由。在标准基准上达到最先进或高度竞争性精度，参数量更小且路由模式可解释。
Motivation: 现有模型通常用单一机制处理多样时序动态，难以捕捉实际序列的异质性（如趋势、非平稳漂移、周期）。需要一种能自适应路由不同预测范式的方法。
Method: 构建三个互补线性基池：全局趋势季节基、差分增量基、相位对齐循环基；引入 Tri-Factorized Fusion Gate，将路由决策分解为通道偏好、水平感知偏移和相位索引偏置，实现点级软路由。
Result: 在标准时间序列基准上达到最先进或高度竞争性精度，同时参数量显著低于复杂基础模型，并展示明确的可解释路由模式。
Conclusion: GatedLinear 通过自适应路由互补线性基，在精度和效率之间取得平衡，且提供可解释性，表明软路由机制对异质序列有效。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: Statistically Undetectable Backdoors in Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We show how an adversarial model trainer can plant backdoors in a large class of deep, feedforward neural networks. These backdoors are statistically undetectable in the white-box setting, meaning that the backdoored and honestly trained models are close in total variation distance, even given the full descriptions of the models (e.g., all of the weights). The backdoor provides access to invariance-based adversarial examples for every input, mapping distant inputs to unusually close outputs. However, without the backdoor, it is provably impossible (under standard cryptographic assumptions) to generate any such adversarial examples in polynomial time. Our theoretical and preliminary empirical findings demonstrate a fundamental power asymmetry between model trainers and model users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明对抗训练者可以在深度前馈神经网络中植入统计上不可检测的后门（backdoor），即在白盒设置下后门模型与诚实模型的总体变差距离很小。后门允许对每个输入生成基于不变性的对抗样本，但不知后门时在标准密码学假设下无法在多项式时间内生成任何对抗样本。理论与初步实验揭示了模型训练者与用户之间的根本能力不对称。
Motivation: 现有后门攻击大多可被统计检测或需要黑盒访问，本文旨在构造在完全白盒访问（包括所有权重）下仍无法区分的后门，挑战“透明模型可信任”的假设。
Method: 利用密码学原语（如伪随机函数）将后门模式编码到网络权重中，使后门模型与诚实模型在输出分布上接近，同时后门触发机制仅对掌握密钥的对抗训练者可知。
Result: 理论上证明后门模型与诚实模型在总体变差距离上不可区分，且不知后门时无法有效生成对抗样本；初步实验验证了所提后门的隐蔽性。
Conclusion: 模型训练者与用户之间存在根本能力不对称：训练者可以植入无法检测的后门，而用户即使拥有完整模型也无法逆向工程或利用该后门。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TSAI-MetaFraud: A Benchmark Dataset for Financial Fraud Transaction and Behavioral Risk Detection in Metaverse Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of metaverse platforms has created virtual economies that introduce new challenges related to fraud, bot activity, and illicit financial behavior. Despite growing interest in trustworthy metaverse analytics, existing datasets typically focus on user behavior, authentication, or financial transactions in isolation, limiting the development and reproducible evaluation of multimodal fraud detection methods. To address this gap, we present TSAI-MetaFraud, a multimodal, multi-task benchmark dataset for fraud analytics in virtual economies. TSAI-MetaFraud integrates behavioral, transactional, and graph-structured information while incorporating realistic fraud and automated bot scenarios. We define benchmark tasks including transaction fraud detection, cross-modal node classification, temporal link prediction, and weakly supervised fraud detection, and provide baseline evaluations using machine learning models and graph neural networks. By jointly capturing behavioral activity, financial interactions, and relational structure within a unified virtual economy, TSAI-MetaFraud provides a benchmark for advancing multimodal learning, graph mining, fraud analytics, and trustworthy AI in emerging metaverse ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TSAI-MetaFraud，一个用于元宇宙生态系统中金融欺诈交易和行为风险检测的多模态、多任务基准数据集。该数据集整合了行为、交易和图结构信息，并包含现实欺诈和自动化机器人场景。定义了交易欺诈检测、跨模态节点分类、时间链接预测和弱监督欺诈检测等基准任务，并提供了使用机器学习和图神经网络的基线评估。
Motivation: 现有数据集通常孤立地关注用户行为、身份验证或金融交易，缺乏多模态欺诈检测方法的发展和可重复评估所需的数据，尤其是元宇宙虚拟经济中的新型欺诈挑战。
Method: 构建 TSAI-MetaFraud 数据集，融合行为、交易和图结构信息，包含真实欺诈和机器人场景，并定义四个基准任务，使用传统机器学习和图神经网络模型提供基线结果。
Result: 通过基线评估展示了数据集的有效性，但摘要中未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: TSAI-MetaFraud 为元宇宙环境中的多模态学习、图挖掘、欺诈分析和可信人工智能提供了统一的基准平台。

papers.title: ALICE: Learning a General-Purpose Pathology Foundation Model from Vision, Vision-Language, and Slide-Level Experts
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are reshaping computational pathology, yet their capabilities remain shaped by pretraining objectives, data sources, and spatial scales, fragmenting complementary expertise across separate backbones. Here we present ALICE, a unified foundation model trained through multi-stage agglomerative distillation that sequentially distills eight vision-only, vision-language, and slide-level teacher models into dedicated modules of a single backbone. ALICE is pretrained on 24,985,184 tile-level pathology images and 155,604 high-resolution images, and evaluated across 21 task scenarios, 96 downstream tasks, and 48 data sources, spanning region-of-interest tissue analysis, vision-language multimodal evaluation, and whole-slide clinical assessment. In all three evaluation settings, ALICE achieved the best average rank among task-matched pathology foundation models. These results demonstrate that agglomerative distillation can consolidate complementary capabilities from specialized models into a unified backbone for broad computational pathology applications. The model is available at https://github.com/WonderLandxD/ALICE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ALICE，一个统一的计算病理学基础模型，通过多阶段聚合蒸馏将八个视觉、视觉语言和全切片级教师模型蒸馏到单个骨干网络的不同模块中。模型在2498万张切片级图像和15.5万张高分辨率图像上预训练，在21个任务场景、96个下游任务和48个数据源上评估，在三类评估中均取得最佳平均排名。
Motivation: 现有病理学基础模型因预训练目标、数据来源和空间尺度的不同而导致互补能力分散在多个骨干网络中，缺乏统一模型。
Method: 采用多阶段聚合蒸馏，依次将八个视觉、视觉语言和全切片级教师模型的知识蒸馏到一个骨干网络的不同专用模块中。
Result: 在21个任务场景、96个下游任务和48个数据源上评估，ALICE在三类评估（ROI组织分析、视觉语言多模态评估、全切片临床评估）中均取得任务匹配病理学基础模型的最佳平均排名。
Conclusion: 聚合蒸馏能够将多个专业模型的互补能力整合到统一骨干网络中，适用于广泛的计算病理学应用。

papers.title: SAGEAgent: A Self-Evolving Agent for Cost-Aware Modality Acquisition in Multimodal Survival Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Does every cancer patient truly need a complete diagnostic workup for accurate survival prediction? In multimodal clinical oncology, diagnostic modalities follow a clinically mandated order of escalating burden -- from demographics collected at intake to genomic profiling requiring specialized tissue analysis. Current multimodal survival methods either assume all modalities are available or passively handle missing data, but none actively reason about whether acquiring the next modality is justified for a given patient along this ordered workflow. We formulate this as a sequential decision problem and propose SAGEAgent (Sequential Acquisition Guided by Experience), a self-evolving LLM-based clinical agent that decides which diagnostic modalities to acquire for each patient, balancing predictive accuracy against clinical invasiveness. SAGEAgent reasons about each patient's evolving diagnostic state through clinical tools that translate numerical predictions into text, an episodic memory that retrieves similar past cases, and a semantic memory that accumulates reusable decision patterns from experience. Experiments on a glioma cohort combining TCGA-LGG, TCGA-GBM, and BraTS with four diagnostic modalities demonstrate that SAGEAgent achieves competitive survival prediction accuracy while reducing average acquisition burden by 55%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGEAgent，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的临床代理，用于在多模态癌症生存预测中顺序决策是否获取下一诊断模态，以平衡预测准确性和临床侵入性。在胶质瘤队列（TCGA-LGG、TCGA-GBM、BraTS）上的实验表明，该方法在保持竞争力的预测准确性的同时，平均降低55%的获取负担。
Motivation: 现有多模态生存预测方法要么假设所有模态可用，要么被动处理缺失数据，但缺乏主动推理对于特定患者是否值得获取更昂贵或侵入性更强的后续模态。
Method: 将模态获取问题形式化为顺序决策问题，提出SAGEAgent代理，包含三个核心组件：将数值预测转化为文本的临床工具、检索相似病例的情景记忆、以及积累可复用决策模式的语义记忆。
Result: 在胶质瘤数据集上，SAGEAgent实现了有竞争力的生存预测准确性，并将平均获取负担降低55%。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了LLM驱动的代理在临床多模态决策中的潜力，能够在保证预测效果的同时大幅减少不必要的检测。

papers.title: Seeing is Free, Speaking is Not: Uncovering the True Energy Bottleneck in Edge VLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the perceptual backbone of embodied AI, but their energy footprint on edge hardware remains poorly understood. Existing efficiency efforts focus predominantly on reducing visual tokens, implicitly treating visual processing as the dominant energy cost. We overturn this implicit assumption through the first systematic energy profiling of on-device VLM inference, spanning five models across three architecture families, four input resolutions, and two hardware platforms (NVIDIA RTX 3070 and Jetson Orin NX). Our analysis yields three findings. First, average inference power is a model-intrinsic constant, invariant to input resolution, image complexity, and prompt type, with less than 5% variation across all conditions. This means that all energy variation across inputs must arise from variation in inference time, not from variation in power draw. Second, each output token costs 11 to 39x more wall-clock time than each input token due to the compute-bound and memory-bound asymmetry between prefill and decode, making output token count the dominant driver of both latency and energy. Third, image complexity, measured by the number of objects in an image, induces up to 4.1x energy differences at identical resolution. This variation arises not from increased visual processing cost, but from differences in output length. These findings expose a fundamental limitation of visual token pruning: even removing all visual tokens saves at most 10% of total energy for fixed-token models. Across models spanning 1 billion to 8 billion parameters, controlling output length saves up to 97% of total energy, with the energy dominance of decoding growing stronger at larger model scale. In short, the true energy bottleneck in edge VLM inference is not what the model sees, but how much it says.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. 10 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地分析了边缘设备上视觉语言模型（VLM）推理的能量分布，揭示了真正的能量瓶颈并非视觉处理，而是输出文本长度。实验覆盖5个模型、3种架构、4种输入分辨率和2个硬件平台，发现平均推理功率为模型固有常数（变化<5%），每个输出token的耗时是输入token的11–39倍，图像复杂度导致的能量差异（高达4.1倍）实质上源自输出长度变化。视觉token剪枝最多节省10%能量，而控制输出长度可节省高达97%能量。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注减少视觉token以降低能耗，隐含假设视觉处理是主要能耗来源，但缺乏系统性实验验证。本文旨在通过实际测量揭示边缘VLM推理的真正能量瓶颈。
Method: 对5个VLM模型（1B–8B参数）在NVIDIA RTX 3070和Jetson Orin NX平台上进行能量剖析，变化输入分辨率、图像复杂度和提示类型，测量功率、时延和能量消耗。
Result: 平均推理功率变化<5%；每个输出token耗时是输入token的11–39倍；图像复杂度（对象数）导致最多4.1倍能量差异，但源于输出长度；视觉token剪枝最多节省10%能量，而控制输出长度节省高达97%能量。
Conclusion: 边缘VLM推理的真正能量瓶颈在于输出长度（解码阶段），而非视觉处理阶段。未来的节能设计应聚焦于减少输出token数量或优化解码效率。
Relevance: 0
