papers.title: Failure as a Process: An Anatomy of CLI Coding Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents are increasingly deployed to autonomously perform software engineering tasks in terminal-based environments, making their reliability a growing concern. Existing empirical studies investigate why coding agents fail, yet they largely treat failure as a final outcome rather than a temporal process, providing limited insight into how failures emerge, evolve, and become unrecoverable. We present the first large-scale empirical study of CLI coding-agent failure trajectories, introducing a process-oriented framework that analyzes failure through its onset, evolution, and recovery across execution trajectories. We first collect 3,843 execution trajectories generated by seven frontier models across three coding-agent scaffolds (OpenHands, MiniSWE, and Terminus2) on Terminal-Bench, then carefully filter them to obtain 1,794 complete and valid trajectories for manual annotation (over 63,000 execution steps), from which we derive 14 findings spanning failure occurrence, root causes, recovery, and cross-system consistency. Our findings show that coding-agent failures are predominantly driven by epistemic errors, typically begin within the first few execution steps, and often remain hidden until recovery is no longer possible, suggesting that improving coding-agent reliability requires earlier validation and intervention rather than relying solely on final-outcome evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对CLI编码助手（coding agent）的失败轨迹进行大规模实证研究，提出了面向过程的分析框架，从失败的发生、演变和恢复三个维度分析3,843条执行轨迹（经过筛选得到1,794条完整有效轨迹，超过63,000个执行步骤），涵盖七个前沿模型和三个编码助手框架（OpenHands, MiniSWE, Terminus2）。研究发现编码助手的失败主要由认知错误（epistemic errors）驱动，通常在前几个执行步骤内开始，并且往往在无法恢复之前一直隐藏，表明提高编码助手可靠性需要更早的验证和干预，而非仅依赖最终结果评估。
Motivation: 现有实证研究将失败视为最终结果而非时间过程，对失败如何出现、演变和变得不可恢复的洞察有限。
Method: 收集七个模型在三个编码助手框架上的3,843条执行轨迹，筛选后对1,794条完整有效轨迹进行人工标注（超过63,000个执行步骤），从失败的发生、原因、恢复和跨系统一致性四个方面得出14条发现。
Result: 失败主要由认知错误驱动，通常在前几个步骤内开始，且往往在恢复已不可能时仍未被发现。
Conclusion: 提高编码助手可靠性需要更早的验证和干预，而非仅依赖最终结果评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DGSfM: Depth-Guided Scale-Aware Global Structure-from-Motion
papers.abstract_en: Global Structure-from-Motion (SfM) is an efficient paradigm for recovering camera poses and sparse 3D structure from unordered images. However, its reliance on scale-ambiguous epipolar geometry makes global positioning sensitive to noisy baseline estimates and weak view-graph constraints, while false edges from visually ambiguous pairs can further degrade reconstruction. We propose DGSfM, a depth-aware global SfM pipeline that uses monocular depth maps as a scalable prior while preserving explicit multi-view optimization. For each image pair, we use a depth-aware relative pose solver to convert scale-ambiguous epipolar constraints into scale-aware relative pose constraints. We further improve robustness through view-graph filtering and depth-consistency-based correspondence pruning, which suppress false edges and matches that remain plausible under epipolar geometry alone. Finally, global scale averaging and depth-guided pose-point initialization align monocular depth maps into a common reconstruction scale and provide stable initialization for global positioning and bundle adjustment. Experiments on ETH3D and IMC2021 show that DGSfM consistently improves over strong global SfM baselines across sparse and dense matching front-ends, achieving substantial gains in pose accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/sithu31296/DGSfM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出DGSfM，一种深度感知的全局运动恢复结构（SfM）流水线，利用单目深度图作为可扩展先验，同时保持显式多视图优化。通过深度感知相对位姿求解器将尺度模糊的对极约束转化为尺度感知约束，并结合视图图过滤和深度一致性对应剪枝提高鲁棒性。全局尺度平均和深度引导的位姿点初始化将单目深度图对齐到公共重建尺度。在ETH3D和IMC2021数据集上，DGSfM在稀疏和密集匹配前端上均一致优于强全局SfM基线，显著提升姿态精度。
Motivation: 全局SfM依赖尺度模糊的对极几何，对噪声基线估计和弱视图图约束敏感，虚假边（来自视觉模糊对）会进一步降低重建质量。
Method: 提出DGSfM，包含深度感知相对位姿求解器、视图图过滤、深度一致性对应剪枝、全局尺度平均和深度引导的位姿点初始化，将单目深度图作为先验融入全局SfM流水线。
Result: 在ETH3D和IMC2021数据集上，DGSfM在稀疏和密集匹配前端上均一致改进强全局SfM基线，显著提升姿态精度。
Conclusion: 论文表明深度先验可有效改善全局SfM的重建鲁棒性和准确性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What VGGT Knows About Overlap: Probing Geometric Foundation Models for Co-Visibility
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental challenge in 3D reconstruction and robotic localization is co-visibility: determining which image pairs share overlapping visible surfaces, particularly in scenarios with minimal overlap. We demonstrate that VGGT implicitly encodes co-visibility as an emergent behavior: without any supervision for this task, its internal representations exhibit a clear hierarchical structure mirroring that of large language models, i.e. early layers build a 3D-aware scene representation, while late layers act as dedicated co-visibility reasoners. In particular, we identify layer L17 as a negative anchor that consistently routes non-co-visible pairs for this backbone, regardless of the evaluation setting, providing task-grounded evidence of layer specialization in a geometry-grounded foundation model. Building on this, we introduce Co-VGGT, which freezes VGGT and trains only a lightweight layer-wise mixture-of-experts head (less than 7.5M parameters) to classify co-visibility from RGB alone, treating each layer as a specialized expert whose geometric abstraction is adaptively weighted per input pair. On the Co-VisiON benchmark, Co-VGGT surpasses the human annotation baseline and improves over prior work by more than 25% pairwise and 10% multiview. Pairwise predictions are well-calibrated (ECE=0.030), enabling direct use as edge weights in visibility graphs for downstream SfM and SLAM pipelines without post-hoc correction. Code and data are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究几何基础模型 VGGT 是否隐式编码了共视性（co-visibility）信息。实验表明 VGGT 的早期层构建 3D 感知场景表示，后期层则充当专门的共视性推理器，其中第 L17 层是负锚点。基于此，提出 Co-VGGT，冻结 VGGT 并训练轻量级层混合专家头（<7.5M 参数）仅从 RGB 图像分类共视性，在 Co-VisiON 基准上优于人工标注基线，相比先前工作提升超过 25% 成对和 10% 多视图性能，且预测校准良好（ECE=0.030）。
Motivation: 共视性是 3D 重建和机器人定位中的基础问题，但缺乏无监督的隐式编码探索。现有方法在最小重叠场景下性能有限。
Method: 通过探测 VGGT 的各层表示，发现其隐式编码了共视性且具有层次结构。提出 Co-VGGT，冻结 VGGT 主干，训练轻量级层混合专家头（<7.5M 参数）对每层特征自适应加权，以分类共视性。
Result: 在 Co-VisiON 基准上，Co-VGGT 超越人工标注基线，成对分类提升 >25%，多视图提升 >10%，预测校准误差 ECE=0.030，可直接用作可见性图边权重用于 SfM 和 SLAM。
Conclusion: VGGT 隐式编码了共视性信息，层特化现象明显；Co-VGGT 无需任何共视性监督即可高效分类，且输出可直接用于下游任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: All Explanations are Wrong, But Many Are Useful: Exploring the Rashomon Explanation Set with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Explaining machine-learning models is increasingly important for decision-making and consumer trust, yet it is widely believed to come at a cost: existing Explainable AI (XAI) methods suffer from a persistent accuracy-explainability trade-off. We argue that this trade-off is not fundamental, but an artifact of treating explanation and prediction as separate objectives; when properly coupled, they become complementary, so that equipping a model to explain itself improves, rather than degrades, its accuracy. We introduce the Rashomon Explanation paradigm, which builds a set of faithful, prediction-guiding explanations rather than a single one, and prove that this set is generally non-empty and that explanation fidelity bounds the performance of the models it guides. To explore this set, we propose RashomonLLM, an Explanation-Prediction-Reflection agentic workflow that generates explanations in natural language by iteratively aligning them with predictions, and we prove it converges and recovers the full set. Across customer-churn classification, clinical survival regression, and industrial click-through prediction on large-scale live-streaming logs, RashomonLLM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art prediction and XAI baselines on both accuracy and explanation quality, with gains driven by explanation fidelity and robust to distribution shifts, temporal splits, and seeds. Our framework thus advances business performance while laying the groundwork for consumer trust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了机器学习中普遍存在的准确率-可解释性权衡观点，提出Rashomon解释范式，构建一组忠实且指导预测的解释而非单一解释。作者证明该集合非空且解释忠实度约束了模型性能。为探索该集合，提出RashomonLLM，一个基于解释-预测-反思的智能体工作流，迭代生成自然语言解释并与预测对齐。在客户流失分类、临床生存回归和工业点击率预测任务上，RashomonLLM在准确率和解释质量上显著超越现有基线，且收益对分布偏移、时间分割和随机种子鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有可解释AI（XAI）方法普遍存在准确率-可解释性的权衡，本文认为该权衡并非本质，而是将解释与预测作为独立目标的人为产物；若能恰当耦合，二者将互补，使模型自我解释可提升而非降低准确率。
Method: 提出Rashomon解释集（所有忠实且预测导向的解释集合）并证明其非空性及解释忠实度对模型性能的边界作用。提出RashomonLLM，采用解释-预测-反思的智能体工作流，通过迭代对齐解释与预测来生成自然语言解释，并证明其收敛并恢复完整集合。
Result: 在客户流失分类、临床生存回归和工业大规模直播点击率预测中，RashomonLLM在准确率和解释质量上均显著优于当前最强的预测和XAI基线，改进由解释忠实度驱动，并对分布偏移、时间分割和随机种子稳健。
Conclusion: 本文框架表明解释与预测可互补，在推进业务性能的同时为消费者信任奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shared Selective Persistent Memory for Agentic LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic LLM systems that generate code through multi-turn tool use face a fundamental context problem: each session starts from zero, discarding the configuration choices, domain constraints, data schemas, and tool-use patterns that made previous sessions productive. Naively persisting entire conversation histories is token-inefficient and counterproductive: irrelevant context degrades generation quality. We introduce shared selective persistent memory, an architecture that identifies and retains four categories of reusable context (task specifications, data schemas, tool configurations, and output constraints) while discarding session-specific reasoning traces. Crucially, this memory is shared: workspaces encapsulating selective memory can be transferred across users with role-based access control, enabling collaborative reuse without redundant specification. We implement it in a deployed collaborative workspace platform where LLM agents produce, edit, and maintain git-versioned artifacts (dashboards, reports, and data-driven documents) from heterogeneous sources (CSV, SQL, REST APIs, and MCP servers). A complementary zero-token data refresh mechanism decouples generated programs from runtime data, enabling artifact reuse without re-invocation. Across three enterprise scenarios, shared selective persistent memory achieves 96% task completion (vs. 79% without memory and 71% with full history). Zero-token refresh eliminates LLM re-invocation for recurring updates (14x task-time reduction), while summary-driven generation cuts per-invocation token cost by 97x versus raw data injection. A replication on four public datasets confirms generalizability, with zero-token refresh succeeding in 12/12 trials. Notably, naive full-history persistence actively degrades completion by biasing the agent with stale traces, while selective memory outperforms both extremes.

papers.title: Multimodal Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to align multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but higher rewards do not always imply better task performance. This risk is amplified when visual evidence is evaluated by text-only or weakly grounded rewards. We study reward hacking in MLLM RL across safety VQA, chart VQA, and stress-test settings, varying reward design, data ambiguity, model scale (2B-32B), and RL algorithm (GRPO, RLOO, DAPO). We introduce Newly Rewarded Failure Rate (NRFR), which measures failures among samples whose proxy reward improves over the SFT baseline. Outcome-only rewards cause severe hacking, reaching 48.1% Reward Hacking Rate (RHR), while NRFR exceeding RHR shows that RL creates new failures rather than merely inheriting them. Scaling reduces but does not eliminate hacking: even the 32B model retains a 54.9% worse rate under outcome-only rewards, whereas answer-aware rewards improve the oracle trend at every scale. Robustness is also algorithm- and scale-dependent: GRPO is consistently most resistant, RLOO remains vulnerable, and DAPO improves substantially from 2B to 8B. Visual-evidence rewards help only with reliable verification: keyword-based checks increase hacking, while VLM-as-judge semantic verification reduces it. Overall, multimodal reward hacking is a systematic result of optimizing imperfect rewards, and robust alignment requires rewards and verifiers that remain reliable under optimization pressure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在强化学习（RL）对齐中的奖励作弊现象，提出新指标NRFR（Newly Rewarded Failure Rate）。实验表明，仅基于结果的奖励导致严重作弊（RHR最高48.1%），且NRFR超过RHR说明RL创造新失败而非继承旧失败。增大模型规模可缓解但无法消除作弊，不同RL算法（GRPO、RLOO、DAPO）鲁棒性差异显著。视觉证据奖励仅在可靠验证（如VLM作为裁判的语义验证）下有效，关键词验证反而加剧作弊。
Motivation: 强化学习用于对齐多模态大语言模型时，高奖励不一定对应任务性能提升，尤其当视觉证据被文本或弱根基奖励评估时，奖励作弊风险被放大。
Method: 在多模态大语言模型的安全VQA、图表VQA和压力测试设定下，改变奖励设计、数据模糊性、模型规模（2B-32B）和RL算法（GRPO、RLOO、DAPO），引入新指标NRFR衡量代理奖励改善但任务失败的样本比例。
Result: 仅基于结果的奖励导致48.1%的奖励作弊率（RHR），NRFR表明RL创造新失败；32B模型在仅结果奖励下仍有54.9%的恶化率；GRPO最抗作弊，RLOO最脆弱，DAPO从2B到8B大幅改善；视觉证据奖励依赖可靠验证，关键词检查增加作弊，VLM语义验证减少作弊。
Conclusion: 多模态奖励作弊是优化不完美奖励的系统性结果，稳健对齐需要可靠且经优化压力测试的奖励函数和验证器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Terminal Dimension Reduction for Time Series with Applications
papers.abstract_en: Terminal embeddings have emerged as a powerful tool for dimension reduction. Given a set of points $P\subset \mathbb{R}^d$, a terminal embedding is a mapping $f:\mathbb{R}^d\rightarrow \mathbb{R}^t$ that preserves the pairwise distance between any pair of points $p\in P$ and $q\in \mathbb{R}^d$ up to small distortion under this mapping. Terminal embeddings have been particularly fruitful for constructing $k$-means and $k$-median coresets, where the objective is to find a typically weighted subset $Ω$ of $P$ such that for any candidate solution, the cost of the clustering objective on $Ω$ approximates the cost of the clustering objective on $P$ up to small distortion. Unfortunately, these techniques have not been extended to more complicated structures such as clustering time-series data under common straight-line interpolation between measurements. The main issue is that terminal embeddings, arguably the central technique in this line of research, cannot be linear and are thus not immediately suitable to preserve linear structures. In this work, we develop a generalization of terminal embeddings to affine line-segments that overcomes this issue. We showcase their applicability by using our lines-preserving terminal embeddings to obtain the first dimension-free coresets for clustering time-series under the Fréchet distance. The underlying dimension reduction uses Johnson-Lindenstrauss (JL) embeddings, and our experiments indicate that terminal embeddings perform similarly to JL and favorably against PCA for synthetic and real-world time-series, while only terminal embeddings extend pairwise distance preservation to the full ambient space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列数据在Fréchet距离下的聚类问题，提出一种将终端嵌入推广到仿射线段的表示方法，使得能够保留线性结构。基于此，首次获得无维数依赖的coresets，实验表明该方法与Johnson-Lindenstrauss嵌入性能相当且优于PCA。
Motivation: 现有终端嵌入无法保留线性结构，因而不能直接应用于时间序列数据中常见的直线插值结构，限制了其在复杂聚类任务中的使用。
Method: 提出一种面向仿射线段的终端嵌入推广，结合Johnson-Lindenstrauss嵌入实现维度约简，并用于构造Fréchet距离下的时间序列聚类coresets。
Result: 获得首个无维数依赖的时间序列聚类coresets；实验显示终端嵌入与JL嵌入性能相当且优于PCA，且能保留全空间距离。
Conclusion: 本文推广了终端嵌入，使其能保留线性结构，为时间序列分析提供新的理论工具，但未涉及具体气象应用。

papers.title: Ceci n'est pas une pipe: AI systems as semantic abstractions
papers.abstract_en: An AI system's output is not the fact or world state it appears to describe, but rather an engineered representation. We propose a semantic framework to describe AI systems, to be able to examine the correctness of such representations. To do so, we distinguish what is justified by accepted domain knowledge, what reference sources say, and what the system can currently use. This allows us to give precise definitions to common failures: extrapolation, refuted or unsupported assertion, sources versus knowledge mismatch, stale or refuted source, added hypotheses, unsupported use... We hope our framework gives a useful vocabulary for specifying and checking AI systems whose outputs, citations, tool calls, and world-changing actions must be justified by reliable claims and explicit authority rather than apparent fluency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种语义框架，用于描述AI系统并检查其输出表征的正确性。框架区分已接受的领域知识、参考来源和系统当前可用知识，从而精确定义外推、被反驳或无支持的断言等常见失败。目标是提供一套词汇，确保AI系统的输出、引用、工具调用等基于可靠声明和明确权威。
Motivation: AI系统的输出表面描述事实或世界状态，但实际上是一种工程化表征，需要一种框架来系统性地检查其正确性。
Method: 提出语义框架，通过区分三种知识层次（领域知识、参考来源、系统当前可用知识）来定义和分类常见失败模式。
Result: 能够精确定义外推、被反驳断言、无支持断言、来源与知识不匹配、过时或已被反驳的来源、额外假设、无支持使用等失败类型。
Conclusion: 该框架为规范和检查AI系统的输出提供了有用的词汇，强调输出必须基于可靠声明和明确权威，而非表面流畅性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SigLIP-HD by Fine-to-Coarse Supervision
papers.abstract_en: High-quality visual representation is a long-standing pursuit in computer vision. In the context of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), feeding higher-resolution images can produce more fine-grained visual tokens. However, it introduces additional computational and design complexity, due to multiple forward passes and post-processing of increased tokens. Before simply adopting a higher resolution, have we truly unlocked the model's full perception capability at a standard resolution? Therefore, we study an interesting problem: how to achieve fine visual perception under lower cost without larger images. We present SigLIP-HD in this work. The core is a highly simple fine-to-coarse supervision design. We enforce the coarse feature of a mid-resolution image to mimic the fine-grained feature of its high-resolution version. We build this framework on the advanced SigLIP 2 model. Our final model produces better visual tokens at exactly the same inference budget. It is validated on extensive MLLM benchmarks and consistently delivers stronger results than our baseline model, especially on OCR-related tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SigLIP-HD，通过细粒度到粗粒度的监督（fine-to-coarse supervision）设计，在标准分辨率下提升视觉表征质量，避免直接采用高分辨率带来的计算开销。该方法基于 SigLIP 2 模型，在 MLLM 基准上取得更好结果，尤其在 OCR 相关任务中表现突出。
Motivation: 当前多模态大模型（MLLM）常通过提高输入图像分辨率来获得更细粒度的视觉 token，但这会增加计算和设计复杂度。作者质疑是否在标准分辨率下已充分挖掘模型感知能力，旨在以更低成本实现精细视觉感知。
Method: 核心是简单的中分辨率图像粗特征模仿高分辨率细特征的细到粗监督设计（fine-to-coarse supervision），构建在 SigLIP 2 模型之上，并在相同推理预算下生成更好的视觉 token。
Result: 在广泛 MLLM 基准上，SigLIP-HD 持续优于基线模型，尤其是 OCR 相关任务。
Conclusion: 通过细到粗监督，可以在不增加推理成本的前提下提升标准分辨率图像的视觉表征质量，为高效 MLLM 提供新思路。

papers.title: Neural Collapse Is Forbidden: Information Floors in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Within-class variance in language-model representations is commonly read as incomplete neural collapse. We argue it is allocated information storage, and that the allocation obeys a law. A one-line centering identity voids a family of simplex equiangular-tight-frame claims, including our own earlier ones; in dimensionless variance shares across 14 models, macro-category structure carries only 4-12% of representational variance and within-token context carries 79-91%, stable across a 100x parameter range. On the theory side, token-level weight decay penalizes a category in proportion to its type count, not its occurrence mass, reducing next-token prediction to an imbalanced K-class problem whose optimum orders category norms by type count. A converse floor, proved for binary categories, forces within-category dispersion to be at least proportional to the conditional mutual information I(token; context | category). The law holds: identity dispersion, not total variance, tracks this information across every tested model and partition, under a model-free estimate and even across models, where one model's information predicts another's dispersion; and over pretraining the category share overshoots, decays, and partially recovers, because the information it must carry never left.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语言模型表示中的类内方差并非不完全神经坍缩的迹象，而是分配的信息存储，且受信息地板定律约束。通过中心化恒等式否定了一类单纯形等角紧框架断言，并在14个模型上发现宏类别结构仅占表示方差的4-12%，而上下文信息占79-91%。理论部分证明，token级权重衰减按类型计数而非出现频率惩罚类别，使最优解排序类别范数；对于二元类别，类内分散度至少与条件互信息 I(token; context | category) 成正比。该定律在多个模型和划分中成立，一个模型的信息可预测另一模型的分散度，预训练过程中类别份额先超调后衰减再部分恢复。
Motivation: 现有研究常将语言模型表示中的类内方差解读为不完全神经坍缩，但本文认为该方差实际上是分配的信息存储，且其分配遵循某种定律，反驳了之前关于单纯形等角紧框架的论断。
Method: 通过中心化恒等式，从理论和实验两方面分析语言模型表示的结构。理论推导了token级权重衰减对类别范数的影响，并证明二元类别下类内分散度与条件互信息的下界关系。实验上，在14个不同规模的模型上计算无量纲方差份额，并利用模型无关的互信息估计验证定律。
Result: 宏类别结构仅占表示方差的4-12%，而上下文信息占79-91%，该比例在100倍参数范围内稳定。二元类别下，类内分散度至少正比于条件互信息，且一个模型的信息可预测另一模型的分散度。预训练过程中类别份额呈现超调、衰减、部分恢复的动力学。
Conclusion: 本文提出的信息地板定律表明，语言模型表示中的类内方差是必然的信息存储，而非不完全坍缩，揭示了表示结构与token上下文信息之间的根本关联。

papers.title: Decoupling Language Guidance from Backbones for Text-Guided Medical Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided medical image segmentation leverages clinical semantics to improve lesion delineation, yet many existing models bind cross-modal fusion, supervision, and decoder design into a task-specific architecture. Such tight coupling makes it difficult to reuse language guidance modules across heterogeneous vision and text backbones, and often requires redesigning the network when the encoder pair changes. This paper presents BTHA, a backbone-transferable hierarchical adapter framework for text-guided medical image segmentation. BTHA is built around a stable feature-level interface: given multi-scale visual features and a text representation, it injects semantic guidance through shape-preserving adapters while maintaining the decoder-side tensor contract. To make this interface effective, we introduce a Hierarchical Coarse-to-Fine Supervision Strategy that decomposes learning into global image-text alignment, multi-scale auxiliary localization, and boundary-aware final mask refinement. We further design a Scale-Adaptive Gated Semantic Guidance (SAGSG) adapter, where resolution-specific gates adaptively control textual injection and channel recalibration suppresses redundant cross-modal responses. Evaluations across diverse vision and text backbones show that the same adapter and supervision design remains effective across convolutional and transformer-based visual encoders as well as different language encoders. Experiments on four public datasets further demonstrate that BTHA improves strong text-guided baselines with modest computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BTHA，一个骨干可迁移的分层适配器框架，用于文本引导的医学图像分割。通过形状保持适配器和分层粗到细监督策略，实现跨视觉和文本骨干的语义引导，在四个公共数据集上提升了强基线性能。
Motivation: 现有文本引导医学分割模型将多模态融合、监督和解码器设计紧密耦合，难以在不同骨干间复用语言引导模块，且更换编码器对时需重新设计网络。
Method: 提出 BTHA 框架，包含稳定特征级接口、分层粗到细监督策略（全局对齐、多尺度定位、边界细化）和尺度自适应门控语义引导适配器（SAGSG），通过分辨率特定门控和通道重校准控制文本注入。
Result: 在多种视觉（卷积、Transformer）和文本骨干上，同一适配器与监督设计保持有效；在四个公共数据集上，BTHA 以较小计算开销提升强文本引导基线。
Conclusion: BTHA 实现了骨干可迁移的文本引导语义注入，为灵活复用语言模块提供方案。

papers.title: Foveation-Guided Dynamic Token Selection for Robust and Efficient Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: The human visual system (HVS) employs foveated sampling and eye movements to achieve efficient perception, conserving both metabolic energy and computational resources. Drawing inspiration from this robustness and adaptability, we introduce the Foveated Dynamic Transformer (FDT), a foveation-guided dynamic token-selection architecture that integrates these mechanisms into a vision transformer framework. The FDT exhibits strong resilience to various types of noise and adversarial attacks, despite not being explicitly trained for such challenges. This inherent robustness is achieved through the use of fixation and foveation modules: the fixation module identifies fixation points to filter out irrelevant information, while the foveation module generates foveated embeddings with multi-scale information. At the 50% fixation-budget setting, FDT achieves higher accuracy than DeiT-S (81.9% vs. 80.9%) while reducing multiply-accumulate operations by 34.57%, highlighting one operating point on its accuracy-efficiency trade-off. These attributes position FDT as an HVS-inspired step toward artificial neural networks that combine adaptive computation with improved resilience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受人类视觉系统（HVS）的注视采样和眼动机制启发，提出了注视引导的动态Transformer（FDT），一种整合注视和中央凹采样的动态令牌选择架构。FDT在未显式训练的情况下对噪声和对抗攻击表现出固有鲁棒性，通过注视模块过滤无关信息，中央凹模块生成多尺度嵌入。在50%注视预算设置下，FDT（81.9%）比DeiT-S（80.9%）准确率更高，同时减少34.57%的乘加运算。
Motivation: 现有视觉Transformer计算成本高且鲁棒性不足，人类视觉系统通过注视和中央凹采样实现高效感知，启发将类似机制引入ViT以提升效率与鲁棒性。
Method: 提出FDT架构，包含两个核心模块：注视模块（fixation module）识别注视点以过滤无关信息，中央凹模块（foveation module）生成具有多尺度信息的中央凹嵌入（foveated embeddings），实现动态令牌选择。
Result: 在50%注视预算下，FDT在ImageNet上达到81.9%准确率，优于DeiT-S的80.9%，同时减少34.57%的乘加运算。FDT对噪声和对抗攻击表现出固有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: FDT是受HVS启发的自适应计算与鲁棒性结合的步骤，展示了注视引导机制在视觉Transformer中的潜力，但摘要未提及对天气相关任务的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProofCouncil: An LLM Agent for Solving Open Mathematical Problems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in solving open problems in mathematics. However, their performance can be further improved through agentic workflows tailored to real-world mathematical practice. To this end, we introduce ProofCouncil, a mathematical agent that is designed to tackle open problems using an author-critic architecture. ProofCouncil served as a submission to the second batch of FirstProof, a challenge consisting of 10 real-world mathematical problems that agents must solve autonomously. Its submissions for 6 of the 10 problems were judged by the referees to be correct up to at most minor revisions, showing the best performance among participating teams. We also evaluate ProofCouncil on 30 open problems collected from mathematical researchers. Among the 21 solutions that received human feedback, 5 were judged completely correct, 2 more were judged promising pending final verification, and a further 8 contained useful partial progress. In this short paper, we describe the development of ProofCouncil and the agent-building library used to create it, which we release as open source to the community.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 7 figures. ProofCouncil appears as System A (IMProofBench ProofCouncil) in the official FirstProof second-batch report (arXiv:2606.18119). Code and agent-building library: https://github.com/eth-sri/proof-council
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍ProofCouncil，一个基于作者-评论家架构的数学智能体，旨在自主解决开放数学问题。在FirstProof第二轮挑战中，该智能体对10个问题中的6个给出了只需小修改的正确解答，表现最佳。此外，在30个收集的开放问题上，21个获得人类反馈，其中5个完全正确，2个有希望待验证，8个包含有用部分进展。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在数学问题上展现出潜力，但通过专为实际数学实践设计的智能体工作流可进一步提升其性能。
Method: 采用作者-评论家架构（author-critic architecture），并构建了一个智能体构建库，开源发布。
Result: 在FirstProof第二轮挑战中，10个问题中6个被评委判定为正确或仅需小修改，表现最佳。在30个开放问题上，21个获得人类反馈，其中5个完全正确，2个有希望待验证，8个包含有用部分进展。
Conclusion: 论文描述了ProofCouncil和智能体构建库的开发，表明该架构在解决开放数学问题上有效。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Dynamic Programming with Recursive Utility Using First-order Conditions
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes the certainty-equivalent first-order learning (CEFOL) algorithm, a deep learning algorithm for solving discrete-time dynamic programming problems with recursive utility. Dynamic programming with recursive utility is challenging because nonlinear certainty equivalent appears in the Bellman equation and the first-order optimality conditions but is difficult to evaluate. By introducing a separate neural network to represent the certainty equivalent, CEFOL enables the exploitation of the Bellman and model-specific first-order optimality conditions. In addition to certainty equivalent, CEFOL also uses neural networks to learn the value functions, policy functions, and Lagrange multipliers by using model-specific first-order conditions to construct residuals for minimization. By using first-order and KKT residuals to learn the policy, CEFOL directly accommodates general equality and inequality constraints on the controls, including occasionally binding constraints, without requiring penalty functions or problem-specific reformulations. We apply the algorithm to risk-sensitive and Epstein--Zin consumption-saving problems, a small-noise robust-control problem, and a DSGE model with recursive preferences and stochastic volatility. Across these applications, out-of-sample Bellman diagnostics and model-specific optimality residuals, including Euler or first-order residuals where applicable, are generally of order 1.0e-4 to 1.0e-3 over the relevant state regions, with larger values mainly near binding constraints, and the learned value and policy functions closely match VFI benchmarks when available. The CEFOL algorithm also works for dynamic programming problems with expected utility, as expected utility is a special case of recursive utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出确定性等价一阶学习（CEFOL）算法，一种用于求解含递归效用动态规划问题的深度学习方法。通过引入独立神经网络表示确定性等价（certainty equivalent），算法利用Bellman方程和模型特定一阶最优性条件；同时使用神经网络学习值函数、策略函数和拉格朗日乘子，并通过一阶和KKT残差直接处理控制变量上的等式与不等式约束。在风险敏感和Epstein-Zin消费-储蓄问题、小噪声鲁棒控制问题以及含递归偏好和随机波动的DSGE模型上，该方法在相关状态区域内的样本外Bellman诊断和最优性残差通常为1.0e-4至1.0e-3量级。
Motivation: 含递归效用的动态规划因非线性确定性等价出现在Bellman方程和一阶最优性条件中而难以求解，传统方法评估困难。
Method: CEFOL算法：使用一个神经网络表示确定性等价，多个神经网络分别学习值函数、策略函数和拉格朗日乘子；利用Bellman方程和模型特定一阶条件构造残差进行最小化；通过一阶和KKT残差直接处理等式/不等式约束（包括偶尔绑定的约束）。
Result: 在风险敏感和Epstein-Zin消费-储蓄问题、鲁棒控制问题及DSGE模型上，样本外Bellman残差和一阶残差在相关状态区域通常为1.0e-4至1.0e-3，接近绑定约束时稍大；学习到的值函数和策略函数与VFI基准高度一致。
Conclusion: CEFOL算法有效求解含递归效用的动态规划问题，且适用于期望效用（作为递归效用的特例）。

papers.title: Active rejection enables reliable generalization of universal machine-learning interatomic potentials
papers.abstract_en: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) bridge quantum-mechanical accuracy and large-scale molecular dynamics, but the cost of high-accuracy calculations such as r$^2$SCAN limits training to datasets that remain small relative to the open materials space. Strong average benchmark performance also does not guarantee reliable energy--force predictions for every structure. We propose Adaptive Multi-Teacher Routing (ATR), which reformulates high-fidelity data construction as a structure-wise decision problem under uncertainty. Using a small set of real r$^2$SCAN labels, ATR calibrates multiple pretrained uMLIP teachers and combines structural descriptors, teacher identity, and inter-teacher disagreement to estimate the reliability of each structure--teacher pair. It selects high-confidence predictions for pseudo-label generation and rejects structures for which no teacher is sufficiently reliable. With real r$^2$SCAN labels for only 0.2\% of candidate structures, ATR distils 2.89 million traceable r$^2$SCAN-level pseudo-labels for pretraining. On held-out r$^2$SCAN structures and the MP-r$^2$SCAN benchmark, a lightweight CHGNet trained on the ATR-generated dataset consistently outperforms the baseline and non-routed controls. Finite-temperature molecular dynamics further shows that ATR improves dynamical robustness across multiple material systems, maintaining stable trajectories where baseline simulations undergo catastrophic structural collapse. These results establish active rejection as an effective mechanism for converting multiple pretrained uMLIPs into a scalable and reliable data-construction system for high-fidelity uMLIPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应多教师路由（ATR），通过主动拒绝机制从少量高精度r2SCAN标签生成大规模伪标签，用于训练通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIP）。仅在0.2%的结构上使用真实标签，即生成289万可追溯的r2SCAN级伪标签，使轻量级CHGNet在多个基准和有限温度分子动力学中超越基线，避免结构崩溃。
Motivation: 通用机器学习原子间势因高精度计算成本高导致训练数据有限，且平均基准性能无法保证每个结构的可靠预测。
Method: ATR将高保真数据构建视为结构级不确定性决策问题：利用少量真实r2SCAN标签校准多个预训练uMLIP教师，结合结构描述符、教师身份和教师间分歧估计每个结构-教师对的可靠性，选择高置信度预测生成伪标签，拒绝不可靠结构。
Result: 在仅使用0.2%候选结构的真实r2SCAN标签下，ATR生成289万伪标签；在MP-r2SCAN基准和有限温度分子动力学中，ATR训练的轻量级CHGNet性能优于基线和非路由对照，维持稳定轨迹而基线出现结构崩溃。
Conclusion: 主动拒绝机制能将多个预训练uMLIP转化为可扩展且可靠的高保真数据构造系统，提升通用势的泛化能力。

papers.title: Hydra++: Real-Time Hierarchical 3D Scene Graph Construction With Object-Level Shape Estimation
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene graphs provide a hierarchical abstraction of environments by encoding spatial entities, such as objects and places, and their relationships. However, existing scene graph systems model object geometry coarsely, relying on partial point clouds or class-level CAD templates, which limits instance-specific shape detail. This paper presents Hydra++, a system-level investigation into how learning-based object shape estimators can be integrated into a hierarchical 3D scene graph pipeline. Hydra++ incorporates category-agnostic shape estimation and a reprojection-mask consistency check to reject degenerate predictions from partial observations or imprecise segmentation. In its default CRISP-based configuration, Hydra++ performs online scene graph construction; slower estimators such as SAM3D are evaluated as modular alternatives to demonstrate generalization-latency trade-offs. Furthermore, to address the challenges of sparse and noisy depth measurements in outdoor environments, Hydra++ supports a hybrid LiDAR-camera configuration for large-scale operation, improving scene-level reconstruction quality. Experiments in both simulation and real-world outdoor campus scenarios demonstrate that Hydra++ improves object- and scene-level reconstruction quality. Project page is available at https://hydra-plusplus.github.io/.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 12 figures, accepted in Proc. IEEE/RSJ IROS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hydra++，一个集成学习式物体形状估计的层次化3D场景图构建系统，支持在线场景图构建，并在室外场景中通过混合LiDAR-相机配置提升重建质量。
Motivation: 现有3D场景图系统对物体几何的建模较为粗糙，依赖部分点云或类别级CAD模板，缺乏实例级形状细节。
Method: Hydra++采用类别无关的形状估计和重投影掩码一致性检查来拒绝退化预测，默认使用CRISP-based配置进行在线构建，并支持混合LiDAR-相机配置以处理室外稀疏噪声深度。
Result: 在仿真和真实室外校园场景中，Hydra++改进了物体级和场景级的重建质量。
Conclusion: Hydra++展示了将形状估计器集成到层次化3D场景图中的可行性，并在室外大尺度场景中通过多传感器配置提升了鲁棒性。

papers.title: Practical Source Code Recovery from Binary Functions Using Anchor-Based Retrieval and LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We present a practical pipeline for recovering source code from stripped binary functions by combining reverse engineering, anchor-based source code retrieval, and large language model reasoning. Our binary-to-source-code retrieval method attempts to identify the source function from a source code database, rather than generating approximate decompiled pseudocode. It extracts anchors such as strings, constants, external calls, and available function names using Ghidra, retrieves candidate files via an inverted-index search database, narrows candidates to likely function snippets, and re-ranks them with a large language model (LLM) based on disassembly, decompiled code, and source metadata. Confident matches can also serve as anchors in later passes. In an evaluation backed by our high-fidelity source code database on a stripped, optimized tcpdump binary, our proposed binary-to-source matching method achieves 95.2% assembly instruction coverage. Experiments on a GitHub-based retrieval database showed lower performance with 35.5% instruction coverage on average, mainly due to retrieval misses. These results show that source-level binary recovery excels with high-quality databases and remains a useful tool in noisy environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个实用的二进制函数源码恢复流水线，结合逆向工程、基于锚点的源码检索和大语言模型推理。该方法通过Ghidra提取字符串、常量、外部调用等锚点，利用倒排索引搜索候选文件，再使用LLM对反汇编、反编译代码和源码元数据进行重排序。在高质量源码数据库上对strip且优化的tcpdump二进制文件进行评测，汇编指令覆盖率达95.2%；在基于GitHub的检索数据库上平均覆盖率为35.5%，主要受限于检索遗漏。结果表明源码级二进制恢复在高质量数据库下表现出色，在噪声环境中仍然有用。
Motivation: 从strip二进制函数中恢复源码是逆向工程中的实际难题，现有方法多生成近似反编译伪代码，而本文尝试直接从源码数据库检索匹配的源码函数。
Method: 提出二进制到源码的检索方法：用Ghidra提取锚点（字符串、常量、外部调用、可用函数名），通过倒排索引数据库检索候选文件，缩小为可能的函数片段，再基于反汇编、反编译代码和源码元数据使用大语言模型重新排序。置信度高的匹配可在后续轮次中作为新的锚点。
Result: 在高质量源码数据库上对strip且优化的tcpdump二进制文件达到95.2%的汇编指令覆盖率；在基于GitHub的检索数据库上平均覆盖率为35.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调源码级二进制恢复在高质量数据库下表现优异，在噪声环境下仍是有用工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robustifying Vision-Language Models via Test-Time Prompt Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP achieve strong zero-shot generalization, but their performance degrades sharply under adversarial perturbations. Existing test-time adaptation methods typically rely on sample-level confidence heuristics, overlooking the intrinsic distributional structure of the data. This sample-centric approach limits robustness, as it fails to distinguish confident adversarial mispredictions from true semantic consistency. In this work, we observe that adversarial distortion is structurally brittle: while holistic representations are corrupted, semantic integrity is often preserved in the distribution of augmented views. Motivated by this insight, we propose RITA, a Robust test-tIme prompt-TAdaptation framework that shifts from sample-level estimates to distribution-level alignment. Specifically, RITA employs optimal transport to align the distribution of augmented visual features with textual prototypes, mitigating adversarial outliers and rectifying cross-modal semantic misalignment. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic cache to progressively accumulate reliable cues from the test stream for online refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RITA significantly improves adversarial robustness without compromising clean accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RITA，一种测试时提示自适应框架，通过最优传输（optimal transport）将增强视觉特征分布与文本原型对齐，以提升视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在对抗扰动下的鲁棒性，同时保持干净精度。实验表明该方法显著改善对抗鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法依赖样本级置信度启发式，忽略数据内在分布结构，难以区分对抗性误判与真实语义一致性，限制了鲁棒性。
Method: 提出RITA框架，采用最优传输对齐增强视觉特征的分布与文本原型，并引入动态缓存逐步积累测试流中的可靠线索进行在线精炼。
Result: 实验证明RITA显著提升对抗鲁棒性，且不损害干净精度。
Conclusion: 从样本级估计转向分布级对齐能有效缓解对抗扰动带来的跨模态语义错位。

papers.title: How Does Bayesian Causal Discovery Fail? Characterising Structural Consequences in Linear Gaussian Networks under Latent Confounding
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian causal discovery is widely used for its ability to quantify epistemic uncertainty over directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) through posterior inference. However, its behaviour under latent confounding remains poorly understood, as existing work typically notes that confounding breaks identifiability without characterising how the posterior distribution over DAGs responds. In this work, we analyse posterior behaviour under latent confounding in linear Gaussian causal models, focusing on additive latent confounding between exactly two observed variables. We derive a critical correlation threshold above which the score function favours graphs with a spurious edge between the confounded variables, and show that this threshold decreases with sample size -- more data lowers the correlation required for the spurious edge to be favoured. Beyond this threshold, we characterize two distinct posterior failure regimes determined by the local structure around the confounded variables. Our findings are supported by exact posterior computations on multiple graph structures, demonstrating both the predicted failure regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析线性高斯因果模型中，潜在混淆变量如何影响贝叶斯结构学习的后验分布。在双变量加性混淆下，推导出一个关键相关阈值，超过该阈值后评分函数会偏爱包含虚假边的图结构；且该阈值随样本量增加而降低。进一步刻画了两种后验失效模式，并通过精确后验计算验证。
Motivation: 现有工作仅指出混淆破坏可识别性，但未系统描述后验分布如何响应混淆。本文旨在填补这一空白，为贝叶斯因果发现在混淆下的失效机制提供理论刻画。
Method: 针对线性高斯因果模型，考虑两个观测变量之间的加性潜在混淆，推导评分函数偏好虚假边的相关阈值，并结合局部结构分析后验失效模式。
Result: 推导出相关阈值随样本量增加而降低；当超过阈值时，后验倾向于包含虚假边的图，且存在两种由局部结构决定的失效模式。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯因果发现对潜在混淆敏感，虚假边在数据量增大时更容易被支持，用户应警惕此类偏差。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Vision-Language Adaptation with Continuous Metadata Conditioning for Animal Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Long-term animal re-identification (ReID) must remain robust to gradual morphological evolution and seasonal appearance shifts. Although recent vision-language models provide strong pretrained visual representations, adapting them to longitudinal ecological settings remains challenging, particularly under identity and temporal distribution shifts. We present a parameter-efficient CLIP adaptation framework for animal ReID and introduce a continuous metadata-conditioning mechanism that incorporates numerical attributes directly into the prompt representation during training. While low-rank visual adaptation, prompt-based supervision, and cross-modal alignment provide the adaptation framework, the proposed metadata-conditioning strategy constitutes the primary methodological contribution. By preserving the continuous structure of numerical metadata rather than discretizing it into textual categories, the proposed approach enables smooth modulation of the embedding space during training while maintaining a purely visual inference pipeline. Experiments on a seven-year longitudinal fish dataset and multiple wildlife benchmarks demonstrate improved performance under closed-set, open-set, and time-aware evaluation protocols. The results demonstrate that continuous metadata conditioning improves robustness to longitudinal appearance variation and temporal distribution shifts, while parameter-efficient adaptation enables a purely visual inference pipeline without requiring metadata at test time. Code and evaluation splits can be found at: https://github.com/AnilOsmanTur/MetaPrompt-ReID.
papers.comment: This is the author's version of the paper accepted for publication in Expert Systems with Applications. The final authenticated version will be available from the publisher
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种参数高效的CLIP适配框架用于动物重识别（ReID），主要贡献是连续元数据条件机制（continuous metadata conditioning），在训练时将数值属性直接整合到提示表示中，平滑调节嵌入空间，测试时保持纯视觉推理。在七年纵向鱼类数据集和多个野生动物基准上，该方法在闭集、开集和时间感知评估下均提升了性能，尤其对纵向外观变化和时间分布偏移具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 动物重识别需应对形态演变和季节外观变化，现有视觉语言模型在纵向生态场景中适配困难，且元数据通常被离散化导致信息损失。
Method: 基于CLIP的参数高效适配框架，结合低秩视觉适配、提示监督和跨模态对齐，核心创新是连续元数据条件机制，将数值元数据直接嵌入提示表示，避免离散化。
Result: 在七年鱼类数据集及多个野生动物基准上，连续元数据条件提升了闭集、开集和时间感知协议下的性能，对纵向外观和时间分布偏移更鲁棒，且测试时无需元数据。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法通过连续元数据条件有效改善长期动物重识别中分布偏移的鲁棒性，参数高效适配保持纯视觉推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Near-optimal node-private community estimation in polynomial-time
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we resolve an open question of Klopp & Zadik (2026) by providing a high-probability polynomial-time, node-private algorithm which nearly matches the performance of their exponential-time node-private algorithm for exact recovery in stochastic block models. Our result involves an explicitly constructed Lipschitz surrogate for the penalized likelihood function, as well as a carefully devised accept-reject algorithm that samples community labels from the corresponding exponential mechanism in polynomial-time. We rigorously analyze the privacy, runtime, and utility of our proposed algorithm, showing that even when the number of communities K grows logarithmically with the number of nodes n, we can achieve the minimax rates for exact recovery with the privacy parameter epsilon growing as log(n), thus matching known lower bounds on the cost of privacy for this setting.

Method: 构造惩罚似然函数的Lipschitz连续代理，并设计接受-拒绝算法从指数机制中高效采样社区标签，从而在保护节点隐私的同时实现多项式时间运行。

Conclusion: 节点隐私社区估计可在多项式时间内实现近最优性能，且隐私损失与已知下界一致。

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling for Small VLMs on Multilingual Visual MCQ
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling (TTS) reliably improves reasoning in large language models, but whether it transfers to small open vision-language models remains unclear. We examine this on EXAMS-V, a multilingual visual multiple-choice benchmark, comparing self-consistency, describe-then-reason with PRM-guided beam search, and two post-hoc selectors across Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and Qwen3.5-4B. What matters is the conditions under which TTS runs, not the search or verification machinery. The largest factor is parseability: an early prompt format left many chains reasoning correctly yet never committing to an answer letter, which a standard answer cue and a guided repair step largely remove. A larger decoding budget removes the rest: raising the per-chain token limit from 1k to 2k recovers 3.7 pp, whereas sampling more chains (8 to 16) adds only 0.15 pp. Once chains have room to finish, elaborate methods contribute little: PRM-guided beam search trails plain self-consistency by 0.39 pp at over eight times the cost, and neither a training-free generative critic nor a trained multimodal PRM beats majority vote across both policies. The largest gain comes instead from the policy model itself (+11.4 pp). Our best configuration reaches 84.1% on the held-out ImageCLEF 2026 test split, ranking first on the Visual MCQ leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究测试时扩展（Test-Time Scaling, TTS）在小参数视觉语言模型（VLMs）上的多语言视觉多项选择题（Visual MCQ）任务中的表现。实验基于EXAMS-V基准和Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-4B模型，发现TTS的效果主要取决于解析能力（parseability）而非搜索或验证机制，提升解码token数比增加采样链数更有效，且自一致性（self-consistency）优于基于PRM的束搜索等方法。最佳配置在ImageCLEF 2026测试集上达到84.1%，位列排行榜第一。
Motivation: 大语言模型的TTS已能可靠提升推理能力，但该技术是否适用于小参数、开放的视觉语言模型尚不明确，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 在EXAMS-V多语言视觉选择题基准上，对比了自一致性、描述-推理（describe-then-reason）结合PRM引导束搜索、以及两种后验选择器，并分析了早期提示格式与解析能力、解码预算等因素的影响。
Result: 解析能力是TTS生效的最大因素，标准答案提示和引导修复可解决早期格式问题；将每链token数从1k增至2k带来3.7个百分点提升，而链数从8增至16仅提升0.15个百分点；PRM引导束搜索在自一致性基础上仅降低0.39个百分点且成本高8倍；模型自身策略升级带来11.4个百分点的最大增益。最佳配置在ImageCLEF 2026保留测试集上达84.1%。
Conclusion: TTS在小VLM上的有效性高度依赖于确保推理链能完整输出答案，而复杂的搜索方法收益有限；主要增益来自基础模型能力的提升。

papers.title: comprisk: A scikit-learn-compatible Python toolkit for competing-risks survival analysis
papers.abstract_en: Medical time-to-event data are frequently subject to competing risks, where the occurrence of one terminal event precludes the others and standard survival methods that treat competing events as censoring yield biased absolute-risk estimates. Correct analysis instead targets the cause-specific cumulative incidence function (CIF). This methodology has been available to applied researchers almost exclusively through R packages, forcing Python-based machine-learning workflows into a Python-to-R round trip. We present comprisk, a scikit-learn-compatible Python toolkit that consolidates the canonical competing-risks methods (a scalable competing-risks random survival forest together with Fine-Gray subdistribution-hazard regression including a penalized variant, cause-specific Cox regression, the Aalen-Johansen CIF estimator, and Gray's K-sample test) behind a single, consistent API, and adds competing-risks-aware model evaluation (inverse probability of censoring weighted time-dependent AUC and Brier score, cause-specific concordance indices with closed-form confidence intervals, and calibration curves). Every estimator is validated numerically against the established R reference implementations. The forest uses a histogram-based, numba-compiled split kernel that fits 10-22x faster than randomForestSRC at comparable discrimination on real electronic-health-record cohorts and scales to n = 10^6 on a consumer CPU. comprisk is distributed on PyPI and lets applied researchers perform correct and scalable competing-risks analysis entirely within the Python scientific stack.
papers.comment: 5 pages. Software paper; package available on PyPI (pip install comprisk). Code archived on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.19876282
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 comprisk，一个与 scikit-learn 兼容的 Python 工具包，用于竞争风险生存分析。它整合了经典方法（随机生存森林、Fine-Gray 回归等）并采用基于直方图、numba 编译的分割核，拟合速度比 R 实现快 10-22 倍，可扩展到百万样本。所有估计器均通过 R 参考实现验证。
Motivation: 医学时间事件数据常面临竞争风险，标准生存方法将竞争事件视为删失会导致有偏估计，而正确分析方法（如 CIF）几乎仅存在于 R 包中，迫使基于 Python 的工作流进行 Python 到 R 的转换。
Method: 提出 comprisk，提供一致的 scikit-learn 风格 API，包含竞争风险随机生存森林、Fine-Gray 回归（含惩罚版）、因果特异性 Cox 回归、Aalen-Johansen CIF 估计、Gray's K 样本检验，以及竞争风险感知的模型评估（IPCW 加权时间依赖 AUC、Brier 分数、一致性指数等）。森林采用直方图基的 numba 编译分割核。
Result: 摘要报告森林拟合速度比 randomForestSRC 快 10-22 倍，在电子健康记录队列上判别能力相当，且可在消费级 CPU 上扩展至 n=10^6。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 comprisk 让应用研究人员能够完全在 Python 科学栈中进行正确且可扩展的竞争风险分析。

papers.title: Multimodal Scenario Similarity Search for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale autonomous-driving datasets contain vast numbers of recorded scenarios, creating a need for efficient retrieval methods that can identify situations similar to a given query. Existing approaches typically rely on either visual representations or motion-based descriptions, making it difficult to understand their relative strengths and limitations for scenario retrieval. In this work, we present a multimodal framework for autonomous-driving scenario retrieval that combines visual and trajectory-based representations within a unified retrieval pipeline. We investigate two trajectory-based approaches: Exo-Trajectory, an explicit matching method based on surrounding-agent motion, and ScenarioFormer, a transformer-based representation learned from object trajectories using contrastive learning. We compare these approaches against strong vision-based baselines and analyze their behavior across a diverse set of driving scenarios. Experimental results show that trajectory representations provide strong retrieval performance for motion-centric events such as cut-ins, turning maneuvers, and traffic queueing, while visual embeddings excel when appearance cues are informative. Most importantly, combining visual and trajectory information consistently improves retrieval quality, yielding the best overall performance. These findings demonstrate that appearance and motion capture are complementary notions of scenario similarity and motivate multimodal retrieval systems for autonomous-driving data mining, dataset curation, and scenario-based validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶大规模数据集中的场景检索问题，提出一种多模态框架，融合视觉表示与基于轨迹的表示（显式匹配的Exo-Trajectory和基于对比学习的Transformer模型ScenarioFormer）。实验表明，轨迹表示在运动中心事件（如切入、转弯、排队）上检索性能强，视觉表示在外观信息重要时更好，两者结合一致提升检索质量，达到最佳整体性能。结论指出外观和运动是互补的场景相似性概念，支持多模态检索系统。
Motivation: 现有场景检索方法要么只基于视觉表示，要么只基于运动描述，难以理解其相对优势与局限，缺乏统一的多模态检索框架。
Method: 提出多模态检索框架，融合视觉特征与两种轨迹表示方法：Exo-Trajectory（显式匹配周围车辆运动轨迹）和ScenarioFormer（基于对比学习的Transformer从对象轨迹学习表示）。与强视觉基线进行对比分析。
Result: 轨迹表示在切入、转弯、排队等运动中心场景中检索性能优异，视觉表示在依赖外观线索时表现更好；两者结合一致提升检索质量，实现最佳整体性能。
Conclusion: 外观和运动是互补的场景相似性概念，多模态检索对自动驾驶数据挖掘、数据集整理和场景验证具有重要价值。

papers.title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
papers.abstract_en: We present Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign, open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) hybrid Mamba Transformer foundation model for German and English. Its hybrid design activates only 3B of 30B parameters per token and keeps the inference cache near-constant as context grows, giving it a decisive throughput advantage over dense models for long-context, high-concurrency deployment. Pretrained on roughly 27 trillion tokens with deliberately up-weighted German, Soofi S matches dense 14 to 27B models on aggregate English and German benchmarks while achieving the best code aggregates in both languages among 17 open base models, and outperforms every European sovereign baseline in our comparison, including ones far larger in active parameters. Among fully open models, Soofi S obtains the highest English and German evaluation scores, ahead of Olmo 3 32B and Apertus 70B. Soofi S was built end-to-end on the German Industrial AI Cloud, a sovereign HPC scale AI infrastructure operated by Deutsche Telekom in Munich. Soofi S will be released under highly permissive, open-access terms: weights, selected intermediate checkpoints, full per-source data accounting, hyperparameters, and training and evaluation code. Where source licenses permit, data-construction artifacts are released under permissive licenses; commercially licensed sources are documented with aggregate statistics and exact mixture accounting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Soofi S 30B-A3B，一个主权、开源的德语和英语混合专家（MoE）Mamba Transformer基础模型。模型采用混合架构，每个token仅激活30B参数中的3B，并能随上下文增长保持近恒定推理缓存，在长上下文、高并发部署中具有吞吐优势。模型在约27万亿token上预训练，刻意提高了德语权重，在英语和德语综合基准上匹配14-27B参数密集模型，并在17个开源基础模型中取得最佳代码聚合分数，优于所有欧洲主权基线。模型将完全开源发布。
Motivation: 缺乏主权、开源且面向德语和英语的先进基础模型，现有模型在效率、透明度和语言覆盖上存在不足。
Method: 采用混合专家（MoE）的Mamba Transformer混合架构，每token仅激活30B参数中的3B；在约27万亿token上预训练，有意提高德语数据权重；在德国工业AI云上构建。
Result: 在英语和德语综合基准上匹配14-27B密集模型；在17个开源基础模型中取得最佳代码聚合分数；优于所有欧洲主权基线，包括更大激活参数的模型；在完全开源模型中取得最高的英语和德语评估分数。
Conclusion: 作者强调该模型是主权、开源的基础模型，具有高效推理和领先性能，将完全开源发布以促进研究。

papers.title: Action-Factored Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Scalable Quantum Device Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning is well suited to problems with large parameter spaces and exploitable local structure, such as the tuning of electrostatically-defined quantum-dot arrays. However, if parameter cross-talk is strong, a non-stationary environment from the perspective of any individual agent can destabilize learning - the same effect that plagues manual tuning of such systems. We propose using a factored representation of the action space, learned online, to decouple agents and minimize their interference. Our framework, QADAPT, uses this factorization to efficiently learn shared policies based on local measurements and rewards. With this modular strategy, we achieve zero-shot generalization to unseen quantum device sizes and maintain an approximately constant number of convergence steps to reach target regimes. This work provides a scalable route toward the rapid calibration of large-scale quantum processors.

papers.title: SVF-CR: Synchronized Visual-Facial Cross-Refinement for Multimodal Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Ambivalence and hesitancy are subtle behavioral states that are expressed through a combination of verbal content, facial behavior, visual context, and acoustic cues. Effective recognition therefore requires not only extracting informative unimodal representations, but also modeling how temporally aligned behavioral evidence interacts across modalities. In this paper, we propose a synchronized visual-facial cross-refinement framework (SVF-CR) with pairwise multimodal evidence fusion for ambivalence and hesitancy recognition. The proposed method first extracts whole-video segment tokens and cropped-face segment tokens using the same temporal partition. The synchronized visual and facial tokens are refined through intra-modal self-attention and bidirectional visual-facial cross-attention, allowing whole-video context and local facial behavior to mutually refine each other before evidence construction. We then construct segment-level visual-facial evidence using consistency and discrepancy modeling, followed by temporal self-attention and attention pooling. Textual and acoustic features are lightly refined through context self-attention and are fused with the enhanced visual-facial evidence at the final decision stage using pairwise evidence fusion. Experiments on the BAH (Behavioral Ambivalence/Hesitancy) public evaluation split show that the proposed synchronized visual-facial cross-refinement improves public macro-F1 over both global visual-face token fusion and synchronized evidence baselines, achieving a public macro-F1 of 0.7156. Code is available at : https://github.com/hiinnnii/BAH-Challenge-ECCV2026\_SVF-CR.

papers.title: Self-Guided Test-Time Training for Long-Context LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Long-context processing has become increasingly important for large language models (LLMs), but simply extending the context window does not guarantee effective utilization of long inputs. As input length grows, accuracy often degrades, indicating that models still struggle to identify and use the evidence most relevant to a question. A promising way to improve long-context utilization is test-time training (TTT), which treats the test context as a training example for instance-specific parameter adaptation. However, applying TTT to the entire long context is prohibitively expensive, while adapting on randomly sampled spans introduces severe noise. Because most spans in a long context are irrelevant to the specific question, training on them may even degrade the base model's performance. Our preliminary study shows that TTT is highly sensitive to training-span quality: on LongBench-v2, TTT on randomly sampled spans hurts performance, whereas TTT on oracle spans substantially improves it. Motivated by this, we propose a simple method, Self-Guided TTT (S-TTT): before adaptation, the model identifies the evidence spans it should learn from, and the standard language-modeling training objective is applied only to those selected spans. On two challenging long-context reasoning benchmarks, LongBench-v2 and LongBench-Pro, S-TTT improves accuracy for both Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, achieving up to a 15% relative improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文LLM在长输入中利用证据能力不足的问题，提出自引导测试时训练（S-TTT）方法。在适应前，模型先识别应学习的证据片段，然后仅在这些片段上应用标准语言建模训练目标。在LongBench-v2和LongBench-Pro上，S-TTT提升了Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的准确率，最高相对提升15%。
Motivation: 长上下文处理中，仅扩展上下文窗口不能保证有效利用长输入，输入长度增长时准确率下降；现有测试时训练（TTT）在整段长上下文上应用代价高，在随机采样片段上适应会引入严重噪声，甚至降低性能。
Method: 提出自引导测试时训练（S-TTT）：在适应前，模型识别应从哪些证据片段中学习，然后仅在这些选定片段上应用标准语言建模训练目标。
Result: 在LongBench-v2和LongBench-Pro上，S-TTT对Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct均提升准确率，最高相对提升15%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调TTT对训练片段质量高度敏感，S-TTT通过自引导选择证据片段来提升长上下文推理性能。

papers.title: Similarity search generalisation in contrastive learning with InfoNCE loss
papers.abstract_en: Similarity search is a primary application of embedding models trained by contrastive learning. For one of the most popular contrastive learning loss functions, InfoNCE, we show that the population risk with $k$ negative samples is $O(1/k)$ close to an expected cross-entropy which quantifies deviation between i) a softmax similarity search over unseen data using the learned embedding function, and ii) an idealised softmax search over the same data but using similarity implicitly represented in the positive sample generator. This complements existing interpretations of InfoNCE in the $k\to\infty$ limit which are phrased in terms of mutual information, and alignment versus uniformity in embeddings. To quantify generalisation performance, we introduce a new continuity bound for the InfoNCE loss, obtained via Gâteaux differentiation. The bound preserves the structure of averaging over negative samples present in the loss function and features an ``inverse temperature'' parameter which can be tuned to account for the algorithmic temperature. For embedding functions which are Lipschitz in a parameter, this yields a simple demonstration that the averaging effect of $k$ negative samples in the InfoNCE loss carries over to stabilisation of the generalisation error as $k$ grows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文从理论上分析了使用InfoNCE损失的对比学习在相似性搜索任务中的泛化性能。证明当使用k个负样本时，群体风险与一个期望交叉熵之间的差距为O(1/k)，该交叉熵量化了理想软搜索与实际嵌入软搜索的偏差。通过Gâteaux微分引入新的连续界，保留损失函数中负样本平均的结构，并包含可调节的逆温度参数。对于参数Lipschitz的嵌入函数，该界表明k个负样本的平均效应会随着k增长而稳定泛化误差。
Motivation: 对比学习广泛应用于相似性搜索，但关于InfoNCE损失泛化性能的理论理解仍然有限，现有工作主要关注k无穷大极限下的互信息或嵌入对齐与均匀性。
Method: 分析InfoNCE损失的群体风险，推导其与期望交叉熵的显式差距；通过Gâteaux微分推导信息NCE损失的连续性边界，保留负样本平均结构并引入逆温度参数以匹配算法温度。
Result: 证明使用k个负样本时群体风险与期望交叉熵的差距为O(1/k)；对于Lipschitz参数的嵌入函数，泛化误差随k增长而稳定。
Conclusion: 从理论上揭示了InfoNCE损失中负样本平均效应对泛化性能的影响，为对比学习实践提供了新的见解。

papers.title: SYNRARE: Synthetic Rare Disease EHR Generation for ML Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Motivation: Rare disease (RD) diagnosis is frequently delayed due to the similarities in symptoms to common disease variants. Machine Learning Algorithms applied to Electronic Health Records show promise for accelerating the diagnosis; however, legal and privacy concerns pose significant barriers. To address these issues, Synthetic Data Generation is an alternative method for obtaining Electronic Health Records and can be applied with any Machine Learning algorithm for benchmarking and development purposes. Despite the availability of Synthetic Data Generation algorithms, support for generating a subset of patients that differ in a definable degree from the majority to simulate patients with RD is often lacking. Results: We present SYNRARE, a graphical user interface based on the Synthea framework that enables easier modification and generation of synthetic Electronic Health Records of RD patients, which differ only to a definable degree from patients with common diseases, thereby enabling the benchmarking and testing of algorithms under controlled technical conditions. SYNRARE enables researchers to rapidly benchmark their Machine Learning algorithms across any scenario. Availability and implementation: SYNRARE, including detailed instructions for installing, is available at https://gitlab.sdu.dk/screen4care/synrare.
papers.comment: Intended for submission to the Application Notes Bioinformatics Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SYNRARE，一个基于 Synthea 框架的图形用户界面工具，用于生成罕见病患者的合成电子健康记录（EHR）。该工具允许研究者定义罕见病患者与常见病患者之间的差异程度，从而在受控条件下对机器学习算法进行基准测试和开发。文章重点介绍了工具的可用性和实现，未报告具体实验结果。
Motivation: 罕见病诊断常因症状与常见病相似而延迟，机器学习在EHR中的应用有潜力，但隐私和法律问题限制了真实数据的使用。现有合成数据生成方法缺乏对罕见病患者子集的灵活支持。
Method: SYNRARE 基于 Synthea 框架，提供图形界面以简化修改和生成过程，允许用户设定罕见病患者与常见病患者的可定义差异程度。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的性能指标或实验对比，仅说明该工具能够快速生成合成数据并支持算法基准测试。
Conclusion: SYNRARE 旨在为研究人员提供一种便捷方式，在受控技术条件下生成罕见病合成EHR，以便评估机器学习算法。

papers.title: Fictional Worldbuilding: Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration with Hierarchical Context Compression and Iterative Review
papers.abstract_en: Worldbuilding, the construction of coherent fictional worlds, is a foundational task in game design and literary creation. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new possibilities for automated content generation, but their application to worldbuilding faces three challenges: context explosion that grows linearly with the building process, the tension between creative diversity and content consistency, and the absence of automated quality assurance. This paper presents AutoWorldBuilder, a multi-agent collaborative system that addresses these challenges through five integrated components: a structured concept network with conflict detection; a DAG-based hybrid batch scheduler that groups tasks by semantic locality; a four-layer context compression mechanism achieving approximately 90% token reduction; an iterative review system with specialized Auditor agents that improves proposal pass rates from 42% to over 85%; and a skill-driven agent architecture supporting zero-code extension with differentiated temperature configuration. Two experiments across 20 diverse worldbuilding tasks, using GPT-OSS 120B and DeepSeek v3.2 as LLM backends, demonstrate a 95.0% success rate. The system generated 56-103 self-consistent concepts per world in 18-31 minutes with zero-conflict delivery. The architectural patterns validated here, including layer-as-budget compression, semantic-locality scheduling, and separation of generation and review, transfer to the broader class of knowledge-intensive, multi-agent LLM applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了AutoWorldBuilder，一个多智能体协作系统，用于自动构建连贯的虚构世界。系统通过结构化概念网络、DAG混合批调度、四层上下文压缩（实现约90%的token减少）、迭代审核机制（将提案通过率从42%提升至85%以上）以及技能驱动的智能体架构，解决了上下文爆炸、创意多样性与内容一致性之间的张力以及缺乏自动质量保证三大挑战。在20个多样化世界构建任务上，使用GPT-OSS 120B和DeepSeek v3.2作为后端，实现了95%的成功率，每个世界生成56-103个自洽概念，耗时18-31分钟，且零冲突交付。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在自动内容生成方面具有潜力，但应用于世界构建面临三个挑战：随构建过程线性增长的上下文爆炸、创意多样性与内容一致性之间的张力、缺乏自动质量保证。
Method: 提出AutoWorldBuilder，一个包含五个组件的多智能体协作系统：带冲突检测的结构化概念网络；基于语义局部性的DAG混合批调度器；四层上下文压缩机制（实现约90%的token减少）；迭代审核系统，配备专门的Auditor智能体，将提案通过率从42%提升至85%以上；支持零代码扩展和差异化温度配置的技能驱动智能体架构。
Result: 在20个多样化世界构建任务上，使用GPT-OSS 120B和DeepSeek v3.2作为LLM后端，系统实现了95%的成功率，每个世界生成56-103个自洽概念，耗时18-31分钟，且零冲突交付。
Conclusion: 论文验证的架构模式（如层即预算压缩、语义局部性调度、生成与审核分离）可迁移到更广泛的知识密集型多智能体LLM应用领域。

papers.title: Data-Efficient Deep Learning: Empirical Guidelines for Training Set Size Estimation in Inertial Sensor Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models dependency on large-scale inertial datasets presents a significant bottleneck in inertial sensor-based classification tasks, such as human activity recognition and smartphone location recognition. In these domains, data collection requires massive recording campaigns that are complex, time-consuming, and difficult to scale. Currently, data-driven guidelines for determining the minimum sample size required to reach a desired accuracy level do not exist. To address this gap, this study presents a systematic empirical evaluation of learning curve convergence rates in inertial classification. We introduce a unified framework that analyzes classification performance under both binary and multi-class scenarios, and derive an empirical formula to estimate performance relative to dataset size. Testing across six diverse, real-world datasets totaling 102.7 hours of inertial measurements demonstrates that accuracy follows a consistent logarithmic growth pattern, regardless of task complexity. Leveraging this finding, we propose a quantitative stability point metric, defined as the sample size required for the learning curve to stabilize within a predefined mean absolute percentage deviation of its asymptotic maximum. Our analysis reveals that models often reach practical stability with substantially fewer samples than traditional heuristics suggest. Ultimately, we offer a generalizable framework to extrapolate total data requirements from small-scale pilot studies, optimizing the tradeoff between recording effort and model reliability. These findings shift the prevailing paradigm from maximizing data volume toward optimizing data efficiency, offering concrete, data-backed guidelines for planning recording campaigns in inertial sensing applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对惯性传感器分类任务（如人体活动识别）中深度学习模型对大规模数据集的依赖问题，系统评估了学习曲线的收敛速率，提出了一个统一框架来分析二元和多元分类性能，并推导出经验公式来估计性能与数据集大小的关系。在六个真实数据集（总计102.7小时惯性测量）上的测试表明，准确率遵循一致的对数增长模式。基于此，定义了稳定性点度量（学习曲线稳定到渐近最大值所需样本量），发现模型通常在远少于传统启发式方法的样本量下达到实际稳定。最终提供了一个从试点研究外推总数据需求的框架，优化记录工作量与模型可靠性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 惯性传感器分类任务中数据收集耗时且难以规模化，目前缺乏确定达到期望精度所需最小样本量的数据驱动指导原则。
Method: 对学习曲线收敛速率进行系统实证评估，引入统一框架分析二元和多元分类性能，推导经验公式，并提出稳定性点度量（样本量使学习曲线稳定在渐近最大值的预定平均绝对百分比偏差内）。
Result: 在六个真实数据集上验证，准确率呈现一致的对数增长模式；模型通常能在远少于传统启发式方法建议的样本量下达到实际稳定。
Conclusion: 研究从最大化数据量转向数据效率优化，为惯性传感应用中的记录活动规划提供了具体的数据驱动指导方针。

papers.title: On-Device Adaptive Battery Power Prediction for Electric Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive power management in Electric Vehicles (EVs) requires accurate power prediction. Although deep learning models have emerged as highly effective for time-series forecasting in this domain, their performance is prone to degradation when exposed to data with distributions different from the training data. We introduce a novel approach that enables on-device learning in resource-constrained EV systems to continuously adapt pretrained battery prediction models to new, unseen data. We leverage existing pretrained models by transforming them into adaptable versions that retain critical hyperparameter knowledge from their initial training. We comprehensively investigate both online and offline model adaptation strategies. Our results demonstrate significant improvements in forecasting performance across various models and time horizons, achieving mean absolute error reductions of up to 7.49\% and 14.88\% with online and offline adaptation techniques, respectively. This study highlights the substantial benefit of on-device adaptation, resulting in enhanced battery power predictions than unadapted model deployments in real-world EV scenarios.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 tables, 5 figures; Accepted to IEEE EdgeCom 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在资源受限的电动汽车系统上进行设备端自适应学习的方法，通过将预训练模型转换为可适应版本并保留关键超参数知识，持续调整电池预测模型以适应新数据。实验表明，在线和离线自适应分别将平均绝对误差降低最多7.49%和14.88%，显著优于未自适应模型。
Motivation: 电动汽车电池功率预测中，深度学习模型在训练数据分布变化时性能会下降，而资源受限的车载系统难以支持大规模重新训练。
Method: 将预训练模型转换为可适应版本，保留初始训练的关键超参数知识，并全面研究在线和离线两种模型自适应策略，在设备端持续学习。
Result: 在线自适应将平均绝对误差降低最多7.49%，离线自适应降低最多14.88%，各种模型和时间跨度上均有一致改进。
Conclusion: 设备端自适应能显著提升电池功率预测在真实场景中的表现，优于直接部署预训练模型。

papers.title: Fully Trainable Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks and Lookup Table Networks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel method for both partial and full optimization of the connections in deep differentiable logic gate networks (LGNs) and lookup table networks (LUTNs). Our training method utilizes a probability distribution over a set of connections per gate/lookup table (LUT) input pin, selecting the connection with highest merit, all whilst the optimal gate types or LUT-entries are learned in parallel. We show that the connection-optimized LGNs outperform standard fixed-connection LGNs on the Yin-Yang, MNIST Handwritten Digits and Fashion-MNIST benchmarks, while requiring only a fraction of the number of logic gates. We achieve 98.92% on the MNIST dataset with two layers of 8000 gates. With only one layer of 8000 gates, we obtain 98.45%, showing that our method requires almost 50 times fewer gates compared to fixed-connection LGNs. Training stability up to ten layers has been ensured by employing a high learning rate, straight-through estimators and trimming constant-output gate types. Additionally, we present a LUT neuron description that enables stable training with backpropagation, tested up to 6-layer deep networks. The model requires four times fewer trainable parameters and still achieves a higher accuracy compared to the fixed-connection LGN training algorithm. Our connection-training algorithm also works well for the LUTNs, achieving an accuracy of 98.88% for two layers of 2000 6-input LUTs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可端到端训练的深度可微分逻辑门网络和查找表网络，通过为每个门/查找表输入引脚维护连接的概率分布并选择最优连接，同时学习门类型或查找表条目。在Yin-Yang、MNIST和Fashion-MNIST基准上，连接优化的逻辑门网络在显著减少门数量的情况下超越了固定连接网络。在MNIST上，两层8000门达到98.92%准确率，比固定连接网络少约50倍门数。还提出了稳定的LUT神经元描述，支持6层深度网络的训练。
Motivation: 可微分逻辑门网络和查找表网络中的连接通常是固定的，限制了模型的表达能力和效率。需要一种方法同时优化连接和门类型或查找表条目。
Method: 对每个门/查找表输入引脚维护一个概率分布，选择具有最高得分的连接，同时并行学习最佳门类型或查找表条目。使用高学习率、直通估计器和修剪常数输出门类型来保证训练稳定性。
Result: 在Yin-Yang、MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上，连接优化的逻辑门网络优于固定连接网络。MNIST两层8000门达到98.92%，一层8000门达到98.45%，门数量减少约50倍。查找表网络两层2000个6输入LUT达到98.88%。
Conclusion: 该方法显著减少了门或查找表的数量，同时提高了准确率，展示了连接优化的有效性。训练稳定性在高达十层网络中得到保证，但该方法目前仅在图像分类基准上验证，未涉及天气预测等应用领域。

papers.title: STEEL: Sparsity-Aware Fused Attention for Energy-Efficient Long-Sequence Inference on AMD's XDNA NPU
papers.abstract_en: The growing adoption of large language model-based agents within operating system workflows has increased the importance of energy-efficient inference on laptop-class systems-on-chip (SoCs). While cloud offloading remains common, it introduces reliability and privacy concerns that are particularly problematic for agentic workloads. Recent laptop SoCs, therefore, incorporate neural processing engines (NPUs) optimized for energy efficiency; however, effectively mapping attention mechanisms onto NPUs remains challenging due to architectural diversity and explicit data-movement programming models. In this work, we present STEEL, the first open-source implementation of FlashAttention targeting XDNA-like NPUs. STEEL introduces a dataflow formulation of prefill attention, enabling efficient exploitation of spatial parallelism and on-chip memory. Furthermore, STEEL addresses the load imbalance induced by the causal mask by leveraging a sparsity-aware pipeline placement onto the NPU array, reducing synchronization overhead and improving utilization. We evaluate STEEL on the AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 SoC and compare its performance against optimized CPU and GPU implementations. Experimental results show that STEEL reduces energy consumption by an average of 9.17x and 1.75x relative to CPU and GPU baselines, respectively. On XDNA 1, STEEL achieves an average 9.6x latency reduction over the prior state of the art, and delivers a 22.8x speedup on average compared to a layer-by-layer attention implementation on XDNA 2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STEEL，首个面向XDNA类NPU的开源FlashAttention实现，通过稀疏感知的流水线放置和空间并行数据流设计，在AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 SoC上实现长序列推理的能效提升。实验表明，相比CPU和GPU基线，能耗分别降低9.17倍和1.75倍；在XDNA 1上延迟比先前最优降低9.6倍，在XDNA 2上比逐层注意力实现加速22.8倍。
Motivation: 在笔记本SoC上运行大语言模型代理时，云卸载存在可靠性和隐私问题，而NPU虽能效优化，但注意力机制因架构多样和显式数据移动编程模型难以有效映射。
Method: 提出面向XDNA NPU的FlashAttention开源实现，采用预填充注意力的数据流公式以利用空间并行性和片上内存，并通过稀疏感知的流水线放置解决因果掩码引起的负载不均问题。
Result: 在AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 SoC上，能耗相比CPU和GPU分别降低9.17倍和1.75倍；在XDNA 1上延迟较先前最优降低9.6倍，在XDNA 2上比逐层注意力实现加速22.8倍。
Conclusion: STEEL证明了在NPU上高效实现注意力机制的可行性，为 laptop-class SoC 上的节能推理提供了新方案。

papers.title: Learning Physics-Informed Surrogate Model of Linear Elastic Displacement Fields from Geometry
papers.abstract_en: This work aims to develop a fast and physically consistent surrogate model for real-time structural health monitoring of fractured elastic domains. We propose a physics-informed DeepONet framework that predicts displacement fields from both boundary conditions and fracture geometry, using a dedicated encoding strategy for the latter and without relying on finite-element-generated training data. The traction-free condition on the fracture boundary is imposed weakly through a localized penalty term. The presented numerical example focuses on one representative fracture geometry, demonstrating the feasibility of the formulation and laying the groundwork for extensions to surrogate modeling across diverse fracture geometries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理信息的DeepONet框架，用于实时结构健康监测中弹性断裂区域的位移场预测。该方法直接从边界条件和断裂几何预测位移场，无需有限元生成训练数据，并通过局部惩罚项弱施加断裂边界的无牵引条件。数值示例表明该框架在代表性断裂几何上的可行性。
Motivation: 现有结构健康监测方法依赖有限元模拟，计算成本高，难以实现实时预测；需要一种快速且物理一致的代理模型。
Method: 提出物理信息DeepONet，通过专用编码策略处理断裂几何，使用局部惩罚项弱施加断裂边界上的无牵引条件，避免依赖有限元训练数据。
Result: 数值示例证明所提框架在代表性断裂几何上能够预测位移场，验证了公式的可行性。
Conclusion: 该工作为扩展到多种断裂几何的代理建模奠定了基础，但当前仅展示单一几何的示例，未来需验证泛化性。

papers.title: When Routes Run Out: Adversarial Co-Learning and Explainable Robustness in Quantum Repeater Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study an adversarial bandit problem for entanglement-based quantum-network routing over a modest graph corpus. Alice selects an end-to-end repeater route for an Ekert-91 protocol (E91) representing her move, while Eve selects an attack surface, either edge intercept--resend or repeater memory degradation. Payoffs are drawn from cached SeQUeNCe-simulated E91 transcripts, and Alice accepts a turn when the finite-sample statistic violates the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) bound. Performing adversarial co-learning across 50 structured topologies, we find that learned retention tracks a full-matrix minimax reference closely (Pearson $r=0.99$): under a one-surface Eve action model, bottleneck families have zero retention, while non-bottleneck families follow a $1-1/N$ coverage principle. We then fit decision-tree explanation models to graph-, attack-, and route-level topology-corpus targets and report their faithfulness. Finally, we construct prompt records for local language models to summarize the tree evidence, resulting in an open-source explanation workflow for quantum-repeater network games.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, submitted to IEEE QCE26, Workshop on Q-GenAI: Synergies between QC & GenAI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究量子中继网络中的对抗性bandit路由问题，通过模拟E91协议，Alice选择路由，Eve选择攻击方式，利用CHSH不等式检测异常。在50种拓扑上学习，发现保留率与全矩阵极小参考高度相关（Pearson r=0.99）。然后使用决策树解释模型并构建提示记录以总结证据，形成一个开源解释工作流。
Motivation: 量子中继网络面临路由选择和攻击风险，需要鲁棒性和可解释性。
Method: 使用对抗性协同学习（adversarial co-learning），基于SeQUeNCe模拟的E91转录，通过CHSH违反统计来接受回合。然后拟合决策树解释模型。
Result: 学习保留率与全矩阵极小参考的Pearson r=0.99；瓶颈族保留率为零，非瓶颈族遵循1-1/N覆盖原则。
Conclusion: 提供了一个用于量子中继网络游戏的开放解释工作流。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present Mach-Mind-4-Flash, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic model with 3B activated parameters. Through post-training optimization alone without scaling pre-training compute, the model achieves performance on par with or surpassing that of 100B-parameter-class models. By introducing scalable agentic interaction environments for large-scale reinforcement learning, the model attains significant performance gains on real-world application tasks. Our pipeline comprises three stages: (1) a unified RL/OPD training infrastructure with dynamic multi-teacher scheduling and operator-level acceleration, delivering 17\% end-to-end training speedup; (2) multiple domain-specific RL experts trained in parallel across Reasoning, General, and Agent tracks, then fused into a single generalist via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) -- a routed reverse-KL objective that eliminates the see-saw degradation of mixed-reward RL; (3) Hybrid Median-length Policy Optimization (HMPO), a single-stage token-efficiency method that compresses reasoning chains by 19--46\% with $\le$0.7 percentage-point accuracy loss. Mach-Mind-4-Flash scores 92.70 on AIME'26, 82.82 on IFBench, 80.74 on Behavioral-SafetyBench, 75.80 on BFCL-v4, 72.31 on BrowseComp-zh, and 84.20 on ClawBench -- leading or matching models with 10--30$\times$ its activated size at a fraction of the inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Mach-Mind-4-Flash，一个 35B 参数 MoE 模型（3B 激活参数），仅通过后训练优化（不增加预训练算力）即达到或超越 100B 参数模型的性能。后训练流程包括：(1) 统一 RL/OPD 基础设施，加速 17%；(2) 多领域专家并行训练后通过 Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) 融合，避免混合奖励的跷跷板退化；(3) Hybrid Median-length Policy Optimization (HMPO) 压缩推理链 19–46% 且精度损失 ≤0.7 百分点。模型在 AIME'26、IFBench、Behavioral-SafetyBench 等基准上领先或持平 10–30 倍激活参数模型，推理成本显著降低。
Motivation: 大模型推理成本高昂，后训练优化可提升效率，但混合多个奖励信号进行 RL 时往往出现跷跷板退化（一个能力提升另一个下降），需要有效的多专家融合方法。
Method: 提出三阶段后训练流水线：(1) 统一 RL/在线策略蒸馏 (OPD) 训练系统，支持动态多教师调度和算子级加速；(2) 分别在推理、通用、智能体三条轨道上并行训练领域专家，然后通过 MOPD（基于路由的反向 KL 散度目标）融合成单一通用模型，消除混合奖励的退化；(3) HMPO 单阶段方法，通过中长序列策略优化在保持精度前提下减少推理 token 数。
Result: AIME'26 得分 92.70，IFBench 82.82，Behavioral-SafetyBench 80.74，BFCL-v4 75.80，BrowseComp-zh 72.31，ClawBench 84.20，与 10–30 倍激活参数模型性能相当或更优，推理成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: 仅通过后训练优化，小激活参数的 MoE 模型即可达到超大模型的性能，证明了后训练（尤其是多专家在线蒸馏和混合长度策略优化）在提升效率与能力方面的关键作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph Neural Networks for Scalable and Transferable Node Centrality Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide a learning-based framework for approximating graph quantities that are expensive to compute exactly. This paper investigates GNNs for scalable approximation of betweenness and closeness centrality, formulated as a node-ranking problem. Exact centrality values are used as supervision, and ranking quality is evaluated using Kendall's tau rank correlation. We study whether message-passing GNNs can learn transferable structural representations across different graph topologies rather than only fitting the distribution used during training. On unseen Erdos renyi graphs, the proposed models achieve tau = 0.851 for betweenness and tau = 0.894 for closeness. A large-scale betweenness model trained on graphs with N = 5,000 nodes achieves tau = 0.938, demonstrating scalability. Mixed-distribution training on Erdos renyi, Barabasi-Albert, and Gaussian Random Partition graphs improves betweenness transfer across graph families. In contrast, closeness centrality remains more sensitive to community-structured graphs and shows reduced transfer to real-world topologies. Finally, GNN inference achieves up to a 97.7x speedup over exact computation. These results show that mixed-distribution training can improve structural transfer in GNN-based centrality approximation, while identifying closeness centrality's sensitivity to topology as an open challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用图神经网络（GNN）近似计算节点介数中心性和接近中心性，将其建模为节点排序问题。在未见过的Erdos-Renyi图上，介数中心性达到Kendall tau=0.851，接近中心性达到0.894；在5000节点的大规模图上介数中心性达到0.938。混合分布训练可提升跨图族系的迁移能力，但接近中心性对社区结构敏感。GNN推理相比精确计算加速达97.7倍。
Motivation: 精确计算介数中心性和接近中心性在大规模图上计算成本高，现有近似方法缺乏可扩展性和可迁移性。
Method: 使用消息传递GNN以精确中心性值作为监督学习节点排名，评估采用Kendall tau秩相关；训练数据包含Erdos-Renyi、Barabasi-Albert、Gaussian Random Partition等图分布。
Result: 在未见Erdos-Renyi图上介数tau=0.851，接近tau=0.894；5000节点图上介数tau=0.938；混合分布训练提升介数跨族系迁移；GNN推理加速达97.7倍。
Conclusion: 混合分布训练可改善GNN中心性近似的结构迁移能力，但接近中心性对拓扑敏感仍是开放挑战。
Relevance: 0
