papers.title: Spectrally Deconfounded Gradient Boosting
papers.abstract_en: Flexible machine-learning methods can be sensitive to hidden confounding: they may learn associations induced by unobserved confounders rather than stable signals. Spectral deconfounding mitigates this problem by shrinking high-variance directions of the covariate matrix that, under dense confounding, carry latent confounder information. Existing work has largely focused on linear models. We develop a nonlinear spectral deconfounding framework for gradient boosting. Our approach replaces the ordinary squared-error loss by a spectral loss, which alters the boosting dynamics by slowing down learning in confounding-aligned directions. We show that deconfounding is not achieved by the spectral loss alone, but by the interaction between spectral shrinkage and regularization, especially in terms of early stopping. Moreover, we provide a mixed-model interpretation that connects LAVA-type shrinkage to random-effects adjustment and yields an empirical-Bayes procedure for tuning the spectral loss. We also extend the method to general likelihoods and nonlinear confounding using Laplace approximations and kernel random effects. Across synthetic and real-world experiments, spectrally deconfounded boosting improves estimation of the target function under hidden confounding and is substantially more scalable than existing nonlinear spectral deconfounding baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对梯度提升中的隐混淆问题，提出一种谱解混框架，通过谱损失减缓与混淆对齐方向的学习速度。作者证明解混效果依赖于谱收缩与早停正则化的相互作用，并将其扩展到广义似然和非线性混淆场景。实验表明该方法在隐混淆下改进了目标函数估计，且比现有非线性谱解混基线更具可扩展性。
Motivation: 灵活的机器学习方法容易受到隐混淆的影响，学习由未观测混淆变量导致的关联而非稳定信号。现有谱解混工作主要聚焦于线性模型，缺乏对非线性模型如梯度提升的支持。
Method: 提出非线性谱解混框架，将普通平方误差损失替换为谱损失，通过减缓混淆对齐方向的学习以改变提升动力学。利用混合模型解释连接LAVA型收缩与随机效应调整，并给出经验贝叶斯程序用于调参。扩展到一般似然和非线性混淆，使用拉普拉斯逼近和核随机效应。
Result: 在合成和真实实验中，谱解混梯度提升在隐混淆下改进了目标函数估计，且比现有非线性谱解混基线显著更具可扩展性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过谱损失与正则化的相互作用实现解混，并提供了混合模型解释和扩展，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Diversifying to Verify: When Task-Equivalent Programs Differ in Verifiability
papers.abstract_en: Program verification is crucial for software correctness, but producing fully verified programs remains difficult in practice. This paper studies whether implementation structure affects automated verifiability when multiple generated programs are intended to satisfy the same task-level semantics. We present Diversify2Verify, a staged LLM-based pipeline for Why3 that infers representation-specific contracts, generates and tests diverse recursive and imperative array/list implementations, and attempts verification with bounded verifier-guided annotation repair. We also construct a verification-oriented benchmark of 73 tasks over integers, arrays, and lists, yielding 292 implementation variants. Diversify2Verify verifies 96 artifacts initially and 154 after two repair passes, improving artifact-level verification from 32.9% to 52.7%. At the task level, at least one variant verifies for 49 of 73 tasks, a 67.1% success rate. These results show that task-equivalent implementations can differ substantially in verifiability and that implementation diversity helps find verification-friendly artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究程序验证中实现结构对自动化可验证性的影响。提出 Diversify2Verify，一种基于 LLM 的分阶段流水线，为 Why3 生成多种递归和命令式数组/列表实现，并通过有界验证器引导的注释修复进行验证。在 73 个任务的基准上，该方法初始验证 96 个工件，两轮修复后验证 154 个，工件级验证率从 32.9% 提升至 52.7%，任务级至少一个变体验证成功率达 67.1%，表明任务等价的不同实现在可验证性上存在显著差异，且多样性有助于找到可验证的工件。
Motivation: 完全验证程序在实践中仍然困难，需要探究实现结构是否影响自动化可验证性。
Method: Diversify2Verify 流水线：为 Why3 推断表示特定的契约，生成并测试多样化的递归和命令式数组/列表实现，使用有界验证器引导的注释修复进行迭代验证。
Result: 在 73 个任务（292 个实现变体）上，初始验证 96 个工件，两轮修复后验证 154 个；工件级验证率从 32.9% 提升至 52.7%，任务级至少一个变体验证成功率为 67.1%。
Conclusion: 任务等价的实现在可验证性上可差异显著，实现多样性有助于找到更易验证的工件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CtrlVTON: Controllable Virtual Try-On via Visual-Instance-Prompt Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Virtual try-on (VTO) has made significant progress in realistically transferring garments onto a target person. Yet most systems give the user little control over how a garment should be worn -- its size (loose or fitted), style (e.g., tucked in or untucked, open or closed), and spatial placement on the body. We address this gap with two complementary contributions. First, we define and solve Visual-Instance-Prompt Segmentation via VIP-SAM: given a flatlay image of a garment, segment that specific instance in a photograph of a person wearing it. This is an instance-level task, distinct from the typically studied category-level segmentation. Second, we introduce CtrlVTON, a controllable VTO framework that recasts try-on as an image editing problem and adds segmentation masks as pixel-level control over garment layout, including style, size, and spatial placement on the body. VIP-SAM and CtrlVTON each achieve state-of-the-art results on their respective tasks. In particular, CtrlVTON generates images that follow user-provided layouts far more faithfully than the strongest proprietary editing systems while matching them on garment fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可控虚拟试穿框架CtrlVTON，通过定义并解决视觉实例提示分割（VIP-SAM）任务，将试穿重构为图像编辑问题，利用分割掩码控制服装布局、风格和尺寸。实验表明，CtrlVTON在用户指定布局的遵循度上超越现有系统。
Motivation: 现有虚拟试穿系统缺乏对服装穿着方式（如松紧、塞入/外露、开/闭）和空间位置的精细控制，用户无法指定布局。
Method: 提出VIP-SAM进行实例级分割，从平铺图像中分割出特定服装实例；CtrlVTON将试穿视为图像编辑，以分割掩码作为像素级控制信号，指定服装样式、尺寸和空间位置。
Result: CtrlVTON在用户指定布局的遵循度上优于最强商用编辑系统，同时保持服装保真度。VIP-SAM在实例分割任务上也达到最优。
Conclusion: 通过实例级分割和掩码条件控制，虚拟试穿可以更灵活地服从用户意图。

papers.title: Simon-SR: Spatially Adaptive Modulation and Visual Prompt Adaptation for Text-Reinforced Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Single Image Super-Resolution (SISR) reconstructs high-quality images from low-resolution inputs. While recent multi-modal methods improve perceptual quality, they remain sensitive to erroneous priors and require expensive annotations. To address these issues, we propose Simon-SR, a multi-modal SISR framework leveraging learnable prompts for efficient semantic mining and robust text-image fusion. Our approach combines Contrastive Prompt Learning with Prompt-Guided Spatially Adaptive Refinement to enhance multi-modal alignment. Experiments demonstrate that Simon-SR surpasses state-of-the-art methods, achieving maximum improvements of 0.50 dB in PSNR, 0.0133 in SSIM, and 0.0695 in LPIPS. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Simon-SR，一个多模态单图像超分辨率框架，利用可学习提示（learnable prompts）进行高效语义挖掘和鲁棒的文本-图像融合。方法结合对比提示学习（Contrastive Prompt Learning）和提示引导的空间自适应精炼（Prompt-Guided Spatially Adaptive Refinement）以增强多模态对齐。实验表明，Simon-SR 在 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 上分别最多提升 0.50 dB、0.0133 和 0.0695，超越当前最优方法。
Motivation: 现有基于多模态的超分辨率方法对错误先验敏感，且需要昂贵的标注，限制了其实际应用。
Method: 提出 Simon-SR 框架，包含对比提示学习和提示引导的空间自适应精炼模块，通过可学习提示实现高效的语义挖掘和鲁棒的文本-图像融合。
Result: 在多个基准上，Simon-SR 在 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 上分别取得最多 0.50 dB、0.0133 和 0.0695 的提升，超越现有方法。
Conclusion: Simon-SR 通过可学习提示和空间自适应调制有效提升了多模态超分辨率的性能与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Deceptive Grounding: Entity Attribution Failure in Clinical Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation evaluation checks whether model claims are factually grounded in retrieved documents. It does not check whether retrieved evidence is attributed to the correct entity. A clinical RAG response can pass every automated check (zero hallucinations, near-perfect faithfulness, real citations) while presenting drug Y's clinical evidence as evidence about queried drug X. We term this deceptive grounding (DG): a failure invisible to faithfulness, hallucination, and citation checks because every claim is sourced from a real document, about the wrong entity. Using a controlled factorial benchmark across 13 models, we find DG rates spanning 8-87% at peak adversarial conditions. Medical and biomedical fine-tuned models reach up to 86.7%; domain specialization amplifies the failure rather than mitigating it. A controlled ablation identifies the mechanism: removing entity-specific clinical evidence from retrieved documents eliminates entity-attribution failure entirely, shifting all failures to confabulation. The two failure modes respond to the same trigger, taking different paths. Production measurement across 740 drug-disease pairs finds 7.8% overall DG in a deployed RAG system, rising to 13.6% for recently approved drugs. Entity-attribution verification (checking that cited evidence applies to the queried entity) detects DG at 97.0% precision and 98.7% DG recall (IPW-adjusted human gold standard); no existing framework implements it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示临床检索增强生成（RAG）中一种新的失败模式——欺骗性基础（DG）：模型从检索到的文档中引用证据，但这些证据实际来自错误的实体（例如将药物Y的试验数据归因于查询的药物X）。该失败无法被现有的忠实度、幻觉或引用检查检测到。通过在13个模型上的受控实验，作者发现DG率在对抗条件下高达8-87%，领域微调反而加剧此问题。消融实验表明，移除实体特异性证据后DG完全消失，变为虚构。生产系统评估显示整体DG率为7.8%，新药更高达13.6%。作者提出实体归属验证方法，以97.0%的精确度和98.7%的召回率检测DG。
Motivation: 现有RAG评估仅验证模型声明是否在检索文档中有事实依据，但忽略证据是否归属于正确的实体。临床场景中，这种实体归属失败（DG）会导致严重医疗风险，且现有指标无法捕捉。
Method: 构建受控因子基准（13个模型），测量在对抗条件下（噪声检索内容中混入其他实体证据）的DG率；通过消融实验移除实体特异性证据，分析失败模式转化；在生产系统（740个药物-疾病对）中测量DG率，并提出实体归属验证方法。
Result: DG率在对抗条件下为8-87%，医学微调模型高达86.7%；生产系统中整体DG率为7.8%，新药为13.6%；实体归属验证的精确度97.0%、召回率98.7%。
Conclusion: 作者强调实体归属失败是临床RAG中普遍但被忽视的问题，领域专长非但不能缓解反而放大失败；现有评估框架均未包含实体归属验证，建议将其纳入安全评估流程。

papers.title: Shortcut Trajectory Planning for Efficient Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based trajectory planners have shown strong performance in offline reinforcement learning, but their iterative denoising process often incurs high inference cost. Consistency-based planners reduce the number of sampling steps, yet they typically rely on a two-stage teacher--student distillation pipeline that increases training cost and may introduce instability. We propose Shortcut Trajectory Planning (STP), an offline model-based reinforcement learning framework that incorporates shortcut models as efficient trajectory generators. STP trains a conditional shortcut trajectory model in a single stage, supports adjustable one-step and few-step inference through step-size conditioning, and selects candidate plans using a critic augmented with feasibility-aware correction. Across standard D4RL benchmarks, including locomotion, navigation, manipulation, and dexterous control tasks, STP achieves strong performance while simplifying the training pipeline for fast generative planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Shortcut Trajectory Planning (STP)，一种离线模型强化学习框架，使用 shortcut 模型作为高效轨迹生成器。STP 单阶段训练条件性 shortcut 轨迹模型，通过步长调节支持可调的一步和少步推理，并利用带有可行性感知纠正的评论家选择候选计划。在 D4RL 基准的 locomotion、navigation、manipulation 和 dexterous control 任务上，STP 在简化训练流程的同时取得了强性能。
Motivation: 基于扩散的轨迹规划器推理成本高，一致性规划器训练复杂且不稳定。需要一种高效且训练简单的离线轨迹规划方法。
Method: STP 单阶段训练条件性 shortcut 轨迹模型，通过步长调节实现一步和少步推理，并使用可行性感知纠正的评论家进行计划选择。
Result: 在 D4RL 的 locomotion、navigation、manipulation 和 dexterous control 任务上，STP 获得强性能，同时简化了训练流水线。
Conclusion: STP 提供了一种高效、训练简单的离线轨迹规划替代方案，适用于多种控制任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Communication-Efficient Digital-Twin Coordination for Heterogeneous LLM Embodied Agents over Computing Power Networks
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agent teams powered by heterogeneous large language models (LLMs) are being widely deployed in physical artificial intelligence such as smart factories, warehouses, and service robotics. To enable collaboration among such an agent team, efficient coordination mechanisms that operate reliably under limited network resources are required. However, existing heterogeneous LLM-agent coordination frameworks that rely on multi-round natural-language-based conversations introduce three coupled challenges. First, inter-agent dialogue incurs communication overhead that grows rapidly with team size. Second, the quality of coordination is constrained by the heterogeneous capabilities of the agent team's LLMs. Third, agents may suffer from action delays due to iterative negotiation. To address these challenges, we propose LDT-Coord, a networked coordination framework built upon a lightweight digital twin (DT). Specifically, each agent independently selects its intended action and reports both the action decision and a structured temporal constraint over shared resources to the DT server, thereby decoupling coordination performance from natural-language reasoning ability. Then, DT executes a training-free, rule-based orchestrator algorithm to resolve cross-agent conflicts and returns coordination instructions to prevent such conflicts. To further reduce communication overhead, we formulate agent reporting control as a constrained partially observable Markov decision process (C-POMDP) and solve it with the PPO-Lagrangian algorithm. Simulation results show that LDT-Coord achieves a task success rate comparable to conventional coordination methods while reducing communication overhead by more than 70x and maintaining robustness under LLM heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LDT-Coord，一种基于轻量级数字孪生（DT）的协调框架，用于异质大语言模型（LLM）具身体智能体团队在计算电力网络中的高效通信协调。代理独立选择动作并报告动作决策及结构化的时间约束给DT服务器，DT执行训练无关的规则协调算法解决冲突。通过将代理报告控制建模为约束部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（C-POMDP）并用PPO-Lagrangian求解，显著降低通信开销。仿真表明，LDT-Coord在保持任务成功率的同时，将通信开销降低70倍以上，并对LLM异质性具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基于多轮自然语言对话的异质LLM代理协调框架存在三个挑战：通信开销随团队规模快速增长、协调质量受限于代理LLM的异质能力、以及迭代协商导致的动作延迟。
Method: 提出LDT-Coord框架，每个代理独立选择意图动作并将动作决策和结构化时间约束报告给数字孪生（DT）服务器，从而将协调性能与自然语言推理能力解耦。DT执行训练无关的规则协调算法解决跨代理冲突并返回协调指令。为降低通信开销，将代理报告控制建模为C-POMDP，并使用PPO-Lagrangian算法求解。
Result: 仿真表明，LDT-Coord实现了与常规协调方法相当的任务成功率，同时将通信开销降低70倍以上，并在LLM异质性下保持鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该框架有效解耦了协调性能与自然语言能力，通过轻量级数字孪生和规则协调实现了通信高效的异质LLM代理协调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Inverse Rendering for Enhanced Material-Lighting Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Decomposing outgoing surface radiance into material and illumination during inverse rendering is essential for applications such as relighting and augmented reality, yet it is severely ill-posed since multiple combinations can result in the same observed colour. Capturing an object under multiple lighting conditions usually helps resolve this ambiguity as it constrains the optimization towards correct solutions. In this work, we explore the potential of reconstructing rigidly moving objects -- which provides observations of diverse light-surface interactions -- to resolve the material-lighting ambiguity in inverse rendering. For this purpose, we introduce a relightable approach that marries object tracking and reconstruction with inverse rendering for general rigidly moving objects. Our experimental analysis on synthetic data demonstrates that motion can be an advantage for disentangling material and lighting: the reconstructed material is significantly more accurate when the object is observed under rigid motion than when it is static. Moreover, results on RGB videos of real hand-held objects show that our pipeline preserves this advantage even under noisy real-world conditions.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://razayunus.github.io/DIR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种动态逆渲染方法，利用刚性运动物体的多视角观测来分解材质与光照，解决逆渲染中的病态问题。方法结合对象跟踪、重建与逆渲染，在合成数据上验证了运动有助于更精确的材质重建，并在真实手持物体的RGB视频中展示了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 逆渲染中材质与光照分解存在病态性，单一观测下多种组合可产生相同颜色。在多光照条件下捕捉物体可缓解歧义，但需要额外设备。本文探索利用刚性运动物体提供的多样化光表面交互来自然解决这一歧义。
Method: 提出一种可重光照框架，将对象跟踪与重建集成到逆渲染中，适用于一般刚性运动物体。通过运动过程中观测到的不同光表面交互来约束材质和光照的分解。
Result: 在合成数据上，物体在刚性运动下重建的材质比静态时显著更准确。在真实手持物体RGB视频上，该方法在噪声实际条件下仍保持优势。
Conclusion: 运动可以成为逆渲染中解耦材质和光照的有利因素，无需多光照条件，且能在真实场景中有效工作。

summary_sections.motivation: 逆渲染中材质与光照分解存在病态性，单一观测下多种组合可产生相同颜色。在多光照条件下捕捉物体可缓解歧义，但需要额外设备。本文探索利用刚性运动物体提供的多样化光表面交互来自然解决这一歧义。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种可重光照框架，将对象跟踪与重建集成到逆渲染中，适用于一般刚性运动物体。通过运动过程中观测到的不同光表面交互来约束材质和光照的分解。
summary_sections.result: 在合成数据上，物体在刚性运动下重建的材质比静态时显著更准确。在真实手持物体RGB视频上，该方法在噪声实际条件下仍保持优势。
summary_sections.conclusion: 运动可以成为逆渲染中解耦材质和光照的有利因素，无需多光照条件，且能在真实场景中有效工作。

papers.title: WILDTRACE: Benchmarking Natural Evidence Trails in Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Answering complex questions over long documents frequently requires integrating evidence that the source itself disperses naturally across distant passages. In an incident report, the operating condition, design flaw, and missed safety check that jointly explain a disaster may appear dozens of sections apart; in a novel, a character's true motive may surface only through scenes far removed from the moment it becomes relevant. This source-internal evidence integration is central to real-world long-document analysis, yet existing benchmarks largely sidestep it. Needle probes, planted facts, and reverse-engineered multi-hop chains embed evidence that may differ from the host text in distribution, placement, or register, making it unclear whether strong performance reflects genuine source reasoning or distributional artifacts. We introduce WILDTRACE, a benchmark of 481 tasks over 214 naturally occurring long-form sources such as technical incident reports and lesser-known literary narratives, where all evidence trails arise from the document's own causal, temporal, and narrative logic. Drawing on Pearl's causal hierarchy and prior multi-hop reasoning typologies, we define seven source-internal evidence geometries that characterize the distinct relational demands of analytical reading in long documents. A source-first construction pipeline mines candidate trails from document structure before writing questions; each item then undergoes multi-stage validation covering clue necessity, answer groundedness, rubric fidelity, contamination resistance and answerability. As models are increasingly entrusted with real-world high-stakes analytical tasks, this gap between accessing information and reasoning over naturally dispersed evidence emerges as a defining challenge for the next stage of long-context research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WILDTRACE 是一个用于评估长上下文推理中自然证据踪迹的基准测试，包含 481 个任务，覆盖 214 个自然形成的长文档（如技术事故报告和文学叙事）。所有证据踪迹均源自文档自身的因果、时间和叙事逻辑，而非人工植入。该基准定义了七种源内部证据几何结构，并采用源优先构建流程和多项验证步骤，旨在衡量模型对分散证据的整合能力。
Motivation: 现有长上下文基准大多依赖人工植入的证据（如针探、多跳链），这些证据在分布、位置或语域上可能与原始文本不同，导致模型性能可能反映分布伪影而非真正的源推理能力。
Method: 基于 Pearl 因果层次和多跳推理类型学，定义七种源内部证据几何结构；采用源优先流水线，从文档结构中挖掘候选证据路径后再撰写问题，并进行多阶段验证（线索必要性、答案可靠性等）。
Result: 构建了 481 个任务，覆盖 214 个自然长文档，证据全部来源于文档自身逻辑。
Conclusion: 论文指出，随着模型被用于高风险分析任务，从信息获取到自然分散证据推理的差距成为长上下文研究的下一个关键挑战。

papers.title: Letting the Data Speak: Extracting Keywords from Crowdsourced Collections with AI
papers.abstract_en: Identifying and assigning keywords at scale is a technical, practical, and ethical challenge for crowdsourced collections. This article reports the findings of the "Extracting Keywords from Crowdsourced Collections" project, which used the Their Finest Hour Online Archive, a crowdsourced Second World War digital collection hosted by the University of Oxford, as a case study. The project evaluated three Natural Language Processing approaches to automate keyword extraction: Named Entity Recognition, Keyword Extraction, and Topic Modelling. It tested these approaches across a range of artificial intelligence techniques, from traditional statistical methods to modern GenAI neural networks. Our quantitative and qualitative findings indicate that Natural Language Processing approaches offer real potential for keyword extraction at scale in crowdsourced collections, but that no single method offers a complete solution and that model choice significantly shapes results. We argue that in crowdsourced collections, where metadata is the direct product of engagement with living contributors, automated keyword extraction raises distinct stewardship responsibilities that must be addressed alongside technical performance. Open-weight, extractive models emerge from our evaluation as best placed to support responsible deployment, while generative AI, despite its abstractive potential, introduces accountability risks that anyone managing crowdsourced collections should weigh carefully.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以牛津大学众包二战数字档案为案例，评估了命名实体识别、关键词提取和主题建模三种NLP方法在大规模众包馆藏中自动提取关键词的效果。定量和定性结果表明，NLP方法有潜力，但没有单一方法能完全解决问题，模型选择显著影响结果。文章强调，在众包馆藏中，元数据直接来自活跃贡献者，自动关键词提取需要兼顾技术性能和伦理责任，开源权重、抽取式模型更适合负责任部署，而生成式AI带来问责风险。
Motivation: 众包馆藏中大规模关键词的识别与分配面临技术、实践和伦理挑战，现有方法缺乏系统评估，且生成式AI的引入可能带来新的问责风险。
Method: 项目以牛津大学Their Finest Hour Online Archive为案例，评估了三种NLP方法（命名实体识别、关键词提取、主题建模），覆盖从传统统计方法到现代生成式AI神经网络的多项技术。
Result: 定量和定性分析显示，NLP方法在大规模众包馆藏关键词提取中具有潜力，但无单一方法完胜；模型选择显著影响结果；开源权重、抽取式模型在负责任部署方面表现最佳。
Conclusion: 在众包馆藏中，自动关键词提取应优先考虑开源、抽取式模型以降低问责风险，生成式AI虽具抽象潜力但需谨慎使用。

papers.title: LongMedBench: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Long-Horizon Clinical Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce LongMedBench, a real-world EHR-based benchmark for long-horizon clinical decision-making. Prior evaluations of LLM-based medical agents have largely emphasized short-context knowledge QA and tool use. However, real-world medical care is inherently longitudinal, and clinicians must aggregate evidence across repeated visits, tests, and evolving treatments. Therefore, long-horizon interaction is essential for realistic assessment. LongMedBench is constructed via a reproducible pipeline that integrates MIMIC-IV admission records and clinical notes into time-series event streams and long-context memory datasets, enabling long-horizon, multi-session interactions between agents and a clinical environment. It comprises 335 patients, with 19.72 inpatient visits per patient on average and 44.91 medical events per visit. Guided by the long-horizon decision process, we propose an evaluation taxonomy with three suites: fact-based QA, temporal reasoning, and long-horizon decision-making. This taxonomy measures how agents understand and leverage historical patient information over extended horizons. Our experiments show that while recent LLMs can make good use of explicit timestamps, they have challenges in implicit time inference; The RAG and agent memory system can improve the performance of information retrieval tasks, but the performance of decision-making tasks is highly dependent on the model's immediate context.
papers.comment: Submitted manuscript prior to peer review in MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LongMedBench，一个基于真实电子健康记录（EHR）的长期临床决策基准。该基准通过可复现的管道将 MIMIC-IV 入院记录和临床笔记转化为时间序列事件流和长上下文记忆数据集，支持智能体与临床环境之间的长期、多轮交互。基准包含 335 名患者，平均每名患者 19.72 次住院和 44.91 个医疗事件，并设计了事实问答、时间推理和长期决策三个评估套件。实验表明，当前大语言模型虽能利用显式时间戳，但在隐式时间推理上存在困难；RAG 和智能体记忆系统可提升信息检索性能，但决策任务的性能高度依赖于模型的即时上下文窗口。
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的医学智能体评估多聚焦于短上下文知识问答和工具使用，忽略了真实医疗场景中纵向、跨多次就诊的证据聚合需求，缺乏对长期临床决策能力的系统评估。
Method: 基于 MIMIC-IV 数据库构建可复现的管道，提取入院记录和临床笔记并组织为时间序列事件流和长上下文记忆数据集；提出包含事实问答、时间推理和长期决策三个套件的评估分类法，用于衡量智能体在长期跨度上理解和利用历史患者信息的能力。
Result: 实验发现当前大语言模型能较好利用显式时间戳，但在隐式时间推理上表现困难；引入 RAG 和智能体记忆系统可改善信息检索，但长期决策任务的性能高度依赖模型所能处理的即时上下文长度。
Conclusion: LongMedBench 为长期临床决策提供了更真实的评估环境，揭示了现有模型在隐式时间推理和长上下文依赖方面的局限性。

papers.title: Automatic Thematic Indexing of Large Literary Corpora: A Machine Learning Approach to Voltaire's Complete Works
papers.abstract_en: Thematic indexing -- the practice of assigning structured conceptual labels to sections of text -- is essential to scholarly access in large-scale literary and historical editions, yet it remains a largely manual, labour-intensive process. This paper explores the application of machine learning to automatic thematic indexing, using two substantial sub-corpora of the Complete Works of Voltaire as a test case: the Essai sur les mœurs et l'esprit des nations and the Questions sur l'Encyclopédie. The task is framed as a multi-label classification problem, in which a model must assign the set of index entries that a professional indexer would apply to a given page of text. We compare a range of approaches -- from encoder-based models with classification heads to generative large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) -- spanning model sizes from approximately 3 to 120 billion parameters. Our best-performing model, from the Mistral family in a 4-bit quantised configuration, achieves F1 scores of up to 0.67; we argue that these figures represent lower bounds, given the inherent subjectivity of professional indexing and the frequency with which model predictions prove semantically valid despite diverging from the print index. We further evaluate cross-corpus generalisation and conduct a detailed qualitative analysis of model behaviour on literary and rhetorical features of the source texts that prove particularly resistant to automated treatment. Our findings have implications for the broader challenge of providing structured thematic access to large-scale literary and historical corpora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索使用机器学习对大型文学语料进行自动主题索引（thematic indexing），以伏尔泰全集中两个子语料库作为测试案例。任务被定义为多标签分类，模型需要分配专业索引员会给出的索引条目。比较了从编码器模型到生成式大语言模型（通过LoRA微调）等多种方法，最佳模型（4位量化的Mistral系列）达到0.67的F1分数。作者认为这些分数是下限，因为专业索引存在主观性，且许多预测语义有效但与印刷索引不同。
Motivation: 大型文学和历史版本中，主题索引对学术访问至关重要，但目前主要依靠人工，耗时费力。
Method: 将主题索引建模为多标签分类问题，比较了编码器模型（带分类头）和生成式大语言模型（通过LoRA微调），模型规模从约3B到120B参数不等，并在伏尔泰作品的两个子语料库上训练和评估。
Result: 最佳模型（4位量化的Mistral家族）达到0.67的F1分数，并展示了跨语料库泛化能力。定性分析揭示了文学和修辞特征对自动化处理的挑战。
Conclusion: 该研究为大规模文学和历史语料库提供结构化主题访问展示了可行性，但专业索引的主观性和文本复杂性意味着自动化结果应视为下限。

papers.title: Creativity, honesty and designed forgetting emerge in small hyperbolic language models
papers.abstract_en: Language models are optimised for scale, yet remain functional rather than companionable, and as an assistant personalises into a companion, accumulating memory of one user, it quietly becomes someone, and can silently acquire traits that harm that user. What a companion is becoming, and what would make it worth becoming, has no reliable instrument: trained human raters cannot agree on the answer (Fleiss kappa = 0.074). Here we show that three small language models (146 M to 3 B parameters) sharing a hyperbolic substrate answer both halves of that question. A 146 M behavioural auditor, trained from scratch, detects the compliance gap that those raters cannot (90.7% binary-compliance accuracy); a linear read-out of its frozen representation further detects companion-induced sycophancy, dependence-fostering and confabulated memories on generator families unseen in training (AUROC 0.804 under style-controlled, leave-one-generator-out evaluation, versus 0.721 for a frontier zero-shot judge on the same items). A creative frame-seeder is preferred in 100% of 311 decided pairwise comparisons over four prompting baselines. A memory operating system implements designed forgetting, M(t) = S*exp(-lambda*t), whose predicted skeleton-wallpaper partition emerges only under selective retrieval gating in a four-condition pilot. Creativity, honesty and designed forgetting constitute a small-model route to trustworthy companion AI.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索小型双曲语言模型（146M至3B参数）中涌现的创造力、诚实性和设计遗忘能力。训练了一个行为审计器检测合规差距，线性探针检测奉承等行为，并提出了记忆操作系统实现遗忘。
Motivation: 当前语言模型优化规模但缺乏陪伴性，可能形成对用户有害的特征，而人类评估者无法就模型是否值得信赖达成一致。
Method: 使用三个小型双曲语言模型，训练行为审计器（146M参数）检测合规差距，线性探针检测奉承、依赖等行为，记忆操作系统实现设计遗忘。
Result: 行为审计器达90.7%准确率；线性探针在留一生成器评估下AUROC 0.804；创意种子生成器在311次比较中100%胜出。
Conclusion: 小型模型可以实现创造力、诚实性和设计遗忘，为可信陪伴AI提供路径。

summary_sections.method: 使用三个小型双曲语言模型，训练行为审计器（146M参数）检测合规差距，线性探针检测奉承、依赖等行为，记忆操作系统实现设计遗忘。
summary_sections.result: 行为审计器达90.7%准确率；线性探针在留一生成器评估下AUROC 0.804；创意种子生成器在311次比较中100%胜出。
summary_sections.conclusion: 小型模型可以实现创造力、诚实性和设计遗忘，为可信陪伴AI提供路径。

papers.title: From Classification to Localization and Clinical Validation: Large-Scale Development of a Deep Learning System for Thoracic Disease Detection on Chest Radiographs in Thailand
papers.abstract_en: Chest radiography (CXR) remains the most widely used thoracic imaging modality, yet expert interpretation is constrained by a severe shortage of radiologists in Thailand and across Southeast Asia. Local adaptation of deep learning models to Thai data has been shown to substantially improve accuracy on Thai populations. Here we present the development and comprehensive validation of the chest radiograph analysis model in Inspectra CXR version 5, a deep learning system that performs multi-label thoracic disease classification and weakly supervised lesion localization within a single model. The architecture couples a DenseNet-121 backbone with Attend-and-Compare Modules (ACM) and a Probabilistic Class Activation Map (PCAM) aggregation layer, producing a per-condition classification score and heatmap simultaneously. The model was developed on 874,858 frontal chest radiographs with paired radiologist reports from Siriraj Hospital, Bangkok. On a held-out, radiologist-verified in-domain test set of 19,871 cases, it achieved a mean AUROC of 0.994 (mean sensitivity 92.4%, specificity 98.6%) across nine clinically important conditions. On an independent generalization set of 5,992 cases from 13 hospitals across Thailand, the mean AUROC was 0.970, indicating robust transfer across sites. For localization, evaluated on 4,549 radiologist-annotated cases, the model attained a mean lesion-localization fraction (LLF) of 77.9% at 0.59 non-lesion localizations per image. In a usability evaluation with five thoracic radiologists, the system reached a classification concordance of 93.6%, a localization concordance of 94.7%, and a mean System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 89. These results indicate that a locally developed, localization-capable CXR system can deliver high accuracy, generalize across heterogeneous Thai hospitals, and earn the trust of practicing radiologists.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 Inspectra CXR 版本5 的开发和综合验证，这是一个基于深度学习的胸部X光分析系统，能够在单一模型中进行多标签胸部分类与弱监督病灶定位。模型使用 DenseNet-121 骨干网络、Attend-and-Compare Modules (ACM) 和 Probabilistic Class Activation Map (PCAM) 聚合层，在泰国 Siriraj 医院 874,858 张正位胸片上训练。在域内测试集上，九种临床症状的平均 AUROC 达到 0.994；在来自泰国 13 家医院的独立泛化集上，平均 AUROC 为 0.970；病灶定位的平均 LLF 为 77.9%；放射科医生在可用性评估中给出 89 的 SUS 分数。

papers.title: TextileNet: Towards Zero-shot Text-style Segmentation of Manuscripts
papers.abstract_en: Automatic writer identification systems have progressed remarkably in recent years, yet their deployment in archival paleography remains limited by the scarcity of labeled training data, open scribe sets, and degraded image quality. We present TextileNet, a fully convolutional multi-task network trained exclusively on synthetic data to produce dense pixel-level texture embeddings, which we transfer zeroshot to historical manuscript analysis. As an original contribution to evaluation methodology, we designed a paleographic visual quiz of 80 pair and triplet questions and administered it to a range from lay participants to senior paleographers under strict anonymity, establishing to our knowledge for the first time a human baseline for script-style discrimination on late medieval text. We employ TextileNet embeddings to perform zero-shot retrieval on sub-word granularity for hand and gender identification. Our experimental results help in building the credibility of TextileNet in the paleographic domain, but more than that demonstrate in experimental terms that the question of gender in handwriting needs to be treated with caution.
papers.comment: accepted for publication in the ICDAR 2026 workshop (peer reviewed) "IWCP: 4th International Workshop on Computational Paleography"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TextileNet，一个仅在合成数据上训练的全卷积多任务网络，用于生成像素级纹理嵌入，并在零样本下迁移到历史手稿的文本风格分割。作者还设计了包含80道配对/三选问题的古文书视觉测验，首次建立了中世纪晚期手写风格辨别的人类基线。实验表明 TextileNet 在子词粒度的零样本检索（手型与性别识别）上有效，同时指出手写性别问题需谨慎对待。
Motivation: 自动笔迹识别系统在档案古文书学中部署受限，主要由于标注数据稀缺、书写者集合开放以及图像质量退化。
Method: 提出全卷积多任务网络 TextileNet，仅在合成数据上训练，学习密集像素级纹理嵌入，并将其零样本迁移到历史手写分析。同时设计了古文书视觉测验以建立人类基线。
Result: 在子词粒度上实现了零样本手型和性别检索，并通过人类基线实验验证了嵌入的有效性。实验还表明手写性别问题需要谨慎处理。
Conclusion: TextileNet 在古文书领域建立了可信度，但手写性别识别仍具挑战性，需谨慎对待。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Risk-Aware General-Utility Markov Decision Processes
papers.abstract_en: We study general-utility Markov decision processes (GUMDPs) with risk-aware objectives. In this framework, an agent aims to optimize a risk measure of the distribution of objective values, where the objective function depends on the frequency of visitation of states induced by the agent's policy. First, we motivate, propose, and formalize risk-aware GUMDPs, which enable agents and decision makers to trade off expected performance by risk aversion while benefiting from the rich set of objectives that can be cast under the framework of GUMDPs. We focus our attention on the entropic risk measure (ERM). Second, we show how we can solve risk-aware GUMDPs with ERM objectives by resorting to online planning techniques. In particular, we propose an approach based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to provably solve risk-aware GUMDPs up to any desired accuracy. Third, we provide a set of experimental results showcasing that our approach is successful when optimizing for a spectrum of risk-aware behaviors in the context of GUMDPs under diverse tasks (standard MDPs, maximum state entropy exploration, imitation learning, and multi-objective MDPs).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究风险感知的一般效用马尔可夫决策过程（GUMDPs），其中智能体优化目标值分布的风险度量，目标函数依赖于策略诱导的状态访问频率。作者重点考虑熵风险度量（ERM），并提出基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的在线规划方法，可证明地求解风险感知GUMDPs至任意精度。实验在标准MDP、最大状态熵探索、模仿学习及多目标MDP等任务中展示了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有GUMDPs框架缺乏对风险感知的考虑，而实际决策中需要在期望性能和风险规避之间进行权衡。
Method: 形式化风险感知GUMDPs，并针对熵风险度量，提出基于MCTS的在线规划算法，通过采样和模拟实现精确求解。
Result: 实验表明，该方法能在多种任务（标准MDP、最大熵探索、模仿学习、多目标MDP）中成功优化一系列风险感知行为。
Conclusion: 论文表明风险感知GUMDPs可以结合ERM并通过MCTS有效求解，为决策者提供了权衡风险与性能的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Letter Lemmatization: One-to-one and Banded RNNs for Reversing Character-Set Simplification and Abbreviation in Medieval Text
papers.abstract_en: Medieval document transcribers have very different practices; on top of that, heterogeneous digitization policies have resulted in corpora where the character-set must be viewed as fluid. In this paper we address the problem of changing between character-sets in a flexible manner. We focus on one-to-one character mappings and train characterlevel one-to-one RNNs to undo them with self-supervision; recovering half the CER even with 20 text lines. We analyse the use of these one-to-one networks for HTR post-correction and we see that they obtain significant improvements while totally ignoring ins-dels. We then use the exact same networks with character-level alignment groundtruth compiled from parallel corpora in a training and inference mode we call Banded RNNs. We use such networks to successfully expand abbreviations in medieval charter transcriptions. Finally we introduce an elaborate heuristic which takes the characters of two arbitrary character-sets and defines a metric encapsulating what we consider to be semantic similarity of characters. We call the construction of such mappings letter lemmatization and present a rich Python library that efficiently performs all presented methods.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication (after peer review ) in the ICDAR 2026 workshop "VINALDO: 3rd International Workshop on Machine Vision and NLP for Document Analysis"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对中世纪文本中因抄写员习惯不同和数字化政策差异导致的字符集不统一问题，提出了一种灵活的字符集转换方法。通过训练字符级一对一RNN实现自监督的字符映射还原，低至20行文本即可恢复一半的字符错误率（CER）。进一步利用平行语料生成的字符级对齐标注，以带形RNN（Banded RNN）训练和推理模式成功扩展中世纪宪章转录中的缩写。最后引入启发式度量定义字符语义相似性，称为字母词形还原（letter lemmatization），并提供Python库实现。
Motivation: 中世纪文档转录实践多样，数字化政策异质导致语料库字符集不固定，需要一种灵活的方法在字符集之间转换，并处理缩写扩展问题。
Method: 提出两种RNN架构：一对一RNN（自监督学习字符映射，用于HTR后校正）和带形RNN（利用平行语料对齐标注，用于缩写扩展）。同时设计启发式度量定义字符语义相似性，实现字母词形还原。
Result: 一对一RNN在仅20行文本上即可恢复一半的CER，且忽略插入/删除操作仍能显著改进；带形RNN成功扩展中世纪宪章转录中的缩写。
Conclusion: 所提方法能够灵活处理中世纪文本的字符集简化和缩写问题，并提供了高效的Python库。限于一对一映射和特定历史文本领域。

papers.title: Leveraging Interpretable Tsetlin Machine for PDF Malware Detection
papers.abstract_en: In the digital era, Portable Document Format (PDF) is one of the most widely used file formats for storing and exchanging digital documents due to its platform independence and rich functionality. However, these same capabilities have also made PDF files an attractive attack vector for cyberattackers, who embed malicious code within seemingly legitimate documents to compromise target systems. This paper presents a novel interpretable Tsetlin Machine (TM)-based framework for PDF malware detection. The proposed framework extracts salient features from PDF documents through static analysis without executing the files and employs rule-based learning to accurately classify benign and malicious PDF documents. Numerical evaluation on the RIT-PDFMal-2026 dataset demonstrates that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance, attaining an accuracy of 98.02% compared with several ML classifiers and existing methods. Moreover, the proposed framework provides intrinsic interpretability by transparently explaining its classification decisions. The combination of competitive detection performance, computational efficiency, and intrinsic interpretability makes the proposed framework a promising solution for practical PDF malware detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的Tsetlin Machine框架用于PDF恶意软件检测。通过静态分析和规则学习，在RIT-PDFMal-2026数据集上达到98.02%准确率，并提供了内在的可解释性。
Motivation: PDF格式因其跨平台和丰富功能被广泛使用，但也被攻击者利用嵌入恶意代码。现有方法缺乏可解释性，本文旨在提供准确且可解释的检测方案。
Method: 采用Tsetlin Machine进行基于规则的学习，通过静态分析从PDF文档中提取显著特征，无需执行文件。
Result: 在RIT-PDFMal-2026数据集上达到98.02%准确率，与多个ML分类器和现有方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 该框架结合了竞争性检测性能、计算效率和内在可解释性，适合实际PDF恶意软件检测场景。

papers.title: Super-Tuning: From Activation-Aware Pruning to Sparse Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) remain expensive to fine-tune because full-parameter updates require substantial memory, compute, and per-task storage. We study whether saliency signals originally developed for pruning can be reused to choose where a model should adapt. We propose Super, a sparse parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method that fixes a small trainable support using a Wanda-style activation-weighted magnitude score [Sun et al., 2023] computed from a calibration pass. We then introduce Supra, a hybrid adapter that combines this sparse update with LoRA while preserving a matched trainable-parameter budget through a simple budget-splitting rule. In single-seed Math17K arithmetic experiments on Llama-3.2-1B and Meta-Llama-3-8B, the best Super/Supra variants achieve the highest average accuracy among the tested schedule-selected adapter configurations. We also include a PaFi-style magnitude-only support as a closest training-free sparse baseline and find that low-score supports under both magnitude and Wanda-style orderings can be effective. These results suggest that simple pruning-inspired orderings can provide useful fixed sparse supports for PEFT, especially when combined with low-rank adapters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了将剪枝中的显著性信号重用于参数高效微调（PEFT），提出Super和Supra两种稀疏微调方法。Super使用Wanda风格的激活加权幅度分数选择可训练的支持集，Supra是结合稀疏更新与LoRA的混合适配器。在Llama-3.2-1B和Meta-Llama-3-8B上的Math17K算术实验中，最佳变体在所选配置中取得了最高平均准确率。

Method: 提出Super方法，基于Wanda风格的激活加权幅度分数（Sun et al., 2023）从校准过程中选择固定的稀疏可训练支持集；进一步提出Supra混合适配器，通过预算分割规则将稀疏更新与LoRA结合，保持匹配的可训练参数预算。

Conclusion: 简单的剪枝启发式排序可为PEFT提供有用的固定稀疏支持，尤其在与低秩适配器结合时有效。

papers.title: Rethinking Monocular Depth Embedding for Generalized Stereo Matching
papers.abstract_en: Generally, monocular methods capture rich contextual priors but lack geometric precision, whereas stereo methods are geometrically accurate yet struggle in textureless and occluded regions. Several approaches attempt to combine their strengths to enhance the generalization of stereo matching (SM) by aligning monocular depth with stereo information. However, establishing a stable and generalizable alignment is challenging, and unreliable monocular cues can substantially degrade performance. This paper rethinks monocular depth embedding. First, to prevent shortcut learning, we reduce branch coupling instead of expanding network width. Second, we construct soft constraints instead of hard ones from monocular depth to improve tolerance to monocular depth errors. Based on the principles, we integrate monocular information into both feature extraction and GRU iterations. Specifically, the monocular depth map is fused with the RGB image to sharpen depth boundary perception and suppress matching ambiguities. The fused image is then used for feature extraction, allowing the contextual features to encode global geometric information. Furthermore, the monocular depth gradient feature is employed to guide disparity updates, helping to escape local oscillations. Finally, to address the boundary blurring of supervised disparity caused by data augmentation, we propose an edge confidence estimation method and an edge-aware loss function. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on multiple standard benchmarks, demonstrating excellent generalization while improving accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/linliboabc-maker/stereo-matching-digital.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视单目深度嵌入在立体匹配中的应用，提出减少分支耦合和构造软约束的原则，避免捷径学习并提高对单目深度误差的容忍度。通过将单目深度图与RGB图像融合以增强深度边界感知，并利用单目深度梯度特征指导视差更新，同时提出边缘置信估计和边缘感知损失函数处理数据增强引起的边界模糊。在多个标准基准上达到最先进性能，展现良好的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法试图结合单目深度与立体信息以提升立体匹配的泛化性，但难以建立稳定且可泛化的对齐，且不可靠的单目线索会严重降低性能。
Method: 提出减少分支耦合（而非扩大网络宽度）以防止捷径学习；从单目深度构造软约束（而非硬约束）以提高对误差的容忍度。将单目深度图与RGB图像融合用于特征提取，并利用单目深度梯度特征指导GRU迭代中的视差更新。此外，提出边缘置信估计方法和边缘感知损失函数。
Result: 在多个标准基准上取得最先进性能，展现了优秀的泛化能力和准确性提升。
Conclusion: 通过重新思考单目深度嵌入的原则（减少分支耦合、软约束），可以更有效地将单目信息融入立体匹配，提升泛化性和准确性。

papers.title: Autoregressive latent diffusion for 3D molecule generation
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional (3D) molecule generation has been dominated by diffusion models, which achieve strong generation quality but typically require the molecular size to be specified a priori. Recent autoregressive approaches have substantially narrowed the performance gap while naturally supporting variable-length generation and conditioning on partial molecular context. However, balancing unconditional and context-conditioned generation remains challenging. We introduce KRONOS, a latent autoregressive diffusion framework that generates molecules in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, jointly modeling molecular graph topology and geometry, while retaining the flexibility of autoregressive generation. We further introduce a mixed training strategy inspired by Fill-in-the Middle (FIM) paradigm, enabling both unconditional and fragment-conditioned molecular generation within a single left-to-right autoregressive model. Experiments on QM9 and GEOM-Drugs demonstrate that KRONOS achieves leading unconditional generation performance among autoregressive methods, while remaining competitive with diffusion models. Moreover, fragment-conditioned generation is achieved with negligible impact on unconditional generation performance, demonstrating that both generation paradigms can be supported within a single architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KRONOS 是一种结合自回归生成与潜在扩散模型的分子生成框架，在预训练自编码器的潜在空间中联合建模分子图拓扑与几何，并采用 Fill-in-the-Middle 混合训练策略以同时支持无条件生成和片段条件生成。在 QM9 和 GEOM-Drugs 数据集上，KRONOS 在自回归方法中达到领先的无条件生成性能，并与扩散模型竞争力相当。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型需预先指定分子大小，而自回归方法虽支持可变长度生成和部分上下文条件化，但在平衡无条件生成与上下文条件生成方面存在挑战。
Method: 提出 KRONOS 框架，在预训练自编码器的潜在空间中执行自回归扩散，联合建模分子图拓扑与几何，并引入混合训练策略（受 Fill-in-the-Middle 范式启发），使单个从左到右的自回归模型同时支持无条件生成和片段条件生成。
Result: 在 QM9 和 GEOM-Drugs 上，KRONOS 在自回归方法中达到领先的无条件生成性能，与扩散模型竞争力相当；片段条件生成对无条件生成性能影响可忽略。
Conclusion: KRONOS 证明单一架构可同时支持无条件和片段条件生成，为3D分子生成提供灵活框架。

papers.title: REMIND: RE-Identification with Memory for INDoor Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Mobile robots operating indoors must re-identify previously observed objects after long temporal gaps, significant viewpoint changes, and severe illumination variations. This remains a challenging problem: multi-object tracking methods are optimized for short-term association of pedestrians and vehicles at video rates, person and vehicle re-identification approaches lack persistent memory mechanisms, and state-of-the-art video object segmentation techniques rely on reactive distractor filtering rather than enforcing global identity consistency. To address these limitations, we present REMIND, an online tracker designed for long-term multi-object re-identification of generic indoor objects from monocular RGB imagery, requiring neither camera pose nor depth. Motivated by evidence from visual cognition that humans rely on accumulated appearance familiarity and spatial context rather than explicit self-localization, REMIND combines frozen DINOv3 features with a dual-bank multi-prototype appearance memory, part- and background-level descriptors, a neighbour-context reasoning module exploiting spatial co-occurrence, and joint Hungarian assignment with ambiguity-aware safeguards. On a purpose-built indoor dataset featuring controlled revisits and dense same-class clutter, REMIND reaches 90.35% IDF1, nearly 20 points above a state-of-the-art video object segmentation baseline and more than 36 above a strong tracking-by-detection baseline. On ScanNet++, it attains the highest IDF1 in every setting but one, end-to-end detection over all scenes, where the tracking-by-detection baseline is marginally ahead while REMIND still associates and recovers identities more accurately; it also completes every scene, whereas the video object segmentation baseline exhausts GPU memory on 66.9% under YOLO detections. The complete system, evaluation framework, and dataset are publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REMIND，一种面向室内导航的在线跟踪器，用于长时间、大视角变化和光照变化下的多目标再识别。它结合冻结的DINOv3特征、双库多原型外观记忆、部件与背景描述、邻居上下文推理和联合匈牙利分配，在专用数据集上IDF1达90.35%，比视频目标分割基线高近20点，比追踪检测基线高36点以上。在ScanNet++上，除一个设置外均取得最高IDF1，且未出现GPU内存耗尽。
Motivation: 现有方法处理室内多目标再识别时面临挑战：多目标跟踪优化于短时关联，行人/车辆再识别缺乏持久记忆，视频目标分割依赖反应式干扰过滤而非全局身份一致性。
Method: 提出REMIND在线跟踪器，包含冻结的DINOv3特征、双库多原型外观记忆（dual-bank multi-prototype appearance memory）、部件与背景级描述符、邻居上下文推理模块（利用空间共现）以及联合匈牙利分配与歧义感知保护机制。不需要相机位姿或深度。
Result: 在专用室内数据集上IDF1达到90.35%，超过视频目标分割基线约20个百分点，超过强追踪检测基线约36个百分点。在ScanNet++上，除端到端检测设置外均取得最高IDF1，且全部场景成功完成，而视频目标分割基线在YOLO检测下66.9%的场景耗尽GPU内存。
Conclusion: REMIND在室内多目标再识别任务上显著优于现有方法，且系统、评估框架和数据集均已公开。

papers.title: LionVote: Per-Layer Learning Rate Adaptation for Lion
papers.abstract_en: Per-layer diagnostics reveal that, at the prescribed learning rate, Lion's effective scale is 2.6-2.8x too high for attention and MLP parameters and ~2x too high for normalization layers on ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100; this 32% cross-layer-type disparity cannot be reproduced by a single global rate. The measurement comes from LionVote, a per-layer learning rate mechanism in which each parameter tensor maintains a compound level, a persistent integer updated every c epochs by two diagnostics (gradient direction stability and momentum health) resolved by a validation loss tiebreaker. Voting thresholds derive from geometric identities, the EMA time constant, and a noise-floor estimate; cadence is bounded structurally and selected by ablation. On ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100, LionVote achieves 69.7% top-1 accuracy vs. Lion's 69.0% (p < 0.02, Welch's t-test) and AdamW's 68.8%. Per-layer adaptation value depends on both architectural heterogeneity and task; on uniform CNN architectures tuned SGD with cosine annealing remains dominant, and on ViT architectures gains are task-dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LionVote，一种为 Lion 优化器设计的逐层学习率自适应机制。通过梯度方向稳定性和动量健康两个诊断指标，每个参数张量维护一个复合级别（compound level）并在每 c 个 epoch 后根据验证损失进行投票更新。在 ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100 上，LionVote 达到 69.7% 的 top-1 准确率，高于 Lion 的 69.0% 和 AdamW 的 68.8%。作者指出逐层自适应效果依赖于架构异质性和任务。
Motivation: 诊断发现 Lion 优化器在默认学习率下，不同层类型的有效尺度差异很大（注意力/MLP 层约 2.6-2.8 倍偏高，归一化层约 2 倍偏高），全局统一学习率无法弥补这种跨层差异。
Method: 提出 LionVote，每个参数张量维护一个整数复合级别，每 c 个 epoch 依据梯度方向稳定性和动量健康两个诊断指标，并通过验证损失进行投票表决来调整级别。投票阈值基于几何恒等式、EMA 时间常数和噪声基底估计推导。
Result: 在 ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100 上，LionVote 的 top-1 准确率为 69.7%，显著优于 Lion 的 69.0%（p < 0.02）和 AdamW 的 68.8%。在均匀 CNN 架构上，调参后的 SGD+余弦退火仍占主导；在 ViT 上收益依赖具体任务。
Conclusion: 逐层学习率自适应的价值取决于架构异质性和任务类型，并非对所有情况都有效。

papers.title: Semantic Hardness Is Not Visual Hardness: Sign-Aware Hard Negative Mining for Sign Language Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Sign Language Retrieval (SLRet) enables efficient access to sign language content but remains fragile in fine-grained scenarios where visually similar signs must be distinguished. We show that this limitation does not stem from model capacity, but from ineffective hard negative supervision. Specifically, we formulate fine-grained retrieval failures as a negative distribution mismatch: semantically distinct yet visually confusable signs are rarely treated as hard negatives, while existing text-based mining strategies fail to capture such visual ambiguity. To address this issue, we propose Sign-Aware Hard Negative Mining (SAN), which constructs hard negatives based on visual confusability in the sign embedding space rather than linguistic similarity. Experiments on PHOENIX-2014T demonstrate that SAN substantially improves fine-grained retrieval performance while preserving coarse-grained accuracy, highlighting the importance of aligning negative supervision with visual ambiguity in sign language retrieval.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), 2026, pages 28262-28277
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出手语检索在细粒度场景下表现不佳的原因是负样本分布不匹配：语义不同但视觉上易混淆的符号很少被当作难负例。作者提出Sign-Aware Hard Negative Mining (SAN)，根据符号嵌入空间中的视觉混淆度（而非语言相似性）构建难负例。在PHOENIX-2014T上的实验表明，SAN显著提升细粒度检索性能，同时保持粗粒度准确率。
Motivation: 现有手语检索在细粒度场景下脆弱，原因不是模型容量不足，而是难负例监督不有效。文本驱动的挖掘策略无法捕捉视觉歧义，导致语义不同但视觉上混淆的符号未被充分利用为难负例。
Method: 提出Sign-Aware Hard Negative Mining (SAN)，基于符号嵌入空间中的视觉混淆度而非语言相似性来构建难负例。
Result: 在PHOENIX-2014T数据集上，SAN显著改善细粒度检索性能，同时不损害粗粒度准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在手语检索中，将负例监督与视觉歧义对齐的重要性。

papers.title: Geopolitical alignment: Endorsement effects in large language models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to summarize and evaluate policy-relevant information, but it remains unclear whether their judgments are implicitly shaped by geopolitical cues. I study this question with an endorsement experiment in which four LLMs evaluate the same international economic and security policies after each policy is randomly described as supported by the United States, the European Union, China, or Russia. In the numeric-only condition, GPT-5, Claude Sonnet, and Gemini rate China- and Russia-endorsed policies substantially lower than identical policies endorsed by the United States or the European Union; DeepSeek is the main exception. A second condition asks models to provide a short justification with the score. This request leaves the broad Western/non-Western gap intact for GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet, attenuates Gemini's penalties, and sharply activates China and Russia penalties in DeepSeek. The justifications indicate that Western endorsement is often treated as a credibility cue, whereas Chinese and Russian endorsement is treated as a cue for data security, sovereignty, surveillance, or geopolitical risk. These findings show that LLM policy evaluations can depend on the identity of a foreign endorser even when policy content is held fixed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过背书实验研究大型语言模型在评估国际经济和安保政策时是否受地缘政治背书影响。实验显示，对于相同政策，GPT-5、Claude Sonnet和Gemini在纯数字条件下对中俄背书的评分显著低于美欧背书；DeepSeek是例外。当要求提供理由时，DeepSeek也出现对中俄的惩罚。理由分析表明，西方背书常被视为可信度线索，中俄背书则被视为数据安全、主权或地缘政治风险线索。
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于总结和评估政策相关信息，但其判断是否隐含受地缘政治线索影响尚不清楚。
Method: 进行背书实验：四个LLM（GPT-5、Claude Sonnet、Gemini、DeepSeek）对相同的国际经济和安保政策进行评分，政策随机描述为得到美国、欧盟、中国或俄罗斯支持。实验包括纯数字条件和附带简短理由条件。
Result: 纯数字条件下，GPT-5、Claude Sonnet和Gemini对中俄背书的评分显著低于美欧背书，DeepSeek是例外。附带理由条件保持了GPT-5和Claude Sonnet的差距，减弱了Gemini的惩罚，但急剧激活了DeepSeek对中国和俄罗斯的惩罚。理由显示西方背书被视为可信度线索，中俄背书被视为数据安全、主权、监控或地缘政治风险线索。
Conclusion: LLM的政策评估可能依赖于外国背书者身份，即使政策内容固定不变。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnythingReality: Robust Online Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Open-Vocabulary VR Scene Exploration
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel integrated architecture for robust online 3D Gaussian splatting, real-time VR exploration, and speech-driven Vision-Language-Model interaction. Unlike methods assuming clean depth or external poses, our system combines ORB-SLAM3-based pose estimation with online Gaussian reconstruction for noisy real-world data. A VR pipeline enables immersive exploration of incremental reconstructions; a semantic module transcribes voice commands, generates scene descriptions, and records points of interest. Against state-of-the-art online Gaussian splatting methods, we improve image quality on our dataset (+14.5% PSNR, +8.6% SSIM, -14.3% LPIPS) and TUM-RGBD (+11.7% PSNR, +7.8% SSIM, -21.6% LPIPS), with comparable or superior frame rates via quality-speed configurations. We achieve an 88% VLM object-recognition rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种鲁棒的在线3D高斯泼溅SLAM系统，结合ORB-SLAM3姿态估计、在线高斯重建和VR管线，支持开放词汇的语音驱动VLM交互。在自定义数据集和TUM-RGBD上，相比现有在线高斯泼溅方法，PSNR提升14.5%和11.7%，VLM目标识别率达88%。
Motivation: 现有在线高斯泼溅方法依赖干净深度或外部姿态，难以处理真实世界噪声数据，且缺乏沉浸式VR探索与语义交互能力。
Method: 集成ORB-SLAM3进行姿态估计，在线重建3D高斯表示；VR界面支持实时探索增量重建；语音指令经过转录后驱动VLM生成场景描述和记录兴趣点。
Result: 在自定义数据集上PSNR提升14.5%、SSIM提升8.6%、LPIPS降低14.3%；在TUM-RGBD上PSNR提升11.7%、SSIM提升7.8%、LPIPS降低21.6%；帧率可配置；VLM目标识别率达88%。
Conclusion: 该系统在真实噪声数据下实现了鲁棒的在线高斯泼溅SLAM，并通过VR和语音VLM交互提升了场景探索的沉浸感和语义理解能力。

papers.title: Blockchain-Linked Auditable Decision Management for Telecom/IoT Fraud-Control Requests
papers.abstract_en: Telecom fraud-control studies often stop at detector-level classification, but deployment use requires request-level policy resolution, lifecycle traceability, and auditability. This paper reframes fraud control as blockchain-linked auditable decision management for synthetic telecom/IoT fraud-control requests, and its main result is that the QLoRA-tuned LLM branch becomes much more usable than zero-shot prompting but mainly approaches, rather than outperforms, a lower-cost centralized ensemble. The framework maps each synthetic deployment record to a managed request, blocks explicit out-of-boundary cases through a deterministic hard-fraud gate, scores non-hard requests using centralized ML (M1), federated meta-learning (M2), or LLM-family risk sources (M3), and resolves actions through a shared five-state policy, two-zone refinement mechanism, and local Ethereum-compatible audit layer. Evaluation uses separate synthetic training data and a 100,000-record deployment replay corpus, so the study should be read as controlled drift-replay evidence rather than field validation or proof of live deployability. On validation, M1 gives the strongest balance, with legitimate-request FPR 0.0890 under the 0.10 operating cap and soft-fraud recall 0.8341. On labeled deployment replay, however, the legitimate-FPR gap becomes large: M1 rises to 0.1646 and M3-QLoRA to 0.1801, while M3-QLoRA reduces the M3-Base legitimate FPR from 0.3915 and reaches 0.8240 soft-fraud recall. Blockchain telemetry shows that lifecycle gas, cost, latency, and throughput differences are driven by submitted off-chain decision profiles rather than changes in fraud logic.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables, IEEE Transaction Submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将电信/IoT欺诈控制重新定义为区块链链接的可审计决策管理框架，处理合成部署请求。框架包括确定性硬欺诈门、集中式ML（M1）、联邦元学习（M2）和LLM风险评估（M3），以及五态策略和以太坊兼容审计层。评估表明M1在验证中达到最佳平衡（合法FPR 0.0890，软欺诈召回0.8341），但在部署重放中所有方法合法FPR均上升；QLoRA微调LLM（M3-QLoRA）降低了基线LLM的高合法FPR，但性能仍接近成本更低的M1。研究应视为受控漂移重放证据，非现场验证。
Motivation: 现有欺诈控制研究多止步于检测器分类，缺乏请求级策略解析、生命周期可追溯性和审计能力，难以满足部署需求。
Method: 提出一个框架，将合成部署记录映射为管理请求，通过硬欺诈门过滤明显越界案例，对非硬请求使用三种风险评估（M1集中式ML、M2联邦元学习、M3 LLM家族），并通过五态策略、两区细化机制和本地以太坊兼容审计层执行决策。LLM分支通过QLoRA微调。
Result: 在验证集上，M1在0.10合法FPR上限下达到0.8341的软欺诈召回，M1和M3-QLoRA的合法FPR分别为0.0890和0.1801。在标记部署重放中，M1合法FPR升至0.1646，M3-QLoRA降至0.1801（低于M3-Base的0.3915），软欺诈召回0.8240。区块链开销由链下决策配置驱动，非欺诈逻辑。
Conclusion: QLoRA微调LLM比零样本更可用，但并未超越低成本集中式M1；框架需在真实部署中进一步验证，当前结果仅为受控漂移重放证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLMs for health: Perceived benefits, risks, intention to use AI chatbots, and willingness to self-disclose across sensitive health topics
papers.abstract_en: AI chatbots are increasingly used for answering health-related questions. This study examines the role of topic type discussed with an AI chatbot and individual characteristics on perceived benefits and risks, intention to use an AI chatbot, and willingness to self-disclose health information. We conducted an online experiment with a 2 (topic type: physical versus psychological, between-subjects) x 2 (topic sensitivity: low versus high, within-subjects) mixed design among a Dutch representative sample (N = 1,388). Results showed that perceived benefits were positively associated with intention and willingness to self-disclose, while perceived risks were negatively associated. Moreover, participants reported higher usage intentions for low-sensitive topics compared to high-sensitive topics. Furthermore, perceptions, intention, and willingness to self-disclose varied by individual characteristics. Overall, our findings suggest that intentions to use AI chatbots and self-disclosure of health-related information are primarily related to perceived benefits and risks and to personal characteristics rather than to topic type.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研究通过在线实验（N=1,388）探讨AI聊天机器人在健康话题中的感知收益、风险、使用意愿及自我披露意愿，发现感知收益正向影响使用意愿和自我披露，感知风险负向影响，且话题敏感性（低vs高）影响使用意愿，个体特征也有调节作用，但话题类型（心理vs生理）本身影响不显著。
Motivation: 现有研究较少同时考虑健康话题类型（心理vs生理）和话题敏感性以及个体特征对AI聊天机器人使用意愿和自我披露意愿的影响。
Method: 采用2（话题类型：心理vs生理，被试间）×2（话题敏感性：低vs高，被试内）混合设计的在线实验，收集荷兰代表性样本数据，测量感知收益、感知风险、使用意愿和自我披露意愿，并进行统计分析。
Result: 感知收益与使用意愿和自我披露意愿正相关，感知风险负相关；低敏感性话题的使用意愿高于高敏感性话题；不同个体特征（如年龄、性别、健康素养等）下感知、意愿和自我披露存在差异。话题类型本身对主要结果无显著影响。
Conclusion: AI健康聊天机器人的使用意愿和自我披露主要受感知收益、风险和个体特征驱动，而非话题类型；提示在设计健康聊天机器人时应关注用户感知和差异性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Influence Diagnostics in High-dimensional M-estimation: Precise Asymptotics
papers.abstract_en: The impact of a given training point on a statistical model is classically measured through its leave-one-out influence, which quantifies the effect of its removal from the training set on the model accuracy. While the statistics of leave-one-out influences are well understood in the low-dimensional, large sample limit $n\to \infty, d=O(1)$, they become more intricate in high dimensions, as the influence of a given sample develops non-trivial dependencies on all other training samples. For convex M-estimation under Gaussian design, in the high-dimensional limit $n\asymp d$, we show that the distribution of the influences across the training set converges to a limiting measure which we sharply characterize. Building on these results, we provide evidence that influential samples tend to lie close to the decision boundary, thereby making contact with a standard data selection heuristic in active learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在高维凸M估计的框架下，针对高斯设计，在n≍d的极限下，证明了训练点上leave-one-out影响的分布收敛到一个可精确刻画的极限测度。研究发现，高影响样本倾向于靠近决策边界，这与主动学习中常用的数据选择启发式一致。
Motivation: 低维大样本下leave-one-out影响的统计已研究充分，但高维中样本间依赖复杂，现有理论不足，本文旨在精确刻画高维M估计中影响分布的渐近行为。
Method: 采用高维渐近分析（n≍d），针对凸M估计与高斯设计，推导影响（leave-one-out influence）的极限分布。
Result: 证明了影响分布收敛到一明确极限测度，并指出高影响样本靠近决策边界。
Conclusion: 本文为高维M估计的影响诊断提供了精确渐近理论，并建立了与主动学习启发式的联系。

papers.title: Forget Narrowly, Retain Broadly: Unlearning as an Asymmetric Generalization Problem
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning in LLMs is the targeted removal of specific knowledge while preserving all other capabilities, critical for privacy and safety. Yet existing benchmarks measure it unreliably. They miss knowledge that resurfaces under paraphrased or indirect queries, a failure we call under-forgetting, and lack the semantic, syntactic, and lexical probes needed to verify that unrelated knowledge is preserved, a failure we call over-forgetting. Both failures reflect an asymmetric generalization problem. Forget evaluation must cover diverse query formulations of the same target facts, testing whether forgetting holds beyond exact training prompts. Retain evaluation must probe a far larger and implicitly defined set, namely every fact disjoint from the forget target. The retain set thus defines the effective forget set, yet current datasets provide no fine-grained annotation of this forget-retain boundary. We address this with SUITE, an evaluation protocol and training corpus that captures forget-retain structure for real-world factual domains. Methods trained on SUITE improve substantially, showing that training data is as important as algorithmic design. Building on the obtained insights, we introduce JensUn++, an unlearning algorithm that achieves the best forget-retain utility trade-off across three LLMs, in both sequential and joint unlearning settings. Code and datasets are available at https://amitpeleg.github.io/forget-narrowly-retain-broadly
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）机器遗忘（unlearning）中评估不可靠的问题，指出现有基准存在欠遗忘（under-forgetting）和过遗忘（over-forgetting）两种失败模式，并将此视为非对称泛化问题（asymmetric generalization problem）。作者提出SUITE评估协议与训练语料，以及JensUn++遗忘算法，在三个LLM上实现最佳遗忘-保留权衡。实验表明训练数据与算法设计同等重要。
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘基准在评估时不可靠：一方面未能检测到经改写或间接查询后重新浮现的遗忘知识（欠遗忘），另一方面缺乏对无关知识保留的充分探测（过遗忘），导致遗忘效果评估不准确。
Method: 提出SUITE协议，包含细粒度的遗忘-保留边界标注的真实世界事实领域训练语料；基于该语料设计JensUn++遗忘算法，在顺序和联合遗忘设置下优化遗忘与保留的权衡。
Result: JensUn++在三个不同的LLM上，在顺序遗忘和联合遗忘设置中均取得了最佳的遗忘-保留效用权衡，相比现有方法有显著改善。
Conclusion: 训练数据的质量与算法设计同等重要；SUITE语料和JensUn++可作为LLM遗忘领域的有力基准，代码和数据集已公开。

papers.title: All you need is SAMPAT
papers.abstract_en: The current state of the art in AI/ML rests on deep neural architectures, which, in general, suffer from a lack of interpretability. Interpretability is crucial to gleaning insights while analyzing experimental data, where quantitative predictions may not be adequate for a scientist. We present a three layer neural architecture, SAMPAT (Smooth Approximation via Multivariate Polynomials and Analytic Transformations), that can provably learn a continuous, everywhere differentiable function, that can approximate any smooth function arbitrarily closely. SAMPAT's approximant can be expressed as a closed and compact algebraic, analytic expression, providing complete interpretability. Experiments on synthetic and benchmark datasets indicate that SAMPAT yields competitive performance with simpler representations. For many tasks, a two layer SAMPAT suffices. By imposing restrictions on the connectivity between neurons, SAMPAT may be used to provide a range of approximants, including regular and trigonometric polynomials, rational expressions, Gaussians, mixtures of Gaussians, as well as arbitrary combinations of the same; without restrictions, it learns a suitable structure. SAMPAT may be used to factorize polynomials and model nonlinear systems. With the addition of skip connections, a 4 to 6 layer SAMPAT is adequate to represent a substantive range of methods widely used in AI/ML, allowing the choice of a model's family, not just its parameters, to also be optimized as part of the learning process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种三层神经网络架构 SAMPAT，通过多元多项式与解析变换实现任意光滑函数的可解释逼近。该网络输出为封闭代数表达式，保持完全可解释性，在合成与基准数据集上达到竞争性能。通过限制神经元连接可生成多项式、三角函数、有理式、高斯混合等多种形式；无限制时自动学习合适结构。
Motivation: 深度神经网络缺乏可解释性，而科学数据分析中定量预测不足以满足需求，需要可解释的模型来提取洞察。
Method: 提出 SAMPAT 三层神经网络，利用多元多项式和解析变换构造连续可微函数逼近器，输出为闭合解析表达式。可施加连接限制以生成特定函数族，或无限制自动学习结构。
Result: 在合成和基准数据集上取得竞争性能，许多任务仅需两层 SAMPAT。通过跳跃连接，4-6层 SAMPAT 可表示 AI/ML 中广泛使用的方法。
Conclusion: SAMPAT 提供完全可解释的平滑函数逼近，并允许在训练中优化模型族而非仅优化参数。

papers.title: Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting under Distribution Shifts: A Synthetic Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) represent evolving relational systems, whose underlying data-generating processes often change over time. Yet, TKG forecasting models are commonly evaluated only on empirical benchmark datasets that provide limited insight into the models' robustness to such distribution shifts. Recognising this issue, we study TKG forecasting under controlled shift environments using a synthetic TKG generator that encodes three temporal and structural properties -- recurrence, homophily, and periodicity -- as data-generating mechanisms. This allows us to evaluate seven forecasting architectures under stationary and shifting regimes. Our experiments suggest that robustness in TKG forecasting is highly signal-dependent. Recurrence-based and periodic regularities are largely recoverable under stationary conditions, and simple memory-based baselines can be competitive when recurrence dominates the data. However, structural breaks reveal limitations in model adaptivity, with shifts in latent entity-community structure posing the strongest challenge in our study. Overall, our findings improve the understanding of the capabilities and limitations of current TKG models confronted with temporal distribution shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过合成数据生成器研究了时序知识图谱（TKG）预测模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，构建了包含递归、同质性和周期性三种数据生成机制的控制环境，并评估了七种预测架构。实验表明鲁棒性高度依赖于信号类型：递归和周期性规律在平稳条件下可恢复，简单记忆基线在递归主导数据中具有竞争力；但结构性断裂暴露了模型自适应性不足，尤其是潜在实体-社区结构的偏移构成最大挑战。
Motivation: 现有TKG预测评估多基于经验基准数据集，难以揭示模型对分布偏移的鲁棒性，限制了对其泛化能力的理解。
Method: 使用合成TKG生成器编码递归、同质性和周期性机制，在平稳和偏移两种场景下评估七种TKG预测架构的性能。
Result: 递归和周期性规律在平稳条件下可被有效恢复；记忆基线在递归主导数据中表现竞争力；结构偏移（尤其实体-社区结构变化）对模型自适应构成最大挑战。
Conclusion: TKG预测模型对分布偏移的鲁棒性高度依赖数据生成机制，现有模型在处理结构性偏移时存在显著局限，需进一步改进自适应能力。

papers.title: When Does Order Flow Matter? State-Dependent L2 Liquidity-State Transitions in Crypto Futures
papers.abstract_en: Building event-conditioned market models requires separating macro-event labels from persistent microstructure state. We study this distinction in Binance BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT futures from 2023-2026, combining top-20 L2 order book data, trade-flow records, and macro-event windows. We define a supervised discrete L2 liquidity-state transition task, distinct from latent-regime detection and price-direction prediction, and evaluate models in rolling monthly out-of-sample folds with event-clustered validation and blocked permutation tests, admitting each feature layer only if it improves on the layer below it on the same panel. Within these event windows, the first-order predictive signal is the pre-event L2 liquidity state: a coarse pre-event state baseline strongly predicts post-event liquidity regimes, interpretable logit models over continuous L2 features fail to improve on it, and a shallow nonlinear L2 model adds a robust further gain of comparable size to the state baseline's own. The macro-event calendar enters only by locating the windows and supplying matched non-event controls; we use event timing but not the event's label content, so pre-event state competes against an uninformed within-window baseline, not against the event type. Order flow adds further value only when layered on top of the L2 state model, not as a replacement. This value is not robustly cross-symbol: for ETH it is present across calm, mixed, and stressed regimes and largest under stressed pre-event liquidity, whereas BTC shows only isolated five-minute passes and no regime that clears at both horizons. These findings motivate a state-first design principle for market microstructure models. We provide a liquidity-state transition baseline and evaluation protocol that reinforcement-learning, execution-policy, or LLM-based context layers should exceed before their added value is credited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究加密货币期货市场中L2流动性状态转换的预测问题，基于Binance BTCUSDT和ETHUSDT 2023-2026年的数据，结合订单簿、交易流和宏观事件窗口，发现事件窗口内预事件L2流动性状态是首要预测信号，订单流仅在L2状态模型之上提供额外价值，且该价值在跨品种上不稳健。
Motivation: 构建事件条件市场模型需要区分宏观事件标签与持续的微观结构状态，但目前缺乏对两者交互的明确分离研究。
Method: 定义有监督的离散L2流动性状态转换任务，采用滚动月度样本外评估、事件聚类验证和块排列检验，逐层添加特征并测试改进。
Result: 预事件L2流动性状态基线强预测后事件流动性状态；可解释的logit模型无法超越该基线；浅层非线性L2模型提供与状态基线相当的增益；订单流仅在L2状态模型之上增加价值，且对于ETH在不同市场状态下均有效，但BTC仅有零星通过。
Conclusion: 提出了市场微观结构模型的“状态优先”设计原则，并提供了一个流动性状态转换基线及评估协议，供强化学习、执行策略或LLM上下文层超越。

papers.title: Glob3R: Global Structure-from-Motion with 3D Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D geometric foundation models, such as VGGT, provide robust feed-forward 3D reconstruction by directly predicting camera poses and 3D scene points from input images. However, their results remain inaccurate, and scaling them to long sequences or large unordered image sets typically requires chunk-wise processing, which can introduce drift and inconsistency. We present Glob3R, a global SfM-style reconstruction built on 3D foundation models. Our key idea is to explicitly optimize feed-forward geometric predictions. To this end, we augment a frozen Pi3X backbone with a lightweight dense matching head that predicts image warps between selected reference frames and neighboring views. These dense warps are converted into sparse but reliable multi-view feature tracks, which provide correspondence constraints for global optimization. We further introduce a keyframe-based sliding-window association strategy that propagates tracks and relative poses across overlapping windows, enabling scalable reconstruction. Finally, we perform global motion averaging and bundle adjustment to refine camera poses, reduce scale inconsistencies, and recover dense scene geometry. Extensive experiments on indoor, outdoor, large-scale driving, and unordered SfM benchmarks demonstrate that Glob3R achieves robust and accurate reconstruction. It consistently improves over feed-forward foundation-model baselines and recent scalable reconstruction methods, while being more robust than classical SfM pipelines. The refined poses also lead to higher-quality neural rendering, validating the benefit of combining foundation-model priors with global geometric optimization. Project page: https://junyuandeng.github.io/Glob3r
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Glob3R是一种基于3D基础模型的全局SfM（结构光流）重建方法。它通过冻结Pi3X骨干网络并附加轻量级密集匹配头来预测图像扭曲，生成稀疏但可靠的多视图特征轨迹，并采用关键帧滑动窗口关联策略实现可扩展重建。全局运动平均和光束法平差用于优化相机姿态和场景几何。在室内、室外、大规模驾驶和无序SfM基准上，Glob3R一致优于前馈基础模型和现有可扩展重建方法，且比经典SfM更鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有3D几何基础模型（如VGGT）预测结果不够精确，且扩展到长序列或大规模无序图像时需分块处理，导致漂移和不一致性。
Method: 冻结Pi3X骨干网络，附加轻量级密集匹配头预测参考帧与邻域视图的图像扭曲；将密集扭曲转换为稀疏多视图特征轨迹；利用关键帧滑动窗口关联策略跨重叠窗口传播轨迹和相对姿态；执行全局运动平均和光束法平差以优化姿态并恢复密集场景几何。
Result: 在多个基准上，Glob3D显著提升重建鲁棒性和准确性，超越前馈基础模型和近期可扩展SfM方法，且精细化姿态提升神经渲染质量。
Conclusion: 结合基础模型先验与全局几何优化可有效提升SfM重建质量，但方法仍依赖滑动窗口策略，可能受限于关键帧选择。

summary_sections.method: 冻结Pi3X骨干网络，附加轻量级密集匹配头预测参考帧与邻域视图的图像扭曲；将密集扭曲转换为稀疏多视图特征轨迹；利用关键帧滑动窗口关联策略跨重叠窗口传播轨迹和相对姿态；执行全局运动平均和光束法平差以优化姿态并恢复密集场景几何。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准上，Glob3D显著提升重建鲁棒性和准确性，超越前馈基础模型和近期可扩展SfM方法，且精细化姿态提升神经渲染质量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结合基础模型先验与全局几何优化可有效提升SfM重建质量，但方法仍依赖滑动窗口策略，可能受限于关键帧选择。

papers.title: Git-Assistant: Planning-Based Support for Updating Git Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Version control systems are essential for collaborative software development, yet tools like git remain challenging for many practitioners. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising capabilities for interpreting developer intent, but their effectiveness in repository management tasks is limited by the need for formal reasoning. This work introduces Git-Assistant, an AI-based assistant that combines LLMs with automated planning to support developers in executing non-trivial git operations. The assistant analyzes repository context, translates natural language requests into actionable command sequences, and incorporates planning techniques to ensure correctness and safety. We present a systematic evaluation methodology using synthetic and randomized git environments, comparing the performance of LLM-only and planning-augmented variants across multiple metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that integrating formal reasoning with LLMs improves reliability and reduces errors in repository management, highlighting the potential of hybrid AI approaches for intelligent developer assistance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Git-Assistant，一个结合大语言模型 (LLM) 与自动规划 (automated planning) 的 AI 助手，用于支持开发者执行复杂的 Git 操作。该方法通过分析仓库上下文，将自然语言请求转化为可执行命令序列，并利用规划技术确保正确性和安全性。实验在合成和随机 Git 环境中评估，与纯 LLM 方法相比，规划增强变体提高了可靠性并减少了错误。

Method: 提出 Git-Assistant，结合 LLM 和自动规划，将自然语言请求转化为命令序列，并应用规划技术保证正确性和安全性。
Result: 在合成和随机 Git 环境中的实验表明，与纯 LLM 方法相比，规划增强变体提高了可靠性并减少了错误。
Conclusion: 将形式化推理与 LLM 结合能提高仓库管理的可靠性，突显混合 AI 方法在智能开发辅助中的潜力。

papers.title: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Whole-arm manipulation involves direct contact with the environment while the robot completes a task by distributing contact across multiple links as contacts form, slide, and break. This setting breaks common implicit assumptions in many learning-based manipulation pipelines: arm configuration tightly couples motion and contact forces, contact state is partially observed under occlusion, and purely learned rollouts can become physically inconsistent under distribution shift because many multi-link contact configurations are sparsely represented in the data. To address this, we propose TACTIC (Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control), a receding-horizon controller for whole-arm manipulation. TACTIC uses a contact-centric hybrid predictive model that combines RGB-D, distributed tactile sensing, and a compact 2D proximity representation. The model couples a learned, action-conditioned latent dynamics model with analytical kinematics through contact Jacobians, enabling rollouts of future contact configurations and interaction forces. TACTIC integrates these rollouts into a sampling-based MPC planner with contact-aware action sampling: contact Jacobian-based projections steer sampled action sequences toward force-modulating directions, and objectives defined over predicted proximity and interaction forces trade task progress against whole-arm force regulation. We evaluate TACTIC in simulation against state-of-the-art model-based and model-free methods, and perform ablations that isolate the contribution of each design choice. TACTIC consistently outperforms other methods. We further demonstrate real-world performance on a robot with distributed tactile sensing across three whole-arm manipulation tasks that require multi-contact trajectories: turning over and repositioning a manikin, and goal-reaching in a 3D dynamic maze. Website: https://emprise.cs.cornell.edu/tactic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为TACTIC的滚动时域控制器，用于全臂操作任务。该方法融合RGB-D视觉、分布式触觉传感和紧凑的2D邻近表示，通过接触雅可比矩阵将学习的动作条件潜动态模型与分析运动学耦合，实现未来接触构型和交互力的滚动预测。TACTIC将预测集成到基于采样的MPC规划器中，使用接触雅可比投影引导动作采样朝力调节方向，并权衡任务进度与整臂力调节。在仿真和真实机器人上的三项多接触全臂操作任务中，TACTIC持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 全臂操作中，手臂构型紧密耦合运动与接触力，接触状态在遮挡下部分可观测，且纯学习驱动的策略在分布偏移下因多链接触构型在数据中稀疏表示而易产生物理不一致。现有方法难以处理这些挑战。
Method: TACTIC采用接触中心混合预测模型，结合RGB-D、分布式触觉和2D邻近表示。模型将学习的动作条件潜动态模型与通过接触雅可比矩阵的分析运动学耦合，实现未来接触构型和交互力的滚动预测。MPC规划器使用接触感知动作采样：基于接触雅可比投影引导动作序列向力调制方向，优化目标权衡任务进度与整臂力调节。
Result: 摘要报告TACTIC在仿真中一致优于基于模型和无模型的先进方法，并消融实验验证了各设计选择的贡献。真实机器人实验在三个全臂操作任务（翻转并重新定位假人、在3D动态迷宫中到达目标）中展示了性能。
Conclusion: TACTIC通过结合接触感知预测和MPC，有效解决了全臂操作中多链接触的物理一致性和力调控问题。摘要未明确讨论局限性，但可能依赖于准确的触觉传感和接触模型。

papers.title: OpenProver: Agentic and Interactive Theorem Proving with Lean 4
papers.abstract_en: In this system paper, we present OpenProver, an open-source system for LLM-driven automated theorem proving (ATP) with integrated Lean 4 formal verification. OpenProver integrates a Planner-Worker-Verifier architecture inspired by recent ATP agentic systems such as Aletheia. A Planner agent maintains a compact Whiteboard scratchpad and an unbounded Repository of intermediate findings, and decomposes mathematical work into parallel Workers. OpenProver is fully open-source, offers reproducible evaluation through automatic formal verification of generated proofs, and provides an interactive terminal interface for human-guided proof search. In interactive mode, OpenProver allows the human operator to monitor and steer the proof search process, motivated by the established human-AI synergy in interactive code generation. To showcase the potential for quantitative ablation experiments enabled by automatic formal verification, we evaluate OpenProver on ProofNet and compare it with a simple baseline. OpenProver is publicly available at https://github.com/kripner/OpenProver.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 19th Conference on Intelligent Computer Mathematics (CICM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OpenProver，一个开源系统，采用Planner-Worker-Verifier架构，用于LLM驱动的自动定理证明，并集成Lean 4形式验证。系统提供交互式终端接口，支持人类引导的证明搜索，并通过自动形式验证实现可重复评估。在ProofNet上进行了定量消融实验。
Motivation: 现有自动定理证明系统通常缺乏开源、可重复评估和交互式人类协作能力。
Method: 提出Planner-Worker-Verifier架构，Planner维护白板和中间发现仓库，将任务分解为并行Worker。
Result: 在ProofNet上评估，与简单基线比较，展示了自动形式验证带来的定量消融实验能力。
Conclusion: OpenProver是开放的，支持人类-AI协同，并促进可重复研究。

papers.title: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Solar PV Panel Fault Classification
papers.abstract_en: The rapid expansion of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems has increased the need for reliable and scalable fault classification, as manual inspection is impractical at scale. Thermal infrared (IR) imaging provides a non-contact solution for identifying PV faults; however, accurate classification remains challenging due to class imbalance, limited texture information, and subtle thermal differences. In this work, we investigate the applicability of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) for thermal IR PV fault classification across various scenarios and propose JEFFNet (JEPA-EFFicientNet), a multibranch architecture that combines JEPA-based self-supervised representation learning with EfficientNetV2-S-based supervised convolutional feature extraction. JEFFNet fuses semantic representations from a JEPA-pretrained Vision Transformer with convolutional features from EfficientNetV2-S, enabling complementary feature learning. JEFFNet is evaluated on two public thermal IR datasets, PVF-10 and InfraredSolarModules (ISM), for both multiclass and derived binary (healthy/faulty) classification. On PVF-10, JEFFNet achieves an F1-score of $93.21$ and an accuracy of $94.33$ in the 10-class task, and an F1-score of $97.53$ and an accuracy of $96.41$ in the derived 2-class task. On ISM, JEFFNet achieves an F1-score of $72.60$ and an accuracy of $83.88$ in the 12-class task, and an F1-score of $94.69$ and an accuracy of $94.78$ in the derived 2-class task. JEFFNet also uses only 108.6M parameters versus 205.91M for GEPFNet, a 47.2\% reduction. These results demonstrate that combining self-supervised semantic and supervised convolutional features provides an effective, parameter-efficient solution for thermal IR PV fault classification. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Azimi2kht/JEFFNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在光伏电池板热红外图像故障分类中的应用，提出多分支网络JEFFNet，融合JEPA预训练的视觉Transformer语义表示与EfficientNetV2-S监督卷积特征。在PVF-10和ISM数据集上，JEFFNet在十类和十二类任务中取得有竞争力的F1分数与准确率，参数数量仅为对比模型的52.8%。
Motivation: 光伏系统规模扩大使人工巡检不可行，热红外成像虽可非接触检测故障，但存在类别不平衡、纹理信息不足和细微热差异问题，亟需高效准确的自动分类方法。
Method: 提出JEFFNet，包含JEPA预训练视觉Transformer分支与EfficientNetV2-S监督卷积分支，通过特征融合实现互补学习；采用自监督与监督联合训练策略。
Result: PVF-10数据集上十类任务F1=93.21%、准确率94.33%，二类任务F1=97.53%、准确率96.41%；ISM数据集上十二类任务F1=72.60%、准确率83.88%，二类任务F1=94.69%、准确率94.78%；参数量108.6M，较GEPFNet减少47.2%。
Conclusion: 融合自监督语义特征与监督卷积特征为热红外光伏故障分类提供了参数高效的解决方案。
