papers.title: Complexity-Guided Component-wise Initialization for Language Model Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained language models often exhibit structured weight spectra, suggesting that training may repeatedly produce similar layerwise and component-wise organization. We ask whether these recurring spectral patterns can be reused as an initialization signal for GPT-2-style language-model pretraining. First, we analyze eleven pretrained GPT-2-style checkpoints that vary in size, language, tokenizer, and training corpus, measuring Frobenius norm and effective-rank entropy across layers and Transformer subcomponents. The checkpoints show shared depth trends, especially increasing scale and stronger spectral concentration in residual-writing matrices. We then construct initialization schemes that imitate the component-wise magnitudes and spectral profiles of pretrained models, and compare them with several weight initialization methods. These initializers visibly change the model's structural spectral patterns, but the evaluation results do not show a corresponding performance advantage. Pretrained-weight reuse remains competitive, while coarse spectral matching alone is not a reliable optimization strategy. Our results suggest that pretrained spectra are useful diagnostics of trained model structure, but that effective reuse likely requires preserving richer information than component-wise scale and singular-value shape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析GPT-2风格语言模型预训练后权重的谱结构，发现不同模型共享深度趋势，尤其是在残差写入矩阵中尺度增加和谱集中。作者尝试模仿这些谱模式作为初始化信号，但实验表明仅靠分量级的谱匹配并不带来性能优势，预训练权重复用仍更具竞争力。
Motivation: 预训练语言模型常呈现结构化的权重谱，提示训练可能反复产生相似的层次和组件组织。本文探究这些谱模式能否被重用为初始化信号以改进预训练。
Method: 首先分析11个GPT-2风格检查点的Frobenius范数和有效秩熵，测量层和Transformer子组件的谱特征。然后构建模仿预训练模型分量级幅度和谱分布的初始化方案，并与多种权重初始化方法比较。
Result: 这些初始化方法改变了模型的结构谱模式，但评估结果未显示相应的性能优势。粗粒度的谱匹配本身不是可靠的优化策略。
Conclusion: 预训练谱是训练后模型结构的有用诊断工具，但有效重用可能需要保留比分量级尺度和奇异值形状更丰富的信息。

papers.title: Interference and Retention in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning commonly relies on post-hoc mechanisms such as replay, elastic regularization, or distillation. This work argues that forgetting should instead be modeled directly as interference between tasks. In the frozen-feature regime, forgetting from learning a new task is exactly the interference energy induced on the old task. In deep networks, the same quantity is recovered through path-averaged curvature with minimal additional forward passes. When task supports are disjoint, forgetting can be eliminated structurally and when task supports overlap in conflicting directions, a non-zero distortion floor is unavoidable. The same geometry optimally merges models through task-aware orthogonalization. From this analysis we derive Interference-Gated Functional Allocation (IGFA), a replay-free, Fisher-free method that shares directions when tasks align and protects them when they conflict. Across benchmarks, IGFA achieves lossless retention when tasks are structurally separable and moves unavoidable cost from irreversible forgetting into deferred but recoverable plasticity when they are not. It matches the strongest replay-free structural baselines on dissimilar-task streams and improves on unconditional projection when similarity makes transfer worth preserving.

papers.title: Application of machine learning to monster level prediction in tabletop RPG game design
papers.abstract_en: Designing balanced adversaries is a central but labor-intensive task in tabletop role-playing game (TTRPG) development. In systems such as Pathfinder, each monster is described by many numerical attributes that jointly determine its power, summarized as an ordinal level. We investigate whether machine learning can support designers by predicting this level from a monster's attributes, framing the task as tabular ordinal regression. We introduce what is, to our knowledge, the first dataset built specifically for TTRPG monster-level prediction, derived from publicly available Pathfinder Second Edition data. Using it, we compare classical regression models with rounding schemes, dedicated tabular ordinal regression algorithms, and neural networks with ordinal-aware losses. To mirror real design workflows, we evaluate all models under chronological and expanding-window protocols with several complementary metrics. Results show that tree-based ensembles outperform linear models and neural approaches, achieving near-perfect ordinal ranking and high predictive accuracy. Explainable AI analyses, such as feature importance and error distributions, show that the model is aligned with human intuition and follows patterns grounded in game rules. Together, these results show that machine learning can reliably approximate designer judgments and serve as an effective computer-aided tool for monster balancing and broader TTRPG system design.

papers.title: Toward Auditable AI Scientists: A Hypothesis Evolution Protocol for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to play a central role in AI-driven scientific discovery. Equipped with broad knowledge, flexible reasoning, and tool use, they have the potential to autonomously explore and solve scientific problems by repeatedly proposing hypotheses, testing them, and revising their beliefs in the light of the evidence. In current agents, however, these hypotheses, tests, and belief updates are buried in unstructured logs, and no mechanism lets the agent or the human researcher audit that process. Here we propose the Hypothesis Evolution Protocol (HEP), an agent harness that provides hypothesis generation, evaluation, and evolution as explicit, auditable operations. On materials-science research tasks, a HEP-equipped agent operates the hypothesis--test--evidence--belief cycle that planning-style agents lack, generalizes across research questions, and exploits the protocol more fully as the base LLM becomes more capable. These results mark a step toward auditable AI scientists, whose scientific reasoning can be inspected, verified, and built upon.

papers.title: YeTI: You Only Need Two Noisy Images for Real-World sRGB Noise Generation
papers.abstract_en: Real-world sRGB image denoising remains challenging due to the nonlinear characteristics of sensor noise and the difficulty of acquiring aligned clean-noisy image pairs. Supervised denoisers often overfit to limited paired datasets, while self-supervised methods still depend on sufficiently diverse noisy observations. These limitations motivate scalable noise synthesis methods that can model real-world noise without clean ground truth or camera metadata. We propose YeTI, a real-world sRGB noise generation framework that learns from only two noisy observations of the same scene. YeTI uses a Reconstruction Autoencoder to disentangle scene structure and noise characteristics, and models the latent noise distribution with a one-step Conditional Diffusion Transformer trained using consistency objectives. Given a single noisy input at inference time, YeTI generates realistic, signal-dependent noise while preserving the underlying scene content. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of YeTI across real-world benchmarks. We evaluate noise generation on SIDD and further assess generalization on SIDD+, MAI2021, and SID, covering smartphone and diverse consumer-camera sensors. Downstream denoising results on DND further show that denoisers trained with YeTI-synthesized images achieve strong real-world performance, highlighting the practical value of clean-image-free and metadata-free noise generation.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 YeTI，一种真实世界 sRGB 噪声生成框架，仅需同一场景的两张含噪图像即可学习噪声分布。使用重建自编码器分离场景结构与噪声，结合条件扩散 Transformer 和一致性目标进行一步噪声生成。实验表明生成噪声逼真，用于训练去噪器可在真实基准上取得强性能。
Motivation: 真实世界 sRGB 去噪面临非线性噪声和干净-噪声图像对难以获取的问题，现有监督方法过拟合，自监督方法依赖多样噪声观测，需可扩展的噪声合成方法。
Method: 提出 YeTI，包括重建自编码器分离场景与噪声，以及用一致性训练的一步条件扩散 Transformer 建模潜噪声分布；推理时仅需单张含噪输入即可生成信号相关噪声。
Result: 在 SIDD、SIDD+、MAI2021、SID 等基准上验证噪声生成质量，下游去噪实验显示用 YeTI 合成数据训练的去噪器在 DND 上表现优异。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 YeTI 无需干净图像或相机元数据即可生成真实噪声，具有实际应用价值。

papers.title: GenVid2Robot: From Video Generation to Robot Manipulation via Rigid-Geometric Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Generated videos provide useful visual motion priors for robot manipulation, but their visual plausibility does not imply physical executability. A generated video usually lacks metric geometry, grasp grounding, robot kinematic feasibility, and execution-time feedback, which makes direct trajectory replay unreliable in real-world manipulation. This paper presents GenVid2Robot, a rigid-geometric consistency framework that converts generated video motion into executable real-robot manipulation trajectories. Given an initial RGB-D observation and a task instruction, GenVid2Robot samples task-relevant semantic anchors from the real first frame, tracks these anchors through generated video candidates, and verifies whether the resulting 2D motion can be explained by first-frame RGB-D anchors under a sparse relative $SE(3)$ model. In this way, generated videos are treated as uncertain visual motion hypotheses rather than direct robot demonstrations. Only geometrically consistent motion is transferred to the robot. The accepted relative motion is then applied to the real grasp-time TCP pose selected by mask-constrained grasping, producing a grasp-conditioned execution trajectory that is consistent with both the visual motion prior and the physical grasp configuration. To reduce execution mismatch caused by RGB-D noise, calibration residuals, and small contact-induced displacement, a bounded depth-compensation module corrects local depth-direction errors without assuming full online replanning. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that GenVid2Robot improves the reliability of generated-video-guided manipulation by grounding visual motion priors with sparse metric geometry, grasp constraints, robot feasibility checking, and bounded execution feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenVid2Robot 框架，通过刚性几何一致性将生成视频中的运动转换为可执行的机器人操作轨迹。该方法利用初始 RGB-D 观测和任务指令，从第一帧采样语义锚点，在生成视频中跟踪锚点，并通过稀疏相对 SE(3) 模型验证 2D 运动是否与第一帧 RGB-D 锚点一致，仅转移几何一致的运动到机器人。实验表明该方法提升了生成视频引导操作的可靠性。
Motivation: 生成视频虽然提供了视觉运动先验，但缺乏度量几何、抓取基础、机器人运动学可行性和执行反馈，直接回放轨迹在真实操作中不可靠。
Method: 提出刚性几何一致性框架，包含语义锚点采样与跟踪、基于稀疏相对 SE(3) 模型的几何一致性验证、掩膜约束抓取选择抓取位姿、以及有界深度补偿模块修正局部深度方向误差。
Result: 真实机器人实验表明，该方法通过将视觉运动先验与稀疏度量几何、抓取约束、机器人可行性检查和有界执行反馈相结合，提高了生成视频引导操作的可靠性。
Conclusion: 通过几何一致性验证和物理约束，生成视频可以可靠地转化为机器人操作轨迹，但该方法依赖于 RGB-D 观测和初始帧锚点选择。

papers.title: HiHR: Hierarchical Hyperbolic Representation for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Aerial-Ground Person Re-IDentification (AG-ReID) aims to retrieve the same person across heterogeneous aerial and ground camera platforms. Although great progress has been made, existing methods remain suboptimal due to the direct feature alignment across views, overlooking view-specific cues. To address this issue, we propose a novel Hierarchical Hyperbolic Representation (HiHR) framework for AG-ReID. More specifically, we first extract multi-granularity features based on pre-trained visual-text encoders. Then, we propose a Text-guided Multi-granularity Fusion (TMF) to fuse multi-granularity features and enhance the representation ability of identity features. Furthermore, we introduce the Hierarchical Hyperbolic Learning (HHL) to construct a hierarchical feature structure in a hyperbolic space. This hierarchy includes a coarse level that ensures identity separability and cross-view consistency, and a fine level that preserves view-specific discriminative cues. As a result, our proposed framework can effectively aggregate view-invariant and view-specific discriminative features for AG-ReID. Extensive experiments on four AG-ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. The source code is available at https://github.com/YangQiWei3/HiHR.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV2026. More modifications may be performed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层次双曲表示（HiHR）框架用于空中-地面行人重识别（AG-ReID）。该方法利用文本引导的多粒度融合和层次双曲学习，在双曲空间中构建粗粒度和细粒度的特征层次，分别捕捉跨视角不变性和视角特定判别性信息。在四个AG-ReID基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有AG-ReID方法直接对齐跨视角特征，忽略了视角特有信息，导致性能次优。
Method: 提出HiHR框架：首先从预训练的视觉-文本编码器提取多粒度特征，然后通过文本引导的多粒度融合（TMF）增强身份特征表示，最后引入层次双曲学习（HHL）在双曲空间中构建包含粗粒度（身份可分性与跨视角一致性）和细粒度（视角特定判别线索）的层次结构。
Result: 在四个AG-ReID基准数据集上的实验证明了该框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效聚合视角不变和视角特定的判别特征，提升AG-ReID性能。

papers.title: Causally Debiased Latent Action Model for Embodied Action Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) aim to simulate future observations conditioned on embodied actions, offering a promising foundation for robot planning, policy evaluation, and data augmentation. However, learning controllable ACWMs requires large-scale action-labeled data, which remains costly to collect in the real world. Latent action models (LAMs) mitigate this bottleneck by inferring latent actions from unlabeled videos, but existing LAMs are typically trained with reconstruction-only objectives and therefore entangle action-relevant dynamics with action-irrelevant visual factors such as backgrounds and untouched objects. In this work, we identify this action-irrelevant bias as a key obstacle to controllable ACWMs and introduce evaluation metrics to measure latent-action bias, action following, and robustness. We propose CD-LAM, a causally debiased framework for LAM-based ACWMs. CD-LAM introduces three efficient fine-tuning objectives: embodiment-centric reconstruction, action-centric contrastive learning, and latent space calibration, which together encourage embodiment-focused, action-aware, and calibrated non-collapsed latent action representations. Experiments on 2B and 14B ACWM backbones show that CD-LAM substantially improves latent-action controllability, downstream robot-action following, visual fidelity, and adaptation efficiency, requiring only 6k fine-tuning steps and more than 12$\times$ fewer robot-action adaptation updates than the baseline.

Motivation: 现有LAM仅以重建为目标训练，导致潜在动作与动作无关的视觉因素（如背景、未触碰物体）相纠缠，成为可控制ACWM的关键障碍。作者引入评估指标来量化这种偏差。

Conclusion: CD-LAM提供了一种高效的去偏方法，使LAM能够学习更可控的潜在动作表示，从而提升ACWM在机器人规划、策略评估和数据增强中的应用潜力。

papers.title: Generative Communications: Overview, Technologies, and Trends
papers.abstract_en: The groundbreaking development of generative artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly boosting the ability to generate content such as images and videos, reshaping communication paradigms. This article introduces generative communications (GenCom), a novel paradigm for 6G networks in which large AI models (LAMs) drive semantic understanding, reasoning, and content generation, embedding these into the communication process. Unlike traditional systems that strictly pursue accurate bit transmission, GenCom enables transmitters to convey only minimal yet sufficient information, while receivers leverage shared generative priors and knowledge bases to synthesize the intended output. Communication is thus redefined as controlled generation rather than data reproduction. We formalize the concept of GenCom, clarify its AI-native and generation-driven properties, and present its core mechanisms. A two-layer GenCom architecture supported by key enabling technologies is proposed, and analysis of four representative application scenarios demonstrates that GenCom offers ultra-efficient transmission, semantic-level robustness, and new network functions. Finally, we outline future research directions, including foundational theory and real-time processing, highlighting a promising pathway toward 6G networks.
papers.comment: accepted by IEEE Wireless Communications Magazine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式通信（GenCom）作为6G网络的新范式，利用大型AI模型（LAMs）驱动语义理解、推理和内容生成，将通信重新定义为受控生成而非数据复制。文章形式化GenCom概念，提出双层架构和关键技术，通过四个应用场景展示其超高效传输、语义级鲁棒性和新网络功能。
Motivation: 传统通信系统严格追求比特级准确传输，在6G时代面临频谱效率瓶颈和语义理解需求；生成式AI的突破为通信范式变革提供可能。
Method: 采用AI原生、生成驱动的方法，发端仅传输最小充分信息，收端利用共享生成先验和知识库合成目标输出；提出包含语义层和生成层的双层架构，并列举多种使能技术。
Result: 通过四个代表性场景分析，证明GenCom能实现超高效传输、语义级鲁棒性和新网络功能。
Conclusion: 生成式通信为6G网络提供有前景的路径，未来需研究基础理论和实时处理等方向。

papers.title: Scoped Verification for Reliable Long-Horizon Agentic Context Evolution under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Deployed LLM agents rely on agentic context, the model-external textual control content assembled by an operational harness. In this work, the mutable component of that context is a persistent system-level instruction that is updated from operational experience while the model, tools, and harness remain fixed. Over long evolution horizons, flat-text maintenance makes verification increasingly difficult as accumulated instructions grow and interact. We propose Graph-Regularized Agentic Context Evolution (GRACE), which maintains the persistent instruction component as a typed semantic graph and validates proposed updates within the local typed neighborhoods of modified nodes. Accepted graph updates are reconstructed as incremental edits to the textual instruction checkpoint used at deployment. We evaluate GRACE within a fixed telecom agent harness derived from $τ^2$-bench under a controlled distribution-shift protocol. Across five independent replications, GRACE improves strict reliability, measured by pass^3, from the Gemini 2.5 Flash zero-shot value of 0.091 to 0.673$\pm$0.136 at the final checkpoint. This exceeds a Gemini 3.1 Pro zero-shot reference of 0.242 on the same held-out set, while the flat-text HCE baseline finishes at 0.191$\pm$0.051. These results identify two requirements for reliable long-horizon context evolution, a structural substrate that makes verification local and a consolidation mechanism that keeps accumulated instruction content usable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图正则化的智能体上下文演化方法（GRACE），通过将持久指令维护为类型化语义图并在局部邻域验证更新，提升长周期智能体上下文演化的可靠性。在电信智能体框架下，采用分布偏移协议评估，GRACE 在严格可靠性指标 pass^3 上从 0.091 提升至 0.673±0.136，显著优于平坦文本基线。
Motivation: 部署的 LLM 智能体依赖外部文本控制内容，随着演化周期增长，平坦文本维护导致验证困难，指令积累和交互带来可靠性挑战。
Method: 提出 GRACE，将持久指令组件维护为类型化语义图，在修改节点的局部类型化邻域内验证更新，接受的图更新重构为文本指令检查点的增量编辑。
Result: 在分布偏移协议下，GRACE 的 pass^3 从 Gemini 2.5 Flash 零样本 0.091 提升至 0.673±0.136，超过 Gemini 3.1 Pro 零样本 0.242，平坦文本基线为 0.191±0.051。
Conclusion: 可靠的长周期上下文演化需要两个条件：使验证局部化的结构基板和保持积累指令内容可用的合并机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attention to Detail: Evaluating Energy, Performance, and Accuracy Trade-offs Across vLLM Configurations
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models are reshaping how software is developed and maintained. They are typically deployed in production using inference engines such as vLLM, which can efficiently serve pre-trained, highly configurable models. While prior work has focused on model architectures and hardware acceleration, the impact of inference engine configuration on energy consumption, performance, and output quality remains poorly understood. In this paper, we present a large-scale controlled study of three selected vLLM configuration options: attention kernel type, prefix caching, and chunked prefill. We evaluate all combinations of these configurations across 5 open-weight LLMs and 5 diverse inference tasks, totaling $9,000$ runs and $93,600$ measures. We analyze energy consumption, latency, and accuracy, and examine both main effects and interaction effects between configuration options and tasks. Our results show that the studied configuration options significantly impact energy and performance, mainly driven by attention type and prefix caching, while chunked prefill has a limited effect under the default vLLM serving configuration and evaluated workloads. These effects are highly model- and workload-dependent, and no configuration is universally optimal. We further show that model choice dominates global trade-offs, while configuration tuning provides local improvements along the Pareto frontier. Unexpectedly, inference options can also affect model accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 vLLM 推理引擎的配置选项（注意力核类型、前缀缓存、分块预填充）进行了大规模控制实验，在 5 个开源 LLM 和 5 个推理任务上共进行 9,000 次运行和 93,600 次测量，分析能耗、延迟和准确度。结果表明，注意力和前缀缓存显著影响能耗与性能，分块预填充效果有限；配置影响高度依赖模型和工作负载，模型选择主导全局权衡，配置调优提供局部 Pareto 改进，且配置选项意外地影响模型准确性。
Motivation: LLM 通常通过 vLLM 等推理引擎部署，但推理引擎配置对能耗、性能和输出质量的影响尚不清楚，此前工作多关注模型架构和硬件加速。
Method: 对 vLLM 的三个配置选项（注意力核类型、前缀缓存、分块预填充）的所有组合进行控制实验，覆盖 5 个开源 LLM 和 5 种推理任务，共 9,000 次运行，测量能耗、延迟和准确度，分析主效应和交互效应。
Result: 注意力核类型和前缀缓存显著影响能耗与性能，分块预填充在默认配置下效果有限；影响高度依赖模型和工作负载；模型选择主导全局权衡，配置调优提供局部 Pareto 改进；配置选项意外地影响模型准确度。
Conclusion: vLLM 配置选项对能耗、性能和准确性有显著但依赖上下文的影响，模型选择比配置调优更重要，调优可提供局部优化，且需注意配置对准确率的潜在影响。

papers.title: TSR-Ego: Temporally Guided Stereo Refinement Framework for Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric 3D human pose estimation from head-mounted stereo cameras is challenging due to fisheye distortion, severe self-occlusion, and frequent truncation of body joints outside the camera field of view. Recent stereo egocentric methods have improved performance through heatmap lifting, stereo correspondence, and transformer-based refinement, but they often rely heavily on frame-local evidence or use temporal information only as auxiliary pose-level context. This limits robustness when current-frame stereo cues are weak, occluded, or ambiguous. We propose TSR-Ego, a temporally guided stereo framework that couples short-term motion evidence with projection-guided feature sampling. The model first enriches dense stereo feature maps using a causal depthwise-separable temporal convolution, allowing past visual evidence to influence the feature space before deformable cross-attention. A single-stage causal stereo decoder then refines learned 3D joint queries through temporal self-attention, joint self-attention, and fisheye deformable stereo cross-attention, using the evolving pose estimate to generate 2D sampling references. Unlike methods that apply temporal reasoning mainly after pose prediction, TSR-Ego uses motion context to shape both the sampled stereo features and the joint representations while preserving online inference without future frames. Experiments on UnrealEgo2 and UnrealEgo-RW show state-of-the-art performance, with especially strong gains on real-world sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TSR-Ego，一种时间引导的立体框架，用于自我中心3D人体姿态估计。通过因果深度可分离时间卷积和单阶段因果立体解码器，在UnrealEgo2和UnrealEgo-RW数据集上取得最先进性能，尤其在真实世界序列上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖帧级局部证据或仅将时间信息作为辅助上下文，在立体线索弱、遮挡或模糊时鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出因果深度可分离时间卷积来丰富立体特征图，再通过单阶段因果立体解码器进行时间自注意力、关节自注意力和鱼眼可变形立体交叉注意力，利用运动上下文引导特征采样和关节表示。
Result: 在UnrealEgo2和UnrealEgo-RW数据集上取得最先进性能，尤其在真实世界序列上获得显著提升。
Conclusion: 该框架将运动上下文用于塑造采样特征和关节表示，同时保持在线推理，不依赖未来帧。

papers.title: Understanding Schedule-Free Methods in Nonconvex Optimization: Rate Guarantees and Escaping Saddles
papers.abstract_en: Schedule-Free methods have attracted growing interest for alleviating the burden of designing and tuning a learning rate scheduler, while matching and sometimes even outperforming optimizers with tuned schedulers. Despite their strong empirical results, their convergence theory in nonconvex optimization, where modern machine learning objectives typically arise, has remained largely unexplored. In this paper, we provide worst-case analyses of Schedule-Free gradient descent and Schedule-Free stochastic gradient descent, in their standard form and without auxiliary modifications or restrictive conditions, for smooth but possibly nonconvex objectives. Based on a Lyapunov analysis derived from the continuous-time limiting ordinary differential equation associated with these methods, we show that Schedule-Free gradient descent and Schedule-Free stochastic gradient descent achieve the optimal worst-case convergence rates attainable among first-order methods. We further formulate Schedule-Free gradient descent as a nonautonomous dynamical system and prove strict-saddle avoidance under an arbitrarily small one-time perturbation. These theoretical results provide a better understanding of the strong performance that Schedule-Free methods demonstrate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对非凸优化中的Schedule-Free梯度下降和随机梯度下降进行了最坏情况收敛分析，基于Lyapunov方法和连续时间极限ODE，证明它们达到一阶方法的最优收敛率，并在任意小单次扰动下证明严格鞍点逃避。理论结果解释了其强实证表现。
Motivation: Schedule-Free方法在实证中表现优异，但非凸优化中的收敛理论尚不明确，缺乏理论保证。
Method: 基于Lyapunov分析和连续时间极限ODE进行最坏情况收敛分析；将Schedule-Free梯度下降视为非自治动力系统，证明严格鞍点逃避。
Result: 证明标准形式的Schedule-Free梯度下降和随机梯度下降在光滑非凸目标上达到一阶方法的最优最坏情况收敛率。
Conclusion: 本文的理论结果加深了对Schedule-Free方法强性能的理解。

papers.title: COAST: Context-Aware Differential Learning for Gene Expression Prediction in Spatial Transcriptomics
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics enables profiling of spatial gene expression but is limited by high cost and low throughput, motivating prediction from H&E histopathology images. Existing context-aware methods mainly supervise absolute expression, while relative expression relationships between spots are rarely used explicitly. We propose COAST, a context-aware differential learning framework for spatial gene expression prediction. COAST conditions the local and global context features with type-specific modulation and aggregates the target and context spot tokens using a Transformer encoder to capture both fine-grained local patterns and slide-level structure. It is trained with a joint objective that combines absolute expression regression with signed differential regression between the target and context spots. Experiments on multiple spatial transcriptomics datasets show consistent improvements in correlation- and distribution-based metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of context-aware differential learning for histology-based spatial gene expression prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出COAST框架，利用上下文感知差分学习从H&E组织病理图像预测空间基因表达。通过类型特定调制和Transformer编码器聚合局部和全局上下文，并联合优化绝对表达回归与符号差分回归。在多个数据集上获得更好的相关性和分布度量。
Motivation: 空间转录组学成本高、通量低，需要从H&E图像预测基因表达。现有方法仅监督绝对表达，未充分利用点之间相对表达关系。
Method: 提出COAST框架，使用类型特定调制处理局部和全局上下文特征，通过Transformer编码器聚合目标点和上下文点的表征。训练采用联合损失：绝对表达回归损失 + 目标与上下文之间的符号差分回归损失。
Result: 在多个空间转录组数据集上，COAST在相关性和分布度量上持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 上下文感知差分学习有效用于组织学图像的空间基因表达预测。

papers.title: A Personalized Computational Framework for Assessing the Sufficiency of Partially Observed Data in Healthcare AI models
papers.abstract_en: Achieving early and timely diagnosis and treatment for disease is a major challenge. Recent applications of machine learning (ML) algorithms trained on patient data have shown promise in many different settings for predicting the patient health state. A challenge often faced when applying these ML algorithms is that at any given time, not all clinical variables (features) needed as input to perform prediction tasks are available. We define the concept of full-feature-capacity (FFC) to refer to prediction performance when such algorithms make use of all features on which they were trained. We then introduce Feature Sufficiency Analysis (FSA) - an analysis for determining whether a subset of all clinical features needed by an AI model is sufficient to achieve FFC. FSA estimates the underlying distributions of missing variables conditioned on features that are available. FSA provides a patient-specific assessment of whether the existing set of measured features achieves FFC. If yes, then there is no need to acquire further inputs and a ML-based prediction. We provide two case studies: prediction of need for postoperative prolonged ventilation in patients recovering from heart surgery; 10-year mortality prediction in an outpatient cohort. We also demonstrate that FSA also provides a clinically interpretable feature-ranking methodology based on prediction sufficiency, identifies intrinsically hard-to-predict patient populations, and has the potential to perform cost-aware optimization for clinical data acquisition. FSA provides a generic computational approach for determining whether incomplete clinical information is sufficient to support trustworthy AI-assisted clinical decision-making, thereby facilitating the prospective deployment of healthcare AI systems across diverse clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医疗AI模型中临床变量部分可观测的问题，定义了全特征容量（FFC）概念，并提出特征充分性分析（FSA）框架。FSA通过估计缺失变量在已有特征条件下的分布，判断当前可用特征子集是否足以达到FFC，从而避免不必要的数据采集。在心脏术后通气时长预测和门诊患者10年死亡率预测两个案例中验证了效果，并展示了可解释性特征排序和成本感知优化的能力。
Motivation: 医疗AI模型常因部分临床特征缺失而无法直接使用，现有方法缺乏对已有特征是否足以支持预测的系统性评估，导致数据采集成本高或预测不可靠。
Method: 提出FSA框架，利用条件分布估计完整特征空间下的预测性能，通过比较子集性能与FFC的差异判断充分性；同时提供基于充分性的特征排序和难预测人群识别。
Result: 在心脏术后通气时长预测和门诊10年死亡率预测两个案例中，FSA有效识别了特征充分性条件，并展示了可解释的特征排序和难预测人群识别能力。
Conclusion: FSA提供了一种通用的计算框架，可在不完全临床信息下评估AI辅助决策的可靠性，有助于推动医疗AI系统在多样化临床场景中的前瞻性部署。

papers.title: What Pixels Are Enough? SEAMS: Sufficiency Saliency via MSE-Preservation Soft-Masks
papers.abstract_en: Saliency maps are most useful when they identify the image regions that are sufficient to preserve a model's behaviour. We introduce SEAMS, a sufficiency-based saliency method that directly optimises a soft mask using a preservation objective. Given a frozen differentiable model output, such as a class probability, CLS embedding, or token representation, SEAMS searches for a compact mask that preserves the selected output. The approach relies on a simple optimisation framework based on soft masks, a learnable budget, and a three-way image composite generated entirely from the query image. As a result, it requires no auxiliary distractor dataset, architecture-specific attribution mechanism, or differentiable top-k relaxation. Experiments with frozen ViT-S/16 and ConvNeXt models show that the same optimisation pipeline can generate object-level, class-conditioned, and token-level explanations by changing only the preserved target. The resulting masks are compact, interpretable, stable across random initialisations, and competitive on insertion and deletion benchmarks. Our results also indicate that different architectures often rely on different sufficient evidence while achieving similar preservation fidelity, highlighting the architecture-dependent nature of visual explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEAMS 是一种基于充分性 (sufficiency) 的显著性方法，通过优化软掩码 (soft mask) 直接最小化模型输出（如类别概率、CLS 嵌入或 token 表示）的均方误差 (MSE) 损失。该方法仅使用查询图像自身生成的三路图像混合，无需辅助数据集或架构特定的归因机制，可生成对象级、类别条件级和 token 级的解释。实验在 ViT-S/16 和 ConvNeXt 模型上进行，掩码紧凑、可解释且初始化稳定，在插入/删除基准上具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有显著性图大多关注模型依赖哪些像素，但缺乏对哪些像素足以维持模型行为的直接优化。SEAMS 旨在通过显式优化一个紧凑的软掩码来保留模型输出，从而提供更准确的充分性解释。
Method: SEAMS 使用可学习的软掩码和可学习预算，通过查询图像自身生成三路图像复合（保留原始像素、模糊像素和反转像素），并优化掩码以最小化冻结模型输出与原始输出之间的 MSE 损失。优化过程无需 top-k 松弛或辅助数据集。
Result: 在 ViT-S/16 和 ConvNeXt 模型上，SEAMS 生成的掩码紧凑、可解释、跨随机初始化稳定，并在插入和删除基准上与现有方法竞争。不同架构往往依赖不同的足够证据，表明视觉解释具有架构依赖性。
Conclusion: SEAMS 是一种简单、通用的充分性显著性方法，可适应不同目标（类别、对象、token）和不同架构。未来工作可探索其在其他视觉任务中的应用。

papers.title: Present but Rescaled: Chat-to-Agent Transfer of Additive Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Additive activation steering (injecting a scaled residual-stream direction during generation) is calibrated almost entirely in single-turn chat, yet the models it targets are increasingly deployed as tool-using ReAct agents. We present the first systematic chat-to-agent transfer study of additive steering, coupling behavioral measurement with a representation read-out in a matched-information design: the same items rendered as plain chat or as a ReAct tool-use episode, with matched-norm random-direction controls and the transcript re-encoded every turn to exclude KV-cache contamination. Transfer is real but rescaled, and the right description is a dissociation: the injected direction reaches the late layers at near-full strength in every setting and model tested (install-site agent-over-chat ratios 0.83-1.16 across three families), while the behavioral coupling is reset per model and context. On Qwen2.5-7B a refusal bypass vector amplifies in the agent (T = 1.45, CI [1.20, 1.78], N = 300); across a powered uniform-protocol distribution the coupling spans amplification (Gemma-2-9B T = 2.00) to attenuation (Yi-1.5-9B T = 0.43, CI [0.29, 0.60]), with no universal constant and a single clean attenuator against a universal sign. Directional ablation of the same axis does not amplify (T = 0.93, CI including 1) while additive injection amplifies (T = 1.50), a 20.1-point gain difference (CI [13.4, 26.8]) that identifies an additive-specific mechanism. Two pre-registered instruments converge to localize the rescaling to the ReAct format scaffold, before any tool observation, rather than to the observation boundary where a dilution account would predict it. The safety implication is immediate and unpredictable: agentic deployment amplifies steering-based refusal bypass by up to 2.00x on some models while others attenuate, so a deployment cannot assume a given model is safe under additive steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了加性激活干预（additive activation steering）从单轮聊天到ReAct智能体使用的迁移效果。通过行为测量和表征读出，发现干预方向在模型深层保持强度，但行为耦合在不同模型和上下文中有差异：拒绝旁路向量在部分模型中被放大（最高2倍），在另一些模型中衰减。预注册实验表明重缩放发生在ReAct格式的脚手架阶段，而非工具观察边界。
Motivation: 加性激活干预主要在单轮聊天中校准，但目标模型越来越多地作为使用工具的ReAct智能体部署，现有研究缺乏对这种迁移的系统评估。
Method: 采用匹配信息设计：相同项目以纯聊天或ReAct工具使用网络形式呈现，使用匹配范数的随机方向控制，每轮重新编码对话以排除KV-cache污染，并进行行为测量与表征读出。
Result: 干预方向在深层以接近完整强度保持（智能体/聊天比例0.83-1.16），但行为耦合因模型而异：Qwen2.5-7B拒绝旁路向量放大（T=1.45），Gemma-2-9B放大2倍，Yi-1.5-9B衰减（T=0.43）。加性注入与定向消融存在20.1点增益差异，表明加性特定机制。
Conclusion: 智能体部署会放大或衰减基于干预的拒绝旁路效果，不同模型差异巨大，因此部署者不能假设给定模型在加性干预下是安全的。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: KV-PRM: Efficient Process Reward Modeling via KV-Cache Transfer for Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have been proven to be highly effective in guiding test-time scaling (TTS) methods, which significantly boost the capabilities of LLM-based multi-agent systems. However, existing PRMs are text-based: they re-encode the entire trajectory text from scratch. In long multi-agent rollouts, the scoring cost, growing quadratically with respect to sequence length L, creates a severe computational bottleneck, severely limiting PRMs' application in long-context scenarios. To resolve this, we introduce KV-PRM, a highly efficient process reward model that eliminates the heavy text re-encoding by directly reading the KV cache produced naturally during the LLM's generation phase. By processing a single "verify token" against the pre-existing KV cache, KV-PRM reduces the scoring cost from O(L^2) to O(L). We formally prove that the KV cache contains strictly greater information capacity than text, and is more efficient for downstream reward modeling. Empirically, across the MATH, GSM8K, and AIME benchmarks, KV-PRM matches or strictly outperforms text-PRMs under various TTS methods such as Beam Search, MCTS, and Weighted Voting, with up to a 5,000x reduction in scoring FLOPs, a 37x reduction in latency, and a 34x reduction in per-sequence memory footprint compared to text-based PRMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KV-PRM，一种高效的过程奖励模型，通过直接利用LLM生成阶段自然产生的KV缓存来避免从头重新编码轨迹文本，将评分成本从O(L^2)降至O(L)。实验证明KV-PRM在MATH、GSM8K和AIME基准上匹配或优于文本PRM，同时实现高达5000倍的计算开销减少、37倍延迟降低和34倍内存占用减少。
Motivation: 现有文本PRM在长上下文多智能体场景中，因重新编码整个轨迹文本导致计算成本随序列长度二次增长，成为严重瓶颈。
Method: KV-PRM通过读取LLM生成阶段已有的KV缓存，仅处理单个“验证令牌”来执行奖励建模，避免了文本重编码，将复杂度从O(L^2)降至O(L)。
Result: 在MATH、GSM8K和AIME基准上，KV-PRM在Beam Search、MCTS和Weighted Voting等TTS方法下匹配或超越文本PRM，并实现5000倍评分FLOPs减少、37倍延迟减少、34倍每序列内存占用减少。
Conclusion: KV-PRM通过KV缓存转移有效解决了文本PRM的计算瓶颈，为长上下文多智能体系统的高效过程奖励建模提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Weaving Light and Time: Unified Harmonic-Geometric Representation Learning for Dense RGB-Event Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Fusing standard RGB frames with asynchronous event streams has emerged as a definitive paradigm for robust perception in degraded environments. Although unified backbones have recently gained traction in multi-modal vision, adapting them to the RGB-Event domain remains fundamentally challenging. Existing architectures either resort to decoupled dual encoders that double computational overhead, or adopt generic unified designs that fail to resolve implicit geometric parallax and cross-spectral aliasing under the extreme representational divide between dense intensity grids and sparse kinematic spikes. To transcend these bottlenecks, we present Evita, the first unified backbone specifically engineered for dedicated dense RGB-Event parsing. To achieve profound modal synergy, Evita explicitly embeds a suite of intrinsic co-learning modules directly into every encoder layer. Specifically, it features Geometric Parallax Rectification for adaptive spatial alignment, Harmonic Spectral Resonance for texture transfer exclusively in the complex frequency domain, and Transient Global Routing for event-driven asymmetric attention. To guarantee robust feature extraction against spatial misalignments and decouple representations from specific event encodings, we construct N-ImageNetV2 alongside a stochastic event representation mixing pretraining protocol, empowering the network to seamlessly accommodate arbitrary event formats in downstream tasks. Extensive evaluations across the DELIVER, DDD17, and DSEC benchmarks confirm that Evita establishes new state-of-the-art metrics while delivering a superior accuracy-latency trade-off for real-time multimodal perception.The code are publicly available at: https://github.com/chaineypung/Evita.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 在DELIVER、DDD17和DSEC基准上取得新的最优结果，并实现了优越的精度-延迟折衷。
Conclusion: Evita是首个专门为密集RGB-事件解析设计的统一骨干，通过深入模态协同实现了鲁棒的特征提取和实时多模态感知。

papers.title: MedRealMM: A Real-World Multimodal Benchmark for Chinese Online Medical Consultation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in online medical consultation, yet existing benchmarks remain poorly aligned with real clinical practice. Many rely on synthetic conversations or patient simulators, omit patient-uploaded medical images, or evaluate open-ended clinical responses using multiple-choice or lexical-overlap metrics that poorly reflect clinical quality. We introduce \textbf{MedRealMM}, a large-scale benchmark for multimodal online medical consultation built from de-identified patient-doctor interactions collected from a nationwide Chinese internet hospital. MedRealMM uses a Multimodal Clinical Challenge Point (MCCP) extraction framework to identify clinically demanding moments in authentic consultation trajectories and converts each into a standardized next-response generation task while preserving the preceding text-image context. Each instance is paired with a case-specific rubric refined by physicians that rewards clinically desirable behaviors and penalizes unsafe, unsupported, or contradictory responses. The current release contains 5,620 real-world multimodal cases spanning 64 clinical departments. We evaluate 19 general-purpose and medical-specialized LLMs, including text-only and multimodal systems. Our results show that image information is critical for reliable clinical performance and that current frontier models remain below the online physician response. Although some frontier models satisfy as many or more positive clinical criteria than physicians, they trigger more negative criteria, indicating that safety-sensitive error avoidance remains a central bottleneck. MedRealMM offers a realistic and reproducible benchmark for evaluating multimodal medical reasoning in real-world online consultation. The dataset will be publicly available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jdh-algo/MedRealMM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedRealMM 是一个基于中国在线医疗平台真实医患交互数据构建的多模态基准，包含 5,620 个来自 64 个科室的案例，每个案例以图文上下文和标准化下一轮响应生成任务的形式呈现，并使用医生制定的病例特异性评分规则评估。评估了 19 个通用和医学专用大语言模型，发现图像信息对临床性能至关重要，现有前沿模型在安全性方面仍落后于真实医生。
Motivation: 现有医疗基准多使用合成对话或患者模拟器，缺少患者上传的医学图像，或采用多选/词汇重叠度量，不能反映真实临床质量。
Method: 提出 Multimodal Clinical Challenge Point (MCCP) 提取框架，从真实医患对话轨迹中识别临床关键时刻，转化为保留图文上下文的下一个响应生成任务，并由医生制定病例特异性评分规则。
Result: 评估表明，图像信息对可靠临床性能至关重要；当前前沿模型在满足积极临床标准上可能接近甚至超越医生，但触发的消极标准更多，安全性误差避免仍是核心瓶颈。
Conclusion: MedRealMM 提供了一个真实、可复现的多模态医疗推理基准，数据集将在 Hugging Face 公开。

papers.title: Control Laguerre Tessellation: Semi-discrete Optimal Transport Over Control Systems
papers.abstract_en: We study the optimal transport of optimally controlled agents from a compactly supported absolutely continuous source to a discrete target measure. The ground cost for the transport is induced by the optimal cost of the agents' motion. When this ground cost satisfies the twist condition, the optimal transport map is given almost everywhere in terms of a Laguerre tessellation of the state space. We refer to this control-theoretic generalization of Laguerre tessellation as Control Laguerre Tessellation (CLT), and illustrate it for two ground costs induced by linear controlled agents with minimum energy and minimum time objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从紧支撑绝对连续源测度到离散目标测度的最优传输问题，其中运输成本由被控智能体的最优运动成本诱导。当该基础成本满足扭曲条件时，最优传输映射几乎处处由状态空间的Laguerre镶嵌给出，作者将此推广称为控制Laguerre镶嵌，并针对线性被控智能体在最小能量和最小时间目标下的两种成本进行了说明。
Motivation: 现有最优传输理论主要考虑静态或被动运输，缺乏对受控智能体运动成本的建模。本文旨在将最优传输与最优控制结合，处理源与目标测度受控运输的场景。
Method: 提出控制Laguerre镶嵌（CLT）方法，通过定义由最优控制成本诱导的基础成本，利用扭曲条件推导出最优传输映射的半离散形式，并给出两种线性控制系统的解析实例。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，仅给出两个示例：最小能量和最小时间线性控制系统的控制Laguerre镶嵌构造。
Conclusion: 本文建立了控制理论与最优传输之间的新联系，但未明确讨论局限性或泛化性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Super-Generalist: Towards Comprehensive and Accurate Medical Image Understanding via Generalist-Specialist Synergy
papers.abstract_en: Medical images require comprehensive and accurate interpretation to support the diagnosis of diverse clincial conditions. Recent vision-language generalist models offer broad task coverage and promising zero-shot capabilities, yet often lack fine-grained anatomical and lesion awareness for reliable diagnosis and spatial interpretability. In contrast, supervised specialist models achieve strong performance on specific tasks but typically lack generalization across diseases and anatomies. In this work, we present SuG, a Super-Generalist framework that unifies generalist vision-language learning with specialist objectives, enabling both broad generalization and specialist-level diagnostic capability. We perform specialist-enhanced vision-language alignment in SuG by incorporating spatial priors from multiple segmentation experts, including anatomy, class-specific lesion and class-agnostic lesion segmentors that captures lesions beyond anatomies annotated during training. To improve lesion grounding capability, we leverage lesion masks as spatial priors to calibrate text-conditioned visual attention, encouraging disease-related semantics to focus on clinically relevant regions. We evaluate SuG on extensive chest and abdominal CT benchmarks, including CT-RATE, Merlin, MedVL-CT69K, and several in-house tumor datasets. SuG achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of disease diagnosis tasks and surpasses specialist models on several critical tumor diagnosis benchmarks. Furthermore, SuG demonstrates strong lesion grounding capability, including robust generalization to lesion types lacking class-specific supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SuG（Super-Generalist）框架，统一通才视觉-语言学习与专才目标，实现医学图像理解的广泛泛化和专才级诊断能力。通过集成多个分割专家的空间先验（解剖、类别特异性病变和类别无关病变分割器）增强视觉-语言对齐，并利用病变掩码校准文本条件视觉注意力以提升病变定位能力。在胸部、腹部CT基准上达到最先进性能，超越专才模型。
Motivation: 现有通才视觉-语言模型在医学图像上缺乏细粒度解剖和病变意识，而专才模型泛化能力不足，无法兼顾广泛任务覆盖和可靠诊断。
Method: 提出SuG框架，通过融合多个分割专家的空间先验（解剖、类别特异性病变、类别无关病变分割器）进行专才增强的视觉-语言对齐，并使用病变掩码作为空间先验校准注意力，使疾病相关语义聚焦于临床相关区域。
Result: 在CT-RATE、Merlin、MedVL-CT69K等胸部、腹部CT基准和多个内部肿瘤数据集上达到最先进诊断性能，在关键肿瘤诊断任务上超越专才模型，并展现出强的病变定位泛化能力。
Conclusion: SuG通过通才-专才协同实现全面准确的医学图像理解，在广泛疾病诊断和病变定位上表现优异。

papers.title: ReGen: Hierarchical Multi-Prompt Representation Generation for Efficient Waveform Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Representation alignment (REPA) has been investigated to accelerate diffusion training, but we observe that regularizing intermediate representations in diffusion Transformers (DiT) may implicitly entangle latents and limit generative capacity. To address this issue, we propose ReGen, a hierarchical multi-prompt representation generation framework that jointly estimates multiple vector fields for both representations and data within a single diffusion model. We further introduce generalized flow matching (GFM) to improve the generalization of conditional flow matching (CFM). We validate ReGen on single-stage waveform diffusion models including neural audio codec and Wave-VAE. ReGen significantly improves waveform generation quality from highly compressed latent representations at 12.5 Hz. We also present ReGenVoice, a latent diffusion model (LDM)-based text-to-speech model that achieves strong speech intelligibility (WER) and speaker similarity (SIM) with a small dataset. Moreover, operating the LDM at 6.25 Hz with rich semantic and acoustic latent representation enables efficient training and sampling, requiring only 1 day of training on 4 GPUs and fast inference with an RTF of 0.08. Audio samples are available at https://regenvoice.github.io/demo/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散Transformer中表示对齐（REPA）可能导致的潜在纠缠和生成能力受限问题，提出ReGen，一种层次化多提示表示生成框架，在单一扩散模型中联合估计表示和数据的多个向量场。同时引入广义流匹配（GFM）改进条件流匹配的泛化能力。在单阶段波形扩散模型（神经音频编解码器、Wave-VAE）上验证，显著提升低码率（12.5 Hz）波形生成质量。基于LDM的文本转语音模型ReGenVoice在少量数据上达到强语音可懂度和说话人相似度，且训练高效（4 GPU 1天）、推理快速（RTF 0.08）。
Motivation: 表示对齐（REPA）虽加速扩散训练，但正则化中间表示可能隐含纠缠并限制生成能力，需解决此问题。
Method: 提出层次化多提示表示生成框架（ReGen），联合估计表示和数据的多个向量场；引入广义流匹配（GFM）改进条件流匹配的泛化。
Result: 在12.5 Hz低码率波形生成任务上，单阶段扩散模型（神经音频编解码器、Wave-VAE）质量显著提升；ReGenVoice在LDM 6.25 Hz下，少量数据实现高语音可懂度（低WER）和说话人相似度（高SIM），训练仅需4 GPU 1天，推理RTF为0.08。
Conclusion: 层次化多提示表示生成与广义流匹配可提升波形扩散模型效率与质量，尤其适用于低比特率语音生成场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IB-Flow: Information Bottleneck-Guided CFG Distillation for Few-Step Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: While large-scale text-to-image generative models have achieved unprecedented visual performance, their inherent reliance on multi-step iterative solvers incurs severe inference latency. Few-step distillation targeting the Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) trajectory has emerged as the prevalent dual-dimensional compression paradigm. However, existing frameworks remain subjugated by a coarse-grained blind injection paradigm that perpetually enforces a globally static guidance strength while indiscriminately sampling the supervisor timestep. This state-agnostic design completely disregards the intrinsic nature of image generation as a dynamic evolutionary process characterized by progressive entropy reduction, which not only restricts the performance boundary of few-step compression but also precipitates severe CFG over-conditioning artifacts. To transcend these limitations, we re-examine the distillation procedure through the theoretical lens of Information Theory, formally modeling it as a dynamic mutual information game constrained by the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle. Specifically, we dismantle traditional blind assumptions via a dual-track adaptive framework. To determine the injection target, we propose an instance-aware selection mechanism that transmutes the intractable KL divergence constraint into a zero-overhead closed-form solution predicated on the local vector field norm. To regulate the injection strength, we introduce an entropy-aware schedule that dynamically decays alongside the SNR, applying maximal thrust for initial structural anchoring before smoothly reverting to the natural manifold to refine micro-details. Extensive empirical evaluations corroborate that our framework fundamentally eradicates over-conditioning artifacts, shattering the performance ceiling to achieve SOTA generative fidelity under extremely stringent 2-step configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息论角度重新审视文本到图像生成中的少步蒸馏问题，提出IB-Flow框架。通过将蒸馏过程建模为信息瓶颈约束下的动态互信息博弈，引入实例感知的注入目标选择和熵感知的注入强度调度，克服了传统全局静态引导强度导致的过度条件化伪影。实验表明在2步配置下达到最先进生成保真度。
Motivation: 现有少步蒸馏方法采用全局静态引导强度和盲目采样监督时间步，忽视了图像生成是一个动态演化过程（逐步降低熵），导致性能受限和过度条件化伪影。
Method: 基于信息瓶颈原理，提出双轨自适应框架：(1) 实例感知的选择机制，将KL散度约束转化为基于局部向量场范数的零开销闭式解；(2) 熵感知的调度，动态随信噪比衰减，先在初始阶段施加最大推力锚定结构，再平滑回归自然流形以细化微观细节。
Result: 大量实验证明该框架从根本上消除了过度条件化伪影，在极其苛刻的2步配置下突破了性能天花板，达到最先进生成保真度。
Conclusion: 该方法通过信息瓶颈视角重新设计蒸馏策略，实现了对CFG轨迹的更精细控制，显著提升了少步生成的性能。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文从信息论角度重新审视文本到图像生成中的少步蒸馏问题，提出IB-Flow框架。通过将蒸馏过程建模为信息瓶颈约束下的动态互信息博弈，引入实例感知的注入目标选择和熵感知的注入强度调度，克服了传统全局静态引导强度导致的过度条件化伪影。实验表明在2步配置下达到最先进生成保真度。

summary_sections.result: 大量实验证明该框架从根本上消除了过度条件化伪影，在极其苛刻的2步配置下突破了性能天花板，达到最先进生成保真度。

papers.title: VTaMo: Video-Text Alignment Model for Sign Language Translation
papers.abstract_en: Sign language translation (SLT) converts continuous sign videos into spoken language text. Gloss-free approaches leverage pre-trained visual encoders and language models but rely on implicit cross-modal alignment from translation supervision alone. We present VTaMo, a framework that introduces explicit multi-granularity alignment at three levels: (1) local alignment via entropy-regularized optimal transport with a learnable null token for fine-grained frame-to-token correspondences; (2) global alignment via a learnable orthogonal transformation that calibrates embedding space geometry through Earth Mover's Distance; and (3) position-aligned contrastive learning for discriminative token-level representations. Experiments on Phoenix-2014T, CSL-Daily, How2Sign, and OpenASL demonstrate consistent state-of-the-art performance, with ablations confirming the complementary contributions of each component. Code is available at https://github.com/junyi2005/vtamo.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VTaMo框架，通过显式多粒度对齐提升手语翻译性能。在三个层次上引入对齐：基于熵正则化最优传输的局部对齐、基于可学习正交变换的全局对齐以及位置对齐的对比学习。在Phoenix-2014T、CSL-Daily、How2Sign和OpenASL数据集上取得最优结果，并进行了消融实验验证各组件贡献。
Motivation: 无词汇方法（gloss-free）依赖预训练视觉编码器和语言模型，但仅通过翻译监督隐式进行跨模态对齐，缺乏显式对齐指导，限制了手语翻译性能。
Method: 提出三层次显式多粒度对齐：局部对齐使用熵正则化最优传输和可学习空标记实现帧到标记的细粒度对应；全局对齐通过可学习正交变换和推土机距离校准嵌入空间几何；位置对齐的对比学习用于判别性标记级表示。
Result: 在Phoenix-2014T、CSL-Daily、How2Sign和OpenASL数据集上达到一致的最优性能，消融实验证实每个组件具有互补贡献。
Conclusion: 显式多粒度对齐是提升无词汇手语翻译的有效方法，代码已开源。

papers.title: 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction from Low-Overlap Captures
papers.abstract_en: Existing volumetric capture of dynamic human performance achieves high fidelity with dense camera arrays. However, in real-world scenarios, only a handful of low-overlap cameras are available, which degrades the output quality and leaves large areas unobserved. Recent 4D reconstruction methods have focused on low-overlap settings, yet they still produce noticeable artifacts in under-observed regions. Video diffusion models have emerged as another option, but they show geometrically inconsistent results for humans. To address these limitations, we propose StudioRecon, a pipeline that reconstructs 4D human scenes from sparse, low-overlap cameras by decoupling background and humans. We densify background supervision by synthesizing hundreds of camera-controlled novel views with a video diffusion model. We also robustly initialize deformable Gaussian humans with cross-view identity association and triangulated multi-view keypoint fitting. Finally, our recursive enhancement module with motion-adaptive consistency injection harmonizes the composed output, thereby further avoiding remaining artifacts. We achieve state-of-the-art novel view synthesis across four real-world datasets and demonstrate applications such as novel trajectory rendering and human replacement.
papers.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Conference Papers '26. First two authors contributed equally. Project page: https://sisyphm.github.io/studiorecon-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StudioRecon，一种从稀疏低重叠相机中重建4D人体场景的管线，通过解耦背景和人体、用视频扩散模型合成数百个相机控制的新视角来密集化背景监督，以及鲁棒初始化可变形高斯人体。在四个真实数据集上实现最先进的新视角合成。
Motivation: 现有体积捕捉方法依赖密集相机阵列，实际场景中只有少量低重叠相机，导致输出质量下降和大面积未观测区域。虽然已有4D重建方法，但在低观测区域仍有明显伪影；视频扩散模型则出现几何不一致。
Method: 提出StudioRecon管线，解耦背景和人体，用视频扩散模型合成数百个相机控制的新视角以密集化背景监督；通过跨视角身份关联和三角化多视图关键点拟合鲁棒初始化可变形高斯人体；最后递归增强模块利用运动自适应一致性注入协调合成输出。
Result: 在四个真实数据集上实现了最先进的新视角合成，并展示了新颖轨迹渲染和人体替换等应用。
Conclusion: Pipeline通过解耦和扩散模型监督以及鲁棒初始化有效改善了低重叠相机下的4D人体场景重建质量，并在多个数据集上验证了有效性。

papers.title: Power Flow Feasibility Assessment Using Variational Graph Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven methods, including graph neural networks, have been studied for accelerating power flow calculations in recent years, but very little attention has been paid to the solution feasibility, which can be obtained by traditional solvers. This paper presents a Variational Graph Autoencoder (VGAE) that detects the power flow solution feasibility, using the IEEE 118-bus case, to assess the validity of the solutions provided by AI-driven solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用变分图自编码器（VGAE）检测电力潮流解的可行性，基于IEEE 118节点系统验证AI求解器提供解的有效性。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动方法（如图神经网络）加速潮流计算，但很少关注解的可行性；本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用变分图自编码器（VGAE）模型，在IEEE 118节点系统上进行训练和评估，以判断潮流解是否可行。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅说明该方法用于评估AI求解器提供解的有效性。
Conclusion: VGAE能够有效检测潮流解的可行性，为AI驱动潮流求解器的可靠性评估提供工具。

papers.title: Augmenting Fundamental Analysis with Large Language Models: A RAG-Based System for Generating Investor Briefs
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we examine the opportunities brought by Large Language Models (LLMs) to various aspects of fundamental analysis of companies based on their reports as well as data and documents describing macroeconomic situation like GDP and inflation changes as well as documents filled to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) which can be found in EDGAR. We were preprocessing those data and than sending via API to gpt-4o model in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) like regime. We prepared as well a document describing an exemplar investor knowledge based on Kitchin cycles. We were scanning data important for analysis of 9 companies for 4 weeks. Using LLM we were producing automatic briefs about them. They were sent to nine participants who are individual investors to evaluate usefulness of such approach to data analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用大型语言模型（LLM）和检索增强生成（RAG）技术，基于公司报告、宏观经济数据和SEC文件，自动生成投资者简报。作者对9家公司进行了4周的数据扫描，并使用gpt-4o生成简报，然后由9位个人投资者评估其有用性。
Motivation: 传统基本面分析需要大量人工处理报告和数据，效率低。LLM和RAG有潜力自动化该过程。
Method: 预处理多种数据源（公司报告、GDP、通胀、SEC EDGAR文件），通过API将数据送入gpt-4o模型，采用类似RAG的方式生成投资者简报。还基于Kitchin周期准备了一份示例投资者知识文档。
Result: 摘要提到生成了简报并发送给9位投资者评估，但未给出具体评估结果或性能指标。
Conclusion: 研究展示了LLM和RAG在基本面分析中自动生成简报的可行性，但需要更多评估。

papers.title: Event Burst Trigger: An Availability Backdoor Attack on Event-Based SNN Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Event-based vision and spiking neural networks (SNNs) are increasingly adopted for edge intelligence under strict latency and energy constraints. However, the vulnerability of event-based SNN object detection models to availability backdoor attacks remains insufficiently studied. This paper presents Event Burst Trigger (EBT), an availability backdoor attack targeting SNN-based object detection models. EBT injects carefully crafted event-based triggers into the training data, which induce temporally concentrated event streams during inference. These burst-like activations increase the number of phantom (i.e., spurious) object candidates, and consequently inflate the computational cost of the post-processing stage, particularly Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS). We evaluate EBT on SpikeYOLO, the state-of-the-art SNN-based object detector, under a poison-only threat model that does not require modifications to the model architecture, loss function, or inference pipeline. Experimental results show that while detection accuracy remains largely preserved, with mAP@0.5 decreasing by less than 0.099, the latency of the NMS stage increases by up to 38%. This indicates that NMS can become a dominant availability bottleneck in event-based SNN object detection. Experiments on an edge platform further show that the proposed attack elevates baseline resource utilization and reduces scheduling slack without inducing conspicuous peaks in resource usage. In addition, STRIP-based backdoor detection fails to reliably distinguish the proposed attack from benign inputs. These results characterize a previously underexplored availability backdoor threat in event-based SNN object detection systems.
papers.comment: The 56th Annual IEEE/IFIP International Conference on Dependable Systems and Networks (DSN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Event Burst Trigger (EBT)，一种针对基于事件相机和脉冲神经网络（SNN）的目标检测模型的可用性后门攻击。EBT通过在训练数据中注入精心构造的事件触发，使推理时产生时间集中的事件流，从而增加虚假目标候选（phantom object candidate），显著提升后处理阶段（尤其是非极大值抑制NMS）的计算开销。在SpikeYOLO上评估显示，mAP@0.5下降小于0.099，但NMS延迟最高增加38%，且边缘平台上资源利用率上升、调度余量减少，STRIP检测无法可靠区分。
Motivation: 事件驱动视觉和SNN在边缘智能中广泛应用，但现有研究对SNN目标检测模型的可用性后门攻击威胁关注不足。
Method: 提出EBT攻击，利用事件流的时间集中性诱导虚假候选目标，从而在训练数据中注入特定事件模式，使推理时NMS阶段计算负载剧增。攻击无需修改模型架构、损失函数或推理流程，属于仅投毒（poison-only）威胁模型。
Result: 在SpikeYOLO上，mAP@0.5下降小于0.099，NMS延迟增加高达38%；边缘平台实验表明基线资源利用率升高，调度余量减少；STRIP检测无法可靠识别攻击。
Conclusion: EBT揭示了一种先前未被充分探索的SNN目标检测可用性后门威胁，表明NMS可能成为事件驱动SNN系统的关键可用性瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Event Stream based Multi-Modal Video Anomaly Detection: A Benchmark Dataset and Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is critical for automated surveillance but remains fragile under challenging conditions such as illumination variations, fast motion, and complex backgrounds when relying solely on visible light videos. To address these limitations, we propose EVAD, an event enhanced VAD framework that jointly exploits conventional video and event streams captured by bio inspired event cameras. Event sensors asynchronously capture brightness changes with high temporal resolution, offering robustness to motion blur and extreme lighting, and providing motion salient cues complementary to video based visual information. To support multi modal VAD research, we construct a large scale visible event benchmark comprising 6.3 billion events and 376,368 video frames collected under diverse illumination levels, motion patterns, and background complexities, filling the gap of realistic and scalable datasets for event based anomaly detection. Building upon this dataset, we design a contrastive multi modal pretraining framework to learn discriminative event representations by aligning semantic embeddings across event streams, visible videos, and textual descriptions. An adaptive fusion module then dynamically integrates event based temporal cues with video based spatial semantics, improving robustness to environmental disturbances. Experiments on benchmarks and the proposed TJUTCM Pha dataset demonstrate that E VAD consistently outperforms methods, validating the effectiveness of event-based sensing for VAD in real world scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EVAD，一种融合事件相机流和可见光视频的多模态视频异常检测框架。构建了大规模可见光-事件基准数据集（6.3亿事件和37.6万帧），并设计对比多模态预训练和自适应融合模块。实验表明在多个基准和提出的TJUTCM Pha数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 传统仅依赖可见光视频的异常检测在光照变化、快速运动、复杂背景下脆弱。事件相机提供高时间分辨率、对运动模糊和极端光照鲁棒，但缺乏多模态数据集和方法。
Method: 构建大规模可见光-事件基准数据集；设计对比多模态预训练框架对齐事件流、可见光视频和文本描述的语义嵌入；提出自适应融合模块动态集成事件时序线索和视频空间语义。
Result: 在多个基准和提出的TJUTCM Pha数据集上，EVAD一致优于现有方法，验证了事件感知在真实场景VAD中的有效性。
Conclusion: 事件增强的视频异常检测框架有效，事件相机作为互补传感方式具有潜力。

summary_sections.motivation: 传统仅依赖可见光视频的异常检测在光照变化、快速运动、复杂背景下脆弱。事件相机提供高时间分辨率、对运动模糊和极端光照鲁棒，但缺乏多模态数据集和方法。
summary_sections.method: 构建大规模可见光-事件基准数据集；设计对比多模态预训练框架对齐事件流、可见光视频和文本描述的语义嵌入；提出自适应融合模块动态集成事件时序线索和视频空间语义。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准和提出的TJUTCM Pha数据集上，EVAD一致优于现有方法，验证了事件感知在真实场景VAD中的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 事件增强的视频异常检测框架有效，事件相机作为互补传感方式具有潜力。

papers.title: Quantum-Enhanced Synthetic Data Generation Using Quantum Circuit Born Machines for Imbalanced Tabular Learning
papers.abstract_en: Data scarcity and class imbalance are persistent challenges in machine learning that degrade model generalization and introduce predictive bias. We present a hybrid quantum-classical framework for synthetic data generation using a Quantum Circuit Born Machine (QCBM) to address these limitations. The proposed approach exploits quantum mechanical properties -- superposition and entanglement -- within a parameterized variational quantum circuit to model complex probability distributions that are difficult for classical generative methods to capture. Experiments are conducted on two tabular benchmark datasets: the Iris dataset and the Telco Customer Churn dataset. Preprocessing includes normalization and PCA-based dimensionality reduction to enable efficient basis encoding for quantum circuits. The QCBM is trained by minimizing Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between real and generated data distributions using a gradient-based parameter-shift optimization rule. Augmenting training data with QCBM-generated synthetic samples at 40-50% of the minority class improves F1-score by approximately 5-15% and minority-class recall by 10-25%. Cross-domain evaluations (Train on Synthetic, Test on Real; and Train on Real, Test on Synthetic) reveal a performance gap of only 3-10%, indicating strong distributional fidelity. Comparative analysis against classical oversampling methods -- SMOTE, Borderline-SMOTE, KMeansSMOTE, and SVM-SMOTE -- shows that QCBM achieves competitive classification performance and produces lower Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) on the Telco dataset, suggesting superior structural similarity in certain imbalanced settings. These findings establish QCBM as a viable complementary tool for data augmentation, particularly for low-dimensional structured tabular data with class imbalance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合量子-经典框架，使用量子电路玻恩机（QCBM）生成合成数据，解决表格数据中的稀缺和类别不平衡问题。在Iris和Telco Customer Churn数据集上，将少数类合成样本增加到40-50%后，F1分数提升5-15%，少数类召回率提升10-25%，且跨域评估性能差距仅3-10%。与SMOTE等经典方法相比，QCBM在Telco数据集上产生更低的MMD，表明其生成数据具有更好的结构相似性。
Motivation: 数据稀缺和类别不平衡导致机器学习模型泛化能力下降和预测偏差，现有经典生成方法难以捕捉复杂分布。
Method: 采用参数化变分量子电路作为QCBM，利用叠加和纠缠特性建模概率分布；通过最小化KL散度进行梯度优化，并采用PCA降维和归一化实现有效基编码。
Result: 在Iris和Telco数据集上，QCBM增强使F1分数提升5-15%，少数类召回率提升10-25%；跨域评估（Train on Synthetic, Test on Real等）显示性能差距仅3-10%，表明分布保真度高。与SMOTE等方法比较，QCBM在Telco数据集上MMD更低。
Conclusion: QCBM可作为数据增强的补充工具，尤其适用于低维结构化表格数据中的类别不平衡场景，但局限在于当前仅测试了低维数据。

papers.title: Quantum Circuits in Diffusion Models: A Fair-Comparison Study and a Mechanistic Analysis of Angle-Embedding Failures
papers.abstract_en: We study the integration of variational quantum circuits (VQCs) into diffusion models through a squeeze-and-excitation (SE) channel-modulation scaffold that isolates the quantum contribution. Using a role-matched classical control and multi-seed significance testing across DDPM and latent diffusion on MNIST and CIFAR-10, with a score-based NCSN study on MNIST, we find that quantum cores achieve comparable mean FID to the classical control across DDPM and latent diffusion, while paired sampling-seed tests for EfficientSU2 detect no statistically significant difference. Although the quantum cores use $4.5$--$9\times$ fewer core parameters than the role-matched control, parameter-matched classical controls attain comparable mean FID, so the experiments do not establish a quantum parameter-efficiency advantage. We further identify a structural failure in score-based NCSN: the unbounded score target, proportional to $1/σ$, drives angle-embedding inputs far beyond the $2π$ period of rotation gates, causing phase aliasing and collapse of the quantum modulator. A bounding transformation, $θ\leftarrow π\tanh(\cdot)$, maps inputs to the non-aliasing domain and substantially improves both quantum cores. Since all circuits are classically simulated at a few-qubit scale, we do not claim quantum advantage. Instead, the study provides a fair-comparison protocol for quantum-enhanced generative models and a mechanistic account of when and why angle embeddings fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过挤压-激励通道调制框架，公平比较了变分量子电路（VQC）与经典对照在扩散模型（DDPM、潜在扩散、基于分数的NCSN）中的性能。在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，量子核心的FID与经典对照相当，但未发现统计显著差异；量子核心参数更少，但与参数匹配的经典对照FID相近，未能证明量子参数效率优势。研究还揭示了基于分数的NCSN中角度嵌入失败的结构性原因：无界分数目标导致输入超出旋转门周期，引起相位混叠。本文不声称量子优势，而是提供了公平比较协议和角度嵌入失效的机理分析。
Motivation: 现有研究将量子电路集成到生成模型中缺乏公平比较，且角度嵌入失败的原因未被深入分析。
Method: 采用挤压-激励通道调制框架隔离量子贡献，使用角色匹配的经典控制、多种子显著性测试，在DDPM、潜在扩散（MNIST、CIFAR-10）和基于分数的NCSN（MNIST）上比较性能。针对角度嵌入失败，提出边界变换θ←π tanh(·)将输入映射到非混叠域。
Result: 量子核心在DDPM和潜在扩散上平均FID与经典控制相当；参数匹配的经典控制也达到相近FID，未显示量子参数效率优势。NCSN中角度嵌入因无界目标导致相位混叠，边界变换显著提升量子核心性能。
Conclusion: 本文提供了量子增强生成模型的公平比较协议，并解释了角度嵌入失效的机理。所有电路在少数量子比特规模上经典模拟，不声明量子优势。

papers.title: Integrating Large Language Models and Graph Convolutional Networks for Semi-Supervised Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: While the growing availability of image data has driven significant advances, labeling datasets remains costly and time-consuming. Therefore, semi-supervised approaches such as Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), which learn from both labeled and unlabeled data, have emerged as a promising solution. One of the primary challenges in applying GCNs to image classification is graph construction, since, unlike in citation networks or similar domains, images typically do not come with a predefined structural representation. For visual data, most studies construct graphs based on the similarity between feature vectors from pretrained deep learning backbones, typically by employing kNN or reciprocal kNN algorithms. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capability in capturing high-level semantics, their integration with GCNs for image classification remains underexplored. Aiming to fill this gap, our approach uses a Vision Language Model (VLM) to generate textual image descriptions, which are then processed by an LLM to estimate semantic similarity scores between connected images. These scores guide the pruning of edges in kNN and reciprocal kNN graphs, filtering out semantically irrelevant neighbors. Experimental results reveal that leveraging LLMs for graph refinement can improve classification accuracy, particularly for kNN graphs and some backbones. The source code is publicly available at http://gcnllm.lucasvalem.com.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将大语言模型（LLM）与图卷积网络（GCN）结合用于半监督图像分类。利用视觉语言模型生成图像文本描述，再由LLM估计语义相似度以修剪kNN或互kNN图中的边，过滤语义不相关的邻居。实验表明该方法可提升分类准确率，尤其对kNN图和某些骨干网络。
Motivation: 图像标注成本高，半监督图卷积网络是可行方案，但图构建是挑战，因为图像缺乏预定义结构。现有方法基于特征向量相似性构建kNN图，但未充分利用高级语义。LLM在捕获高级语义方面有潜力，但将其与GCN结合用于图像分类尚未充分探索。
Method: 使用视觉语言模型（VLM）生成图像文本描述，然后由LLM估计连接图像之间的语义相似度得分，据此修剪kNN或互kNN图中的边，过滤掉语义不相关的邻居。
Result: 实验结果显示，利用LLM进行图细化可提高分类准确率，尤其针对kNN图和某些骨干网络。
Conclusion: 本文填补了LLM与GCN在图像分类中结合的空白，表明图细化可提升半监督图像分类性能。

papers.title: Equivariant Filter for High Performance Image Tracking using an Event Camera
papers.abstract_en: Image tracking is the problem of estimating the transformation that relates a moving image of a scene to an original reference image. The problem is important in control of autonomous vehicles or robots, where the image encodes information about the motion of the camera or environment, as well as in pure computer vision applications. In this paper, we present an equivariant filter design for high performance tracking of planar image transformations using an event camera. The design exploits the Asynchronous Event Blob (AEB) tracker (Wang et al., 2024) to extract feature-position measurements from the raw event stream, and an equivariant filter to compute an affine image translation and rotation using the special Euclidean group symmetry. The equivariant filter incorporates an equivalent-measurement update step that de-correlates the (highly temporally correlated) feature-position measurements provided by the AEB tracker. We evaluate the design experimentally using two datasets involving general and fast rotational motion. We benchmark results against direct optimisation (estimating the relative transformation from the raw blob tracks), and a covariance intersection approach for overcoming data correlation. Our design provides smooth image tracking for features moving up to 7000 pixels per second on the image plane.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于等变滤波器的事件相机图像跟踪方法，利用AEB跟踪器提取特征位置测量，并结合特殊欧几里得群对称性计算仿射变换参数。该方法通过等效测量更新步骤解耦高度时间相关的测量，在快速运动（最高7000像素/秒）数据集上实现平滑跟踪。
Motivation: 事件相机图像跟踪中，现有方法难以同时处理快速运动和高时间相关性测量，导致跟踪性能受限。
Method: 采用AEB跟踪器从原始事件流提取特征位置，设计等变滤波器利用特殊欧几里得群对称性计算仿射变换，并通过等效测量更新步骤解耦高度时间相关的测量。
Result: 在一般和快速旋转运动数据集上，与直接优化和协方差交叉方法相比，该方法在特征速度高达7000像素/秒时仍能实现平滑跟踪。
Conclusion: 等变滤波器结合等效测量更新可有效处理事件相机高时间相关性测量，实现高性能图像跟踪。

papers.title: Beyond Metadata: CAPRA for Hidden Subgroup Analysis under Missing Metadata in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging models are often deployed without the demographic, acquisition, and quality metadata needed for subgroup auditing. Once those metadata disappear, clinically critical failure modes can be masked by strong aggregate performance, and many robust-learning methods lose the group structure they rely on. We present CAPRA, a calibrated proxy-axis framework for hidden subgroup analysis under missing metadata. CAPRA predicts image-derived semantic axes, calibrates axis posteriors on a small metadata-labeled split via patient-level cross-fitting, and organizes those posteriors into a calibrated subgroup interface that supports both deployment-time failure analysis and downstream robust learning without requiring subgroup labels at deployment. Across fundus, dermoscopy, and chest radiography, CAPRA reveals disparity patterns missed by metadata-only slicing, remains informative under dataset shift, and produces subgroup partitions that align more closely with explicit failure axes than image-only or latent-slice baselines. The same interface can also be reused by downstream robust learners, although those gains are domain-dependent. Overall, CAPRA turns hidden subgroup analysis under missing metadata into a calibrated, interpretable, and reusable subgroup interface for deployment-time analysis and robust transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAPRA框架，用于在医学影像中缺失人口统计、采集和质量元数据时进行隐藏子组分析。CAPRA通过预测图像衍生的语义轴，并在少量带元数据标注的样本上通过患者级交叉拟合校准这些轴的后验概率，构建校准子组界面。在眼底镜、皮肤镜和胸部X光片数据集上，CAPRA能够发现被元数据切片遗漏的差异模式，在数据集偏移下保持信息性，且产生的子组分块比仅基于图像或潜在切片的方法更贴近显式失败轴。该界面还可复用于下游鲁棒学习，但收益具有领域依赖性。
Motivation: 医学影像模型部署时往往缺少人口统计、采集和质量元数据，导致临床关键失败模式被强聚合性能掩盖，且许多鲁棒学习方法依赖的组结构随之丢失。
Method: 提出CAPRA框架，通过预测图像衍生语义轴，在少量带元数据标注的样本上采用患者级交叉拟合来校准轴的后验概率，从而组织成校准子组界面，支持部署时失败分析和下游鲁棒学习，无需部署时提供子组标签。
Result: 在眼底镜、皮肤镜和胸部X光片数据集上，CAPRA揭示了被元数据切片遗漏的差异模式，在数据集偏移下仍保持信息性，其子组分块比仅基于图像或潜在切片基线更贴近显式失败轴。
Conclusion: CAPRA将缺失元数据下的隐藏子组分析转化为一个校准、可解释且可复用的子组界面，适用于部署时分析和鲁棒迁移。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在眼底镜、皮肤镜和胸部X光片数据集上，CAPRA揭示了被元数据切片遗漏的差异模式，在数据集偏移下仍保持信息性，其子组分块比仅基于图像或潜在切片基线更贴近显式失败轴。
summary_sections.conclusion: CAPRA将缺失元数据下的隐藏子组分析转化为一个校准、可解释且可复用的子组界面，适用于部署时分析和鲁棒迁移。

papers.title: A Coreset Selection Framework with Ensemble Aggregation for Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of image data has produced large-scale datasets, raising concerns about the time and memory costs of model training. Selecting representative training subsets, however, remains challenging: individual sample contributions are unclear, and model behavior varies across datasets and runs. We address these challenges with a framework that combines coreset selection with an ensemble aggregation over multiple runs. For coreset selection, we propose SCOre-Stratified Selection (SCOSS), which partitions the training data into intervals based on a chosen score and samples from each interval. The ensemble combines predictions from multiple runs, each performed on an independently sampled training subset. As baselines, we use moderate and random selection, each in original and class-balanced versions. We assess the framework with Simple Graph Convolution (SGC) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers under different sampling ratios. Experiments show that SCOSS is competitive with baselines, often the best choice for SGC, and enables favorable trade-offs between accuracy and efficiency. On the fine-grained dataset, SGC with SCOSS outperforms SVMs when using fewer labeled samples. The code and supplementary materials are publicly available at http://scoss.lucasvalem.com.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合核心集选择（coreset selection）与集成聚合（ensemble aggregation）的框架，用于图像分类中的训练子集采样。其中核心集选择方法SCOSS（Score-Stratified Selection）基于分数将训练数据分层后采样，集成聚合结合多次独立采样的预测结果。实验表明SCOSS在SGC和SVM分类器上具有竞争力，在细粒度数据集上使用较少标记样本时SGC优于SVM。
Motivation: 大规模图像数据导致训练时间和内存成本高昂，但现有训练子集选择方法难以明确样本贡献，且模型行为因数据集和运行次数而异。
Method: 提出SCOSS核心集选择方法：根据选定分数将训练数据划分区间并从中采样；集成聚合多次运行（每次使用独立采样子集）的预测结果。以中等选择和随机选择为基线，使用SGC和SVM分类器在不同采样率下评估。
Result: SCOSS在SGC上常为最佳选择，在细粒度数据集中SGC+SCOSS优于SVM，且能在准确率和效率间取得有利折衷。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效选择代表性训练子集，提升图像分类的效率和性能。

papers.title: L-MAD: A Systematic Evaluation of Multi-Agent Debate Structures in Legal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While multi-agent debate (MAD) frameworks have shown significant potential in general reasoning, their effectiveness in highly structured, knowledge-heavy legal domains remains under-explored. In this work, we introduce the Legal Multi-Agent Debate (L-MAD) framework to systematically evaluate different debate structures and aggregation methods within Legal Textual Entailment. By assigning distinct expert personas to multiple agents, L-MAD improves upon strong single-agent baselines by up to 8\%. Furthermore, analyzing how debate scales reveals a clear trade-off: increasing the agent population reduces inconsistency and improves accuracy, whereas extending discussion rounds induces a detrimental \textit{over-deliberation drift} where agents reinforce each other's mistakes. Ultimately, our findings outline the practical boundaries and safety margins of deploying collaborative multi-agent systems in high-stakes legal reasoning environments.
papers.comment: Outstanding paper in the AI4Law Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出L-MAD框架，系统评估多智能体辩论结构在法律文本蕴含任务上的效果。通过赋予不同专家角色，该方法相比强单智能体基线提升最多8%。分析发现增加智能体数量降低不一致性并提升准确率，但延长讨论轮次会导致“过度讨论漂移”现象，智能体相互强化错误。研究为高风险法律推理中部署协作多智能体系统提供了实际边界和安全裕度。
Motivation: 多智能体辩论在一般推理中表现优异，但在高度结构化、知识密集的法律领域中的有效性尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出Legal Multi-Agent Debate (L-MAD)框架，将不同专家角色分配给多个智能体，系统评估不同辩论结构和聚合方法在法律文本蕴含任务上的表现。
Result: 相比强单智能体基线提升最多8%，增加智能体数量减少不一致性并提高准确性；但延长讨论轮次导致“过度讨论漂移”损害性能。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了在风险敏感的法律推理中部署协作多智能体系统的实际边界和安全裕度，指出智能体数量与讨论轮次之间的权衡。

papers.title: Solving Stochastic Fixed-Point Equations with High Probability
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic fixed-point equations $\mathbf{T}(\mathbf{x}) = \mathbf{x}$ over normed spaces $(\mathcal{E}, \|\cdot\|)$, where the operator $\mathbf{T}$ is nonexpansive or contractive and is accessed only through unbiased stochastic evaluations with bounded second central moment. Given $ε> 0, δ\in (0, 1)$, the goal is to output $\mathbf{x} \in \mathcal{E}$ such that $\|\mathbf{T}(\mathbf{x}) - \mathbf{x}\| \leq ε$ with probability at least $1-δ$. We introduce VR-GHAL, a variance-reduced gradual Halpern method for quadratically smoothable Banach spaces. The key algorithmic ingredient is a recursive stochastic estimator based on clipped differences of oracle evaluations: instead of clipping $τ(\mathbf{x}; ξ)$ itself, we clip stochastic differences at the Lipschitz scale $γ\|\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{y}\|$. This makes the estimator pathwise Lipschitz along the algorithmic trajectory while permitting martingale concentration under finite second moments in the native norm. Our main theorem gives an anytime high-probability residual bound: on a single event of probability at least $1 - δ$, the residual decreases nearly geometrically across epochs, up to lower-order logarithmic factors. Under only bounded variance, displaying only the dependence on the target error $ε$ and Lipschitz constant $γ\in (0, 1]$ of $\mathbf{T}$, the resulting oracle complexity is $\min\{ε^{-5}, (1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2}\}$. Under a Lipschitz-in-expectation oracle, the dependence improves to the corresponding $ε^{-3}$ nonexpansive rate (i.e., for $γ= 1$), and under samplewise nonexpansiveness to $ε^{-2}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在赋范空间中求解随机不动点方程的高概率算法，提出方差缩减的逐步Halpern方法（VR-GHAL），在仅有有界二阶矩的条件下达到高概率残差界。算法通过裁剪随机评价的差分的Lipschitz尺度构造递归随机估计器，使估计器沿算法轨迹逐路径Lipschitz。主要定理给出任意时间的高概率残差界，在仅有界方差下oracle复杂度为min{ε^{-5}, (1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2}}。
Motivation: 在随机优化和控制等领域，需要以高概率求解随机不动点方程，但现有方法通常需要强矩假设或仅提供期望收敛。
Method: 提出VR-GHAL方法，其关键是通过裁剪随机评价的差分的Lipschitz尺度来构造递归随机估计器，使估计器沿算法轨迹逐路径Lipschitz，同时允许使用原生范数下的有限二阶矩进行鞅集中。
Result: 主要定理给出任意时间的高概率残差界：在概率至少1-δ的单一事件上，残差近乎几何级数下降。在仅有界方差下，oracle复杂度为min{ε^{-5}, (1-γ)^{-3}ε^{-2}}；在Lipschitz期望oracle下改进为ε^{-3}（γ=1）；在样本逐点非扩张下达到ε^{-2}。
Conclusion: 本文提供了求解随机不动点方程的高概率算法，其在弱假设下达到最优或接近最优的oracle复杂度。

papers.title: PRecG: Legal Precedent Retrieval with Graph Neural Networks and Rhetorical Role Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Legal precedent retrieval is a fundamental task in legal case preparation, planning, litigation strategy, and legal research. Current approaches for automatic precedent retrieval map legal documents to a low-dimensional semantic space and compute similarity based on the proximity of their representations. These approaches treat legal documents as monolithic texts, ignoring the rhetorical organization of the legal technicalities. Ergo, they overlook nuanced legal meanings and fail to distinguish the contextual significance of legal entities and concepts that vary based on their rhetorical roles within the document. To address this insufficiency, we propose the PRecG pipeline that computes the similarity between pairs of legal judgments by hierarchically learning their representations. The process begins by decomposing each document into distinct semantic units (segments) based on the rhetorical roles of sentences. For each rhetorical segment, a knowledge graph is constructed to capture the legal entities and their relationships within the segment. Contextual representations of the entities are then learned and aggregated to derive segment-level embeddings. These embeddings are further integrated to produce a unified document-level representation, and finally, the semantic similarity between a pair of documents is computed. We validate the performance of the proposed approach through extensive experiments on a benchmark Indian legal dataset, comparing it against state-of-the-art baselines to demonstrate its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRecG流水线，利用图神经网络和修辞角色分割进行法律先例检索。方法将法律判决分解为基于句子修辞角色的语义段，为每个段构建知识图谱，学习实体表示，聚合得到段级嵌入，再整合为文档级表示，计算相似度。在印度法律数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法将法律文档视为整体文本，忽略修辞组织，无法区分法律实体在不同修辞角色下的上下文重要性。
Method: 提出PRecG流水线：先根据句子修辞角色将文档分割为语义段；为每段构建知识图谱捕捉实体和关系；学习实体上下文表示并聚合得到段级嵌入；整合为文档级表示；计算文档对之间的语义相似度。
Result: 在印度法律基准数据集上，与最先进基线相比，展示了有效性。
Conclusion: 本文方法通过修辞角色分割和图神经网络捕获法律文档的结构化语义，提高了先例检索的精度。
