papers.title: Causal ASCEND: Scalable Two-tier Causal Discovery on High Dimensional Multi-omics Data
papers.abstract_en: Biological systems exhibit a hierarchical structure, characterised by directed flow from upstream regulators to downstream effects. Although this ordering provides a natural scaffold for causal inference, most causal discovery and GRN methods either ignore the tiered organisation or condition on all upstream variables, which becomes infeasible for high-dimensional omics data. We present ASCEND (Ancestral Scalable Causal discovEry via iNherited Descent), a constraint-based framework that leverages known two-tiered structure to enable genome-scale causal discovery. ASCEND introduces a divide-and-conquer strategy that maintains dynamically updated ancestral conditioning sets for each downstream variable, dramatically reducing the number of conditional independence tests required, and achieves polynomial-time complexity where traditional approaches face exponential blow-up. Through extensive simulations and real biological data, we demonstrate that ASCEND accurately recovers ancestral relationships, scales properly and much faster, and outperforms existing gene regulatory network inference methods in both causal precision and computational efficiency. The algorithm's ability to resolve directionality makes it particularly suited for integrating multi-omic data where upstream regulators (e.g., SNPs, methylation sites) and downstream responses (e.g., gene expression) are measured jointly.
papers.comment: Main material: 8 pages + supplementary material. 16 pages in all
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ASCEND 框架，利用已知的两层级结构（上游调控因子如SNP、甲基化位点，下游响应如基因表达）进行高维多组学数据的因果发现。该方法采用分治策略，动态更新祖先条件集，将条件独立性检验数量从指数级降至多项式级，并在模拟和真实生物数据上证明了其因果精度和计算效率优于现有基因调控网络推断方法。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在高维多组学数据中常因条件集过大而不可行，而忽略层级结构会导致错误推断。需要一种能利用生物系统天然层级结构且可扩展至基因组规模的方法。
Method: 提出 ASCEND（Ancestral Scalable Causal discovEry via iNherited Descent），一种基于约束的框架，采用分治策略，为每个下游变量维护动态更新的祖先条件集，大幅减少条件独立性检验次数，实现多项式时间复杂度。
Result: 在模拟和真实生物数据上，ASCEND 准确恢复祖先关系，扩展性好且速度更快，在因果精度和计算效率上优于现有基因调控网络推断方法。
Conclusion: ASCEND 利用已知的两层级结构实现可扩展的因果发现，特别适合整合多组学数据，其中上游调控因子和下游响应被联合测量。

papers.title: Shortcut Learning in Legal Judgment Prediction: Empirical Evidence from the UK Employment Tribunal
papers.abstract_en: Current Legal Judgment Prediction (LJP) is constrained by its reliance on post-hoc judicial materials, increasing the likelihood that models perform retrospective classification rather than true forecasting. This paper empirically investigates shortcut learning in this context by studying claim-level outcome prediction in UK Employment Tribunal (UKET) decisions. Using a corpus of 33,158 individual claims, we predict outcomes from claim texts and LLM-extracted case summaries, evaluating models ranging from interpretable TF-IDF-based classifiers to black-box LLMs. While headline predictive performance figures appear strong, we demonstrate that such performance in LJP systems trained on post-hoc judicial text can be driven by the retrospective nature of the source material. Stratifying the test data by human judgments of leakage reveals that performance increases where outcome-revealing cues are embedded in the narrative. Moreover, a model trained on just the 4% of features identified as leakage achieves high performance, outperforming human experts. These findings substantiate concerns that LJP performance may be exaggerated by linguistic artefacts. Yet this vulnerability is not fatal to the research agenda. Instead, post-hoc judgments might be treated as potentially contaminated texts, requiring active auditing. Retraining models after masking leakage features results in only a negligible reduction in Macro-F1. Hence, while models will opportunistically exploit shortcuts when available, they remain capable of extracting useful predictive signals when these artefacts are removed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文实证研究法律判决预测（LJP）中的捷径学习问题，基于英国就业法庭（UKET）的33,158份索赔文本。作者发现，模型在事后司法材料上表现良好，但高绩效往往源自文本中的结果泄露线索，而非真正的预测能力。通过分层测试数据并隔离泄露特征，模型仅用4%的泄露特征即可超越人类专家。然而，掩蔽泄露特征后重新训练，模型的Macro-F1仅略有下降，表明模型仍能从非泄露信号中学习。
Motivation: 当前LJP模型通常依赖事后司法材料，可能导致模型进行回顾性分类而非真正预测。本文旨在揭示这种捷径学习现象，并评估其对模型性能的影响程度。
Method: 使用33,158份UKET索赔文本和LLM提取的案件摘要，训练从可解释的TF-IDF分类器到黑盒LLM的多种模型。通过人工判断泄露对测试数据进行分层，并训练仅使用泄露特征的模型进行对比实验。
Result: 模型在泄露特征上表现极高，仅用4%的泄露特征即可超越人类专家；但掩蔽泄露特征后重新训练，Macro-F1仅下降极小，表明模型仍能利用非泄露信号。
Conclusion: LJP性能可能被语言伪影夸大，但这种漏洞并非致命。将事后判决视为潜在污染文本并主动审计后，模型仍可提取有效预测信号。

summary_sections.method: 使用33,158份UKET索赔文本和LLM提取的案件摘要，训练从可解释的TF-IDF分类器到黑盒LLM的多种模型。通过人工判断泄露对测试数据进行分层，并训练仅使用泄露特征的模型进行对比实验。
summary_sections.result: 模型在泄露特征上表现极高，仅用4%的泄露特征即可超越人类专家；但掩蔽泄露特征后重新训练，Macro-F1仅下降极小，表明模型仍能利用非泄露信号。
summary_sections.conclusion: LJP性能可能被语言伪影夸大，但这种漏洞并非致命。将事后判决视为潜在污染文本并主动审计后，模型仍可提取有效预测信号。

papers.title: Consistent but Miscalibrated: Evaluating LLM Limitations for Risk Communication in Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly deployed as post-hoc explainers of AI-generated outputs, yet it remains unclear whether they can reliably communicate probabilistic information in natural language. For this role to be viable, models must produce identical verbal descriptions for identical inputs, and select descriptions that accurately reflect the magnitude of the underlying numerical quantities. We evaluate whether nine LLMs meet these requirements within a two-stage prediction pipeline, in which an upstream model has produced probabilistic outputs characterized by their likelihood and uncertainty, and LLMs are tasked with selecting an appropriate verbal descriptor for each. We simulate predictions from an upstream model by taking samples from a Beta distribution parameterized by its mode and prior sample size. We then prompt LLMs to explain these predictions under six domain contexts and with ten temperature settings, and repeating each experiment ten times. We find that LLMs are generally consistent but miscalibrated, with substantially weaker performance on uncertainty than on likelihood tasks. Providing models with precomputed summary statistics (mode and prior sample size) reduced sensitivity to contextual framing but did not resolve the underlying miscalibration, suggesting that the bottleneck resides in the verbalization step itself. These findings indicate that current LLMs do not yet constitute reliable zero-shot standalone risk communication tools for probabilistic predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了九种大型语言模型（LLM）在自然语言中沟通概率信息的能力，重点关注一致性和校准性。通过上游模型生成概率输出（由Beta分布模拟），LLM需选择合适的语言描述。实验发现，LLM在一致性上表现良好，但校准性较差，尤其在不确定性任务上，即使提供预计算统计量也无法解决校准问题，表明当前LLM不是可靠的风险沟通工具。
Motivation: LLM被越来越多地用作AI输出的后验解释器，但其是否能可靠地在自然语言中传达概率信息尚不明确。需要验证模型是否能为相同输入生成相同描述，并准确反映数值量级。
Method: 采用两阶段预测管道：上游模型（Beta分布采样）生成概率输出（包括可能性和不确定性），LLM选择合适的语言描述符。测试九种LLM，六种领域上下文，十种温度设置，每次实验重复十次。
Result: LLM总体一致但校准不良，不确定性任务表现显著差于可能性任务。提供预计算统计量降低了上下文框架敏感性，但未解决校准问题。
Conclusion: 当前LLM尚未成为概率预测的可靠零样本风险沟通工具，瓶颈在于语言化步骤本身。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Reduced-Order Models: The Mother of World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models -- compressed latent representations of an environment that support action-conditioned prediction and planning -- are typically presented as a product of modern self-supervised learning. This paper argues that the functional anatomy of a world model was independently developed, deployed, and formally analyzed decades earlier in the model-order-reduction (MOR) and control literature, under different names and for a different purpose: the real-time operation of physical systems. We trace the anatomy across three communities. Low-dimensional models of turbulence built on proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) supplied latent dynamics learned from data of a chaotic environment; eigenface methods in early computer vision supplied the encoder-decoder half, including a primitive runtime validity check; and measurement-based POD frameworks for facility thermal control assembled the complete loop -- POD coefficients as latent state, parametric dependence on actuator setpoints as action conditioning, modal reconstruction as decoding, and, critically, a priori analytical error bounds as a verification layer that certified when the model's predictions could be trusted in closed loop. We then examine what each tradition possesses that the other lacks: MOR contributes verification, physical grounding, and extreme data efficiency; learned world models contribute nonlinear representation, transferability, and horizon. We argue that the outstanding obstacle to deploying world models in systems that cannot fail -- power, thermal, process control -- is not predictive fidelity but verifiability, and we outline a research agenda for physics-grounded, verifiable world models that unifies the two lineages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了世界模型（world models）的功能架构早在几十年前的模型降阶（MOR）和控制文献中就已独立开发、部署并形式化分析，但名称和目的不同。通过追踪三个领域（基于本征正交分解（POD）的湍流低维模型、计算机视觉中的特征脸方法、基于测量POD的热控制框架），文章指出MOR贡献了验证、物理基础和极端数据效率，而学习型世界模型贡献了非线性表示、可迁移性和长程预测。作者认为部署在不能故障的系统中（如电力、热力、过程控制）的主要障碍不是预测保真度，而是可验证性，并提出了一个统一两条脉络、基于物理、可验证的世界模型研究路线。
Motivation: 当前世界模型通常被视为现代自监督学习的产物，缺乏形式化验证能力，难以部署在安全关键系统中。本文旨在揭示世界模型与更早的模型降阶理论在功能解剖上的本质相似性，并指出验证性（verifiability）才是关键缺失。
Method: 通过跨领域的文献梳理和功能解剖分析，将世界模型分解为编码器-解码器、潜在动态、动作条件预测、验证层等模块，并与POD、特征脸、测量POD框架逐一对应。
Result: 本文未提供实验性结果，而是通过理论论证和历史追踪提出：MOR传统拥有先验误差界和闭环可信度认证，而学习型世界模型拥有非线性表示和长程预测能力，两者互补。
Conclusion: 当前世界模型在安全关键系统部署中的主要短板是可验证性而非预测精度；未来应融合MOR的严谨验证与学习型模型的灵活性，构建物理可解释、可验证的世界模型。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Coding-agents can replicate scientific machine learning papers
papers.abstract_en: Scientific machine learning papers typically make computational claims, e.g., that the relative mean square error is less than 5% or that the 95% predictive credible interval covers the test data. A coding agent can be prompted to replicate those claims from paper materials alone, but the prompt does not by itself reliably preserve progress or check whether generated evidence supports the paper's claims. We introduce Paper-replication, a workflow that makes each selected paper claim a target with recorded evidence, and implement it as a coding-agent skill. The workflow makes the agent record those targets, reconstruct the paper's method, run computational experiments, link generated outputs to provenance and comparisons with the paper's claims, record where matched evidence appears in the replication report, and pass validation checks before completion. We evaluate Paper-replication on twelve independent runs across four scientific machine learning papers. All twelve workspaces pass the completion gate, and all 158 recorded targets are matched with report coverage. Even in this completed workspace state, repeated runs differ in how papers are divided into targets, in numerical fidelity to the source papers, in elapsed replication time, in the number of intermediate executions replaced before final evidence is accepted, and in the rules used to accept evidence. Paper-replication makes completion depend on workspace evidence and validation checks rather than on the agent's final message.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种名为Paper-replication的工作流，使编码代理（coding agent）能够复制科学机器学习论文中的计算声明。该工作流将每个选定的论文声明作为目标并记录证据，要求代理重构方法、运行实验、链接输出与来源和声明进行对比，并通过验证检查。在四篇科学机器学习论文上的十二次独立运行中，所有工作空间均通过完成门，158个目标均被报告覆盖。
Motivation: 科学机器学习论文通常包含计算声明（如误差率低于5%），但通过提示编码代理复制这些声明难以可靠地保留进展或验证生成的证据。
Method: 提出Paper-replication工作流，使代理记录目标声明、重构论文方法、运行实验、将输出链接到来源并与声明对比、记录报告中的匹配证据，并通过验证检查完成。
Result: 在四篇科学机器学习论文的十二次独立运行中，所有工作空间通过完成门，158个目标均被报告覆盖。重复运行在目标划分、数值保真度、耗时、执行替换次数和证据接受规则上存在差异。
Conclusion: Paper-replication使完成取决于工作空间证据和验证检查，而非代理的最终消息，提供了可复现的论文声明验证框架。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: CORGI: Consistency-Aware 3D Dog Reconstruction from a Single Image in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing high-fidelity 3D models of highly articulated animals, such as dogs, from a single in-the-wild image remains a formidable challenge. In this paper, we introduce CORGI, a novel framework for consistency-aware 3D dog reconstruction from a single unconstrained image that completely eliminates the need for 3D supervision. To overcome generative inconsistencies and the lack of multi-view capture, our pipeline introduces three core components. First, we propose a Canonical-Driven Orbital Generation (CDOG) strategy, utilizing specialized Canonical and Orbit LoRAs to normalize arbitrary input poses and synthesize reliable 360-degree video observations. Second, we design a Consistency-aware Deformable 3DGS (CA-3DGS) module that anchors on a D-SMAL prior, explicitly modeling per-view generative errors through dedicated neural deformation fields to learn accurate vertex-level displacements. Finally, to eliminate structural distortions and recover high-frequency details, we introduce a self-supervised Deformation-Conditioned Generative Repair (DCGR) module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CORGI achieves state-of-the-art performance, generalizing seamlessly across diverse dog breeds to produce geometrically accurate, visually coherent, and fully animatable 3D assets ready for downstream applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CORGI框架，用于从单张野外图像中重建高保真3D狗模型，无需3D监督。通过CDOG策略生成多视角视频，CA-3DGS模块处理一致性变形，DCGR模块修复结构失真和细节，在多种犬种上达到SOTA效果。
Motivation: 从单张非约束图像重建高度关节动物（如狗）的3D模型面临生成不一致和缺乏多视角观测的挑战。
Method: 提出CORGI框架，包含三个核心模块：Canonical-Driven Orbital Generation (CDOG) 策略归一化姿态并合成360度视频；Consistency-aware Deformable 3DGS (CA-3DGS) 模块基于D-SMAL先验建模每视角生成误差；自监督Deformation-Conditioned Generative Repair (DCGR) 模块消除结构扭曲并恢复高频细节。
Result: 实验显示CORGI在多种狗品种上实现几何精确、视觉连贯且可动画的3D资产，达到SOTA性能。
Conclusion: CORGI无需3D监督即可从单张图像生成高质量3D狗模型，适用于下游应用。

papers.title: ECHO: Prune To Act, Trace To Learn With Selective Turn Memory In Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents must repeatedly interact with tools, accumulate evidence, and make decisions under bounded context windows. Context-management methods make such rollouts feasible by simplifying past interactions through deletion, folding, or memory editing. However, when useful history is collapsed into compressed states, the reconstructed context may no longer reveal which earlier observations support a successful final answer. This creates a mismatch between bounded-context acting and outcome-based reinforcement learning: the policy acts on reconstructed context, while the learner lacks source-level provenance for assigning credit to the evidence that mattered. We propose ECHO, a selective turn-memory framework for traceable context reconstruction in Agentic RL. ECHO compresses each completed environment turn into a compact source-indexed memory record, reconstructs bounded policy contexts by selecting useful records, and reuses the selected source indices to route positive outcome credit to the final trajectory segment, reused evidence turns, memory findings, and memory-selection actions. On BrowseComp-Plus, ECHO reaches 43.4% held-out accuracy, outperforming GRPO at 28.9% and the rolling-summary baseline SUPO at 36.1%, while using fewer turns and lower trajectory volume than SUPO. The trained policy also improves zero-shot generalization across multi-objective QA, code generation, and deep information-seeking benchmarks on both dense and MoE backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ECHO，一种选择性回合记忆框架，用于智能体强化学习中的可追溯上下文重建。ECHO将每个环境回合压缩为源索引记忆记录，通过选择有用记录重建策略上下文，并利用选中的源索引将正结果信用分配给最终轨迹段、重用的证据回合、记忆发现和记忆选择动作。在BrowseComp-Plus上，ECHO达到43.4%的留出准确率，优于GRPO（28.9%）和滚动摘要基线SUPO（36.1%），且使用更少的回合和较低的轨迹容量。
Motivation: 长程语言智能体在有限上下文窗口下重复交互，现有上下文管理方法通过删除、折叠或记忆编辑简化历史，但压缩后的上下文可能丢失早期观察与最终答案之间的溯源关系，导致基于结果的强化学习中信用分配缺乏证据级别的来源。
Method: ECHO框架通过选择性回合记忆实现可追溯上下文重建：压缩每个环境回合为紧凑的源索引记忆记录；选择有用记录重建有界策略上下文；复用选中的源索引将正结果信用路由到最终轨迹片段、重用的证据回合、记忆发现和记忆选择动作。
Result: 在BrowseComp-Plus上，ECHO达到43.4%留出准确率，分别超过GRPO（28.9%）和SUPO（36.1%），且使用更少回合和更低轨迹容量。训练后的策略在密集和MoE骨干网络上，跨多目标QA、代码生成和深度信息寻找基准上提升了零样本泛化。
Conclusion: ECHO通过选择性回合记忆和可追溯信用分配，在长程智能体任务中实现了更高的准确率和效率，并展现了良好的零样本泛化能力。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出ECHO，一种选择性回合记忆框架，用于智能体强化学习中的可追溯上下文重建。ECHO将每个环境回合压缩为源索引记忆记录，通过选择有用记录重建策略上下文，并利用选中的源索引将正结果信用分配给最终轨迹段、重用的证据回合、记忆发现和记忆选择动作。在BrowseComp-Plus上，ECHO达到43.4%的留出准确率，优于GRPO（28.9%）和滚动摘要基线SUPO（36.1%），且使用更少的回合和较低的轨迹容量。

summary_sections.method: ECHO框架通过选择性回合记忆实现可追溯上下文重建：压缩每个环境回合为紧凑的源索引记忆记录；选择有用记录重建有界策略上下文；复用选中的源索引将正结果信用路由到最终轨迹片段、重用的证据回合、记忆发现和记忆选择动作。

summary_sections.conclusion: ECHO通过选择性回合记忆和可追溯信用分配，在长程智能体任务中实现了更高的准确率和效率，并展现了良好的零样本泛化能力。

papers.title: PRISM: Latent Composition Consistency for Single-Image Reflection Removal
papers.abstract_en: Single-image reflection removal (SIRR) seeks to recover the transmission layer from a mixture corrupted by reflections -- a severely ill-posed problem. Existing methods operate in pixel space, where the nonlinear sRGB formation model entangles the two layers and limits generalization. We observe that pretrained VAE latent spaces exhibit substantially lower coherence between image layers compared to pixel space, providing a more favorable working space for decomposition. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{PRISM} (Pretrained-latent Reflection Image Separation Model), which reinterprets SIRR as a latent linear separation problem. Under an approximate additive formulation in latent space, PRISM learns a flow matching velocity field on a pretrained FLUX backbone that recovers both transmission and reflection in a single forward pass. To enforce robust disentanglement, we introduce a Latent Composition Consistency (LCC) strategy that constructs synthetic mixtures by swapping reflection latents across samples and enforces consistent decomposition via a cycle loss. We further propose a Layer Contrastive Separation (LCS) loss that promotes semantic separation between layers through patch-level contrastive learning, without requiring explicit reflection targets. Experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods by significant margins, with strong generalization to in-the-wild images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM，利用预训练VAE潜空间将单图像反射去除重新表述为潜空间中的线性分离问题。通过FLUX骨干网络学习流匹配速度场，并引入潜成分一致性（LCC）策略和层对比分离（LCS）损失来增强解纠缠。在六个基准上显著超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在像素空间操作，sRGB形成模型导致两层纠缠，泛化受限。观察到预训练VAE潜空间中图像层间相干性较低，更适合分解。
Method: 重新将SIRR看作潜空间中的线性分离问题；在预训练FLUX骨干上学习流匹配速度场；提出LCC策略，通过跨样本交换反射潜变量并应用循环损失构建合成混合物；提出LCS损失，通过补丁级对比学习促进层间语义分离。
Result: 在六个基准上显著超越最先进方法，对野外图像泛化能力强。
Conclusion: 潜空间线性分离范式结合成分一致性策略能有效解决单图像反射去除问题。

papers.title: Memory-Managed Long-Context Attention: Bounded Editable Memory with a Hard Lifecycle and Calibrated Sparse Fallback
papers.abstract_en: We study memory-managed long-context attention: explicit bounded memory with a learned query-independent writer, lifecycle control, query-aware reading, calibrated sparse fallback, and frozen-LLM generation from raw evidence. Track A is a controlled versioned-variable task where last-mention retrieval is wrong by construction. Its full lifecycle scores 1.000 on all three seeds versus a 0.333 lexical baseline, and generation reaches 300/300 at 146 prompt tokens, compared with 172/300 for full-context reading at 729 tokens. Track B uses held-out HotpotQA questions and train-derived, answer-excluded distractors at natural and 8.2k-word lengths. A learned two-hop selector with a bounded 32-passage cache and fallback beats dense retrieval by 5.5--16.6 F1 and reaches 102--116% of full-context F1 at 10% of the evidence words. These real-text gains come from the learned selector; the cache preserves quality at a 0--2.9 F1 cost, and static QA text does not exercise overwrite or protection. The original Llama budget gate failure and the forward-adjudicated Qwen follow-up are reported explicitly. All backbones are frozen; joint training, faithful architecture baselines, and systems measurements remain future work.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, Audit-corrected revision of the previous version. This revision adds preregistered Track A and Track B evaluations, corrected data and statistical protocols, artifact-sourced figures, and a full disclosure of the original budget-gate failure and forward-only adjudication. All backbones are frozen; no leaderboard or systems-superiority claim is made
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种内存管理长上下文注意力机制，包含显式有界内存、学习型查询无关写入器、生命周期控制、查询感知读取和校准稀疏回落。在Track A的版本变量任务上达到满分（1.000），在Track B的HotpotQA任务上，结合学习型两跳选择器和32条缓存的有界内存，F1分数超过稠密检索5.5-16.6，达到全上下文性能的102-116%但仅使用10%的证据词。实验基于冻结骨干模型，未进行联合训练或全架构基线对比。
Motivation: 长上下文注意力机制在处理极长序列时面临内存爆炸和效率问题，现有有界内存方法缺乏精细的生命周期管理和有效的稀疏回溯策略。
Method: 设计了显式有界内存系统，包括学习型查询无关写入器管理内存更新、硬生命周期控制（覆盖与保护）、查询感知读取机制，以及基于校准的稀疏回落（fallback）策略，使用学习型选择器从外部存储中补充相关信息。
Result: Track A任务上，所有三个随机种子均达到1.000满分，而词汇基线仅为0.333；生成任务在146个提示词下达300/300，全上下文729词时仅172/300。Track B HotpotQA上，学习型选择器加32条缓存的有界内存比稠密检索F1提升5.5-16.6，达到全上下文F1的102-116%，仅用10%证据词。静态QA文本未触发覆盖或保护操作。
Conclusion: 该方法在受控任务和真实文本任务上均展现有效性和效率，但质量提升主要来自学习型选择器而非内存管理本身；静态QA测试未验证覆盖与保护机制，联合训练和忠实架构基线是未来工作。

papers.title: Towards Continuous Power Forecasting: Practical Continual Learning for Real-World Energy Systems in Nonstationary Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Power forecasting models deployed in real-world energy markets must operate under nonstationary conditions, where data distributions continually evolve due to weather variability, infrastructure upgrades, and changing consumption behaviors. In practice, these models face strict operational constraints: historical data may be limited or unavailable for repeated retraining, and uninterrupted long-term service is often required. This paper addresses these challenges by proposing the paradigm of Continuous Power Forecasting, which views power forecasting as a continual learning problem rather than a static offline task. Based on an adaptive continual learning framework for regression, we systematically investigate the practical effectiveness of six representative continual learning approaches from three methodological categories. These approaches are evaluated under different realistic assumptions regarding data accessibility and update policies. Experimental validation on real-world power datasets demonstrates that continual learning enables forecasting models to self-adapt to distributional drift, accumulate knowledge over time, and mitigate catastrophic forgetting without relying on large-scale historical data storage. Beyond performance gains, our study provides practical insights into the stability and adaptation behaviors of different continual learning approaches under realistic operational constraints. Overall, this work illustrates how continual learning can be pragmatically integrated into industrial power forecasting pipelines, offering a scalable and sustainable solution for long-term deployment in dynamic environments.
papers.comment: Accepted by the joint workshop at ECML PKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连续电力预测范式，将电力预测视为连续学习问题，系统研究了六种代表性连续学习方法在真实电力数据集上的表现。实验表明，这些方法能自适应分布漂移、积累知识并缓解灾难性遗忘，无需大量历史数据存储，适合长期动态部署。
Motivation: 电力预测模型在实际部署中面临非平稳环境，数据分布因天气、基础设施和消费行为变化而持续演变，且存在历史数据有限和长期服务要求等约束，传统静态训练方法难以适应。
Method: 基于自适应连续回归框架，从三类方法论中选取六种代表性连续学习方法，在不同数据访问性和更新策略假设下进行系统评估。
Result: 在真实电力数据集上，连续学习使模型自适应分布漂移、随时间积累知识、减轻灾难性遗忘，且不依赖大规模历史数据存储。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了连续学习可实用地集成到工业电力预测流程中，为动态环境下的长期部署提供可扩展且可持续的解决方案。

papers.title: Evolutionary Discovery of Developmental Reward Schedules in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: The temporal structure of reward composition in reinforcement learning (RL) is typically hand-designed and held fixed throughout training, leaving the progression of motivational priorities largely unexplored. In this work, we propose an evolutionary framework for discovering developmental reward schedules, in which three distinct biologically inspired motivational components -- agency, novelty, and reactivity -- are combined through time-varying weights that dynamically shift over the course of training. Evaluated on two sparse-reward MiniGrid tasks: DoorKey-6x6 and KeyCorridorS3R1, our framework compares the generalizability of four evolutionary algorithms: CMA-ES, xNES, DE, and L-SHADE against an extrinsically motivated baseline (our main comparison point), and three additional hand-designed methods. On DoorKey-6x6, all evolved methods outperform the non-evolved baselines, with L-SHADE achieving the best performance -- an approximate relative mean improvement of 11.4% over the extrinsic only baseline. On KeyCorridorS3R1, CMA-ES achieves the best overall performance, with the remaining evolved methods showing weaker and less reliable generalization capability compared to the extrinsic only baseline. Interestingly, the discovered schedules diverge from our defined developmental ordering, with novelty consistently emerging as the dominant early signal during training, across both tasks. Collectively, our results position evolutionary optimization as a promising approach for developmental reward schedule discovery in deep reinforcement learning, and suggest that what evolution finds to be optimal in computational settings may differ from what it finds to be optimal in biology. The code for this project can be found at: https://github.com/alannadels/Evolutionary_RL.git.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Development and Learning (ICDL)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个进化框架，用于自动发现深度强化学习中的发育型奖励调度（developmental reward schedules）。该框架将三种受生物学启发的动机分量（代理性、新颖性、反应性）通过随时间变化的权重动态组合，并在两个稀疏奖励的MiniGrid任务（DoorKey-6x6和KeyCorridorS3R1）上进行评估。结果表明，进化优化的方法（特别是L-SHADE和CMA-ES）在部分任务上优于手动设计的基线，且发现的最优调度中新颖性始终是早期训练的主导信号。
Motivation: 深度强化学习中奖励组合的时间结构通常由人工设计并固定不变，忽视了激励优先级随训练进程的变化，而生物发育过程中奖励机制是动态调整的。本文旨在通过进化优化自动发现有效的发育型奖励调度。
Method: 提出一个进化框架，将三种动机分量（代理性、新颖性、反应性）通过动态权重组合，使用四种进化算法（CMA-ES、xNES、DE、L-SHADE）优化权重序列，并与外在奖励基线及三种手工调度方法对比。
Result: 在DoorKey-6x6任务上，所有进化方法均优于非进化基线，L-SHADE取得最佳性能，相对平均改进约11.4%；在KeyCorridorS3R1上，CMA-ES表现最佳，但其他进化方法泛化能力较弱。进化发现的调度中，新颖性在训练早期始终占主导。
Conclusion: 进化优化是发现深度强化学习发育型奖励调度的一种有前景的方法，且计算最优调度可能与生物学最优调度存在差异。

papers.title: Kernel of Partition Paths: A Unified Representation for Tree Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: A recent line of work has reframed individual decision trees as linear models on engineered features associated with their splits, opening routes for oracle inequalities and feature-importance reinterpretation, but leaving open the question of what unified geometric object a forest induces when one indexes its feature map by nodes rather than by splits. The present paper studies that object. KPP indexes the feature map by the nodes of the forest, weighted by a path metric that turns each coordinate into a component of a squared-Euclidean path-isometric embedding. KPP unifies four pillars under a single node-indexed representation whose Gram is non-diagonal and carries a metric: prediction, exact additive attribution, deterministic Lipschitz robust radius in the KPP metric, and uniform Rademacher risk bounds for regression and classification under fixed, honest, or cross-fit conditioning. All probabilistic guarantees are conditional on the representation and are stated under three explicit conditioning regimes; the robust-radius guarantee is deterministic in the KPP metric rather than in a norm on the raw input. Conjectured fast-rate refinements for both regression and classification are stated as open problems and are not claimed as theorems.
papers.comment: v3 (38 pages): adds a 40-dataset benchmark study with Friedman and Nemenyi analyses, leaf-only and node-weight ablations, and per-dataset supplementary tables; incorporates three correctness-focused revision passes. Results and conclusions unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出核化划分路径（KPP），统一树集成（tree ensemble）的预测、可解释性、鲁棒半径和风险界四个支柱，通过将特征图按节点索引并加权路径度量，构建非对角Gram矩阵的几何表示。所有理论保证均在KPP度量下成立，而非原始输入空间的范数。
Motivation: 现有工作将单棵决策树重新表述为基于分裂特征的线性模型，但森林整体诱导的几何对象尚未被统一刻画。
Method: 提出KPP表示，用节点索引特征图，并引入平方欧几里得路径等距嵌入的路径度量，该表示的Gram矩阵非对角且携带度量结构。
Result: KPP统一了预测、精确加法归因、确定性Lipschitz鲁棒半径（在KPP度量下）以及回归和分类的均匀Rademacher风险界（在固定、诚实或交叉拟合条件下）。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出核化划分路径（KPP），统一树集成（tree ensemble）的预测、可解释性、鲁棒半径和风险界四个支柱，通过将特征图按节点索引并加权路径度量，构建非对角Gram矩阵的几何表示。所有理论保证均在KPP度量下成立，而非原始输入空间的范数。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有工作将单棵决策树重新表述为基于分裂特征的线性模型，但森林整体诱导的几何对象尚未被统一刻画。
summary_sections.method: 提出KPP表示，用节点索引特征图，并引入平方欧几里得路径等距嵌入的路径度量，该表示的Gram矩阵非对角且携带度量结构。
summary_sections.result: KPP统一了预测、精确加法归因、确定性Lipschitz鲁棒半径（在KPP度量下）以及回归和分类的均匀Rademacher风险界（在固定、诚实或交叉拟合条件下）。

papers.title: Are LLMs Ready to Assist Physicians? PhysAssistBench for Interactive Doctor-Patient-EHR Assistance
papers.abstract_en: The most plausible near-term role of medical LLMs is to assist rather than replace physicians, yet current evaluations often test isolated capabilities: clinical knowledge, EHR system interaction, or patient communication. Physician assistance instead requires coordinating these capabilities within the same interaction, where physicians issue underspecified requests, patients describe symptoms ambiguously, and EHR systems demand precise tool use. We introduce PhysAssistBench, a benchmark for interactive doctor-patient-EHR assistance. Built from real MIMIC-IV cases, PhysAssistBench uses a scalable pipeline to construct agentic patients: interactive, record-grounded agents that turn static EHR records into multi-turn clinical scenarios while preserving clinical factuality. PhysAssistBench provides a curated bilingual evaluation set of 1,296 manually reviewed and physician-validated turns. Experiments with leading LLMs show that current models remain unreliable in this setting, which exposes a key bottleneck for clinical LLMs: reliable assistance requires coordination across knowledge, communication, and systems, not isolated gains in any of them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysAssistBench是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在交互式医生-患者-电子健康记录（EHR）辅助场景中表现的新基准。它基于MIMIC-IV真实病例构建了可交互的智能患者代理，并包含1296个经人工审核的双语评估回合。实验表明，当前先进LLM在此场景下仍不可靠，主要瓶颈在于需要协调知识、沟通和系统能力。
Motivation: 现有医学LLM评估多聚焦于孤立能力（如临床知识、EHR交互或患者沟通），但医生辅助需要这些能力的协同。该工作填补了缺乏端到端交互式辅助评估的空白。
Method: 提出PhysAssistBench基准，通过可扩展管道从MIMIC-IV静态EHR记录生成交互式患者代理，构建多轮临床场景，并建立双语评估集。
Result: 实验显示，当前主流LLM在PhysAssistBench上表现不可靠，表明可靠辅助需要知识、沟通和系统的协调，而非单一能力的提升。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了LLM在临床辅助中的关键瓶颈，为未来研究提供了评估框架。

papers.title: Code Correctness Signals in LLM Hidden States: Pre-Generation Probing and Repair Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Large language models encode rich information in their hidden states. This work asks whether code correctness is legible in the hidden states of Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, before it generates and as it repairs a failed attempt, studied on 444 LiveCodeBench tasks. It reports two findings connected by a single confound-control tool: residualization. First, the correctness of the model's first-attempt code is linearly decodable from the prompt-final hidden state, with a leakage-free held-out AUC of 0.955 +/- 0.006 across 50 outer splits. After the linear effect of prompt length is removed from each hidden state dimension, the probe still reaches 0.940 +/- 0.009, well above a prompt-length baseline of 0.720 +/- 0.015. Second, on 246 cleaned cases where the model attempts to repair a failed first attempt, the hidden state shift from the failing attempt to its repair carries a robust geometric direction of repair success, significant on both a magnitude and a split-half test against label-shuffled nulls. This direction remains significant on both tests after a conditional residualization against three repair-context covariates that differ between successful and failed repairs, indicating a genuine repair-success signal that the observable repair context does not account for. The contribution is as much methodological as empirical, a confound-control diagnostic that reports each signal only to the extent it survives the control.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 8 tables. Code, data, and analysis scripts available at https://github.com/CarloDiCicco/ReasoningLab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究代码正确性是否在大语言模型（Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507）的隐藏状态中可读，基于444个LiveCodeBench任务。通过线性探测（linear probing）和残差化（residualization）控制混杂因素，发现首轮代码的正确性可以从最终隐藏状态中线性解码（AUC 0.955），且去除提示长度效应后仍显著（0.940）。在修复失败代码时，隐藏状态的变化方向包含修复成功的几何信号，且经条件残差化控制上下文混淆后依然存在。
Motivation: 探索大语言模型在生成代码之前，其隐藏状态中是否编码了代码正确性的信息，以及修复过程中的隐藏状态变化能否反映修复成功与否。
Method: 使用线性探针（linear probe）从提示最终隐藏状态解码代码正确性，并通过残差化（residualization）去除提示长度等混杂效应；对于修复案例，分析隐藏状态位移的方向与修复成功的几何关系，并用条件残差化控制修复上下文差异。
Result: 首轮代码正确性的线性探针达到AUC 0.955±0.006，去除提示长度影响后仍达0.940±0.009，远超基线的0.720±0.015。修复案例中，隐藏状态位移方向在幅度检验和分裂半检验中均显著，且经残差化控制上下文后依然显著。
Conclusion: 代码正确性信号在LLM生成前已存在于隐藏状态，且修复过程中存在稳健的几何方向指示修复成功，该信号不能被观测到的修复上下文完全解释。本文同时提供了一个混杂控制诊断工具。

papers.title: CITRAS-FM: Tiny Time Series Foundation Model for Covariate-Informed Zero-Shot Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained time series foundation models (TSFMs) have enabled zero-shot forecasting on unseen target series. However, existing TSFMs often incur high computational cost and provide limited support for diverse variable types, often failing to account for covariates that exogenously influence target variability. To address these challenges, we propose CITRAS-FM, a tiny 7M-parameter TSFM that supports univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed zero-shot forecasting with real-time CPU inference. Built on a patch-based, decoder-only Transformer, CITRAS-FM introduces Shifted Attention into the cross-variate module to effectively exploit known covariates accessible throughout the forecast horizon. Moreover, to enable covariate-aware pretraining despite the scarcity of covariate-rich corpora, we propose CovSynth, which synthesizes realistic covariates from decomposed components of target series. Experiments on fev-bench, spanning 100 tasks across various settings, demonstrate that CITRAS-FM achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracy among sub-10M TSFMs while delivering sub-0.1-second CPU inference, offering a strong balance between forecasting accuracy and real-time deployability.
papers.comment: Accepted to EUSIPCO 2026. Code available at https://github.com/hitachi-ais/citras-fm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CITRAS-FM是一个仅7M参数的小型时间序列基础模型，支持单变量、多变量和协变量信息下的零样本预测，并能在CPU上实时推理。模型采用基于补丁的解码器仅Transformer，引入Shifted Attention机制以利用已知协变量，并提出CovSynth方法从目标序列分解成分中合成协变量以进行预训练。在fev-bench基准上，该模型在小于10M参数的TSFM中取得了最先进的零样本精度，推理时间低于0.1秒。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型计算成本高，且对协变量支持有限，无法有效利用外生协变量进行预测。
Method: 提出CITRAS-FM，一种7M参数的补丁解码器Transformer，在跨变量模块中使用Shifted Attention来利用整个预测范围内的已知协变量；并提出CovSynth方法从目标序列的分解成分中合成协变量，用于协变量感知的预训练。
Result: 在fev-bench的100个任务上，CITRAS-FM在小于10M参数的TSFM中达到最先进的零样本精度，且CPU推理时间低于0.1秒。
Conclusion: 该模型在预测精度和实时部署能力之间取得了良好平衡，适用于需要快速CPU推断的协变量感知零样本预测场景。

papers.title: Language Models Need Sleep: Learning to Self-Modify and Consolidate Memories
papers.abstract_en: The past few decades have witnessed significant advances in the design of machine learning algorithms, from early studies on task-specific shallow models to more general deep Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite showing promising results in tasks that require instant prediction or in-context learning, existing models lack the ability to continually learn and effectively transfer their temporal in-context knowledge to their long-term parameters. Inspired by human learning process, we introduce a ''Sleep'' paradigm that allows the models to continually learn, distill their short-term fragile memories into stable long-term knowledge with replay, and recursively improve themselves with ''Dreaming'' process. In more detail, sleep consists of two stages: (1) Memory Consolidation: an upward distillation process, called Knowledge Seeding, where the memories of a smaller-self are distilled into a larger network to provide more capacity while preserving the knowledge. As a proof of concept, we present a new Generalized Distillation process for {Knowledge Seeding} (i.e., the combination of on-policy distillation with Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based imitation learning); (2) Dreaming: a self-improvement phase, where the model uses RL to generate a curriculum of synthetic data to rehearse new knowledge and refine existing capabilities without human supervision. Our experiments on long-horizon, continual learning, knowledge incorporation, and few-shot generalization tasks support the importance of the sleep stage.
papers.comment: A version of this work has been publicly available from September 2025 on OpenReview
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 受人类学习过程启发，本文提出一种“睡眠”范式，使大语言模型能够持续学习，将短期脆弱记忆通过回放蒸馏为稳定的长期知识，并通过“做梦”过程递归自我改进。睡眠包括两个阶段：（1）记忆巩固，即向上蒸馏过程“知识播种”，通过策略蒸馏与基于强化学习的模仿学习结合，将小模型记忆迁移到大网络；（2）做梦，即自我改进阶段，模型使用强化学习生成合成数据课程来排练新知识并完善已有能力。实验在长时程、持续学习、知识融合和少样本泛化任务上验证了睡眠阶段的重要性。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型缺乏持续学习能力，无法有效将临时上下文知识转化为长期参数，限制了其在需要长期记忆和知识积累场景下的表现。
Method: 提出睡眠范式，包含两个阶段：记忆巩固阶段采用“知识播种”过程，即结合策略蒸馏和基于强化学习的模仿学习的广义蒸馏；做梦阶段中，模型通过强化学习自主生成合成数据课程进行自我改进。
Result: 在长时程、持续学习、知识融合和少样本泛化任务上的实验支持了睡眠阶段的重要性。
Conclusion: 睡眠范式能使大语言模型更好地持续学习和知识巩固，类似人类睡眠中的记忆整合过程，为提升模型长期学习能力提供了新方向。

papers.title: AnchorMoE: Interpretable Time Series Classification via Anchor-Routed MoE
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series classification (MTSC) is pivotal in high-stakes domains, such as clinical diagnosis and industrial fault detection, where safe deployment necessitates transparent decision-making. However, isolating the temporal segments that drive model predictions is challenging because discriminative signals in real-world time series are typically sparse, heterogeneous, and heavily obscured by background noise. This paper, therefore, proposes AnchorMoE, an interpretable-by-construction classification framework. Built upon a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, AnchorMoE encodes multi-view representations of local patches and routes them to specialized experts, ensuring that the final prediction is formulated as an exact additive decomposition over the input segments, facilitating ante-hoc transparency rather than relying on post-hoc estimations. To maintain the reliability of this decomposition under sparse signal distributions, we introduce a geometric orthogonality constraint that penalizes representational redundancy, compelling distinct experts to specialize in heterogeneous predictive patterns. Furthermore, an uncertainty-aware reliability gate is designed to dynamically calibrate the contribution of each segment, effectively suppressing residual background noise. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic benchmarks demonstrate that AnchorMoE achieves highly competitive classification performance while faithfully grounding its decisions in the raw time series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorMoE 是一种基于混合专家（MoE）的可解释时间序列分类框架。它通过多视角局部片段编码和专家路由实现精确的加性分解，确保预测过程透明。引入几何正交性约束和不确定性感知门控机制，提升稀疏信号下的分解可靠性与噪声抑制能力。在真实与合成基准上取得竞争性分类性能，并能忠实解释决策。
Motivation: 多变量时间序列分类（MTSC）在临床诊断和工业故障检测等高风险领域至关重要，但真实世界中的判别信号稀疏、异质且被噪声掩盖，现有后验解释方法难以准确识别关键时间片段。
Method: 构建基于 MoE 的 AnchorMoE 框架：将输入序列分割为局部片段并编码多视图表示，通过路由机制分配给不同专家，最终预测为各片段贡献的精确加性分解。引入几何正交约束鼓励专家学习异质模式，并设计不确定性感知门控动态调整片段权重以抑制噪声。
Result: 在真实和合成基准上的实验表明，AnchorMoE 在保持高分类性能的同时，能够将决策忠实归因于原始时间序列的特定片段。
Conclusion: Ante-hoc 可解释性设计避免了后验解释的不可靠性，特别适用于信号稀疏且噪声严重的场景。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 构建基于 MoE 的 AnchorMoE 框架：将输入序列分割为局部片段并编码多视图表示，通过路由机制分配给不同专家，最终预测为各片段贡献的精确加性分解。引入几何正交约束鼓励专家学习异质模式，并设计不确定性感知门控动态调整片段权重以抑制噪声。
summary_sections.result: 在真实和合成基准上的实验表明，AnchorMoE 在保持高分类性能的同时，能够将决策忠实归因于原始时间序列的特定片段。
summary_sections.conclusion: Ante-hoc 可解释性设计避免了后验解释的不可靠性，特别适用于信号稀疏且噪声严重的场景。

papers.title: Latent Reward Steering: An Adaptive Inference-Time Framework that Implicitly Promotes Cognitive Behaviors in Reasoning LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Strong reasoning depends not only on model knowledge but also on how effectively cognitive behaviors are deployed during generation. Existing methods often rely on explicit behavior-level control, making them insufficiently adaptive when failures and required corrections vary across reasoning states, tasks, and models. To this end, we propose Latent Reward Steering (LRS), an adaptive inference-time framework that promotes cognitive behaviors by optimizing the sparse-autoencoder (SAE) latent states that implicitly carry them. Rather than relying on predefined cognitive behaviors or steering directions derived from them, LRS trains a latent reward model on reasoning traces by final answer correctness to estimate the quality of intermediate latent states. During inference, reward gradients provide state-specific correction directions for fragile latent states, while a reward and confidence gate restricts intervention to states the reward signal flags as fragile. Experiments on multiple reasoning LLM backbones and benchmarks show that \ours consistently improves performance over various baselines, and post-hoc analyses further indicate that \ours implicitly promotes good cognitive behaviors that fix the original reasoning errors. Code is available at: https://github.com/jiakanglee/Latent-Reward-Steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Latent Reward Steering (LRS)框架，通过优化稀疏自编码器（SAE）的潜在状态隐式促进推理LLMs的认知行为。LRS训练一个潜在奖励模型，根据最终答案正确性评估中间潜在状态质量，并在推理时利用奖励梯度提供状态特定的修正方向，同时通过奖励与置信度门控限制干预范围。实验表明LRS在多个推理LLM骨干和基准上一致优于基线，后续分析显示其隐式促进了修复原始推理错误的良好认知行为。
Motivation: 强推理不仅依赖模型知识，还依赖生成过程中认知行为的有效部署。现有方法通常依赖显式的行为级控制，在推理状态、任务和模型变化时适应性不足。
Method: 提出LRS框架：训练一个基于推理轨迹最终答案正确性的潜在奖励模型，用于估计中间SAE潜在状态的质量；推理时，奖励梯度为脆弱潜在状态提供状态特定的修正方向，并通过奖励与置信度门控仅对奖励信号标记为脆弱的状态进行干预。
Result: 在多个推理LLM骨干和基准上，LRS一致优于各类基线；后验分析表明其隐式促进了修复原始推理错误的良好认知行为。
Conclusion: LRS通过隐式优化携带认知行为的SAE潜在状态，提供了一种自适应推理时干预框架，避免了显式行为定义和预设修正方向，提升了推理性能。

papers.title: DriveMA: Driving Vision-Language-Action Models with verifiable Meta-Actions
papers.abstract_en: Driving Vision-Language-Action Models (Driving VLAs) aim to use language to improve end-to-end planning, but the language-action gap limits this promise. We propose DriveMA, a Driving VLA framework built on verifiable meta-actions, which summarize future ego motion into compact language-domain intentions and can be constructed from expert trajectories with a trajectory-grounded annotation pipeline and can be verified against generated trajectories through rule-based projection. DriveMA exploits this verifiability with action-centric supervised training and a data-efficient turn-level credit assignment reinforcement learning framework, explicitly aligning high-level decisions with low-level trajectory planning through dense rewards and precise credit assignment. DriveMA sets a new state of the art on the Waymo Open Dataset Vision-based E2E Driving, achieving a Rater Feedback Score of 8.060 with a 2B model and further improving it to 8.079 with a 4B model; it also obtains competitive closed-loop planning performance on NAVSIM. These results show that even a simple meta-action interface can achieve state-of-the-art planning when made verifiable and optimized for language-action alignment. Code, data, and models are available at https://tsinghua-mars-lab.github.io/DriveMA.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DriveMA 是一个驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型框架，通过可验证的元动作（meta-actions）来缩小语言与动作之间的差距。元动作将未来自车运动总结为紧凑的语言域意图，并可通过轨迹注释管道从专家轨迹构建，以及通过基于规则的投影对生成轨迹进行验证。DriveMA 利用元动作的可验证性，采用以动作为中心的监督训练和数据高效的分回合信用分配强化学习，通过密集奖励和精确信用分配显式对齐高层决策与低层轨迹规划。在 Waymo Open Dataset 基于视觉的端到端驾驶任务上，DriveMA 使用 2B 模型达到 8.060 的评分，使用 4B 模型提升至 8.079，同时在 NAVSIM 上取得有竞争力的闭环规划性能。
Motivation: 驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型（Driving VLA）旨在利用语言改进端到端规划，但语言-动作差距限制了其潜力。
Method: 提出 DriveMA 框架，基于可验证的元动作，包括轨迹注释管道和规则投影验证；采用以动作为中心的监督训练和分回合信用分配强化学习。
Result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 端到端驾驶任务上，2B 模型获得 8.060 的评分，4B 模型提升至 8.079；在 NAVSIM 上取得有竞争力的闭环规划性能。
Conclusion: 即使简单的元动作接口，只要具备可验证性并优化语言-动作对齐，也能实现最先进的规划性能。

papers.title: Explaining is Harder Than Predicting Alone: Evaluating Concept-based Explanations of MLLMs as ICL Visual Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to classify images from a few labelled examples. Yet, how these models use the provided context remains opaque. While Chain-of-Thought prompting is widely used, recent work argues that it may not reflect true internal computation. In this paper, we systematically evaluate the concept-based explainability of frozen MLLMs under few-shot ICL using five conditions of increasing formal rigour, ranging from baseline classification to Description Logics (DL) axiom generation. Evaluating four state-of-the-art MLLMs via an independent LLM-as-a-judge pipeline, we demonstrate that explaining is genuinely harder than predicting alone. Surprisingly, forcing models to generate formally structured, concept-based explanations degrades predictive accuracy monotonically (from 93.8% to 90.1%), contradicting the assumption that explicit reasoning universally aids performance. However, when models successfully articulate class-discriminative visual features, explanation quality strongly correlates with correct predictions. Our findings suggest that while MLLMs excel at visual classification, they lack the specific instruction-tuning required for formal, machine-verifiable explainability.
papers.comment: Accepted to the CompLearn Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在少样本上下文学习（ICL）下进行概念可解释性解释的能力。通过五种形式化程度递增的条件（从基线分类到描述逻辑公理生成），独立评估四个前沿MLLM。结果表明，要求模型生成形式化结构化概念解释会单调降低预测准确率（从93.8%降至90.1%），说明解释比单纯预测更难，且MLLMs缺乏机器可验证可解释性所需的指令微调。
Motivation: 现有上下文学习研究多关注预测性能，但对模型如何利用上下文进行可解释性解释仍不透明，且链式思维提示可能不反映真实内部计算。
Method: 设计五种形式化约束递增的条件（基线、链式思维、结构化概念、属性逻辑、描述逻辑公理），通过独立LLM-as-a-judge流水线评估四个MLLM的视觉分类和解释质量。
Result: 预测准确率从基线93.8%单调下降至最严格条件下的90.1%；当模型成功表达类别判别性视觉特征时，解释质量与正确预测强相关。
Conclusion: MLLMs在视觉分类上表现优异，但缺乏生成形式化、机器可验证解释所需的特定指令微调，提示可解释性需要更专门的训练。

papers.title: LaCoVL-FER: Landmark-Guided Contrastive Learning Network with Vision-Language Enhancement for Facial Expression Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) in the wild requires models to identify subtle expression cues under large variations in pose, occlusion, illumination, and identity. Recent FER methods improve robustness by introducing visual attention, facial landmarks, or vision-language models as auxiliary priors. However, these priors are typically integrated in a static manner, failing to capture instance-specific facial variations, thereby resulting in severe attention redundancy and representation instability. To address this issue, we propose LaCoVL-FER, a landmark-guided contrastive learning network with vision-language enhancement for FER, which shifts FER from static prior injection to sample-adaptive prior refinement. Specifically, a Landmark-Guided Adaptive Encoder (LGAE) calibrates regional appearance features with landmark geometry through Bi-branch Gated Cross Attention (BGCA), suppressing noisy responses and producing expression-relevant representations. In parallel, a Vision-Language Enhancement Strategy (VLES) refines the generalizable visual features from a frozen CLIP image encoder into expression-specific visual representations. Based on them, an Expression-Conditioned Prompting (ECP) mechanism adapts fixed class-level textual prompts from the frozen CLIP text encoder into instance-aware textual representations. The resulting visual-textual representations are aligned as adaptive semantic priors to enhance robustness and generalization. Quantitative and qualitative experiments show that LaCoVL-FER outperforms state-of-the-art methods on RAF-DB, FERPlus, and AffectNet. The code is available at https://github.com/ylin06804/LaCoVL-FER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LaCoVL-FER，一种地标引导的对比学习网络结合视觉-语言增强，用于野外面部表情识别。该方法通过地标引导自适应编码器（LGAE）校准区域外观特征，视觉-语言增强策略（VLES）提炼CLIP视觉特征，以及表情条件提示（ECP）适应文本提示，将静态先验注入转为样本自适应先验细化。实验在RAF-DB、FERPlus和AffectNet上超越当前最优方法。
Motivation: 现有面部表情识别（FER）方法常以静态方式集成视觉注意力、面部地标或视觉-语言模型等先验，未能捕捉实例特异性面部变化，导致注意力冗余和表示不稳定。
Method: 提出LaCoVL-FER，包含三个核心组件：地标引导自适应编码器（LGAE）通过双分支门控交叉注意力（BGCA）校准区域外观特征与地标几何；视觉-语言增强策略（VLES）将冻结的CLIP图像编码器的一般视觉特征提炼为表情特异性表示；表情条件提示（ECP）将冻结CLIP文本编码器的固定类级文本提示适配为实例感知的文本表示，并对齐视觉-文本表示作为自适应语义先验。
Result: 在RAF-DB、FERPlus和AffectNet数据集上，定量和定性实验表明LaCoVL-FER超越当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 本文强调从静态先验注入转向样本自适应先验细化，通过地标引导和视觉-语言增强提升了FER的鲁棒性和泛化性。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Information-Bottleneck Coordination Graphs for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Coordination graphs are a central abstraction in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), yet existing sparse-graph learners lack a theoretically grounded mechanism to decide which edges should exist and how much information each edge should carry. Current methods rely on heuristic criteria that offer no formal guarantee on the learned topology, and no principled way to allocate different communication capacities to structurally different agent relationships. To address this, we propose Heterogeneous Information-Bottleneck Coordination Graphs (HIBCG), which learns a group-aware sparse graph in which both edge existence and message capacity are theoretically justified. With the graph information bottleneck (GIB) serving as the underlying tool, HIBCG first constructs a group-aligned block-diagonal prior that provides a closed-form criterion for edge retention -- determining which edges should exist and at what density per group block -- and then controls per-agent feature bandwidth on the resulting topology, compressing messages to retain only task-relevant content. We prove that the group-aligned prior strictly tightens the variational bound on topology learning, that the objective decomposes per group block, enabling differential edge control, and that capacity allocation follows a water-filling principle.
papers.comment: Updated organization; corrected theoretical statements and proofs. Main paper + appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出异构信息瓶颈协调图（HIBCG），用于多智能体强化学习中学习具有理论保证的稀疏协调图，同时确定边的存在性和消息容量。该方法基于图信息瓶颈（GIB），构造群对齐块对角先验，提供边保留的闭式准则，并控制每智能体特征带宽以压缩任务相关消息。理论证明该先验收紧拓扑学习的变分界，目标可逐块分解，容量分配遵循注水原理。
Motivation: 现有稀疏图学习方法依赖启发式准则，缺乏对拓扑学习的形式化保证，且无法为不同智能体关系分配不同通信容量。
Method: 利用图信息瓶颈（GIB），构造群对齐块对角先验作为边的保留准则，并基于所得拓扑控制每智能体特征带宽，通过注水原理分配消息容量。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅提供理论证明：群对齐先验收紧变分界、目标可分解、容量分配遵循注水原理。
Conclusion: HIBCG为多智能体强化学习中的稀疏图学习提供了理论依据，能够同时决定边的存在性和消息容量。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出异构信息瓶颈协调图（HIBCG），用于多智能体强化学习中学习具有理论保证的稀疏协调图，同时确定边的存在性和消息容量。该方法基于图信息瓶颈（GIB），构造群对齐块对角先验，提供边保留的闭式准则，并控制每智能体特征带宽以压缩任务相关消息。理论证明该先验收紧拓扑学习的变分界，目标可逐块分解，容量分配遵循注水原理。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有稀疏图学习方法依赖启发式准则，缺乏对拓扑学习的形式化保证，且无法为不同智能体关系分配不同通信容量。
summary_sections.method: 利用图信息瓶颈（GIB），构造群对齐块对角先验作为边的保留准则，并基于所得拓扑控制每智能体特征带宽，通过注水原理分配消息容量。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅提供理论证明：群对齐先验收紧变分界、目标可分解、容量分配遵循注水原理。
summary_sections.conclusion: HIBCG为多智能体强化学习中的稀疏图学习提供了理论依据，能够同时决定边的存在性和消息容量。

papers.title: XAI and Statistical Analysis for Reliable Intrusion Detection in the UAVIDS-2025 Dataset: From Tree to Hybrid and Tabular DNN Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: During thDuring the last few years, the term Mechanistic Interpretability, a specific area, under the umbrella of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), has been introduced, to explain the decisions made by complex machine learning (ML) models in critical systems like UAV intrusion detection systems (UAVIDS). In this paper, we apply best-practices for data pre-processing and examine a wide range of tree-ensembles, deep neural networks, hybrid stacking models and the latest ensemble neural networks to detect intrusions in UAV, with stratified 10-fold cross validation. With our top-performing model, XGBoost, we proceed to Shapley Additive explanations (SHAP), to analyze the global and local feature importances and understand which features, each attack targets, to mimic normal traffic and where the misclassifications occur. Furthermore a distribution analysis follows, by visually comparing violin plots and the curves of kernel density estimations. With the Westfall-Young permutation test for multiple comparisons, the Bandwidth optimization of the KDEs and the selection of Jensen-Shannon Distance for the test, we discover the true causes of false predictions, observed in Wormhole and Blackhole attacks in UAVIDS-2025. The findings provide robust, reliable and explainable models for UAV intrusion detection, along with statistical insights, which capture and clarify the masked nature of the attacks, regarding the challenge of Density Support Intersection, between these attacks, in this dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机入侵检测系统（UAVIDS）中的可解释性和可靠性需求，在UAVIDS-2025数据集上评估了多种树集成、深度神经网络、混合堆叠模型和集成神经网络，最佳模型为XGBoost。通过SHAP分析全局和局部特征重要性，并结合核密度估计（KDE）带宽优化和Westfall-Young置换检验等统计方法，揭示了Wormhole和Blackhole攻击中误分类的真实原因，提供了鲁棒且可解释的检测模型。
Motivation: 无人机入侵检测系统需要复杂ML模型的高准确率，同时要求模型决策可解释且可靠。现有方法在解释误分类原因方面不足，尤其针对模拟正常流量的攻击（如Wormhole和Blackhole）。
Method: 采用分层10折交叉验证，对比了树集成（如XGBoost）、DNN、混合堆叠和最新集成神经网络。对最佳模型XGBoost使用SHAP进行特征重要性分析，并通过小提琴图、KDE曲线、Westfall-Young置换检验（多重比较）和Jensen-Shannon距离进行分布分析，优化KDE带宽。
Result: 发现Wormhole和Blackhole攻击的误分类主要源于密度支撑交集（Density Support Intersection）问题，即攻击流量与正常流量的特征分布高度重叠，导致模型难以区分。
Conclusion: 论文强调结合XAI（特别是SHAP）与严格的统计检验能够揭示入侵检测中误分类的根本原因，为UAVIDS-2025数据集提供了可靠且可解释的模型，并指出攻击的伪装性质是误报的关键挑战。

papers.title: Embodied Multi-Agent Coordination by Aligning World Models Through Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Effective collaboration between embodied agents requires more than acting in a shared environment; it demands communication grounded in each agent's evolving understanding of the world. When agents can only partially observe their surroundings, coordination without communication is provably hard, but communication can, in principle, bridge this gap by allowing agents to share observations and align their world models. In this work, we examine whether LLM-based embodied agents actually realize the ability to communicate. We extend PARTNR, a benchmark for collaborative household robotics, with a natural-language dialogue channel that enables two agents with partial observability to communicate during task execution. To evaluate whether dialogue leads to genuine world-model alignment rather than superficial coordination, we propose a framework for measuring world-model alignment defined over per-agent world graphs: observation convergence (do private world models align over time?), information novelty (do messages convey what the partner lacks?), and belief-sensitive messaging (do agents model what their partner knows?). Our experiments across three LLMs reveal that dialogue reduces action conflicts 40 to 83 percentage points but degrades task success relative to silent coordination. Using our metrics, we characterize the gap between superficial coordination and genuine world-model alignment, and identify where current models fall on this spectrum. Project Website: https://uiuc-conversational-ai-lab.github.io/partnr-dial-wmd/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于LLM的具身多智能体系统能否通过自然语言对话实现真正的世界模型对齐，而非表面协调。在PARTNR基准上添加对话通道，提出基于世界图的度量框架（观察收敛、信息新颖性、信念敏感消息）。实验表明对话减少动作冲突40-83个百分点，但任务成功率下降，揭示当前LLM在实现真正对齐上的不足。
Motivation: 具身智能体在部分可观测环境下协作困难，通信理论上可弥补，但LLM智能体是否真正利用通信实现世界模型对齐尚不清楚。
Method: 在PARTNR基准上扩展自然语言对话通道，允许两个部分可观测的智能体通信；提出基于世界图的度量框架，包括观察收敛、信息新颖性和信念敏感消息。
Result: 对话减少动作冲突40-83个百分点，但任务成功率相对于无通信协作下降；度量结果表明存在表面协调与真正世界模型对齐的差距。
Conclusion: 当前LLM在对话中实现世界模型对齐的能力有限，度量框架可用于评估和改进多智能体协作中的通信质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tuning Derivatives for Causal Fairness in Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Artificial-intelligence systems are becoming ubiquitous in society, yet their predictions typically inherit biases with respect to protected attributes such as race, gender, or age. Classical fairness notions, most notably Statistical Parity (SP), demand that predictions be independent of the protected attributes, but are overly restrictive when these attributes influence mediating variables that are considered business necessities. Recent causal formulations relax SP by distinguishing allowed from not-allowed causal paths and by complementing SP with Predictive Parity (PP), requiring the predictor to replicate the legitimate influence of business-necessities. Existing path-based definitions are mainly practical when applied to categorical attributes. This paper introduces a new framework for fairness in structural causal models that is tailored to continuous protected attributes. We formalize SP and PP through path-specific partial derivatives, establish conditions under which these criteria coincide with prior causal definitions, and characterize when a fair predictor, one that satisfies SP along not-allowed paths while achieving PP along allowed paths, exists. Building on this theory, we propose a fair tuning algorithm that either constructs such a predictor or, when not possible, allows for a trade-off between SP and PP. We present experiments on simulated and real data to evaluate our proposal, compare it with previously proposed methods, and show that it performs better when PP is considered.
papers.comment: Published with open access in Machine Learning (Springer) on 18 May 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续敏感属性，在结构因果模型中提出了基于路径特定偏导数的公平性框架，形式化了统计均等（SP）和预测均等（PP），并提出了一个公平调整算法，能够在满足SP和PP之间进行权衡。实验在模拟和真实数据上展示其优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有因果公平定义主要适用于分类敏感属性，而连续敏感属性的公平性处理不足。
Method: 通过路径特定偏导数定义SP和PP，建立与先前因果定义一致的条件，并提出公平调整算法，当无法同时满足时允许SP和PP之间的权衡。
Result: 实验表明该方法在考虑PP时优于先前提出的方法。
Conclusion: 该框架为连续敏感属性提供了因果公平性的正式定义和实用调整算法，支持SP和PP之间的权衡。

papers.title: Render-in-the-Loop: Vector Graphics Generation via Visual Self-Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising capabilities in generating Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) via direct code synthesis. However, existing paradigms typically adopt an open-loop "blind drawing" approach, where models generate symbolic code sequences without perceiving intermediate visual outcomes. This methodology severely underutilizes the powerful visual priors embedded in MLLMs vision encoders, treating SVG generation as a disjointed textual sequence modeling task rather than an integrated visuo-spatial one. Consequently, models struggle to reason about partial canvas states and implicit occlusion relationships, which are visually explicit but textually ambiguous. To bridge this gap, we propose Render-in-the-Loop, a novel generation paradigm that reformulates SVG synthesis as a step-wise, visual-context-aware process. By rendering intermediate code states into a cumulative canvas, the model explicitly observes the evolving visual context at each step, leveraging on-the-fly feedback to guide subsequent generation. However, we demonstrate that applying this visual loop naively to off-the-shelf models is suboptimal due to their inability to leverage incremental visual-code mappings. To address this, we first utilize fine-grained path decomposition to construct dense multi-step visual trajectories, and then introduce a Visual Self-Feedback (VSF) training strategy to condition the next primitive generation on intermediate visual states. Furthermore, a Render-and-Verify (RaV) inference mechanism is proposed to effectively filter degenerate and redundant primitives. Our framework, instantiated on a multimodal foundation model, outperforms strong open-weight baselines on the standard MMSVGBench. This result highlights the remarkable data efficiency and generalization capability of our Render-in-the-Loop paradigm for both Text-to-SVG and Image-to-SVG tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Render-in-the-Loop 范式，将 SVG 生成重构为逐步视觉上下文感知过程。通过渲染中间代码为累积画布并引入视觉自反馈（VSF）训练策略，使多模态大语言模型在生成每一步时都能观察视觉状态。同时提出 Render-and-Verify (RaV) 推理机制过滤退化图元。在 MMSVGBench 基准上优于多个开源基线，展示了数据效率和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 SVG 生成方法采用开环盲画方式，仅将 SVG 生成视为文本序列建模，未能利用 MLLM 视觉编码器中的视觉先验，导致难以推理部分画布状态和隐式遮挡关系。
Method: 首先对路径进行细粒度分解以构建密集的多步视觉轨迹，然后提出视觉自反馈（VSF）训练策略使下一步图元生成条件于中间视觉状态，最后在推理时使用 Render-and-Verify (RaV) 机制过滤退化冗余图元。
Result: 基于多模态基础模型实现的框架在标准 MMSVGBench 上优于强开源基线，在 Text-to-SVG 和 Image-to-SVG 任务上均表现出数据效率和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 提出的 Render-in-the-Loop 范式通过引入视觉循环和自反馈，有效提升了 SVG 生成质量，展示了结合视觉与代码序列的潜力。

papers.title: HiPO: Hierarchical Preference Optimization for Adaptive Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is an effective framework for aligning large language models with human preferences, but it struggles with complex reasoning tasks. DPO optimizes for the likelihood of generating preferred over dispreferred responses in their entirety and lacks the granularity to provide feedback on subsections of many-step solutions typical of reasoning tasks. Existing methods excel at either stable preference learning (e.g., DPO variants like KTO and RSO) or structured reasoning (e.g., ReMA's multi-agent RL framework, Tree of Thoughts), but fail to merge these complementary strengths. We propose HiPO (Hierarchical Preference Optimization), an extension of DPO that separates responses into reasoning segments (query clarification and context, reasoning steps, and answer) and computes loss as a weighted sum of the DPO loss for each segment. Our approach enables segment-specific training while maintaining DPO's computational efficiency and training stability. We demonstrate that for multiple 7B LLMs fine-tuned using HiPO and DPO on the Math Stack Exchange preference dataset, the models trained with HiPO outperform the others on a variety of common math benchmarks and achieve greater organization, logical flow, and consistency as measured by GPT-4.1.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Includes ablation study across Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on 5 math reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH500, Minerva, AIME24, Gaokao2023). GPT-4.1 used for structured evaluation of reasoning quality
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiPO (Hierarchical Preference Optimization)，扩展DPO，将LLM的推理响应分割为查询澄清与上下文、推理步骤、答案三个片段，并对每个片段分别计算DPO损失的加权和。在Math Stack Exchange偏好数据集上微调多个7B模型，HiPO在数学推理基准上优于DPO，且GPT-4.1评估显示更好的组织、逻辑流和一致性。
Motivation: DPO对复杂推理任务缺乏细粒度反馈，无法区分多步解法的子段质量；现有方法要么擅长稳定偏好学习，要么擅长结构化推理，但无法结合两者。
Method: HiPO将响应分割为三个推理片段，计算每段的DPO损失并加权求和，实现片段级训练，同时保持DPO的计算效率和训练稳定性。
Result: 在GSM8K、MATH500等数学基准上，HiPO训练的7B模型优于DPO；GPT-4.1结构化评估显示更好的组织、逻辑流和一致性。
Conclusion: HiPO通过层次化偏好优化提升了LLM的数学推理能力，在保持DPO优势的同时提供更细粒度的反馈。

papers.title: Enhancing AI and Dynamical Subseasonal Forecasts with Probabilistic Bias Correction
papers.abstract_en: Decision-makers rely on weather forecasts to plant crops, manage wildfires, allocate water and energy, and prepare for weather extremes. Today, such forecasts enjoy unprecedented accuracy out to two weeks thanks to steady advances in physics-based dynamical models and data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) models. However, model skill drops precipitously at subseasonal timescales (2 - 6 weeks ahead), due to compounding errors, systemic model biases, and the chaotic nature of the atmosphere. To counter this degradation, we introduce probabilistic bias correction (PBC), a machine learning framework that substantially reduces systematic error by learning to correct historical probabilistic forecasts. When applied to the leading dynamical and AI models from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), PBC doubles the modest subseasonal skill of the AI Forecasting System and improves the skill of the operationally-debiased dynamical model for 91% of pressure, 92% of temperature, and 98% of precipitation targets. We designed PBC for operational deployment, and, in ECMWF's 2025 real-time forecasting competition, its global forecasts placed first for all weather variables and lead times, outperforming the dynamical models from six operational forecasting centers, an international dynamical multi-model ensemble, ECMWF's AI Forecasting System, and the forecasting systems of 34 teams worldwide. These probabilistic skill gains translate into more accurate prediction of extreme events and have the potential to improve agricultural planning, energy management, and disaster preparedness in vulnerable communities.

papers.title: A Self-Evolving Agentic Framework for Metasurface Inverse Design
papers.abstract_en: Metasurface inverse design can realize complex optical functionality, but turning a target optical response into executable optimization code still requires substantial expertise in computational electromagnetics and solver-specific software engineering. We present a self-evolving agentic framework that lowers this barrier by coupling a coding agent, explicit human-readable skill files, and a deterministic physics-based evaluator. Rather than updating model weights, it revises the skill files from solver-grounded feedback, while the base model and differentiable solver, which provides the physics simulation and gradients, stay fixed. On a multi-type benchmark, skill evolution raises same-type task success from 38\% to 74\%, the fraction of physical criteria met from 0.51 to 0.87, and reduces average attempts from 4.10 to 2.30. On two new-type families, success holds near ceiling on one (0.92 to 0.90) and rises from 0.20 to 0.90 on the other. Skill evolution offers a practical path toward autonomous and accessible inverse-design workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自进化智能框架，用于超表面逆向设计。该框架结合编码代理、人类可读的技能文件和基于物理的确定性评估器，通过更新技能文件而非模型权重来提升性能。在多种类基准上，同类型任务成功率从38%提高到74%，物理准则满足比例从0.51提升到0.87，平均尝试次数从4.10降至2.30。在两种新型任务上，成功率分别保持在高位（0.92到0.90）和从0.20上升到0.90。
Motivation: 超表面逆向设计需要大量计算电磁学和求解器软件工程专业知识，现有方法门槛高，难以自动化。
Method: 提出一个自进化代理框架，包含编码代理、人类可读的技能文件和固定的可微分求解器。通过从求解器反馈中修订技能文件来提升性能，不更新模型权重。
Result: 在多种类基准上，同类型任务成功率从38%升至74%，物理准则满足比例从0.51升至0.87，平均尝试次数从4.10降至2.30。在两种新型任务上，成功率保持稳定或大幅提升。
Conclusion: 技能进化为自主且易用的逆向设计工作流提供了实用路径。

papers.title: RELISH: LLM REgression with a Latent Iterative State Head
papers.abstract_en: We present RELISH (REgression with a Latent Iterative State Head), a novel, lightweight architecture designed for text regression with large language models. Rather than decoding numeric targets as text or aggregating multiple generated outputs, RELISH predicts scalar values directly from frozen LLM representations by iteratively refining a learned latent state through cross-attention over token-level representations, and then mapping the final state to a point estimate with a linear regressor. Across six datasets, four LLM backbones, and two LLM training regimes, RELISH consistently outperforms prior baselines from all three major LLM regression families, including autoregressive decoding, regression-aware inference, and existing predictive head methods. Despite these gains, RELISH remains highly parameter-efficient, requiring only $\sim$3.4-3.7M trainable parameters across frozen LLM backbones (only 0.01-0.04$\%$ additional overhead), far less than LoRA-based alternatives that grow with model size (0.26-0.42$\%$). Our code is available at https://github.com/SamSoup/RELISH.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Third Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RELISH，一种轻量级文本回归架构，通过迭代优化潜在状态和交叉注意力机制，从冻结的LLM表示中直接预测标量值。在六个数据集、四个LLM骨干和两种训练模式下，RELISH一致优于三种主要LLM回归家族（自回归解码、回归感知推理、预测头方法）的基线，且仅需约3.4-3.7M可训练参数（占冻结模型参数的0.01-0.04%），远少于LoRA变体（0.26-0.42%）。
Motivation: 现有LLM回归方法要么将数值目标解码为文本（效率低），要么聚合多个生成输出（不稳定），导致性能或参数效率不佳。RELISH旨在通过直接回归标量值解决这些问题。
Method: RELISH通过一个潜在迭代状态头（Latent Iterative State Head），对冻结LLM的token级表示进行交叉注意力，迭代细化学习到的潜在状态，最后用线性回归器映射到点估计。训练时仅更新头部参数，LLM冻结。
Result: 在六个数据集上，使用四个LLM骨干和两种训练模式，RELISH在所有指标上超越现有三类基线方法。参数效率极高，仅增加0.01-0.04%参数。
Conclusion: RELISH证明了一种参数高效的LLM回归方法，可在冻结LLM基础上通过轻量头实现优越性能，避免了LoRA等全模型微调的开销。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Diagnosing Long-Video Quantitative Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs via Enumeration and Counting
papers.abstract_en: Final-answer video QA can show whether a model predicts the right number, but not which instances it counted, when the supporting evidence occurs, or why it failed. We diagnose long-video quantitative reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) through three coupled abilities: enumerating query-relevant instances, temporally grounding supporting evidence, and aggregating the evidence into counts. To support this analysis, we build EC-Bench, an evidence-annotated evaluation suite with 152 untrimmed videos longer than 30 minutes, 1,699 open-ended queries across six reasoning categories, and human-verified evidence spans. We evaluate 22 open-source and proprietary MLLMs using timestamped visual frames and transcripts. The best average scores reach only 29.98% Enumeration F1 and 23.74% Counting accuracy, compared with human performance of 78.57% and 82.97%, respectively. Our analyses show that counting errors are rarely isolated arithmetic mistakes: Enumeration F1 is strongly associated with Counting accuracy, temporal grounding quality is associated with lower counting error, and Counting accuracy drops as supporting evidence becomes more distributed. These findings recast long-video counting as evidence retrieval, temporal grounding, deduplication, and aggregation across the video, rather than simple numerical prediction.
papers.comment: The first two authors are equally contributed. The data and code are publicly available at: https://github.com/matsuolab/EC-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过枚举与计数任务诊断多模态大模型在长视频中的定量推理能力，构建了 EC-Bench 评估套件，包含 152 个超过 30 分钟的视频、1699 个开放式查询及人工标注的证据片段。评估 22 个模型显示，最佳平均枚举 F1 仅 29.98%，计数准确率 23.74%，远低于人类水平（78.57% 和 82.97%）。分析表明计数错误并非单纯算术失误，而与证据检索、时间定位、去重和聚合能力密切相关。
Motivation: 现有视频问答仅关注最终答案，无法揭示模型计数过程中遗漏的实例、证据出现的时间点或失败原因，缺乏细粒度诊断方法。
Method: 提出 EC-Bench 评估套件，包含长视频、开放式计数查询及人工验证的证据片段，通过枚举 F1、时间定位质量和计数准确率三个指标，系统分析模型的枚举、时间定位和聚合能力。
Result: 最佳模型枚举 F1 为 29.98%，计数准确率 23.74%，远低于人类；枚举能力与计数准确率强相关，时间定位质量越高计数错误越低，证据越分散计数准确率越差。
Conclusion: 长视频计数应重新定义为证据检索、时间定位、去重和聚合的综合任务，而非简单的数值预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RehearsalNeRF: Decoupling Intrinsic Neural Fields of Dynamic Illuminations for Scene Editing
papers.abstract_en: Although there has been significant progress in neural radiance fields, an issue on dynamic illumination changes still remains unsolved. Different from relevant works that parameterize time-variant/-invariant components in scenes, subjects' radiance is highly entangled with their own emitted radiance and lighting colors in spatio-temporal domain. In this paper, we present a new effective method to learn disentangled neural fields under the severe illumination changes, named RehearsalNeRF. Our key idea is to leverage scenes captured under stable lighting like rehearsal stages, easily taken before dynamic illumination occurs, to enforce geometric consistency between the different lighting conditions. In particular, RehearsalNeRF employs a learnable vector for lighting effects which represents illumination colors in a temporal dimension and is used to disentangle projected light colors from scene radiance. Furthermore, our RehearsalNeRF is also able to reconstruct the neural fields of dynamic objects by simply adopting off-the-shelf interactive masks. To decouple the dynamic objects, we propose a new regularization leveraging optical flow, which provides coarse supervision for the color disentanglement. We demonstrate the effectiveness of RehearsalNeRF by showing robust performances on novel view synthesis and scene editing under dynamic illumination conditions. Our source code and video datasets will be publicly available.
papers.comment: Accepted to the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Changyeon Won and Hyunjun Jung contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RehearsalNeRF，一种在动态光照变化下解缠神经辐射场的方法。通过利用稳定光照下的排练场景强制几何一致性，使用可学习光照向量分离光照颜色与场景辐射，并借助光流正则化解缠动态物体。在新视图合成和场景编辑任务上展现出鲁棒性能。
Motivation: 现有神经辐射场方法在动态光照变化下，场景辐射与光照颜色高度耦合，难以有效解缠，限制了场景编辑的能力。
Method: 利用稳定光照下的排练场景（如动态光照发生前拍摄）来强制几何一致性；引入可学习光照向量表示时序光照颜色，用于从场景辐射中分离光照；针对动态物体，采用交互式掩码和基于光流的正则化进行解缠。
Result: 在动态光照条件下的新视图合成和场景编辑任务中，RehearsalNeRF表现出鲁棒性能，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: RehearsalNeRF能有效解缠动态光照与场景辐射，支持灵活的场景编辑，且代码和数据集将公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predictive Photometric Uncertainty in Gaussian Splatting for Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled impressive photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, to transition from a pure rendering engine to a reliable spatial map for autonomous agents and safety-critical applications, knowing where the representation is uncertain is as important as the rendering fidelity itself. We bridge this critical gap by introducing a lightweight, plug-and-play framework for pixel-wise, view-dependent predictive uncertainty estimation. Our post-hoc method formulates uncertainty as a Bayesian-regularized linear least-squares optimization over reconstruction residuals. This architecture-agnostic approach extracts a per-primitive uncertainty channel without modifying the underlying scene representation or degrading baseline visual fidelity. Crucially, we demonstrate that providing this actionable reliability signal successfully translates 3D Gaussian splatting into a trustworthy spatial map, further improving state-of-the-art performance across three critical downstream perception tasks: active view selection, pose-agnostic scene change detection, and pose-agnostic anomaly detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个轻量级、即插即用的后处理方法，为3D高斯点云渲染提供像素级、视角依赖的预测不确定性估计。该方法通过贝叶斯正则化线性最小二乘优化重建残差，提取每个原语的不确定性通道，无需修改原始场景表示或降低渲染质量。实验表明，该不确定性信号在主动视角选择、姿态无关场景变化检测和异常检测三项下游任务中提升了性能。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯点云渲染在新视角合成方面表现出色，但缺乏不确定性估计，限制了其在安全关键和自主系统中的应用。
Method: 提出后处理方法，将不确定性建模为贝叶斯正则化的线性最小二乘优化问题，基于重建残差为每个高斯原语学习不确定性通道，无需修改底层表示。
Result: 该方法在不牺牲渲染保真度的前提下提供可靠的不确定性信号，并在主动视角选择、场景变化检测和异常检测三项下游任务中提升了现有最新技术的性能。
Conclusion: 本文填补了3D高斯点云渲染中不确定性估计的空白，将其转化为可信赖的空间地图，适用于安全关键感知任务。

summary_sections.method: 提出后处理方法，将不确定性建模为贝叶斯正则化的线性最小二乘优化问题，基于重建残差为每个高斯原语学习不确定性通道，无需修改底层表示。
summary_sections.result: 该方法在不牺牲渲染保真度的前提下提供可靠的不确定性信号，并在主动视角选择、场景变化检测和异常检测三项下游任务中提升了现有最新技术的性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文填补了3D高斯点云渲染中不确定性估计的空白，将其转化为可信赖的空间地图，适用于安全关键感知任务。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Climate Science and Machine Learning in Climate Model Emulation
papers.abstract_en: For decades, physics-based climate models have been used to provide insights for climate decision-making. Their application is, however, constrained by significant computational and technical demands. Machine learning (ML) emulators offer a way to reduce these high computational costs; yet, it remains challenging to use ML emulators effectively in climate research. In practice, climate scientists often bypass emulators altogether, and machine learning researchers frequently develop them as methodological showcases without proving their practical utility. The reasons are diverse, ranging from limited accessibility and a lack of specialized knowledge to broader concerns about the physical grounding of ML methods. Here, we discuss limitations and introduce a framework for guiding emulator development, considering both climate science and machine learning perspectives. We argue that designing easy-to-adopt emulators that address clearly defined tasks and demonstrate their reliability is essential. This offers a promising path towards making machine-learning approaches more relevant and usable for applied climate research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论气候科学与机器学习在气候模型仿真（emulator）开发中的差距，指出实际应用中气候科学家常绕过仿真器，而ML研究者开发的仿真器缺乏实用性。作者提出一个框架指导仿真器开发，强调要面向明确任务、易于采用且物理可靠，以提升ML方法在气候研究中的实用性。
Motivation: 气候模型计算成本高，ML仿真器虽有潜力但实际应用中并未被有效采用，原因是可访问性低、缺乏专业知识以及对ML方法物理基础的担忧。
Method: 通过分析双方视角，提出一个框架来指导仿真器开发，包括定义明确任务、确保易用性和可靠性。
Result: 论文讨论了现有局限并提出框架，但摘要未报告具体实验结果。
Conclusion: 强调设计实用、接地气的ML仿真器是弥合气候科学与机器学习之间差距的关键。

papers.title: From Cross-Validation to SURE: Asymptotic Risk of Tuned Regularized Estimators
papers.abstract_en: We derive the asymptotic risk function of regularized empirical risk minimization (ERM) estimators tuned by $n$-fold cross-validation (CV). The out-of-sample prediction loss of such estimators converges in distribution to the squared-error loss (risk function) of shrinkage estimators in the normal means model, tuned by Stein's unbiased risk estimate (SURE). This risk function provides a more fine-grained picture of predictive performance than uniform bounds on worst-case regret, which are common in learning theory: it quantifies how risk varies with the true parameter. As key intermediate steps, we show that (i) $n$-fold CV converges uniformly to SURE, and (ii) while SURE typically has multiple local minima, its global minimum is generically well separated. Well-separation ensures that uniform convergence of CV to SURE translates into convergence of the tuning parameter chosen by CV to that chosen by SURE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文推导了通过n折交叉验证调参的正则化经验风险最小化估计量的渐近风险函数。该估计量的样本外预测损失依分布收敛于正态均值模型中由Stein无偏风险估计调参的收缩估计量的平方误差损失。关键中间步骤表明n折交叉验证一致收敛到SURE，且SURE的全局最小值是良好分离的。
Motivation: 学习理论中的最坏情形后悔界不能精细刻画风险如何随真实参数变化，需要更细粒度的渐近风险分析。
Method: 利用正态均值模型与渐近等价性，证明n折交叉验证一致收敛到SURE，并利用SURE全局最小值的良好分离性保证调参收敛。
Result: 正则化ERM估计量的样本外预测损失渐近等价于由SURE调参的收缩估计量的风险函数。
Conclusion: 论文提供了交叉验证调参的渐近风险刻画，比最坏情形界更精细，但仅适用于平方误差损失和正则化ERM设定。

papers.title: Machine Learning for Network Attacks Classification and Statistical Evaluation of Adversarial Learning Methodologies for Synthetic Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Supervised detection of network attacks has always been a critical part of network intrusion detection systems (NIDS). Nowadays, in a pivotal time for artificial intelligence (AI), with even more sophisticated attacks that utilize advanced techniques, such as generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and reinforcement learning, it has become a vital component if we wish to protect our personal data, which are scattered across the web. In this paper, we address two tasks, in the first unified multi-modal NIDS dataset, which incorporates flow-level data, packet payload information and temporal contextual features, from the reprocessed CIC-IDS-2017, CIC-IoT-2023, UNSW-NB15 and CIC-DDoS-2019, with the same feature space. In the first task we use machine learning (ML) algorithms, with stratified cross validation, in order to prevent network attacks, with stability and reliability. In the second task we use adversarial learning algorithms to generate synthetic data, compare them with the real ones and evaluate their fidelity, utility and privacy using the SDV framework, f-divergences, distinguishability and non-parametric statistical tests. The findings provide stable ML models for intrusion detection and generative models with high fidelity and utility, by combining the Synthetic Data Vault framework, the TRTS and TSTR tests, with non-parametric statistical tests and f-divergence measures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了首个统一多模态网络入侵检测数据集，融合流级数据、数据包载荷信息和时间上下文特征，来自CIC-IDS-2017、CIC-IoT-2023、UNSW-NB15和CIC-DDoS-2019数据集。首先使用机器学习算法（带分层交叉验证）进行攻击检测，然后使用对抗学习生成合成数据，并通过SDV框架、f-散度、可区分性和非参数统计检验评估其保真度、可用性和隐私性。结果提供了稳定的入侵检测模型和高保真度、高可用性的生成模型。
Motivation: 网络攻击日益复杂，利用生成式AI和强化学习等技术，传统监督检测面临挑战；同时缺乏统一的多模态NIDS数据集来评估不同方法。
Method: 构建统一特征空间的多模态数据集；使用机器学习算法（分层交叉验证）进行攻击分类；采用对抗学习算法生成合成数据，并利用SDV框架、f-散度、可区分性和非参数统计检验评估合成数据质量（保真度、可用性、隐私性）。
Result: 获得了稳定的入侵检测模型；生成模型在SDV框架、TRTS/TSTR测试、非参数统计检验和f-散度度量下表现出高保真度和高可用性。
Conclusion: 本文为网络入侵检测提供了稳定的ML模型，并展示了对抗学习生成合成数据的潜力，但摘要未强调局限性。

papers.title: Learning Lineage-guided Geodesics with Finsler Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory inference investigates how to interpolate paths between observed timepoints of dynamical systems, such as temporally resolved population distributions, with the goal of inferring trajectories at unseen times and better understanding system dynamics. Previous work has focused on continuous geometric priors, utilizing data-dependent spatial features to define a Riemannian metric. In many applications, there exists discrete, directed prior knowledge over admissible transitions (e.g. lineage trees in developmental biology). We introduce a Finsler metric that combines geometry with classification and incorporate both types of priors in trajectory inference, yielding improved performance on interpolation tasks in synthetic and real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Finsler几何的轨迹推断方法，将离散的有向先验（如发育生物学中的谱系树）与连续几何先验结合，在合成和真实数据上改进插值性能。
Motivation: 现有轨迹推断方法主要利用数据依赖的空间特征定义Riemannian度量，但忽略了离散、有向的先验知识（如谱系树），限制了在存在此类先验的应用中的性能。
Method: 引入Finsler度量，通过结合分类与几何先验，将离散有向先验整合到轨迹推断中，从而在插值任务中利用两种先验。
Result: 摘要报告在合成和真实数据上，该方法在插值任务上相比基线有改进。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了结合离散有向先验与连续几何先验在轨迹推断中的有效性，但未明确讨论扩展至其他领域或局限性。
