papers.title: Regression-aware Continual Learning for Android Malware Detection
papers.abstract_en: Malware evolves rapidly, forcing machine learning-based detectors to be continuously updated. With antivirus vendors processing hundreds of thousands of new samples daily, datasets can grow to billions of examples, making full retraining impractical. Continual learning (CL) has emerged as a scalable alternative, enabling incremental updates without full data access while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we analyze a critical yet overlooked issue in this context: security regression. Unlike forgetting, which manifests as a drop in average performance on previously seen data, security regression captures harmful sample-level prediction changes, e.g., malware samples that were correctly detected before an update but evade detection afterward. This poses serious risks in security-critical applications, as the silent reintroduction of previously detected threats may undermine users' trust in the update process, leading them to perceive a regression in security even if the average model performance has actually improved. We first formalize and quantify security regression in CL-based malware detectors, revealing that up to 3-6% of malware experience it after model updates. We then address this issue by introducing a regression-aware framework to the CL setting. Specifically, we instantiate it via Positive Congruent Training (PCT), showing seamless integration with any prior CL strategy. Experiments on the ELSA, Tesseract, and AZ-Class datasets show that our method effectively halves regression across different CL scenarios while maintaining strong detection performance over time.
papers.comment: Accepted for pubblication in IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对持续学习在Android恶意软件检测中引发的安全回归（security regression）问题，即模型更新后部分先前正确检测的恶意样本被漏过，威胁用户信任。作者量化了该问题（3-6%恶意样本受影响），并提出通过正一致训练（Positive Congruent Training, PCT）来减少回归，在多个数据集上实现回归减半且保持强检测性能。
Motivation: 持续学习虽能避免完整重训练，但模型更新可能导致部分之前正确检测的恶意样本被错误分类（安全回归），而现有工作忽视了此风险。
Method: 形式化定义并量化安全回归；提出回归感知框架，并通过正一致训练（PCT）实例化，可与现有持续学习策略无缝集成。
Result: 在ELSA、Tesseract、AZ-Class数据集上，方法将不同持续学习场景下的安全回归减半，同时保持强检测性能。
Conclusion: 安全回归是持续学习恶意软件检测的关键问题，所提方法能有效缓解，但需要在更广泛场景下验证。

papers.title: GrAInS: Gradient-based Attribution for Inference-Time Steering of LLMs and VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time steering methods offer a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) by modifying internal activations at test time without updating model weights. However, most existing approaches rely on fixed, global intervention vectors, overlook the causal influence of individual input tokens, and fail to leverage informative gradients from the model's logits, particularly in multimodal settings where visual and textual inputs contribute unevenly. To address these limitations, we introduce GrAInS, an inference-time steering approach that operates across both language-only and vision-language models and tasks. GrAInS uses contrastive, gradient-based attribution via Integrated Gradients to identify the top-k most influential tokens, both positively and negatively attributed based on their contribution to preferred versus dispreferred outputs. These tokens are then used to construct directional steering vectors that capture semantic shifts from undesirable to desirable behavior. During inference, GrAInS adjusts hidden activations at transformer layers guided by token-level attribution signals, and normalizes activations to preserve representational scale. This enables fine-grained, interpretable, and modular control over model behavior, without retraining or auxiliary supervision. Empirically, GrAInS consistently outperforms both fine-tuning and existing steering baselines: it achieves a 13.22% accuracy gain on TruthfulQA using Llama-3.1-8B, reduces hallucination rates on MMHal-Bench from 0.624 to 0.514 with LLaVA-1.6-7B, and improves alignment win rates on SPA-VL by 8.11%, all while preserving the model's fluency and general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GrAInS，一种基于梯度归因的推理时干预方法，适用于纯语言和多模态模型。通过集成梯度（Integrated Gradients）识别对偏好输出有正/负贡献的令牌，构建方向性干预向量，并在推理时调整隐藏激活，无需微调。在TruthfulQA上准确率提升13.22%，在MMHal-Bench上幻觉率从0.624降至0.514，在SPA-VL上对齐胜率提升8.11%。
Motivation: 现有推理时干预方法依赖固定全局干预向量，忽略输入令牌的因果影响，未利用模型logits的梯度信息，尤其在多模态场景中视觉与文本输入贡献不均。
Method: 使用对比集成梯度进行基于梯度的归因，识别top-k最影响偏好/非偏好输出的令牌，构建方向性干预向量，在Transformer层调整隐藏激活并进行归一化以保持表征尺度。
Result: 在TruthfulQA上准确率提升13.22%（Llama-3.1-8B），在MMHal-Bench上幻觉率从0.624降至0.514（LLaVA-1.6-7B），在SPA-VL上对齐胜率提升8.11%，同时保持流畅性和通用能力。
Conclusion: GrAInS实现了细粒度、可解释且模块化的推理时行为控制，无需再训练或辅助监督，在多个基准上优于微调和现有干预基线。

papers.title: A Practical Guide to Interpretable Role-Based Clustering in Multi-Layer Financial Networks
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the functional roles of financial institutions within interconnected markets is critical for effective supervision, systemic risk assessment, and resolution planning. We propose an interpretable role-based clustering approach for multi-layer financial networks, designed to identify the functional positions of institutions across different market segments. Our method follows a general clustering framework defined by proximity measures, cluster evaluation criteria, and algorithm selection. We construct explainable node embeddings based on egonet features that capture both direct and indirect trading relationships within and across market layers. Using transaction-level data from the ECB's Money Market Statistical Reporting (MMSR), we demonstrate how the approach uncovers heterogeneous institutional roles such as market intermediaries, cross-segment connectors, and peripheral lenders or borrowers. The results highlight the flexibility and practical value of role-based clustering in analyzing financial networks and understanding institutional behavior in complex market structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多层金融网络中机构功能角色的聚类问题，提出一种可解释的基于角色的聚类方法。该方法利用基于egonet的特征构建可解释节点嵌入，并采用一般聚类框架。使用ECB的货币市场统计报告数据，识别出市场中介、跨段连接者、外围借贷者等角色，展示了该方法的灵活性和实用价值。
Motivation: 理解金融网络中的机构功能角色对于有效监管、系统性风险评估和处置规划至关重要，但现有方法缺乏可解释性。
Method: 提出一种基于角色聚类的通用框架，包括邻近度量、聚类评估标准和算法选择。构建基于egonet特征的可解释节点嵌入，捕捉层内和跨层的直接与间接交易关系。
Result: 在ECB的货币市场统计报告交易数据上，该方法成功识别出市场中介、跨段连接者和外围借贷者等异质机构角色。
Conclusion: 该方法在分析金融网络和理解复杂市场结构中的机构行为方面具有灵活性和实用价值。

papers.title: Single-Frame Point-Pixel Registration via Supervised Cross-Modal Feature Matching
papers.abstract_en: Point-pixel registration between LiDAR point clouds and camera images is a fundamental yet challenging task in autonomous driving and robotic perception. A key difficulty lies in the modality gap between unstructured point clouds and structured images, especially under sparse single-frame LiDAR settings. Existing methods typically extract features separately from point clouds and images, then rely on hand-crafted or learned matching strategies. This separate encoding fails to bridge the modality gap effectively, and more critically, these methods struggle with the sparsity and noise of single-frame LiDAR, often requiring point cloud accumulation or additional priors to improve reliability. Inspired by recent progress in detector-free matching paradigms, we revisit the projection-based approach and introduce the detector-free framework for direct point-pixel matching between LiDAR and camera views. To further enhance matching reliability, we introduce a repeatability scoring mechanism that acts as a soft visibility prior. This guides the network to suppress unreliable matches in regions with low intensity variation, improving robustness under sparse input. Extensive experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and MIAS-LCEC-TF70 benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming prior approaches on nuScenes (even those relying on accumulated point clouds), despite using only single-frame LiDAR.

papers.title: Uncovering smooth structures in single-cell data with PCS-guided neighbor embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell sequencing is revolutionizing biology by enabling detailed investigations of cell-state transitions. Many biological processes unfold along continuous trajectories, yet it remains challenging to extract smooth, low-dimensional representations from inherently noisy, high-dimensional single-cell data. Neighbor embedding (NE) algorithms, such as t-SNE and UMAP, are widely used to embed high-dimensional single-cell data into low dimensions. But they often introduce undesirable distortions, resulting in misleading interpretations. Existing evaluation methods for NE algorithms primarily focus on separating discrete cell types rather than capturing continuous cell-state transitions, while dynamic modeling approaches rely on strong assumptions about cellular processes and specialized data. To address these challenges, we build on the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) framework for reliable and reproducible data-driven discoveries. First, we systematically evaluate popular NE algorithms through empirical analysis, simulation, and theory, and reveal their key shortcomings, such as artifacts and instability. We then introduce NESS, a principled and interpretable machine learning approach to improve NE representations by leveraging algorithmic stability and to enable robust inference of smooth biological structures. NESS offers useful concepts, quantitative stability metrics, and efficient computational workflows to uncover developmental trajectories and cell-state transitions in single-cell data. Finally, we apply NESS to six single-cell datasets, spanning pluripotent stem cell differentiation, organoid development, and multiple tissue-specific lineage trajectories. Across these diverse contexts, NESS consistently yields useful biological insights, such as identification of transitional and stable cell states and quantification of transcriptional dynamics during development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于可预测性-可计算性-稳定性（PCS）框架，系统评估了t-SNE和UMAP等邻域嵌入（NE）算法在单细胞数据中的不足，如伪影和不稳定性，并提出了NESS方法，通过利用算法稳定性改进NE表示，以可靠推断平滑的生物学结构，如发育轨迹和细胞状态转换。在6个单细胞数据集上的应用验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有邻域嵌入算法（如t-SNE和UMAP）在单细胞数据中常引入失真和误导性解释，且现有评估方法主要关注离散细胞类型分离，而非连续细胞状态转换；动态建模方法则依赖于强假设和专门数据。
Method: 提出NESS方法，基于PCS框架，通过引入算法稳定性来改进邻域嵌入表示，提供定量稳定性指标和高效计算流程，以稳健地发现单细胞数据中的平滑结构。
Result: 在6个单细胞数据集（涵盖多能干细胞分化、类器官发育和多种组织特异性谱系轨迹）上，NESS一致揭示了有意义的生物学见解，如识别过渡态和稳定细胞状态，并量化发育过程中的转录动态。
Conclusion: NESS提供了可靠且可解释的框架，用于从单细胞数据中提取平滑生物学结构，克服了传统NE算法的失真问题，但方法可能依赖于参数选择，且未在气象等非生物学领域验证。

papers.title: Transformer-Based Inverse Microrheology for Experimental Mechanics at Ultra-High Strain Rates
papers.abstract_en: Traditional rheological tools are often limited in characterizing soft materials under ultra-high strain-rate loading conditions (> 1000 s^-1) due to constraints in spatiotemporal resolution, loading rate, and invasiveness. Recently, inertial microcavitation rheometry (IMR), which utilizes laser-induced inertial cavitation (LIC) to dynamically deform surrounding materials, has emerged as a powerful experimental mechanics technique for probing nonlinear viscoelastic properties under extreme loading conditions. However, conventional IMR relies on computationally expensive iterative inverse fitting procedures, limiting its scalability and real-time applicability. Here, we introduce a new AI-enhanced experimental mechanics framework, called Bubble Dynamics Transformer (BDT), that integrates physics-based cavitation simulations with Transformer neural network architectures to achieve rapid inverse characterization of soft material viscoelasticity from experimentally measured bubble dynamics. The proposed framework directly predicts viscoelastic material parameters from time-resolved bubble radius evolution curves without iterative optimization. The BDT is trained using synthetic datasets generated from physics-based Keller--Miksis cavitation simulations and validated using experimental laser-induced cavitation data obtained from hydrogels and viscous polymer solutions. The proposed AI-driven framework demonstrates excellent agreement with our previous IMR while substantially accelerating constitutive parameter inference. Experimental demonstrations further reveal the capability of the framework to characterize rate-dependent material behavior across a wide range of soft materials, from viscous liquids to various viscoelastic hydrogels, at ultra-high strain rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bubble Dynamics Transformer (BDT)，一种结合物理空化模拟与 Transformer 神经网络的 AI 增强实验力学框架，用于快速反演软材料在超高应变率下的粘弹性参数。BDT 直接从气泡半径时间序列预测材料参数，避免了传统迭代反演的耗时过程，并在水凝胶和粘性聚合物溶液的实验数据上验证了其准确性。
Motivation: 传统惯性微空化流变学 (IMR) 依赖计算昂贵的迭代反演，限制了其实时和大规模应用。需要一种快速、可扩展的反演方法以实现超高应变率下软材料特性的在线表征。
Method: 提出 BDT 框架，使用基于 Keller-Miksis 空化模拟生成的合成数据集训练 Transformer 网络，从而直接从实验测得的气泡半径演化曲线预测粘弹性材料参数，无需迭代优化。
Result: BDT 在粘弹性参数推断上显著加速，与先前 IMR 方法结果高度一致，并可表征从粘性液体到各种粘弹性水凝胶的宽范围软材料在超高应变率下的率相关行为。
Conclusion: 该 AI 驱动框架为超高应变率下软材料的实时反演表征提供了有效途径，有望拓展 IMR 技术的实用性和可扩展性。

papers.title: M4V: Multimodal Mamba for Efficient Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video generation has significantly enriched content creation and holds the potential to evolve into powerful world simulators. However, modeling the vast spatiotemporal space remains computationally demanding, particularly when employing Transformers, which incur quadratic complexity in sequence processing and thus limit practical applications. Recent advancements in linear-time sequence modeling, particularly the Mamba architecture, offer a more efficient alternative. Nevertheless, its plain design limits its direct applicability to multimodal and spatiotemporal video generation tasks. To address these challenges, we introduce M4V, a multimodal Mamba framework for efficient text-to-video generation. Specifically, a MultiModal diffusion Mamba (MM-DiM) block is designed within the framework to enable seamless integration of multimodal information and spatiotemporal modeling. In detail, we introduce a novel multimodal token re-composition design, which employs a bidirectional scheme for multimodal information integration through simple token arrangement, along with visual registers to enhance spatialtemporal consistency. As a result, the MM-DiM blocks in M4V reduce FLOPs by 45% compared with the attention-based alternative when generating videos at 768x1280 resolution. Additionally, several training strategies are explored in this work to provide a better understanding of training text-to-video models using only publicly available datasets. Extensive experiments on text-to-video benchmarks demonstrate M4V's ability to produce high-quality videos while significantly lowering computational costs. Project page: https://huangjch526.github.io/M4V_project/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出M4V，一种基于多模态Mamba的高效文本到视频生成框架。通过设计多模态扩散Mamba（MM-DiM）块，实现了多模态信息集成和时空建模。该框架在768x1280分辨率下相比基于注意力的方案减少了45%的FLOPs，并在公开数据集上进行了训练策略探索。
Motivation: 基于Transformer的文本到视频生成因二次复杂度计算成本高，而Mamba架构的直接应用受限于其朴素设计无法有效处理多模态和时空任务。
Method: 提出M4V框架，核心是MM-DiM块，采用多模态token重组设计，通过双向方案和视觉寄存器（visual registers）增强时空一致性。
Result: 在768x1280分辨率下，M4V的FLOPs比基于注意力的替代方案减少45%，在文本到视频基准上生成高质量视频。
Conclusion: 摘要表明M4V能够以更低计算成本生成高质量视频，并提供了仅使用公开数据集的训练策略。

papers.title: Multi-Metric Adaptive Experimental Design Under a Fixed Budget with Validation
papers.abstract_en: A/B tests in online experiments face statistical power challenges when testing multiple candidates simultaneously, while adaptive experimental designs (AED) alone fall short in inferring experiment statistics such as the average treatment effect, especially with many metrics (e.g., revenue, safety) and heterogeneous variances. This paper proposes a fixed-budget multi-metric AED framework with a two-phase structure: an adaptive exploration phase to identify the best treatment, and a validation phase with an A/B test to verify the treatment's quality and infer statistics. We propose SHRVar, which generalizes sequential halving (SH) with a novel relative-variance-based sampling and an elimination strategy built on reward z values. It achieves a provable error probability that decreases exponentially, where the exponent H3 generalizes the complexity measure for SH and SHVar with homogeneous and heterogeneous variances, respectively. Numerical experiments demonstrate its performance and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对固定预算下多度量（multi-metric）自适应实验设计（AED）问题，提出一个两阶段框架：自适应探索阶段寻找最优处理，验证阶段通过A/B测试推断统计量。提出的SHRVar方法推广了顺序淘汰算法（SH），使用基于相对方差的采样和基于奖励z值的淘汰策略，实现了指数级下降的误差概率，其中指数H3推广了SH和SHVar的复杂度度量。数值实验验证了其性能和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 在线实验（A/B测试）在同时测试多个候选方案时面临统计功效不足的问题，而单独的自适应实验设计（AED）难以推断平均处理效应等实验统计量，尤其在涉及多个度量（如收入、安全性）且方差异质时。
Method: 提出固定预算下的多度量AED两阶段框架：第一阶段是自适应探索阶段，使用SHRVar方法，该方法基于相对方差采样和奖励z值进行淘汰；第二阶段是A/B测试验证阶段，以验证最优处理的质量并推断统计量。SHRVar推广了顺序淘汰（SH）算法，处理同质和异质方差场景。
Result: SHRVar实现了指数级下降的误差概率，其中指数H3统一了SH（同质方差）和SHVar（异质方差）的复杂度度量。数值实验展示了其性能和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文提出的固定预算多度量AED框架能在有限的实验资源下有效识别最优处理并提供统计推断，理论保证和实验支持了方法的有效性。

papers.title: A Descriptive and Normative Theory of Human Beliefs in RLHF
papers.abstract_en: Human preferences in RLHF are typically modeled as a function of the human's reward function or corresponding optimal state-action values. In this work, we propose that human beliefs about the capabilities of the agent being trained also play a key role in preference generation. We examine two questions related to this hypothesis, one descriptive and one normative, respectively: Do human labelers' beliefs about agent capabilities affect the preferences that they provide? And what is the ideal set of beliefs about an agent -- and resulting preferences -- for humans to have? We propose a new preference model that incorporates human beliefs and provide a normative theory that bounds the error on the final learned policy based on the mismatch between the human's beliefs and an idealized set of beliefs. We then confirm via a human study that beliefs about agent capabilities do, in fact, significantly affect preferences and can be influenced through simple interventions. Additionally, we empirically show through synthetic experiments that it is often suboptimal for human preference labelers to assume agent optimality. Collectively, these results theoretically and empirically demonstrate how reducing the mismatch between human beliefs and agent capabilities can lead to more performant RLHF and point toward new best practices for RLHF practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了在RLHF中，人类标签者对于被训练agent能力的信念会影响其提供的偏好。作者建立了一个包含信念的偏好模型，并给出了规范化理论，界定了最终策略的误差与信念偏差。人类实验证实信念确实影响偏好，合成实验表明假设agent最优性通常是次优的。
Motivation: 现有RLHF将人类偏好建模为奖励函数或状态-动作值的函数，忽略了人类对agent能力的信念的影响。本文旨在检验这一假设并探讨理想信念。
Method: 提出包含信念的偏好模型，给出基于信念偏差的误差界理论；通过人类实验和合成实验验证。
Result: 人类实验表明信念显著影响偏好；合成实验表明假设agent最优性次优。
Conclusion: 本文从理论和实验上证明减少人类信念与agent能力之间的不匹配可以提升RLHF性能，指向新的实践指南。

summary_sections.result: 人类实验表明信念显著影响偏好；合成实验表明假设agent最优性次优。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文从理论和实验上证明减少人类信念与agent能力之间的不匹配可以提升RLHF性能，指向新的实践指南。

papers.title: Towards Identifiability of Interventional Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: We study identifiability of stochastic differential equations (SDE) under multiple interventions. Our results give the first provable bounds for unique recovery of SDE parameters given samples from their stationary distributions. We give tight bounds on the number of necessary interventions for linear SDEs, and upper bounds for nonlinear SDEs in the small noise regime. We experimentally validate the recovery of true parameters in synthetic data, and motivated by our theoretical results, demonstrate the advantage of parameterizations with learnable activation functions in application to gene regulatory dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多重干预下随机微分方程（SDE）的可辨识性，首次给出了从平稳分布唯一恢复SDE参数的理论界限。对于线性SDE，给出了所需干预次数的紧界；对于非线性SDE，在小噪声条件下给出了上界。合成数据实验验证了参数恢复，并将理论结果应用于基因调控动力学，展示了可学习激活函数参数化的优势。
Motivation: SDE参数估计在干预下的可辨识性缺乏理论保证，现有方法无法确定从观测数据中唯一恢复参数所需的条件。
Method: 利用多重干预下SDE平稳分布的数据，推导线性SDE可辨识性的紧界，并针对非线性SDE在小噪声框架下给出上界。
Result: 给出了线性SDE可辨识性的紧界和非线性SDE的上界；合成数据实验成功恢复真实参数，基因调控实验表明可学习激活函数参数化优于传统方法。
Conclusion: 为干预SDE的可辨识性提供了首个可证明的界，为实际应用（如基因调控网络推断）提供了理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Black-Box Obfuscation: Mechanistic Analysis and Defense of White-Box Monitors
papers.abstract_en: White-box monitoring is increasingly adopted as an auditing tool as Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed in daily operations to ensure safe model behavior. However, white-box monitors can be circumvented, and the mechanisms underlying such evasion have not been systematically characterized, nor have principled defenses been proposed. This work addresses both challenges. Controlled red-team experiments reveal two primary evasion strategies: geometric shifting, defined as the systematic migration of information between linear and non-linear representational subspaces, and covariance manipulation. These mechanisms account for the failure of single-detector approaches, as information migrates to subspaces inaccessible to individual detectors. This issue is urgent due to growing evidence that models are becoming evaluation-aware, enabling those with misaligned objectives to exploit these vulnerabilities and evade monitoring during deployment. In response, \textsc{SafetyNet} is introduced as a principled ensemble, with dual purpose: it provides further empirical validation that our mechanistic findings are real and actionable, and it offers a concrete starting point for future work on robust latent-space monitoring. The study experiment across five model families on the MAD and Anthropic Sleeper Agent benchmark, with SafetyNet achieving around 100\% AUROC scores outscoring Beatrix and CROW. The code is available at: https://github.com/MaheepChaudhary/eval-aware-evasion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究白盒监控的规避机制，发现几何移位（信息在线性和非线性表征子空间间迁移）和协方差操控两种主要策略。提出集成防御SafetyNet，在MAD和Anthropic Sleeper Agent基准上达到约100% AUROC，优于Beatrix和CROW。
Motivation: 白盒监控虽被广泛用于LLM安全审计，但其可被规避的机制尚未系统化，也缺乏有原则的防御方法。随着模型变得“评估感知”，拥有错误目标的模型可能利用这些漏洞。
Method: 通过受控红队实验识别几何移位和协方差操控两种规避策略，并基于此设计集成方法SafetyNet，由多个检测器组成，旨在捕获迁移到不同子空间的信息。
Result: 在五个模型家族、MAD和Anthropic Sleeper Agent基准上，SafetyNet达到约100% AUROC，超越Beatrix和CROW。
Conclusion: 本文系统揭示了白盒监控的规避机制，并提供SafetyNet作为一种有原则的集成防御，为鲁棒潜在空间监控的未来工作奠定基础。

papers.title: AffordanceSAM: Segment Anything Once More in Affordance Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Building a generalized affordance grounding model to identify actionable regions on objects is vital for real-world applications. Existing methods to train the model can be divided into weakly and fully supervised ways. However, the former method requires a complex training framework design and can not infer new actions without an auxiliary prior. While the latter often struggle with limited annotated data and components trained from scratch despite being simpler. This study focuses on fully supervised affordance grounding and overcomes its limitations by proposing AffordanceSAM, which extends SAM's generalization capacity in segmentation to affordance grounding. Specifically, we design an affordance-adaption module and curate a coarse-to-fine annotated dataset called C2F-Aff to thoroughly transfer SAM's robust performance to affordance in a three-stage training manner. Experimental results confirm that AffordanceSAM achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the AGD20K benchmark and exhibits strong generalized capacity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AffordanceSAM，通过扩展 SAM 的分割泛化能力到 affordance grounding。设计了 affordance-adaptation 模块和粗到细标注数据集 C2F-Aff，采用三阶段训练策略。在 AGD20K 基准上达到 SOTA 性能并展现强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有弱监督方法需要复杂训练框架且不能推断新动作；全监督方法受限于标注数据少和组件从零训练。
Method: 提出 AffordanceSAM，包含 affordance-adaptation 模块，构建 C2F-Aff 数据集，通过三阶段训练迁移 SAM 性能。
Result: 在 AGD20K 基准上达到 SOTA 性能，并展现强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 扩展 SAM 的泛化能力到 affordance grounding，克服了全监督方法的局限性。

papers.title: Multi-Attribute Steering of Language Models via Targeted Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time intervention (ITI) has emerged as a promising method for steering large language model (LLM) behavior in a particular direction (e.g., improving helpfulness) by intervening on token representations without costly updates to the LLM's parameters. However, existing ITI approaches fail to scale to multi-attribute settings with conflicts, such as enhancing helpfulness while also reducing toxicity. To address this, we introduce Multi-Attribute Targeted Steering (MAT-Steer), a novel steering framework designed for selective token-level intervention across multiple attributes. MAT-Steer learns steering vectors using an alignment objective that shifts the model's internal representations of undesirable outputs closer to those of desirable ones while enforcing sparsity and orthogonality among vectors for different attributes, thereby reducing inter-attribute conflicts. We evaluate MAT-Steer in two distinct settings: (i) on question answering (QA) tasks where we balance attributes like truthfulness, bias, and toxicity; (ii) on generative tasks where we simultaneously improve attributes like helpfulness, correctness, and coherence. MAT-Steer outperforms existing ITI and parameter-efficient fine-tuning approaches across both task types (e.g., 3% average accuracy gain across QA tasks and 55.82% win rate against the best ITI baseline).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAT-Steer框架，通过稀疏正交的导向向量实现多属性（如准确性、毒性、偏见）的语言模型推理时干预，在QA和生成任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有推理时干预方法难以扩展到多属性场景，属性间存在冲突（如同时提升帮助性和降低毒性）。
Method: 学习导向向量，通过对齐目标将不良输出的表示向良好输出靠近，并施加稀疏性与正交性约束以减少属性间冲突。
Result: 在QA任务上平均准确率提升3%，在生成任务上以55.82%胜率击败最佳ITI基线。
Conclusion: MAT-Steer有效支持多属性同时控制，无需参数更新。

papers.title: Looking Locally: Object-Centric Vision Transformers as Foundation Models for Efficient Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Current state-of-the-art segmentation models encode entire images before focusing on specific objects. This wastes computational resources. We introduce FLIP (Fovea-Like Input Patching), a parameter-efficient vision model that realizes object segmentation through biologically-inspired top-down attention. FLIP selectively samples multi-resolution patches centered on objects of interest from the input. As a result, it allocates high-resolution processing to object centers while maintaining coarser peripheral context. This off-grid, scale-invariant design enables FLIP to outperform META's Segment Anything models (SAM, SAM2 and fast variants) by large margins: With more than 440$\times$ fewer parameters, FLIP-Tiny (0.51M parameters) reaches a mean IoU of 79.90% while SAM2-L reaches 75.87% IoU (224.45M parameters). FLIP-Large even achieves 83.26% mean IoU (96.6M parameters), still running about $2\times$ faster than SAM2-L. We evaluate on six benchmarks in total. In five established benchmarks (Hypersim, KITTI-360, OpenImages, COCO, LVIS) FLIP consistently outperforms SAM and various variants of it. In our novel ObjaScale dataset, which stress-tests scale invariance with objects ranging from 0.0001% up to 25% of the image area, we show that FLIP segments even very small objects accurately, where existing models fail severely. FLIP opens new possibilities for real-time, object-centric vision and offers much higher energy efficiency. We believe that FLIP can act as a powerful foundation model, as it is very well-suited to track objects over time, for example, when being integrated into slot-based scene segmentation architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FLIP（Fovea-Like Input Patching），一种参数高效的视觉模型，通过仿生学自上而下注意力机制，从输入图像中按物体中心选择性地采样多分辨率补丁，实现高效、尺度不变的物体分割。FLIP-Tiny仅0.51M参数即在多个基准上超越SAM系列，mIoU达79.90%，而SAM2-L（224.45M参数）为75.87%。FLIP-Large（96.6M参数）达到83.26% mIoU，速度比SAM2-L快约2倍。
Motivation: 当前最优分割模型需先编码整个图像再聚焦物体，造成计算资源浪费。
Method: 提出FLIP，采用Fovea-Like Input Patching，从输入中按物体中心采样多分辨率补丁，实现离网格、尺度不变的设计。
Result: FLIP-Tiny（0.51M参数）mIoU 79.90%，优于SAM2-L（224.45M参数，75.87%）；FLIP-Large（96.6M参数）mIoU 83.26%，速度比SAM2-L快约2倍。在Hypersim、KITTI-360、OpenImages、COCO、LVIS及新提出的ObjaScale数据集上均表现优异。
Conclusion: FLIP为实时、物中心视觉提供了高效方案，适合作为基础模型集成到基于槽的场景分割架构中用于物体跟踪。

papers.title: VerteNet -- A Multi-Context Hybrid CNN Transformer for Accurate Vertebral Landmark Localization in Lateral Spine DXA Images
papers.abstract_en: Vertebral Landmarks Localization in Dual-Energy X-ray Absorptiometry based Lateral Spine Imaging plays a critical role in evaluating spinal alignment, Vertebral Fracture Assessment, and facilitating intervertebral guide placement for Abdominal Aortic Calcification quantification. While lateral spine DXA scans offer advantages such as reduced cost and lower radiation exposure, its analysis remains challenging due to a low signal-to-noise ratio and imaging artifacts. Artificial Intelligence presents a promising approach for improving the precision and accuracy of VLL. In this study, we introduce a novel architecture that employs dual-resolution attention mechanisms to capture both fine-grained local details and broader contextual information. Our approach enhances feature integration by leveraging skip connections and decoder layers through dual-resolution self-attention and cross-attention mechanisms. This design improves the ability of the model to learn complex patterns, enabling precise vertebral corner localization while maintaining both local and global contextual awareness. We evaluated the proposed framework on DXA LSI images acquired from multiple machines and found that it outperforms recent state-of-the-art architectures for VLL, achieving a normalized mean error of 4.92 and a normalized median error of 2.35. The proposed framework, VerteNet, enables highly accurate VLL in DXA LSI images from diverse acquisition systems and demonstrates strong robustness to low signal-to-noise ratios, owing to its enhanced ability to capture both fine-grained local details and broader contextual information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VerteNet，一种结合CNN与Transformer的混合架构，用于侧位脊柱DXA图像中的椎骨标志点定位。该方法利用双分辨率注意力机制同时捕获局部细节和全局上下文，并在多机器采集的DXA图像上实现了归一化平均误差4.92、中位误差2.35的性能，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 侧位脊柱DXA图像信噪比低且存在成像伪影，传统方法难以精确定位椎骨标志点；现有AI方法在鲁棒性和精度上仍有不足。
Method: 提出VerteNet，包含双分辨率自注意力和交叉注意力机制，通过跳跃连接和解码器层增强特征融合，同时保留局部和全局上下文信息。
Result: 在来自多台设备的DXA图像上，归一化平均误差4.92，归一化中位误差2.35，优于近期最先进架构。
Conclusion: VerteNet能够在不同采集系统下实现高精度椎骨标志点定位，对低信噪比图像具有强鲁棒性。

papers.title: On Motion Blur and Deblurring in Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) in mobile robotics enables robots to localize themselves by recognizing previously visited locations using visual data. While the reliability of VPR methods has been extensively studied under conditions such as changes in illumination, season, weather and viewpoint, the impact of motion blur is relatively unexplored despite its relevance not only in rapid motion scenarios but also in low-light conditions where longer exposure times are necessary. Similarly, the role of image deblurring in enhancing VPR performance under motion blur has received limited attention so far. This paper bridges these gaps by introducing a new benchmark designed to evaluate VPR performance under the influence of motion blur and image deblurring. The benchmark includes three datasets that encompass a wide range of motion blur intensities, providing a comprehensive platform for analysis. Experimental results with several well-established VPR and image deblurring methods provide new insights into the effects of motion blur and the potential improvements achieved through deblurring. Building on these findings, the paper proposes adaptive deblurring strategies for VPR, designed to effectively manage motion blur in dynamic, real-world scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Robotics & Automation Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究运动模糊对视觉地点识别（VPR）性能的影响，并评估图像去模糊技术的改善潜力。通过引入包含多强度运动模糊的新基准，实验分析了多种VPR和去模糊方法，并提出了自适应去模糊策略以应对动态场景中的运动模糊。
Motivation: 现有VPR研究主要关注光照、季节、天气等变化，但运动模糊的影响鲜有探讨，尤其在快速运动或低光长曝光场景下；同时，去模糊对VPR的帮助也缺乏系统评估。
Method: 构建包含三个数据集的新基准，覆盖不同运动模糊强度；实验对比多种VPR方法和去模糊技术；基于结果提出自适应去模糊策略。
Result: 实验揭示了运动模糊对VPR性能的显著影响，并表明去模糊可以带来性能提升，具体数值待查。
Conclusion: 运动模糊是VPR中不可忽视的因素，自适应去模糊策略能在动态场景中有效提升鲁棒性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究运动模糊对视觉地点识别（VPR）性能的影响，并评估图像去模糊技术的改善潜力。通过引入包含多强度运动模糊的新基准，实验分析了多种VPR和去模糊方法，并提出了自适应去模糊策略以应对动态场景中的运动模糊。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有VPR研究主要关注光照、季节、天气等变化，但运动模糊的影响鲜有探讨，尤其在快速运动或低光长曝光场景下；同时，去模糊对VPR的帮助也缺乏系统评估。
summary_sections.method: 构建包含三个数据集的新基准，覆盖不同运动模糊强度；实验对比多种VPR方法和去模糊技术；基于结果提出自适应去模糊策略。

summary_sections.conclusion: 运动模糊是VPR中不可忽视的因素，自适应去模糊策略能在动态场景中有效提升鲁棒性。

papers.title: Prototypical Few-Shot Medical Image Semantic Segmentation with Background Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot Semantic Segmentation (FSS) aims to adapt a pre-trained model to new classes with as few as a single labeled training sample per class. The existing prototypical work used in natural image scenarios biasedly focus on capturing foreground's discrimination while employing a simplistic representation for background, grounded on the inherent observation separation between foreground and background. However, a frequency spectrum entropy analysis suggests that this paradigm is not applicable to medical images where the foreground and background share numerous visual features, necessitating a more detailed description for the background. In this paper, we present a new Background-fused prototype (Bro) approach for FSS in medical images. Instead of identifying a commonality of background subjects in the support image, Bro fuses this background to discriminative prototypes, with two pivot designs. Specifically, Feature Similarity Calibration (FeaC) initially reduces noise in the support image by employing feature cross-attention with the query image. Subsequently, Hierarchical Channel-Adversarial Attention (HiCA) merges the background into comprehensive prototypes. We achieve this by a channel groups-based attention mechanism, where an adversarial Mean-Offset structure encourages a coarse-to-fine fusion. Designed as a generic plug-in, our Bro can be seamlessly integrated with existing FSS models. Extensive experiments validate the specificity of the background in medical images and the efficacy of Bro in enhancing the performance of previous FSS models on standard benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向医学图像的小样本语义分割方法 Background-fused prototype (Bro)，通过特征相似性校准和分层通道对抗注意力将背景信息融合到判别性原型中，提升分割性能。
Motivation: 现有原形方法在自然图像中侧重于前景判别而简单化背景，但医学图像中前景与背景共享大量视觉特征，需要更精细的背景描述。
Method: 提出 Bro 方法，包含两个关键设计：Feature Similarity Calibration (FeaC) 通过查询图像与支持图像的交叉注意力减少噪声；Hierarchical Channel-Adversarial Attention (HiCA) 基于通道分组注意力机制，利用对抗性 Mean-Offset 结构将背景逐步融合到原型中。该方法可作为通用即插即用模块。
Result: 在标准医学图像基准上，Bro 显著提升了现有小样本分割模型的性能，验证了医学图像背景特异性和 Bro 的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文强调了医学图像中小样本分割中背景建模的重要性，所提 Bro 方法通过背景融合有效改善了分割效果。

papers.title: Human Vision Constrained Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep-learning super-resolution (SR) techniques process images and videos independently of the underlying content and viewing conditions. However, the sensitivity of the human visual system (HVS) to image details changes depending on the underlying image characteristics, such as spatial frequency, luminance, color, contrast, or motion; as well viewing condition aspects such as ambient lighting and distance to the display. This observation suggests that computational resources spent on up-sampling images/videos may be wasted whenever a viewer cannot resolve the synthesized details i.e the resolution of details exceeds the resolving capability of human vision. Motivated by this observation, we propose a human vision inspired and architecture-agnostic approach for controlling SR techniques to deliver visually optimal results while limiting computational complexity. Its core is an explicit Human Visual Processing Framework (HVPF) that dynamically and locally guides SR methods according to human sensitivity to specific image details and viewing conditions. We demonstrate the application of our framework in combination with network branching to improve the computational efficiency of SR methods. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations, including user studies, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in reducing FLOPS by factors of 2$\times$ and greater, without sacrificing perceived quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受人类视觉系统启发的、与架构无关的超分辨率控制方法，通过显式的人类视觉处理框架动态指导SR方法，在保持感知质量的同时减少计算量。在实验中，该方法将FLOPs降低2倍以上，且用户研究证实感知质量无损。
Motivation: 现有深度学习超分方法未考虑图像内容和观看条件对视觉敏感度的影响，导致计算资源浪费于观众无法分辨的细节。
Method: 提出人类视觉处理框架，根据空间频率、亮度、对比度、运动以及环境光照、观看距离等因素，动态局部地引导超分网络分支，控制细节生成。
Result: 定量和定性评估（含用户研究）表明，该方法在保持感知质量的前提下，将FLOPs降低2倍以上。
Conclusion: 利用人类视觉系统的感知局限可以显著提升超分计算效率，且不牺牲视觉质量。

papers.title: Zero-shot 3D General Obstacle Detection via Multimodal Foundation Models and Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Detecting general obstacles is critical for autonomous driving, especially in long-tail scenarios with rare or unseen objects. Existing methods rely on supervision or predefined categories, limiting generalization. We propose a training-free approach that combines multimodal foundation models with geometric reasoning for 3D obstacle detection. Our key idea is to detect obstacles as deviations from the road surface, segmented in 2D and localized in 3D via temporal LiDAR aggregation. The pipeline operates in a zero-shot manner without task-specific training. Experiments show accurate localization up to 100 meters and 10-25% recall gains from foundation model priors, while enabling scalable autolabeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的零样本3D通用障碍物检测方法，结合多模态基础模型（如视觉语言模型）与几何推理。核心思路是将障碍物检测为路面表面的偏差，通过2D分割和时序LiDAR点云聚合实现3D定位。实验表明该方法可检测100米内的障碍物，且利用基础模型先验使召回率提升10-25%，同时支持可扩展的自动标注。
Motivation: 现有障碍物检测方法依赖监督或预定义类别，难以处理自动驾驶中的长尾稀有目标，泛化能力有限。
Method: 提出训练自由的两阶段流程：首先在2D图像上利用多模态基础模型分割出偏离路面的区域，然后通过时序LiDAR点云聚合将这些区域投影到3D空间，利用几何一致性定位障碍物。整体无需特定任务训练。
Result: 在真实自动驾驶数据上，论文报告该方法可实现100米内的准确3D定位，并且引入基础模型先验后召回率提升10-25%。
Conclusion: 零样本通用障碍物检测是可行的，且基础模型先验和几何推理的结合能有效提升检测性能，同时为自动标注提供可扩展方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Accelerating Large Language Model Inference with Self-Supervised Early Exits
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a modular approach to accelerate inference in large language models (LLMs) by adding early exit heads at intermediate transformer layers. Each head is trained in a self-supervised manner to mimic the main model's predictions, allowing computation to stop early when a calibrated confidence threshold is reached. We evaluate several confidence metrics and show that entropy provides the most reliable separation between correct and incorrect predictions. Experiments on the Pythia model suite (70M to 2.8B parameters) demonstrate that our method significantly reduces inference cost while maintaining accuracy across multiple benchmarks. We further adapt this approach to speculative decoding, introducing Dynamic Self-Speculative Decoding (DSSD), which achieves 1.66x higher token acceptance than manually-tuned LayerSkip baselines with minimal hyperparameter tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化方法，在大型语言模型（LLM）的中间Transformer层添加早期退出头，每个头通过自监督训练模仿主模型预测，当达到校准的置信度阈值时提前停止计算。在Pythia模型套件（70M至2.8B参数）上，该方法显著降低推理成本并保持准确性。进一步扩展到推测解码，提出动态自推测解码（DSSD），在无需大量超参数调优的情况下，比手动调优的LayerSkip基线实现1.66倍更高的token接受率。
Motivation: LLM推理成本高昂，早期退出方法可以减少计算量，但现有方法通常需要监督训练或任务特定调整。
Method: 在中间层添加早期退出头，每个头通过自监督学习模仿最终层的预测分布，使用熵作为置信度指标决定是否提前退出。
Result: 在Pythia模型套件上，该方法在降低推理成本的同时保持准确性；DSSD在推测解码中达到1.66倍更高的token接受率。
Conclusion: 自监督早期退出是一种有效的LLM推理加速方法，且可适配推测解码模式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LDPKiT: Superimposing Remote Queries for Privacy-Preserving Distillation
papers.abstract_en: To protect privacy in regulated domains such as healthcare and finance, model owners may allow only remote API access while keeping both the training data and model parameters private. However, model users performing inference on such remotely hosted models may be required to transmit potentially sensitive inputs, raising privacy concerns. In this work, we present LDPKiT, a framework for non-adversarial, privacy-preserving model distillation that leverages a user's private in-distribution data while bounding privacy leakage. LDPKiT introduces a novel superimposition technique that generates approximately in-distribution samples, enabling effective knowledge transfer under local differential privacy (LDP). Experiments on Fashion-MNIST, SVHN, and PathMNIST demonstrate that LDPKiT consistently improves utility while maintaining privacy, with benefits that become more pronounced at stronger noise levels. For example, on SVHN, LDPKiT achieves nearly the same inference accuracy at $ε=1.25$ as at $ε=2.0$, yielding stronger privacy guarantees with less than a 2\% accuracy reduction. We further conduct sensitivity analyses to examine the effect of dataset size on performance and provide a systematic analysis of latent space representations, offering intuitive and empirical insights into the accuracy gains of LDPKiT.
papers.comment: 18 pages, published at the 6th International Workshop on Advances on Security and Privacy Technologies and Solutions (IWAPS) co-located with the International Conference on Availability, Reliability and Security (ARES), Linköping, Sweden, August 24 - 27, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LDPKiT是一个非对抗性的隐私保护模型蒸馏框架，通过叠加远程查询生成近似分布内样本，在本地差分隐私约束下实现知识迁移。在Fashion-MNIST、SVHN和PathMNIST上的实验表明，LDPKiT在强噪声水平下能提升效用，例如在SVHN上ε=1.25时达到与ε=2.0几乎相同的推理精度，精度下降不到2%。
Motivation: 在医疗和金融等监管领域，模型所有者仅允许远程API访问以保护训练数据和模型参数，但用户传输敏感输入时存在隐私泄露风险。现有方法难以在非对抗场景下有效进行隐私保护的知识蒸馏。
Method: 提出叠加技术（superimposition technique），通过远程查询生成近似分布内样本，并结合本地差分隐私（LDP）实现隐私保护的模型蒸馏。
Result: 在SVHN上，LDPKiT在ε=1.25时达到与ε=2.0几乎相同的推理精度，精度降低不到2%；在Fashion-MNIST和PathMNIST上同样一致提升效用，且强噪声下优势更明显。
Conclusion: LDPKiT能有效在隐私保护下实现知识蒸馏，其叠加技术有助于提升效用，尤其在强隐私预算下。敏感性分析和潜在空间表示分析提供了对精度提升的直观和实证理解。

papers.title: Contrastive Learning on Multimodal Analysis of Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health record (EHR) systems capture a wealth of multimodal clinical data, encompassing both structured clinical codes and unstructured clinical notes. Yet, many EHR-focused studies have traditionally examined these modalities in isolation or combined them using simplistic methods, overlooking the intrinsic synergy between them. In reality, these modalities are deeply interconnected, each containing clinically relevant and complementary information that, when integrated effectively, can provide a more comprehensive understanding of patient health. Despite the success of multimodal contrastive learning in vision-language applications, its potential remains under-explored in multimodal EHR, particularly in terms of theoretical understanding. To support statistical analysis of multimodal EHR data, we propose a multimodal feature embedding generative model and design a multimodal contrastive loss to learn EHR feature representations. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates the effectiveness of multimodal learning over single-modality learning and connects the solution of the loss function to the singular value decomposition of a pointwise mutual information matrix. This connection leads to a privacy-preserving algorithm tailored for multimodal EHR representation learning. Simulation studies show that the proposed algorithm performs well under a variety of configurations. We further validate its clinical utility using real-world EHR data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电子健康记录（EHR）中结构化临床代码与非结构化临床笔记的多模态融合问题，提出一种多模态特征嵌入生成模型及对比学习损失函数。理论分析表明该多模态学习策略优于单模态方法，并揭示了损失函数解与点互信息矩阵奇异值分解之间的联系。模拟与真实EHR数据验证了所提算法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有EHR研究常孤立处理不同模态或采用简单拼接，忽略了模态间的互补信息，缺乏理论基础。
Method: 提出多模态特征嵌入生成模型，设计多模态对比损失（multimodal contrastive loss），并通过损失解与点互信息矩阵SVD的关联，导出隐私保持的表示学习算法。
Result: 模拟实验显示算法在多种配置下表现良好；真实EHR数据上的临床效用验证也支持其有效性。
Conclusion: 多模态对比学习可有效整合EHR的异构数据，且隐私保护版本适用于实际临床场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 多模态对比学习可有效整合EHR的异构数据，且隐私保护版本适用于实际临床场景。

papers.title: Hierarchical Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: Causal questions often arise in settings where data are hierarchical: subunits are nested within units. Consider students in schools, cells in patients, or cities in states. In these settings, unit-level variables (e.g., a school's budget) may affect subunit-level outcomes (e.g., student test scores), and subunit-level characteristics may aggregate to influence unit-level outcomes. In this paper, we show how to analyze hierarchical data for causal inference. We introduce hierarchical causal models, which extend structural causal models and graphical models by incorporating inner plates to represent nested data structures. We develop a graphical identification technique for these models that generalizes do-calculus. We show that hierarchical data can enable causal identification even when it would be impossible with non-hierarchical data--for example, when only unit-level summaries are available. We develop estimation strategies, including using hierarchical Bayesian models. We illustrate our results in simulation and through a reanalysis of the classic "eight schools" study.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层级因果模型（HCM），扩展结构因果模型和图模型以处理嵌套数据（如学生嵌套于学校、细胞嵌套于患者）。引入内板（inner plate）表示嵌套结构，发展推广do演算的图形识别技术，展示层级数据能实现非层级数据无法实现的因果识别（例如仅用单元级汇总）。结合层级贝叶斯模型进行估计，并通过模拟和“八所学校”经典研究再分析验证。
Motivation: 因果推断常面临层级数据（单元内嵌套子单元），但现有因果模型难以直接处理这种嵌套结构及跨层级效应（如单元变量影响子单元结局，子单元特征聚合影响单元结局）。
Method: 提出层级因果模型，在结构因果模型中引入内板表示嵌套；推广do演算得到层级数据的图形识别准则；结合层级贝叶斯模型进行估计。
Result: 模拟和“八所学校”研究再分析表明，层级数据结构能实现仅凭非层级数据无法完成的因果识别（如仅用单元级汇总数据时）。
Conclusion: 层级因果模型为嵌套数据的因果推断提供了理论框架和实用工具，特别适用于单元级干预或汇总数据场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProSGNeRF: Progressive Dynamic Neural Scene Graph with Frequency Modulated Foundation Model in Urban Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representation has demonstrated promising results in 3D reconstruction on various scenes. However, existing approaches either struggle to model fast-moving objects or are incapable of handling large-scale camera ego-motions in urban environments. This leads to low-quality synthesized views of the large-scale urban scenes. In this paper, we aim to jointly solve the problems caused by large-scale scenes and fast-moving vehicles, which are more practical and challenging. To this end, we propose a progressive scene graph network architecture to learn the local scene representations of dynamic objects and global urban scenes. The progressive learning architecture dynamically allocates a new local scene graph trained on frames within a temporal window, with the window size automatically determined, allowing us to scale up the representation to arbitrarily large scenes. Besides, according to our observations, the training views of dynamic objects are relatively sparse according to rapid movements, which leads to a significant decline in reconstruction accuracy for dynamic objects. Therefore, we utilize a foundation model network to encode the latent code. Specifically, we leverage the generalization capability of the visual foundation model DINOv2 to extract appearance and shape codes, and train the network on a large-scale urban scene object dataset to enhance its prior modeling ability for handling sparse-view dynamic inputs. In parallel, we introduce a frequency-modulated module that regularizes the frequency spectrum of objects, thereby addressing the challenge of modeling sparse image inputs from a frequency-domain perspective. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art view synthesis accuracy, object manipulation, and scene roaming ability in various scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProSGNeRF，一种渐进式动态神经场景图网络，联合解决大规模城市场景和快速移动物体带来的3D重建问题。该方法利用DINOv2基础模型提取外观和形状编码，并通过频率调制模块从频域角度处理稀疏视图输入，实现动态物体和全局场景的高质量重建。实验在多种场景下达到最先进的视图合成精度和场景漫游能力。
Motivation: 现有隐式神经表示方法难以同时处理大规模相机自运动和快速运动物体，导致城市场景重建质量低。
Method: 提出渐进式场景图网络架构，动态分配局部场景图并自动确定时间窗口大小；结合DINOv2基础模型编码潜在码，并在大规模城市场景物体数据集上预训练；引入频率调制模块正则化物体频谱，应对稀疏视图输入。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在多种场景下实现最先进的视图合成精度、物体操作和场景漫游能力。
Conclusion: 论文强调，通过渐进式场景图、基础模型和频率调制可以联合解决大规模动态城市场景的重建挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ruby: Unmasking Unsafe Rust in Stripped Binaries via Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Rust, as an emerging system programming language, introduces $\texttt{unsafe}$ to allow developers to bypass safety checks during compilation. As a result, memory safety bugs are typically confined to the $\texttt{unsafe}$ regions, which have been the primary focus of Rust bug-finding tools. However, such tools rely on the presence of the $\texttt{unsafe}$ keyword in Rust source code; there are no tools available that can examine Rust binaries to pinpoint $\texttt{unsafe}$ areas. Therefore, we propose $\texttt{Ruby}$, the first tool that unmasks $\texttt{unsafe}$ regions in Rust binaries using machine learning. By capturing the subtle differences in the binary instructions, $\texttt{Ruby}$ can identify 91.75% of the total $\texttt{unsafe}$ regions with a false positive rate of 6.16%, beating SOTA LLM models including GPT-5.2, Claude-4.5 and Gemini-3. We further applied $\texttt{Ruby}$ to guide symbolic execution and fuzzing, showing a speed-up of 57.95% and 21.26%, with five bugs confirmed and patched by Google in Android library fuzzing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ruby，首个通过机器学习在 Rust 二进制中识别 unsafe 区域的工具。Ruby 捕获二进制指令的细微差异，以 91.75% 的召回率和 6.16% 的假阳性率识别 unsafe 区域，性能超过 GPT-5.2、Claude-4.5 和 Gemini-3 等大型语言模型。将其应用于符号执行和模糊测试，分别加速 57.95% 和 21.26%，并在 Android 库模糊测试中发现并修复了 5 个 bug。
Motivation: 现有 Rust 漏洞检测工具依赖源代码中的 unsafe 关键字，无法直接分析二进制文件。缺乏能够定位 Rust 二进制中 unsafe 区域的方法，限制了漏洞发现能力。
Method: Ruby 使用机器学习模型，通过分析 Rust 编译后二进制指令的差异特征来识别 unsafe 区域。不需要源代码或符号信息。
Result: Ruby 在测试中识别出 91.75% 的 unsafe 区域，假阳性率 6.16%，优于 GPT-5.2、Claude-4.5 和 Gemini-3。引导模糊测试和符号执行分别提升效率 57.95% 和 21.26%，并发现 5 个已被 Google 确认并修复的 bug。
Conclusion: Ruby 是首个在无需源代码的情况下通过机器学习检测 Rust 二进制中 unsafe 区域的工具，展示了在现实场景中辅助漏洞挖掘的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Fourier analytique approach to Gaussian mixture learning
papers.abstract_en: Suppose that we are given independent, identically distributed random samples $x_1,\cdots,x_n$ from a mixture at most $k$ many $d$-dimensional spherical Gaussian distributions $μ_1,\cdots,μ_{k_0}$ of identical and known variance $σ^2$ in each coordinate, such that the minimum $\ell^2$ distance between two distinct centers $y_l$ and $y_j$ is greater than $2Δσ\min\{\sqrt{d},\sqrt k\}$, where $Δ>C_0$, and $C_0$ is a sufficiently large universal constant. We develop a randomized algorithm that learns the centers $y_l$'s of the Gaussian components to within an $\ell^2$ distance of $k^{-\tilde C_0}$ -- in presence of arbitrarily large number of components and in arbitrary dimension, when the weights are known to be uniform. Furthermore, if the number of components is $k= Ω(2^d)$, then for arbitrary universal constant $c>0$, even for unknown weights, the algorithm learns the centers to within an $\ell^2$ distance of $d^{-\tilde C_0}$ and the weights up to an accuracy of $cw_{min}$, with probability greater than $1 - \exp(-k/c)$, provided that the weights lie in $[c/k,1/ck]$, and the minimum separation is just $2c\sqrt d$. The number of samples and the computational time is bounded above by $\mathrm{poly}(k, d)$ in either case. Such a bound on the sample and computational complexity was previously unknown in the regime of non-constant dimension, and in particular, when $d$ is not $O(1)$. When $d = O(1)$, this complexity bound follows from work of Regev and Vijayaraghavan, where it has also been shown that the sample complexity of learning a random mixture of Gaussians in a ball of radius $o(\sqrt{d})$ in $d$ dimensions, when $d$ is $Θ( \log k)$, is at least super-polynomial in $k, d$, showing that our result is tight in this case.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于傅里叶分析的随机算法，用于学习已知方差、最小中心间距大于一定阈值的球形高斯混合模型的中心。在权重均匀且分量数任意、维度任意的情况下，算法能以多项式样本和计算复杂度将中心学习到高精度；当分量数指数于维度时，对未知权重也能有效学习。
Motivation: 在高维非恒定维度下，高斯混合模型学习的样本和计算复杂度此前未知，现有方法多局限于低维或常数维度。
Method: 利用傅里叶分析技术，设计随机算法，通过采样和多项式时间计算，在高维、多分量条件下恢复混合成分的中心和权重。
Result: 在权重均匀、最小分离距离足够大时，学习中心误差可达亚多项式级；当分量数指数于维度时，即使权重未知，也能以高概率恢复中心（误差 d^{-\tilde C_0}）和权重（精度 c w_min）。样本和计算复杂度均为 poly(k, d)。
Conclusion: 论文证明了在非恒定维度下高斯混合学习的高效性，并指出在 d=O(log k) 时结果紧致，与 Regev 和 Vijayaraghavan 的下界匹配。

papers.title: Model Agnostic Graph Prompt Learning for Crystal Property Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks have emerged as a powerful tool for the fast and accurate prediction of various crystal properties. These models often encode domain-specific knowledge into their graph encoding modules, which increases their parameter size and makes their performance heavily dependent on domain expertise. Added to this, explicitly incorporating all chemical and structural features, that might influence a specific crystal property into the GNN encoder, is a challenging task. In this work, we propose a soft prompt learning framework that captures latent features essential for property prediction, which are not explicitly provided to the GNN. We introduce a novel multilevel graph prompt learning framework comprising both node-level and graph-level soft prompts. At the node level, we capture the local chemical semantics of different atom types, while at the graph level, we encode the global structural symmetry of the crystal graph. Our proposed prompt learning framework is lightweight and seamlessly integrates with any existing GNN encoder. Extensive experiments on popular benchmark datasets show that incorporating prompt learning significantly improves (3\% - 15\%) the performance of state-of-the-art GNN models in crystal property prediction tasks. Furthermore, the learned soft prompts enable cross-property knowledge transfer, enhancing prediction performance for properties with limited training data. Code is available at https://github.com/shrimonmuke0202/Prompt.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种模型无关的图提示学习框架，用于晶体性质预测。该框架通过节点级和图级的软提示（soft prompt）捕获局部化学语义和全局结构对称性，无需修改现有GNN编码器。在多个基准数据集上，该方法将现有最先进GNN模型的预测性能提升了3%-15%，并支持跨性质知识迁移，对数据稀缺的性质尤其有效。
Motivation: 现有GNN晶体性质预测模型依赖领域知识手动编码特征，参数规模大且难以涵盖所有影响性质的因素。
Method: 提出多级软提示学习：节点级提示捕捉不同原子类型的局部化学语义，图级提示编码晶体图的全局结构对称性；提示轻量且可即插即用到任意GNN编码器。
Result: 在流行基准数据集上，将SOTA GNN性能提升3%-15%；软提示支持跨性质迁移，提升小样本性质预测。
Conclusion: 提示学习能有效补充GNN未显式编码的潜在特征，是一种轻量且通用的增强手段。

papers.title: Sensitivity-Aware Thresholding and Token Routing for Activation Sparsification in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Efficient inference in Large Language Models (LLMs) requires deciding where computation can be reduced while preserving model quality. We study this problem through multilayer perceptron (MLP) activation sparsification and token-level conditional routing. We first propose Sensitivity-Aware Thresholding for Sparsity (SATS), a threshold calibration method to choose layerwise gate thresholds using a local MLP output sensitivity proxy rather than calibrating thresholds directly from activation percentiles. While SATS retains the existing mechanism of sparsifying MLP activations by thresholding gate activations, it replaces percentile-based calibration with a sensitivity-aware selection rule. We then introduce a lightweight token routing framework that dynamically selects between a base path and a modified path on a per-token basis, rather than applying the modified computation uniformly to all tokens. We evaluate both methods on multiple recent open-weight LLMs. Our results show that SATS improves over the threshold-based sparsification baseline at matched actual sparsity and that token routing yields a more favorable quality-throughput trade-off than static activation modification baselines. Overall, our results suggest that improved threshold calibration and token routing can improve the quality-throughput trade-off in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型推理中的效率问题，提出两种方法：Sensitivity-Aware Thresholding for Sparsity (SATS) 和轻量级 token 路由框架。SATS 通过局部 MLP 输出敏感性代理替代百分位数来校准每层门控阈值，实现激活稀疏化；token 路由则在每个 token 基础上动态选择基础路径或修改路径。在多个开源 LLM 上的实验表明，SATS 在相同实际稀疏度下优于基线阈值方法，token 路由在质量-吞吐量权衡上优于静态修改方法。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型推理中，通过阈值稀疏化 MLP 激活的方法通常基于激活百分位数校准阈值，可能不是最优；此外，静态修改所有 token 的计算会导致效率损失。
Method: 提出 SATS，利用局部 MLP 输出对门控激活的敏感性作为代理，自适应选择每层阈值；同时提出 token 路由框架，每个 token 由轻量级路由器选择是否走修改路径，而非统一处理。

Conclusion: 改进的阈值校准和 token 路由能有效提升大语言模型推理中的质量-吞吐量权衡。

papers.title: Group Invariant Spectral Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Spectral embedding methods are widely used for dimensionality reduction and clustering of high-dimensional datasets with intrinsic low-dimensional structures. Although many datasets of practical interest exhibit invariance under symmetries such as rotations, standard spectral embedding methods do not account for this, treating symmetry-related data points as unrelated. Our approach to this problem is to incorporate the symmetries directly into the affinity kernels used for spectral embedding. We analyze the case of a Riemannian data manifold $M$ with symmetries given by a compact Lie group~$G$ and prove that, under suitable conditions, graph Laplacians constructed from three types of invariant kernels converge pointwise to explicit second-order differential operators on the quotient space $M/G$. Our analysis implies improved convergence rates, as the effective dimension drops according to the dimension of the group. We validate our approach on datasets with $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ or $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ symmetry, and show that $G$-invariant spectral embedding recovers the intrinsic geometry of the data, in contrast to standard spectral embedding, which fails to do so even in the limit of infinite data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在谱嵌入中将数据对称性（如旋转）直接融入亲和核中。作者证明在紧致黎曼流形和紧致李群作用下，三种类型的不变核构造的图拉普拉斯算子逐点收敛到商空间上的显式二阶微分算子，有效维度随群维数下降而降低。在SO(2)和SO(3)对称数据集上的实验表明，群不变谱嵌入能恢复内在几何结构，而标准谱嵌入即使在无限数据极限下也无法做到。
Motivation: 标准谱嵌入方法忽略数据中的对称性，将对称相关的点视为无关，导致无法正确恢复具有旋转等对称性的高维数据的内在几何结构。
Method: 通过构造三类群不变亲和核（群不变核），将对称性直接嵌入谱嵌入的图拉普拉斯构造中，并在紧致李群作用下分析其逐点收敛性到商空间上的二阶微分算子。
Result: 理论证明收敛速度提升，有效维度随群维数下降；在SO(2)和SO(3)对称数据集上，群不变谱嵌入成功恢复数据内在几何，而标准谱嵌入即使无限数据也失败。
Conclusion: 群不变谱嵌入能有效利用对称性提升降维与聚类性能，尤其适用于具有旋转对称性的实际数据集。

papers.title: A Formalization of the Mean-Field Derivation of the Vlasov Equation: AI-Assisted Lean Formalization as a Strategy Game
papers.abstract_en: We formalize a research result in the Lean 4 proof assistant by having a mathematician direct an AI system, and frame the activity as a formalization game. The objective is to turn a LaTeX document into Lean. The game is won when the development compiles, contains no sorry, and a machine check shows the target theorems rest on Lean's foundational axioms alone. Reuse is a second check, by a definition we introduce: whether the development yields a self-contained layer of general mathematics the wider library could absorb. The case study is a complete, axiom-clean formalization of well-posedness for the nonlinear Vlasov equation via Dobrushin's mean-field route -- existence, uniqueness, the stability estimate and mean-field limit, and a short-window superposition principle (weak solutions are Lagrangian). The human's role was to direct, not to write proofs: to scope the definitions, steer the decompositions, and triage the library's gaps; the AI agent executed. The formalization certifies the proof of each statement as written; whether the written statement is the intended theorem stays the mathematician's judgment. The optimal-transport machinery that fell out of the build (in particular, properties of the Wasserstein-1 metric and the Kantorovich-Rubinstein duality theorem) separates into a self-contained layer that compiles against Mathlib alone: about a sixth of the development (49 of 299 declarations), behind a 22-declaration interface with no reverse dependency. The headline theorems ran in about a week, the full development in about a month. We report the quantitative claims as observations of one game, not as general laws. The game's rules name no particular system, so the methodological framing is meant to outlast the tools of any one run.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 4 figures. Lean 4 development, blueprint site, and agent logs: https://github.com/Hydrodynamical/Vlasov_Meanfield_Formalization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以Lean 4证明助手形式化Vlasov方程的mean-field推导（包括适定性、稳定性估计和平均场极限），并引入“形式化游戏”框架：由数学家指导AI系统将LaTeX文档转换为Lean代码，要求编译通过、无sorry且仅依赖基础公理。案例完整形式化了Dobrushin路径下的非线性Vlasov方程结果。
Motivation: 形式化数学证明耗时且对专家依赖高，本文探索如何通过数学家指导AI系统加速形式化过程，并将此过程框架化为一种策略游戏。
Method: 提出形式化游戏：数学家负责定义范围、分解步骤、修补库缺口，AI系统（此处为某个未指名的agent）执行代码编写。通过一个完整案例（Vlasov方程形式化）验证框架可行性。
Result: 完整形式化了Vlasov方程的适定性、稳定性估计和平均场极限，约一个月完成全部开发，关键定理约一周。其中约1/6的声明（49/299）可独立编译为Mathlib层。
Conclusion: 方法框架独立于具体系统，旨在超越单次运行的工具局限。

papers.title: AlphaZero in Sparsely Rewarded Games: Limits and Auxiliary Supervision
papers.abstract_en: AlphaZero has demonstrated that a neural-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search can achieve superhuman performance, but strong play does not necessarily imply perfect play. We study this gap in two oracle-evaluable domains with contrasting structure: Connect Four, a solved partisan game with exact game-theoretic values, and Chomp, an impartial game whose optimal play is governed by Grundy-number structure. Under a unified self-play $+$ MCTS pipeline, we compare vanilla AlphaZero, a multi-frame variant (limited to Chomp), and an AlphaZero Auxiliary Loss (AZAL) that adds oracle-derived policy supervision. We find that vanilla AlphaZero achieves strong play across both domains but cannot preserve the exact trajectories required for optimal play: in Connect Four, it fails to maintain the optimal line of play, while in Chomp, it fails to consistently restore the $g=0$ invariant. On rectangular Chomp boards, multi-frame inputs alone do not remove this gap. Nevertheless, AZAL substantially improves oracle consistency across multi-seeded full-game traces and sampled-state evaluations. On Chomp, AZAL reaches perfect full-game oracle consistency on 10x11 and high but not complete consistency on 9x10; on Connect Four, AZAL improves oracle-match rate and delays the first oracle mistake, but does not reach perfect play.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AlphaZero 在两类稀疏奖励游戏（Connect Four 和 Chomp）中的极限与辅助监督。结果表明，原版 AlphaZero 虽能强对弈但无法维持最优轨迹，而引入 oracle 策略损失的 AZAL 变体显著提升了 oracle 一致性，但在 Chomp 的 9x10 棋盘上仍未达到完美。
Motivation: AlphaZero 的强对弈能力并不等价于完美对弈，论文希望探究在具有已知最优解的游戏中，MCTS+自对弈方法的精确性缺口。
Method: 在统一的 MCTS+自对弈框架下比较三种变体：原版 AlphaZero、仅用于 Chomp 的多帧变体，以及添加 oracle 策略损失（AZAL）的辅助监督方法。
Result: 原版 AlphaZero 在 Connect Four 中无法保持最优线路，在 Chomp 中无法恢复 g=0 不变量；AZAL 显著提升 oracle 一致性，在 Chomp 10x11 上达到完美，在 Connect Four 上改善但未达完美。
Conclusion: 额外的 oracle 策略损失能有效缩小 AlphaZero 与最优策略的差距，但完全消除 gap 仍具挑战。

papers.title: SCATE: Learning to Supervise Coding Agents for Cost-Effective Test Generation
papers.abstract_en: While autonomous coding agents have significantly advanced automated test generation, they remain fundamentally limited by lazy generation, a phenomenon where agents prematurely terminate tasks and systematically avoid complex programmatic logic, resulting in inadequate code coverage. Currently, mitigating this premature termination requires continuous human-in-the-loop supervision. This heavy reliance on human intuition creates a bottleneck that negates the efficiency gains of automated generation. We propose SCATE, a framework for adaptive, automated supervision of coding agents that replaces human intervention during test generation. By formulating supervision as a contextual bandit problem, SCATE learns to select the most promising testing actions based on the current coverage and class testability metrics, maximizing coverage gains while minimizing wasted generation effort. Our empirical evaluation demonstrates that SCATE integrates seamlessly with different coding agents. When applied to GEMINI-CLI, it achieves 32.3% higher line coverage and 30.9% higher branch coverage than the agent-only baseline. A comparison with CLAUDE CODE confirms the framework dynamically adapts its policy to optimize each agent's unique strengths. SCATE also consistently outperforms state-of-the-art non-agentic approaches across all metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCATE框架，通过上下文赌博机（contextual bandit）学习方法自适应监督编码智能体（coding agents）进行自动化测试生成，替代人工干预。实验表明，集成SCATE后，GEMINI-CLI的代码行覆盖率提升32.3%，分支覆盖率提升30.9%，且优于CLAUDE CODE等基线方法。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体在自动化测试生成中存在提前终止任务（lazy generation）的问题，导致代码覆盖率不足，且缓解该问题需要持续的人工监督，形成效率瓶颈。
Method: 将监督过程形式化为上下文赌博机问题，根据当前覆盖率和类可测试性指标选择最有前景的测试动作，最大化覆盖率增益并最小化生成开销。
Result: 在GEMINI-CLI上，行覆盖率提升32.3%，分支覆盖率提升30.9%；与CLAUDE CODE对比，SCATE能动态调整策略以适应不同智能体；在非智能体方法上全面领先。
Conclusion: SCATE可无缝集成不同编码智能体，通过自适应监督有效提升测试生成效率，减少人工干预。

papers.title: The Patchwork Problem in LLM-Generated Code
papers.abstract_en: LLM-generated code often compiles, passes tests, and appears correct, yet breaks once deployed. The root cause is frequently structural rather than logical. A generated endpoint references configuration keys never declared in the project, an import targets a package that does not exist in any registry, or a new route omits the authentication guard applied to every sibling endpoint. Each patch is locally valid but globally incoherent, and standard CI toolchains rarely surface these failures. As LLM-powered coding tools see widespread adoption, this blind spot poses a growing risk to software quality. We call this the \textbf{patchwork problem}. This paper formalizes structural coherence as consistency invariants over graph representations of repository artifacts, including import, call, dependency, configuration, schema, resource, control-flow, and routing graphs, and introduces an eight-category failure taxonomy distinguishing defects specific to LLM generation from those merely amplified by it. We present a hybrid verification framework that delegates to mature static analysis tools where they already excel and deploys purpose-built detectors for cross-cutting invariants underserved by existing toolchains, targeting provable constraint violations rather than heuristic pattern matching. Empirical evaluation across two frontier models under four prompting strategies reveals that the vast majority of structural failures evade type checking, testing, and SAST entirely, and that failure patterns diverge qualitatively between models in ways that challenge model-agnostic mitigation strategies. External validation on real-world AI-generated repositories confirms that these failures are not artifacts of controlled experimentation but are prevalent wherever LLMs write code with minimal human oversight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出LLM生成的代码在编译、测试通过后部署时仍会失败，根源在于结构性全局不连贯，称为“拼凑问题”（patchwork problem）。作者形式化了结构一致性为仓库工件图表示上的一致性不变量，提出了八类故障分类法，并构建了混合验证框架。实验表明大多数结构性故障逃逸了类型检查、测试和SAST，且模型间故障模式存在定性差异。
Motivation: 现有LLM代码工具生成的代码表面正确但部署后失败，标准CI工具链难以发现结构性故障，构成软件质量风险。
Method: 形式化结构一致性为一致性不变量，基于导入、调用、依赖、配置、模式、资源、控制流和路由图；提出八类故障分类法；构建混合验证框架，结合现有静态分析工具和针对跨领域不变量的专用检测器。
Result: 在两个前沿模型和四种提示策略上的实验表明，大多数结构性故障完全逃逸类型检查、测试和SAST；模型间故障模式存在定性差异；实际AI生成仓库验证了这些故障的普遍性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这一盲点对LLM代码工具的广泛采用构成风险，并提出了针对性的验证框架。

papers.title: Optimal Top-$k$ Identification from Pairwise Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: We study the active learning problem of fixed-confidence top-$k$ identification from noisy pairwise comparisons. In this problem, an algorithm sequentially chooses pairs of items to compare, observes the outcomes, and stops when it can return the set of top-$k$ items with error probability at most $δ$. The objective is to design such a $δ$-correct procedure that minimizes the expected number of comparisons (the sample complexity). This problem falls within the broader literature on fixed-confidence pure exploration in bandit models, where a common target is asymptotic optimality: the algorithm's expected sample complexity matches the information theoretic lower bound as $δ\to 0$. Asymptotically optimal procedures have been developed for a range of fixed-confidence pure-exploration problems, however to the best of our knowledge, for top-$1$, or more generally top-$k$ identification from pairwise comparisons under latent utility models an asymptotically optimal algorithm has not been established. In this setting, we develop such an algorithm. We characterize the structure of the lower bound and formulate it as a saddle-point problem. This structure enables a computationally efficient primal-dual procedure that learns the asymptotically optimal comparison allocation online. We then construct an adaptive comparison-allocation algorithm that tracks the allocation learned by the primal-dual procedure and prove it is asymptotically optimal.

papers.title: Federated Low-Rank Koopman Learning for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection in IoT Systems
papers.abstract_en: Distributed IoT systems generate multivariate time-series streams for monitoring physical assets, servers, and embedded sensing platforms. Detecting abnormal temporal behavior is critical for fault diagnosis, predictive maintenance, and security. However, practical IoT anomaly detection is hindered by decentralized and non-IID data, limited bandwidth, and the constrained computation and memory of edge devices. This paper proposes FedKAD, a resource-efficient federated Koopman anomaly detection framework for distributed IoT multivariate time series. Unlike deep-learning-based anomaly detectors that require training and communicating large neural models, FedKAD learns normal temporal dynamics through lightweight sliding-window Koopman representations. Federated training is formulated as a low-rank consensus problem, where raw sensor streams and local reduced dynamics remain on device while only compact subspace variables are exchanged with the server. To optimize the shared representation under orthonormality constraints, we develop a federated Stiefel-ADMM algorithm and provide convergence and stationarity analysis under partial client participation. During inference, each client detects anomalies locally by measuring the prediction residual between observed future trajectories and the learned Koopman dynamics. Experiments on four widely used multivariate time-series anomaly detection benchmarks show that FedKAD maintains or improves detection performance compared with federated deep-learning baselines. More importantly for IoT deployment, FedKAD provides up to $2.1\times10^3$ faster training, $80\times$ lower communication, and $79\times$ lower inference latency than neural baselines, confirming its suitability for resource-constrained edge devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedKAD，一种资源高效的联邦 Koopman 异常检测框架，用于分布式 IoT 系统的多变量时间序列异常检测。通过轻量级滑动窗口 Koopman 表示学习正常动态，将联邦训练建模为低秩共识问题，并开发联邦 Stiefel-ADMM 算法。实验表明，FedKAD 在多个基准上保持或提升检测性能，同时训练速度提升高达 2100 倍，通信量降低 80 倍，推理延迟降低 79 倍。
Motivation: 分布式 IoT 系统面临数据分散、非独立同分布、带宽有限以及边缘设备计算和内存受限的挑战，现有基于深度学习的异常检测器需要训练和通信大型神经网络，不适合资源受限场景。
Method: 提出 FedKAD 框架，利用轻量级滑动窗口 Koopman 表示学习正常时间动态，将联邦训练表述为低秩共识问题，仅交换紧凑子空间变量。开发联邦 Stiefel-ADMM 算法并在部分客户端参与下提供收敛性和平稳性分析。推理时通过预测残差进行本地异常检测。
Result: 在四个多变量时间序列异常检测基准上，FedKAD 保持或优于联邦深度学习基线，并提供高达 2100 倍的训练加速、80 倍的通信降低和 79 倍的推理延迟降低。
Conclusion: FedKAD 有效解决了资源受限 IoT 设备上的分布式异常检测问题，具有显著的计算和通信效率，适合边缘部署。

papers.title: CLAP: Direct VLM-to-VLA Adaptation via Language-Action Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic capabilities from pretrained VLMs, yet large-scale post-training on robot data and architectural modifications can reshape the backbone so extensively that it becomes difficult to isolate what the VLM contributes to control. Directly converting pretrained VLMs into VLAs with minimal architectural change offers a more transparent path to understanding how VLM capabilities transfer across model scales. The core obstacle is output-distribution mismatch: predicting actions as bare numeric token sequences moves generation away from the VLM's pretrained language distribution, degrading the capabilities we seek to preserve. To address this, we propose CLAP (Causal Language-Action Prediction), which prepends each numeric action sequence with a natural-language action description, causally conditioning precise action-token prediction on a language-action plan without modifying the backbone architecture. With single-epoch fine-tuning alone, 2B CLAP achieves 90.8% on LIBERO (+14.9 pt over VLA-0) and improves robustness on LIBERO-PRO under language, object, and spatial perturbations. We will release CLAP at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B as an open-weight, multi-scale compact VLA family from a single VLM lineage, enabling controlled analysis of VLM-to-VLA capability transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CLAP（Causal Language-Action Prediction）方法，通过在数值动作序列前添加自然语言动作描述，以因果方式条件化动作预测，从而将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）直接转化为视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），无需修改骨干架构。仅需单周期微调，2B参数模型在LIBERO基准上达到90.8%准确率，较VLA-0提升14.9个百分点，并在LIBERO-PRO上展现出更强的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 直接转换预训练VLM为VLA时存在输出分布不匹配问题：预测裸数值动作序列会偏离VLM预训练的语言分布，损害其语义能力迁移。需要一种最小化架构变化的方法，以透明地研究VLM能力如何跨模型规模迁移。
Method: CLAP在每个数值动作序列前添加自然语言动作描述，形成语言-动作计划，并因果地（causally）条件化后续动作令牌的预测，同时保持骨干架构不变。仅在机器人数据上进行单周期微调。
Result: 2B CLAP在LIBERO任务上达到90.8%（+14.9% over VLA-0），在LIBERO-PRO上对语言、物体和空间扰动表现出更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: CLAP提供了一种无需大幅修改架构即可将VLM转化为VLA的透明路径，并计划发布0.8B、2B、4B多个尺度的开放权重模型，以支持VLM到VLA能力迁移的受控分析。

papers.title: Stochastic Linear Bandits with Partially Observed Actions
papers.abstract_en: The stochastic linear bandit, where actions are represented as vectors and rewards are linear, is a central paradigm for sequential decision making. We study a partially observed variant of this problem in which the learning agent only sees a random subset of coordinates for each action. Such partial observability arises naturally in settings like recommendation and healthcare, where full action descriptions can be expensive or even impossible to obtain. In general, this makes sublinear regret information-theoretically impossible. However, we show that this barrier can be overcome when the action vectors have low intrinsic dimension. We propose an algorithm, TOFU-POV, that estimates the latent action subspace using the masked actions, imputes current actions using an epoch-wise frozen representation, and runs OFUL in the resulting low-dimensional coordinates. Our theory shows that TOFU-POV enjoys a $\sqrt{T}$ regret that scales with the intrinsic action subspace dimension as opposed to the ambient dimension and quantifies the interaction between these quantities and the missingness, decision set size, and subspace conditioning. We also devise a rank-adaptive algorithm that does not require the knowledge of the intrinsic dimension. We complement these guarantees with a lower bound based on a novel product construction that separates usual reward-learning uncertainty from a missingness-dependent cost intrinsic to partial observation. Synthetic and real data experiments support our theory and show that TOFU-POV can substantially improve upon natural baselines in this challenging problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究部分观测动作的随机线性赌博机问题，提出TOFU-POV算法，在动作向量具有低内在维度时实现次线性遗憾，并通过理论和实验验证。
Motivation: 实际场景中（如推荐系统和医疗）动作的完整描述难以获取，导致部分观测下的线性赌博机问题在一般情形下无法实现亚线性遗憾。
Method: 利用掩蔽动作估计潜在动作子空间，使用逐时期冻结表示进行当前动作插补，并在低维坐标上运行OFUL算法，同时提出无需内在维度的自适应秩算法。
Result: TOFU-POV的遗憾界为√T，依赖动作子空间内在维度而非环境维度，并量化了缺失性、决策集大小和子空间条件的影响；下界表明存在由缺失性引起的额外代价。
Conclusion: 部分观测动作下的线性赌博机问题可通过低维动作子空间克服信息论障碍，TOFU-POV在合成和真实数据上优于基线。

papers.title: MultiView-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for World-Centric Multi-View Integration in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent benchmarks for VLMs largely assess single- or limited-view perception, leaving untested the core cognitive ability to integrate observations across viewpoints into a coherent, world-centric (allocentric) 3D mental model. We introduce MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark expressly designed to evaluate multi-view integration for holistic 3D scene comprehension. Unlike existing datasets that focus on pixel-level mapping or camera-relative navigation, MultiView-Bench requires models to decouple object positioning from transient perspectives and ground them in a fixed global coordinate system. This capability serves as a prerequisite for VLMs before being deployed for downstream tasks such as mechanical part assembly. Our systematic evaluation of frontier VLMs reveals consistent failure modes: strong performance on 2D planar relations from a single image, but marked difficulty with 3D spatial relations and with aggregating information across views. We further identify biases in VLMs, such as struggles with unconventional axis directions and sensitivity to object colorways and texture variations. Acknowledging these limitations, we propose ViewNavigator, a multi-agent framework that actively selects informative viewpoints, perceives, and fuses multi-view evidence, improving diverse base models on MultiView-Bench even under a strict budget-matched comparison (and by 3-5x for the full agent).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultiView-Bench是一个专门用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）多视角整合能力（从不同视角形成以世界为中心的3D心智模型）的诊断基准。现有基准主要测试单视图或有限视图感知，而MultiView-Bench要求模型将物体位置与视角解耦，并在固定全局坐标系中进行理解。对前沿VLM的系统评估显示，它们在2D平面关系上表现良好，但在3D空间关系和跨视图信息聚合上存在显著困难，并且存在对非常规轴方向、颜色和纹理的偏差。
Motivation: 现有VLM基准主要评估单一或有限视角的感知能力，缺乏对模型整合多视角信息形成连贯3D心智模型这一核心认知能力的测试，而这种能力对于机械零件组装等下游任务至关重要。
Method: 提出了MultiView-Bench诊断基准，专门设计用于评估多视角整合进行整体3D场景理解。此外，提出了ViewNavigator，一个多智能体框架，主动选择信息丰富的视角、感知并融合多视图证据，以提升基础模型在MultiView-Bench上的表现。
Result: 对前沿VLM的系统评估揭示了一致的失败模式：在单张图像的2D平面关系上表现良好，但在3D空间关系和跨视图信息聚合上表现困难，并存在对非常规轴方向、颜色和纹理的偏差。ViewNavigator在严格的预算匹配比较下提升了多种基础模型在MultiView-Bench上的性能，在全智能体设置下提升3-5倍。
Conclusion: 论文强调了多视角整合能力是VLM的关键瓶颈，提出的基准和框架有助于诊断和改善这一能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading
papers.abstract_en: AI agents have become capable of autonomously completing short, well-specified tasks. However, existing terminal benchmarks largely focus on simple problems that finish within minutes and are evaluated only by their final outcome. This setup overlooks intermediate progress and partial solutions, yielding sparse reward signals and an incomplete picture of agent capability. We introduce Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench, a terminal benchmark of 46 long-horizon tasks spanning nine categories, including experiment reproduction, software engineering, multimodal analysis, interactive games, and scientific computing. Each task follows a Terminal-Bench-style setup with a reference solution or simulation engine, but is further decomposed into fine-grained graded subtasks. This design enables dense intermediate rewards and partial credit, allowing evaluation to capture not only whether an agent reaches the final goal, but also how far it progresses on open-ended workflows. Tasks in Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench typically require hundreds of episodes and minutes to hours of execution, stressing long-horizon planning, long-context management, and iterative debugging rather than one-shot problem solving. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find that agents consume on average 9.9M tokens per task, with roughly 231 episodes and 85.3 minutes of execution time per run, making Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench more demanding than prior terminal-based benchmarks. Even the strongest tested model achieves 15.2% pass@1 at a partial-reward threshold of 0.95 and 10.9% at a perfect-reward threshold of 1.0, while the mean pass rate across models is 4.3% and 1.7% under the two thresholds, respectively. These results reveal headroom for improvement. We further analyze failure modes and error patterns, and release Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench to support future progress on long-horizon terminal agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench，一个包含46个长时程终端任务的基准，涵盖实验复现、软件工程、多模态分析、交互游戏和科学计算等九大类别。每个任务被分解为细粒度子任务，提供密集的中间奖励和部分学分，以评估代理在长时间序列下的进展。评估15个前沿模型发现，最强模型在部分奖励阈值0.95下pass@1仅为15.2%，完全奖励阈值1.0下为10.9%，平均通过率分别为4.3%和1.7%，表明大量改进空间。
Motivation: 现有终端基准大多关注短时简单任务，仅根据最终结果评估，忽视中间进展和部分解，无法全面反映代理能力。
Method: 设计一个包含46个长时程任务的基准，每个任务采用Terminal-Bench风格设置，并分解为细粒度评分子任务，实现密集中间奖励和部分学分机制。
Result: 15个前沿模型平均每任务消耗900万token、约231个回合和85.3分钟执行时间。最强模型在部分奖励阈值0.95下pass@1为15.2%，完全奖励阈值1.0下为10.9%；所有模型平均通过率分别为4.3%和1.7%。
Conclusion: 现有代理在长时程终端任务上表现有限，该基准揭示了显著改进空间，并发布以支持未来研究。
