papers.title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models via Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Despite the success of knowledge distillation (KD) in Large Language Models (LLMs), the underlying mechanism behind its efficacy remains unclear. In this paper, we propose a unified approach to explore the common mechanism of various KD methods using interactions. Specifically, we decompose the output score of the LLM into the sum of numerous interactions. Each interaction represents a nonlinear relationship involving a set of input variables (e.g., words). Based on the decomposed interactions, we discover that the common mechanism underlying various KD methods is the sparsification of interactions, i.e., student models retain fewer interactions for inference while suppressing other interactions to zero effects. Furthermore, we discover that the performance variance across different KD methods arises from their capabilities in handling complex interactions. A KD method typically yields better performance if it enables the student model to achieve higher sparsity of complex interactions. Motivated by these insights, we propose a plug-and-play loss function called Complex Interaction Penalty (CIP) to explicitly enforce the sparsity of complex interactions during the distillation process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that integrating CIP consistently improves the performance of diverse KD methods on both in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一框架，通过将LLM的输出分数分解为多个交互（interactions）来理解知识蒸馏（KD）的共同机制。研究发现，不同KD方法的共同本质是交互稀疏化：学生模型保留少量交互用于推理，其余交互被抑制为零。不同KD方法的性能差异源于处理复杂交互的能力，能够实现更高复杂交互稀疏性的方法通常表现更好。基于此提出即插即用的损失函数CIP（Complex Interaction Penalty），显式强制蒸馏过程中复杂交互的稀疏性，实验表明在域内和分布外基准上一致提升多种KD方法的性能。
Motivation: 知识蒸馏在LLM中应用广泛但其有效性的底层机制尚不明确，缺乏统一的解释框架。
Method: 将LLM的输出分数分解为大量基于输入变量（如单词）的交互，每个交互表示一组变量的非线性关系。通过分析交互的稀疏性揭示KD的共同机制，并基于此设计CIP损失函数，在蒸馏过程中显式惩罚复杂交互，促进稀疏化。
Result: 实验表明，CIP损失能够一致提升多种知识蒸馏方法在域内和分布外基准上的性能。
Conclusion: 知识蒸馏的核心机制是交互稀疏化，且不同方法的性能差异取决于其处理复杂交互的能力；CIP作为一种改进手段可有效提升蒸馏效果。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: HALO: Hybrid Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We study how to improve a frozen pretrained language model with a small amount of adaptive extra computation. A simple approach is to add additional refinement steps on top of the backbone hidden states, but fixed extra refinement can be wasteful: a one-step refinement head may be too weak, while forcing a second full-sequence refinement step everywhere can increase compute without improving transfer. We introduce HALO, a hybrid adaptive latent-refinement method that combines a coarse refinement stage with selective second-stage latent refinement on a subset of tokens chosen by token scoring and monotonic token halting. On the main public benchmark comparison built from MMLU-Pro and GPQA-Diamond, HALO achieves the best overall average among the paper-facing methods, outperforming the frozen backbone, fixed-1, and fixed-2. Internal analysis further shows that HALO reaches nearly the same token-accuracy level as fixed-2 while using fewer average applied refine steps than fixed-1 and far fewer than fixed-2. These results suggest that the key advantage is not simply more refinement, but a better allocation of refinement: HALO achieves the strongest paper-facing result while also using less measured controller compute than either fixed baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HALO，一种混合自适应潜在推理方法，用于在冻结的预训练语言模型上添加少量自适应额外计算。该方法结合粗粒度推理阶段和基于令牌评分与单调令牌停止的选择性细粒度推理，在MMLU-Pro和GPQA-Diamond基准上取得最佳平均结果，相比固定一步或两步推理更高效。
Motivation: 固定额外推理步骤要么不足（一步）要么浪费计算（两步），需要一种自适应分配计算量的方法以提高效率。
Method: HALO包含两个阶段：第一阶段进行粗粒度推理，第二阶段根据令牌评分和单调停止机制选择部分令牌进行细粒度潜在推理，从而自适应地分配计算资源。
Result: 在MMLU-Pro和GPQA-Diamond基准上，HALO的平均性能优于冻结主干、固定一步和固定两步推理，且使用的平均推理步数少于固定一步，远少于固定两步。
Conclusion: HALO表明，关键在于更好地分配推理计算量而非单纯增加步数，在保持高性能的同时降低计算开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CogniConsole: Externalizing Inference-Time Control as a Formal Abstraction for Reliable LLM Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Reliability in large language model (LLM) systems is typically framed as a function of model capability. We challenge this by demonstrating that reliability is significantly influenced by \emph{inference-time control} -- the computational layer governing task framing and context selection. We introduce \emph{CogniConsole}, an architectural instantiation that externalizes this control into a structured interface combining programmatic coordination with bounded prompt-based reasoning. Through \emph{controllability-oriented probes} ($N=489$) in a multi-step interactive environment, we show that increasing structural scaffolding -- from unstructured to fully scaffolded -- \textbf{systematically reduces output variance and failure rates under a fixed model architecture}. Our results indicate that many observed failure modes, such as context drift and inconsistent constraint adherence, arise from under-specified control rather than insufficient capability. This work provides an empirical basis for treating inference-time control as a first-class abstraction, opening new directions for designing and evaluating LLM systems beyond scaling alone.
papers.comment: Revised version focusing on the CogniConsole system architecture and empirical evaluation of inference-time control probes (N=489)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文质疑大语言模型（LLM）的可靠性仅取决于模型能力，提出推理时控制（inference-time control）是关键因素。作者设计CogniConsole架构，将控制外化为结构化接口，结合程序化协调与受限的提示推理。通过在多步交互环境中进行489次可控性探测，发现增加结构脚手架（从无结构到全结构化）能系统性地降低输出方差和失败率，表明许多失败模式源于控制不足而非能力不足。
Motivation: 主流观点认为LLM可靠性主要依赖模型规模与训练数据，论文指出推理时控制（如任务框架和上下文选择）同样重要，但未被充分研究。
Method: 提出CogniConsole架构，将推理时控制外化为结构化接口，包含程序化协调与基于提示的受限推理；通过可控性探测（controllability-oriented probes）在固定模型下比较不同脚手架级别的效果。
Result: 在489次多步交互实验中，从无结构到全结构化脚手架，输出方差和失败率系统性降低；上下文漂移和不一致约束违背等失败模式主要源于控制不足。
Conclusion: 应把推理时控制视为一等抽象，为设计评估LLM系统开辟新方向，超越单纯缩放模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interval Certifications for Multilayered Perceptrons via Lattice Traversal
papers.abstract_en: In this work we present a rigorous theoretical framework to a foundational problem of AI safety, namely adversarial robustness. In particular, we show that the adversarial robustness problem can be reduced to a lattice traversal problem. Each element of this lattice corresponds to an interval, i.e., an axis-aligned hyper-rectangle, containing an input point $\mathbf{x}$. Consider a multilayered perceptron classifier (MLP). An interval $I$ constitutes a sound certification if $\mathbf{x} \in I$ and $\mathbf{x}$ can be freely perturbed in $I$ without changing the MLP's prediction. Complementarily, an interval $I$ constitutes a complete certification if $\mathbf{x} \in I$ and when $\mathbf{x}$ moves outside of $I$ the MLP's prediction is guaranteed to change. While the sound certification problem corresponds to the well-studied adversarial robustness, complete certifications have not been examined in the literature. We develop lattice traversal operators, which we apply in a refine & verify iterative scheme. Using formal MLP verifiers, sound maximality and complete minimality are guaranteed. Moreover, we examine objective optimization problems. There we discover some interesting asymmetries. For complete certifications, the minimum solution is obtained in polynomial oracle calls. This does not hold for sound certifications, where we prove strong intractability results. Additionally, we examine optimization problems in symmetric intervals (i.e., $\ell_\infty$-spheres), where we provide logarithmic algorithms. Finally, we present an empirical evaluation, using the novel ParallelepipedoNN system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将多层感知器（MLP）的对抗鲁棒性问题归约为格遍历问题，定义了两类区间认证：sound certification（保证区间内预测不变）和complete certification（保证区间外预测改变）。通过开发格遍历算子并采用 refine & verify 迭代方案，利用形式化验证器实现完全性保证。理论分析揭示了不对称性：完全认证的最小解可在多项式时间内获得，而 sound 认证被证明是强难解的；对称区间（ℓ∞-球）上则给出了对数算法。实验基于新系统 ParallelepipedoNN 进行。
Motivation: 对抗鲁棒性是AI安全的基础问题，但现有工作主要关注 sound certification（标准对抗鲁棒性），而 complete certification 尚未被系统研究。本文旨在建立统一的理论框架，阐明两类认证的本质区别及其计算复杂性。
Method: 将对抗鲁棒性归约为格遍历问题，每个格元素对应一个轴对齐超矩形区间。开发格遍历算子，应用于 refine & verify 迭代方案，借助形式化 MLP 验证器确保 sound 最大性和 complete 最小性。进一步研究对称区间上的优化问题。
Result: 理论发现：complete certification 的最小解可在多项式次 oracle 调用内获得；sound certification 则被证明是强难解的。对称区间上给出对数时间算法。实验部分使用 ParallelepipedoNN 系统进行了经验评估。
Conclusion: 本文在理论上建立了 MLP 区间认证的格遍历框架，揭示了 sound 与 complete 认证之间的计算不对称性，为对抗鲁棒性的形式化验证提供了新工具和理论边界。
Relevance: 0
